Therefore, our project aims to use single modality based on thermal infrared domain, by removing the reliance on visible light as much as possible. This single modality can be expected to be faster as it does not rely on multimodal data. We propose a method, Thermal-to-Depth Gaussian Splatting (TDg), that uses only thermal images and depth estimation in its architecture to derive the radiance fields. Our TDg method outperforms the MSMG (Multiple Single-Modal Gaussians) baseline in most cases on our test datasets, RGBT-Scenes and ThermalMix. On average, the rendering quality metrics such as learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS), structural similarity index measure (SSIM), and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of TDg are 1.12%, 0.034%, and 0.01% better than the baseline MSMG values. It also reduces the training time significantly, by 12 mins 47 secs (55% improvement). Overall, our method is successful in deriving these thermal radiance fields, which can ultimately have several applications, such as identifying heat sources critical in surveillance, search or rescue operations, and industrial inspections where temperature is widely used to monitor machines.

</details>


### [129] [Colored Noise Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30332)
*Hadar Davidson,Noam Issachar,Sagie Benaim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Colored Noise Sampling (CNS)，一种无需训练的随机求解器，通过动态、时步和频率相关的噪声注入策略，利用扩散模型的频谱偏差特性（先解决低频全局结构，后处理高频细节），在多个架构（SiT、JiT、FLUX）上显著优于标准ODE/SDE采样器，实现了FID的大幅下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SDE求解器未能考虑扩散模型生成轨迹中的频谱偏差（低频结构先于高频细节收敛），在整个过程中注入均匀白噪声，导致能量预算的无效使用。

Method: 建立频率解耦能量传递的数学框架，重新审视SDE推理过程；提出Colored Noise Sampling (CNS)，一种无需训练的动态、时步和频率相关的噪声调度策略，将注入能量高效分配至结构上尚未解析的频率波段。

Result: 在ImageNet-256上，无引导FID显著降低：SiT-XL/2从8.26降至6.27，JiT-B/16从32.39降至26.69，JiT-H/16从11.88降至8.31；在Classifier-Free Guidance下也取得一致的相对FID改进。

Conclusion: CNS作为即插即用的推理时采样替代方案，通过主动利用模型固有的频谱偏差，系统地引导生成分布朝向真实数据流形，在多种架构和设置下均显著优于标准基线。

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art image synthesis, with their generative trajectories fundamentally exhibiting a spectral bias, resolving low-frequency global structures early and high-frequency fine details later. Conventional stochastic differential equation (SDE) solvers fail to account for this dynamic, naively injecting uniform white noise throughout the entire process and misusing the finite energy budget. In this work, we establish a mathematical framework that reconsiders SDE inference as a targeted, frequency-decoupled energy transfer. Leveraging this framework, we introduce Colored Noise Sampling (CNS), a novel, training-free stochastic solver. Rather than injecting uniform white noise, CNS utilizes a dynamic, timestep- and frequency-dependent schedule that more efficiently allocates injected energy toward structurally unresolved frequency bands. By actively exploiting the model's inherent spectral bias, CNS systematically steers the generated distribution toward the true data manifold. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CNS significantly outperforms standard ODE and SDE baselines as a strictly plug-and-play, inference-time sampler substitution across diverse architectures (SiT, JiT, FLUX). Compared to standard sampling on ImageNet-256, CNS achieves substantial unguided FID reductions, improving from 8.26 to 6.27 on SiT-XL/2, 32.39 to 26.69 on JiT-B/16, and 11.88 to 8.31 on JiT-H/16, while yielding consistent relative FID improvements with Classifier-Free Guidance. Project page is available at https://hadardavidson.github.io/CNS/.

</details>


### [130] [REST3D: Reconstructing Physically Stable 3D Scenes from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30338)
*Xiaoxuan Ma,Jiashun Wang,Nicolas Ugrinovic,Yehonathan Litman,Kris Kitani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REST3D是一个能从单张RGB图像重建物理稳定3D场景的框架，通过智能物理场景理解构建场景树表示，并结合物理约束优化来解决物体漂浮、穿透等问题，显著提升物理模拟稳定性，同时保持与输入图像的视觉一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图像重建方法虽能生成几何上合理的3D场景，但缺乏对物理结构的理解，常产生物体漂浮、穿透等物理不一致结果，导致物理模拟不稳定。图像条件场景生成方法虽改进了物理合理性，但依赖强场景先验，生成的物体排列不准确，无法匹配输入图像。

Method: 提出REST3D框架，包含：(1) 智能物理场景理解技术，从重力-支撑视角构建场景树表示，捕捉物体物理状态和物体间关系；(2) 利用场景树初始化场景（使用图像到3D模型），进行场景树引导的对齐和物理约束优化，在消除物理违规的同时保持与输入图像的视觉一致性。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，REST3D显著减少了物理错误，提高了模拟稳定性，同时保持高质量重建效果。并在VR人机交互中展示了重建场景的潜力。

Conclusion: REST3D通过将物理场景理解与物理约束优化相结合，成功实现了从单张图像到物理稳定3D场景的重建，为沉浸式交互和内容创作提供了可靠的数字资产生成方案。

Abstract: Reconstructing physically stable 3D scenes from a single RGB image enables casual images to be converted into simulation-ready digital assets for applications such as immersive interaction and content creation. However, existing single-image reconstruction methods fall short in capturing the physical structure of a scene. As a result, they often produce geometrically plausible but physically inconsistent results, including object floating and penetration, which lead to unstable behavior in physics simulations. Image-conditioned scene generation methods improve physical plausibility but often rely on strong scene priors, yielding plausible yet inaccurate object arrangements that fail to match the input image. We propose REST3D, a single-image reconstruction framework that can reconstruct physically stable 3D scenes by integrating physical scene understanding with physics-constrained refinement. We first introduce an agentic physical scene understanding technique that constructs a scene-tree representation capturing object physical states and inter-object relationships from a gravity-support perspective, providing a structural prior for reconstruction. Leveraging this structure, we initialize the scene using image-to-3D models, followed by scene-tree-guided alignment and physics-constrained optimization to resolve physical violations while preserving visual consistency with the input image. Experiments show that our method significantly reduces physical errors and improves simulation stability on both synthetic and real-world datasets while maintaining strong reconstruction quality. We further demonstrate the reconstructed scenes in VR-based human-object interaction, showing their potential for immersive applications.

</details>


### [131] [Benchmarking Single-Factor Physical Video-to-Audio Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30339)
*Tingle Li,Siddharth Gururani,Kevin J. Shih,Gantavya Bhatt,Sang-gil Lee,Zhifeng Kong,Arushi Goel,Gopala Anumanchipalli,Ming-Yu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlatSounds是一个评估生成式视频-to-音频（V2A）模型物理推理能力的基准测试，通过受控反事实对和单视频模式测试，发现现有模型在物理准确性上存在权衡：依赖文本描述提升物理和语义准确性，但会降低时间对齐质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有V2A模型评估侧重于感知真实性，忽视了在受控干预下的物理正确性，缺乏对模型是否真正捕获底层物理过程的审计。

Method: 构建FlatSounds基准，包含两类测试：（1）受控反事实对——单一物理因素被改变；（2）单视频模式测试——探测内部一致性和方向趋势。通过物理属性与时间的准确性来评估模型。

Result: 最新V2A模型呈现一致权衡：依赖文本描述（而非视觉流）推断物理和语义；文本描述提升物理与语义准确性，但反而降低时间对齐精度；基于物理的指标与人类偏好测试高度相关。

Conclusion: 需要推动V2A模型超越音频质量导向，转向直接从像素学习物理过程。

Abstract: Generative video-to-audio (V2A) models produce highly plausible soundtracks, but it remains unclear whether they capture the underlying physical processes. Existing evaluations emphasize perceptual realism and overlook physical correctness under controlled interventions. In this paper, we introduce FlatSounds, a benchmark that audits the physical reasoning of V2A models through: 1) controlled counterfactual pairs in which a single physical factor is varied, and 2) single-video pattern tests that probe internal consistency and directional trends. These settings test whether the generated audio correctly reflects specific physical properties and timings. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals a consistent trade-off: models rely more on text captions than the visual stream to infer physics and semantics. Captions generally improve physical and semantic accuracy, but paradoxically degrade temporal alignment. Our results highlight the need to move beyond audio quality toward learning physical processes directly from pixels. Finally, we find that our physics-based metrics correlate strongly with human preference tests on our own data. Project webpage: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/flatsounds/

</details>


### [132] [GPIC: A Giant Permissive Image Corpus for Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30341)
*Keshigeyan Chandrasegaran,Kyle Sargent,Suchir Agarwal,Michael Jang,Michael Poli,Juan Carlos Niebles,Justin Johnson,Jiajun Wu,Li Fei-Fei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GPIC是一个约28万亿像素的大型许可图像数据集，包含1亿训练样本、20万验证样本和100万测试样本，所有图像均允许研究和商业使用，并提供了基准测试协议和参考基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉生成建模的可扩展方法需要大型、可访问且稳定的数据集，现有数据集在规模、许可和可用性方面存在不足。

Method: 收集互联网图像，使用最先进的视觉-语言模型进行标注，经过安全过滤和去重处理，托管在Hugging Face上，并提供像素空间流匹配的参考基线。

Result: 构建了约28万亿像素的GPIC数据集，包含1亿训练样本、20万验证样本和100万测试样本，所有图像均获得许可。

Conclusion: GPIC为视觉生成建模研究提供了大规模、许可开放、稳定的数据集和基准，有助于推动该领域的发展。

Abstract: Studying scalable methods for visual generative modeling requires large, accessible, and stable datasets. We introduce GPIC, a Giant Permissive Image Corpus of approximately 28 trillion pixels. GPIC comprises diverse internet images captioned by a state-of-the-art vision-language model, including 100M training, 200K validation, and 1M test examples. Moreover, all GPIC images are permissively licensed for both research and commercial use. GPIC is safety-filtered, deduplicated, and centrally hosted on Hugging Face. We provide a benchmarking protocol for generative modeling on GPIC. Finally, we provide a reference baseline for pixel-space flow matching on GPIC. Our dataset, benchmark, and models are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/stanford-vision-lab/gpic. Evaluation toolkit and code are available at https://gpic.stanford.edu

</details>


### [133] [YoCausal: How Far is Video Generation from World Model? A Causality Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30346)
*You-Zhe Xie,Yu-Hsuan Li,Jie-Ying Lee,Kaipeng Zhang,Yu-Lun Liu,Zhixiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: YoCausal是一个受认知科学启发、基于时序反转构建的两层基准，用于评估视频扩散模型是否真正理解因果关系。实验表明，理解时间箭头不等于理解因果关系，现有模型与人类因果认知仍有显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准大多依赖合成数据，存在sim-to-real差距，难以评估视频扩散模型在真实世界中是否真正理解因果关系而非过拟合统计时间模式。

Method: 基于Violation of Expectation范式，通过零成本时序反转真实视频生成自然反事实样本。Level 1用Reverse Surprise Index（RSI）量化时间箭头感知；Level 2用Causality Cognition Index（CCI）结合VLM将数据集分层为因果与非因果子集，分离真实因果推理与时间偏差。

Result: 评估13个SOTA视频扩散模型发现：感知时间箭头不等于理解因果关系，模型与人类因果认知水平存在显著差距。

Conclusion: YoCausal揭示了当前VDMs在因果推理上的根本局限，强调了超越时间统计模式、迈向真正世界模型所面临的挑战。

Abstract: As video diffusion models (VDMs) advance toward world models, a key question arises: do they truly understand causality, or merely overfit to statistical temporal patterns? Existing benchmarks mostly rely on synthetic data, limiting real-world generalization due to the sim-to-real gap. We present YoCausal, a two-level benchmark inspired by the Violation of Expectation (VoE) paradigm from cognitive science. By temporally reversing real-world videos at zero cost as natural counterfactual samples, YoCausal establishes an arbitrarily extensible evaluation protocol. Level 1 introduces the Reverse Surprise Index (RSI), quantifying arrow-of-time perception via denoising loss. Level 2 introduces the Causality Cognition Index (CCI), which leverages a VLM to stratify datasets into causal and non-causal subsets, disentangling genuine causal reasoning from temporal bias. Evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art VDMs reveals that perceiving the arrow of time does not imply understanding causality, and a significant gap persists relative to human-level causal cognition.

</details>


### [134] [NeuROK: Generative 4D Neural Object Kinematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30347)
*Chen Geng,Guangzhao He,Yue Gao,Yunzhi Zhang,Shangzhe Wu,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuROK（神经对象运动学），一种数据驱动的运动学状态参数化方法，通过学习潜在空间和生成变形形状的解码器，将静态3D对象的物理动态生成简化为低维潜在空间中的动力学问题，在大规模4D数据集上训练并以Transformer为基础架构，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成4D动态的方法依赖预定义物理模型和系统辨识，局限于特定类别和小规模数据集。作者希望克服这些限制，提出一种数据驱动、通用的动态对象生成框架。

Method: 学习一个潜在空间（表示对象所有可能状态）和一个解码器（将潜在向量映射为形变后的3D形状）。利用Transformer编码器-解码器架构在大规模4D数据集上训练。从拉格朗日力学视角，将动态生成简化为低维潜在空间中的动力学问题。

Result: 该方法在多种动态对象类型上展现了有效性和泛化性，相比前人方法具有显著优势。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的运动学状态参数化可以有效克服传统物理模型方法的局限性，为构建全面的3D世界模型中的4D动态生成提供了通用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Data-driven approaches have revolutionized 3D vision, enabling transformers to effectively reconstruct and generate static 3D objects. However, generating simulative 4D dynamics -- realistic temporal deformations of static objects under various physical conditions -- remains challenging and often ad hoc, despite its importance in building comprehensive 3D world models. Most existing methods assume a predefined physical model and use system identification to estimate parameters, restricting these methods to specific categories and small-scale datasets. We propose that these restrictions can be overcome by learning a data-driven kinematic state parameterization for object-centric physical systems. Specifically, we learn both a latent space representing all possible states of the object and a decoder that maps any sampled latent to a plausibly deformed shape of the object. We refer to this parameterization as Neural Object Kinematics (NeuROK), and learn a transformer-based encoder-decoder model on a curated large-scale 4D dataset. This formulation and the learned model significantly simplify the generation of simulative dynamics since we only need to consider the dynamics within a low-dimensional latent space from the Lagrangian mechanics' perspective in classical physics. We demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of this neural simulation framework across diverse dynamic object types, showing clear advantages over prior works. Project page: https://chen-geng.com/neurok

</details>


### [135] [AdaState: Self-Evolving Anchors for Streaming Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30349)
*Yusuf Dalva,Pinar Yanardag*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 自回归视频扩散模型因首帧锚点机制导致视频动态受限，本文提出用自适应隐状态替代静态首帧锚点，使模型在去噪过程中动态生成场景参考，从而实现更丰富的运动和自然场景演进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型在注意力缓存中对首帧赋予特权位置作为场景锚点，该锚点因最干净无误差而吸引过多注意力，抑制了视频动态、相机运动和场景演进，导致生成视频在时间维度上浅层化、静态化。

Method: 用自适应隐状态（adaptive state）替代静态首帧锚点，该状态作为隐藏潜变量在每个块中与内容一同去噪但永不渲染；模型在每一步通过同时关注前一状态和当前内容来生成场景锚点，使参考随生成内容演进。同时将时间视为相对的而非绝对的，每步生成共享相同的位置结构，状态转移在各块间保持一致，从而在去噪过程中引入循环性，去噪充当转移函数、KV缓存充当载体。

Result: 实验表明自适应状态显著改善了视频动态，生成视频中运动更丰富、场景演进更自然。

Conclusion: 通过将静态首帧锚点替换为动态演进的自适应隐状态，有效缓解了首帧锚点导致的注意力偏置问题，提升了视频生成的时间动态性，且无需额外外部模块。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate streaming video by producing frames sequentially, conditioning each chunk on previously generated content. These models are structurally anchored to the first frame: its key-value representation occupies a privileged position in the attention cache and serves as the primary scene reference throughout generation. As the cleanest and most error-free position in the cache, this anchor draws disproportionate attention, suppressing video dynamics, and locking scene composition to the initial viewpoint even as the scene naturally evolves. The result is a temporally shallow video in which motion, camera movement, and scene progression are dampened in favor of static consistency. To address this, we replace the static anchor with an adaptive state, a hidden latent that the model denoises alongside content at every chunk but never renders. Rather than referencing a frozen first frame, the model generates its own scene anchor at each step by attending to both the previous state and the current content, producing a reference that evolves with the generated content. Unlike standard video generation, which encodes an absolute notion of time, our formulation treats time as relative: every generation step sees the same positional structure regardless of how far generation has progressed, and the state transition is identical at every chunk. Together, these properties introduce a recurrence into the generation process, where denoising serves as the transition function, and the KV cache serves as the carrier, requiring no external module. Experiments demonstrate that the adaptive state substantially improves video dynamics, enabling richer motion and natural scene progression within generated videos.

</details>


### [136] [VideoMLA: Low-Rank Latent KV Cache for Minute-Scale Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30351)
*Hidir Yesiltepe,Jiazhen Hu,Tuna Han Salih Meral,Adil Kaan Akan,Kaan Oktay,Hoda Eldardiry,Pinar Yanardag*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次在视频扩散模型中应用多头潜在注意力（MLA），用共享低秩内容潜变量和分离的3D-RoPE位置键替代每头键值，在每层缓存中将每token KV内存降低92.7%，在长视频生成中达到最佳综合分数，吞吐量提升1.23倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频扩散模型固定使用滑动窗口KV缓存，但每头的KV缓存布局本身是流式内存和延迟的主要贡献者，却鲜有改进。作者试图通过MLA解决这一问题。

Method: 将MLA引入视频扩散，用共享低秩内容潜变量和分离的3D-RoPE位置键替代每头KV；分析了MLA在视频扩散中成功的原因——MLA瓶颈决定了有效秩而非预训练谱，即使随机初始化也占据几乎满秩预算。

Result: 每层每token KV内存降低92.7%；在短视野基线中持平，长视野中取得最佳综合分数；在单B200上吞吐量提升1.23倍。

Conclusion: MLA在视频扩散中有效，其瓶颈决定有效秩而非预训练谱，可作为高效长视频扩散的实用方案。

Abstract: Long-rollout causal video diffusion has converged on a fixed-size sliding-window KV cache, with recent progress innovating within this layout by changing which tokens occupy the window or how their positions are encoded. The per-head KV layout itself, a dominant contributor to streaming memory and latency, has been mostly left unchanged. In this paper, we present the first study of Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) in video diffusion. VideoMLA replaces per-head keys and values with a shared low-rank content latent and a shared decoupled 3D-RoPE positional key, reducing per-token KV memory by 92.7% at every cached layer. We further investigate why MLA succeeds in video diffusion even though the spectral assumption often used to motivate it in language models does not hold: pretrained video attention is not low-rank, with 99%-energy effective rank far above any practical latent dimension. VideoMLA retains quality at compression ratios where direct spectral approximation would predict large reconstruction error. We show that the MLA bottleneck, rather than the pretrained spectrum, determines the effective rank: both spectral and random initialization occupy nearly the full rank budget from initialization, and training preserves this budget while adapting within it. On VBench, VideoMLA matches short-horizon streaming video diffusion baselines, achieves the best overall score at long horizons among evaluated methods, and improves throughput by 1.23x on a single B200.

</details>


### [137] [GMOS: Grounding Moving Object Segmentation in 3D Space and Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30352)
*Junyu Xie,Tengda Han,Weidi Xie,Andrew Zisserman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GMOS框架，将运动物体分割从2D序列级提升到3D空间与瞬时时间粒度，通过RGB视频直接输出3D感知的多运动物体分割，并构建GMOS-2K数据集和MOS-I评估协议，在多个基准上达到SOTA且推理速度更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MOS方法依赖预计算的2D辅助模态（光流、点轨迹），缺乏3D几何信息；且将运动视为序列级属性，忽略了每个物体的瞬时运动状态。

Method: 提出GMOS框架，直接在RGB视频上操作，输出3D感知、时间细粒度的多运动物体分割；同时提出轻量变体GMOS-S用于快速部署；构建GMOS-2K数据集（2210个真实视频）并设计MOS-I瞬时评估协议及三个互补指标。

Result: 在MOS、MOS-I和无监督VOS基准上达到SOTA，运行速度显著快于先前的多物体MOS方法，支持在线推理和流式部署。

Conclusion: 将MOS问题重新定位于3D空间和瞬时时间维度是有效的，GMOS在精度和效率上均取得显著提升。

Abstract: Moving Object Segmentation (MOS) aims to discover, segment, and track objects that move independently of the camera. Current MOS methods, however, exhibit two fundamental limitations: they rely on pre-computed 2D auxiliary modalities such as optical flow or point trajectories that lack 3D geometric information, and they treat motion as a sequence-level attribute, overlooking the instantaneous motion state of each object. We address both by grounding MOS in 3D space and time, and propose GMOS, a framework that operates directly on RGB video to produce 3D-aware, temporally fine-grained segmentation of multiple moving objects, alongside a foreground--background variant GMOS-S for faster deployment. To support training and evaluation in this regime, we curate GMOS-2K, a dataset of 2,210 real-world videos with per-object temporal motion annotations drawn from five established Video Object Segmentation (VOS) benchmarks, and formalise MOS-I ("I" for instantaneous), a temporally fine-grained evaluation protocol with three complementary metrics. GMOS achieves state-of-the-art results across MOS, MOS-I, and Unsupervised VOS benchmarks, while running significantly faster than prior multi-object MOS methods and supporting online inference for streaming deployment.

</details>


### [138] [Gaga: Group Any Gaussians via 3D-aware Memory Bank](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.07977)
*Weijie Lyu,Xueting Li,Abhijit Kundu,Yi-Hsuan Tsai,Ming-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Gaga是一个3D场景重建与分割框架，利用不一致的2D零样本分割掩码，通过3D感知记忆库实现跨视角的掩码关联，无需连续视角假设，对稀疏采样图像鲁棒，性能优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D场景分割方法依赖视频目标跟踪或对比学习，需要连续视角假设，对视角变化和稀疏采样不鲁棒。Gaga旨在利用空间信息直接关联不同相机视角下的物体掩码，消除连续视角限制。

Method: 提出3D感知记忆库（3D-aware memory bank）来关联跨视角的2D分割掩码；利用空间信息而非时序或对比学习进行掩码关联；支持来自不同来源的2D分割掩码。

Result: 在定性和定量评估中，Gaga均优于现有最先进方法，对相机视角变化和稀疏采样图像表现出鲁棒性，兼容多种零样本分割模型。

Conclusion: Gaga是一个高效且通用的开放世界3D场景分割框架，适用于3D场景理解与操控等实际应用。

Abstract: We introduce Gaga, a framework that reconstructs and segments open-world 3D scenes by leveraging inconsistent 2D masks predicted by zero-shot class-agnostic segmentation models. Contrasted to prior 3D scene segmentation approaches that rely on video object tracking or contrastive learning methods, Gaga utilizes spatial information and effectively associates object masks across diverse camera poses through a novel 3D-aware memory bank. By eliminating the assumption of continuous view changes in training images, Gaga demonstrates robustness to variations in camera poses, particularly beneficial for sparsely sampled images, ensuring precise mask label consistency. Furthermore, Gaga accommodates 2D segmentation masks from diverse sources and demonstrates robust performance with different open-world zero-shot class-agnostic segmentation models, significantly enhancing its versatility. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate that Gaga performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods, emphasizing its potential for real-world applications such as 3D scene understanding and manipulation.

</details>


### [139] [Looking Beyond Text: Reducing Language bias in Large Vision-Language Models via Multimodal Dual-Attention and Soft-Image Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.14279)
*Haozhe Zhao,Shuzheng Si,Liang Chen,Yichi Zhang,Maosong Sun,Mingjia Zhang,Baobao Chang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LACING框架通过多模态双注意力机制（MDA）和软图像引导（IFG）来解决大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）中由语言偏差引起的幻觉问题，无需额外训练资源或数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM在视觉-语言任务中表现优异，但存在因语言偏差导致的幻觉问题，即模型过度依赖文本信息而忽略视觉输入。作者识别出两个主要原因：1）LLM预训练阶段与多模态对齐阶段的训练数据规模不同；2）文本数据的短期依赖导致的学习推理偏差。

Method: 提出LACING框架，包含两个核心组件：1）多模态双注意力机制（MDA），引入并行双注意力机制以增强视觉输入在整个模型中的整合；2）软图像引导（IFG），在训练和推理阶段引入可学习的软视觉提示来替代视觉输入，迫使模型优先处理文本输入，并提出一种新的解码策略来缓解模型对相邻文本输入的过度依赖。

Result: 综合实验表明，该方法能有效消除LVLM的语言偏差，增强视觉理解能力并减少幻觉，且无需额外的训练资源或数据。

Conclusion: LACING提供了一种系统性的解决方案，通过去偏策略显著提升了LVLM的视觉关注度，为缓解多模态模型中的语言偏差问题提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved impressive results in various vision-language tasks. However, despite showing promising performance, LVLMs suffer from hallucinations caused by language bias, leading to diminished focus on images and ineffective visual comprehension. We identify two primary reasons for this bias: 1. Different scales of training data between the pretraining stage of LLM and multimodal alignment stage. 2. The learned inference bias due to short-term dependency of text data. Therefore, we propose LACING, a systemic framework designed to address the language bias of LVLMs with muLtimodal duAl-attention meChanIsm (MDA) aNd soft-image Guidance (IFG). Specifically, MDA introduces a parallel dual-attention mechanism that enhances the integration of visual inputs across the model. IFG introduces a learnable soft visual prompt during training and inference to replace visual inputs, designed to compel LVLMs to prioritize text inputs. Then, IFG further proposes a novel decoding strategy using the soft visual prompt to mitigate the model's over-reliance on adjacent text inputs. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method effectively debiases LVLMs from their language bias, enhancing visual comprehension and reducing hallucinations without requiring additional training resources or data. The code and model are available at [lacing-lvlm.github.io](https://lacing-lvlm.github.io).

</details>


### [140] [Soften the Mask: Adaptive Temporal Soft Mask for Efficient Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.21004)
*Meng-zhu Li,Quanxing Zha,Hongjun Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaTosk，一种监督时序软掩码自编码器网络，通过并行结合自监督重建分支（随机硬掩码）和监督分类分支（自适应时序软掩码），有效减少动态面部表情识别中的背景噪声和语义冗余，在保持竞争性能的同时显著降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态面部表情识别方法难以处理背景噪声和冗余语义等无关信息，影响识别的效率和效果。

Method: 提出AdaTosk网络，包含并行分支：(1) 自监督重建分支使用随机二元硬掩码生成多样训练样本；(2) 监督分类分支使用自适应时序软掩码，包含类不可知软掩码和类语义软掩码两个关键组件，分别增强关键表情时刻和减少语义冗余。

Result: 在广泛使用的基准数据集上，AdaTosk相比当前最先进方法显著降低计算成本，同时保持有竞争力的识别性能。

Conclusion: AdaTosk通过时序软掩码机制有效过滤无关信息，在效率和效果之间取得良好平衡，为DFER任务提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition (DFER) facilitates the understanding of psychological intentions through non-verbal communication. Existing methods struggle to manage irrelevant information, such as background noise and redundant semantics, which impacts both efficiency and effectiveness. In this work, we propose a novel supervised temporal soft masked autoencoder network for DFER, namely AdaTosk, which integrates a parallel supervised classification branch with the self-supervised reconstruction branch. The self-supervised reconstruction branch applies random binary hard mask to generate diverse training samples, encouraging meaningful feature representations in visible tokens. Meanwhile the classification branch employs an adaptive temporal soft mask to flexibly mask visible tokens based on their temporal significance. Its two key components, respectively of, class-agnostic and class-semantic soft masks, serve to enhance critical expression moments and reduce semantic redundancy over time. Extensive experiments conducted on widely-used benchmarks demonstrate that our AdaTosk remarkably reduces computational costs compared with current state-of-the-art methods while still maintaining competitive performance.

</details>


### [141] [Domain-Agnostic Feature Modulation for Semi-Supervised Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20897)
*Venuri Amarasinghe,Kalinga Bandara,Isun Randila,Asini Jayakody,Chamuditha Jayanga Galappaththige,Ranga Rodrigo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对半监督领域泛化（SSDG）中无域标签的挑战，提出特征调制策略增强类判别特征并抑制域特定信息，以及动态损失缩放函数优化伪标签利用，在四个基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SSDG方法依赖伪标签且假设能获取域标签，但域偏移导致域噪声和伪标签不一致，降低模型性能。本文旨在解决更困难的"无域标签"SSDG问题，即训练时未标记数据无域标签可用。

Method: 1）特征调制策略：将特征向"相似平均表征"（类原型的改进版本）偏移，增强类判别特征、抑制域特定信息，促使分类器区分相近类别、特征提取器形成聚类紧密的域不变表征。2）损失缩放函数：动态降低伪标签的固定置信阈值，优化未标记数据利用，缓解域噪声并提升伪标签准确率。

Result: 在四个主流领域泛化基准数据集上取得显著性能提升，无需域标签即可实现优异效果。

Conclusion: 所提出的无域标签SSDG方法通过特征调制和动态阈值调整，有效解决了域噪声导致的伪标签不准确问题，验证了无需域标签即可实现强泛化能力的可行性。

Abstract: Semi-supervised domain generalization (SSDG) leverages a small fraction of labeled data alongside unlabeled data to enhance model generalization. Most of the existing SSDG methods rely on pseudo-labeling (PL) for unlabeled data, often assuming access to domain labels-a privilege not always available. However, domain shifts introduce domain noise, leading to inconsistent PLs that degrade model performance. Methods derived from FixMatch suffer particularly from lower PL accuracy, reducing the effectiveness of unlabeled data. To address this, we tackle the more challenging domain-label agnostic SSDG, where domain labels for unlabeled data are not available during training. First, we propose a feature modulation strategy that enhances class-discriminative features while suppressing domain-specific information. This modulation shifts features toward Similar Average Representations-a modified version of class prototypes-that are robust across domains, encouraging the classifier to distinguish between closely related classes and feature extractor to form tightly clustered, domain-invariant representations. Second, to mitigate domain noise and improve pseudo-label accuracy, we introduce a loss-scaling function that dynamically lowers the fixed confidence threshold for pseudo-labels, optimizing the use of unlabeled data. With these key innovations, our approach achieves significant improvements on four major domain generalization benchmarks-even without domain labels. We will make the code available.

</details>


### [142] [CamC2V: Context-aware Controllable Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.06022)
*Luis Denninger,Sina Mokhtarzadeh Azar,Juergen Gall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CamC2V是一种上下文到视频（C2V）扩散模型，通过整合多图像条件与3D约束及相机控制，实现更连贯、上下文感知的视频生成，在RealEstate10K数据集上FVD指标提升24.09%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像到视频（I2V）扩散模型仅能动画化静态图像，无法扩展图像提供的上下文；引入相机轨迹等约束虽能增强多样性但会降低视觉质量，限制了需要忠实场景表示的应用场景。

Method: 提出CamC2V模型，将多个图像条件作为上下文与3D约束相结合，并加入相机控制，以丰富全局语义和细粒度视觉细节，同时强调有效的上下文表示需要时序感知。

Result: 在RealEstate10K数据集上，CamC2V在FVD指标上实现了24.09%的视觉质量提升，并增强了相机可控性。

Conclusion: CamC2V通过融合多图像上下文、3D约束与相机控制，有效解决了I2V模型上下文受限和视觉质量下降的问题，实现了更连贯、可控的视频生成。

Abstract: Recently, image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models have demonstrated impressive scene understanding and generative quality, incorporating image conditions to guide generation. However, these models primarily animate static images without extending beyond their provided context. Introducing additional constraints, such as camera trajectories, can enhance diversity but often degrade visual quality, limiting their applicability for tasks requiring faithful scene representation. We propose CamC2V, a context-to-video (C2V) model that integrates multiple image conditions as context with 3D constraints alongside camera control to enrich both global semantics and fine-grained visual details. This enables more coherent and context-aware video generation. Moreover, we motivate the necessity of temporal awareness for an effective context representation. Our comprehensive study on the RealEstate10K dataset demonstrates a $24.09\%$ (FVD) improvement in visual quality and camera controllability. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/LDenninger/CamC2V.

</details>


### [143] [Privacy Protection Against Personalized Text-to-Image Synthesis via Cross-image Consistency Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.12747)
*Guanyu Wang,Kailong Wang,Yihao Huang,Mingyi Zhou,Geguang Pu,Li Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出跨图像抗个性化（CAP）框架，通过跨图像风格一致性约束增强对扩散模型个性化攻击的防御能力，并设计了动态比例调整策略以平衡攻击过程中的一致性损失影响。在CelebHQ和VGGFace2基准上的实验表明CAP显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有抗个性化方法忽视了个性化任务的多图像特性，独立对每张图像添加扰动，未能利用图像间关系实现更强的隐私保护。

Method: 提出CAP框架，在对抗扰动中添加跨图像风格一致性约束，并引入动态比例调整策略自适应平衡一致性损失的影响。

Result: 在CelebHQ和VGGFace2基准上，CAP显著提升了对抗个性化攻击的效果。

Conclusion: 从群体层面视角进行隐私保护，利用图像间关系能有效增强抗个性化能力。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of diffusion models and personalization techniques has made it possible to recreate individual portraits from just a few publicly available images. While such capabilities empower various creative applications, they also introduce serious privacy concerns, as adversaries can exploit them to generate highly realistic impersonations. To counter these threats, anti-personalization methods have been proposed, which add adversarial perturbations to published images to disrupt the training of personalization models. However, existing approaches largely overlook the intrinsic multi-image nature of personalization and instead adopt a naive strategy of applying perturbations independently, as commonly done in single-image settings. This neglects the opportunity to leverage inter-image relationships for stronger privacy protection. Therefore, we advocate for a group-level perspective on privacy protection against personalization. Specifically, we introduce Cross-image Anti-Personalization (CAP), a novel framework that enhances resistance to personalization by enforcing style consistency across perturbed images. Furthermore, we develop a dynamic ratio adjustment strategy that adaptively balances the impact of the consistency loss throughout the attack iterations. Extensive experiments on the classical CelebHQ and VGGFace2 benchmarks show that CAP substantially improves existing methods.

</details>


### [144] [EPiC: Efficient Video Camera Control Learning with Precise Anchor-Video Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21876)
*Zun Wang,Jaemin Cho,Jialu Li,Han Lin,Jaehong Yoon,Yue Zhang,Mohit Bansal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EPiC提出了一种无需相机姿态或点云估计的高效精确相机控制视频生成框架，通过基于首帧可见性的掩码构建对齐的锚点视频，并引入轻量级Anchor-ControlNet模块（参数增加不到1%），在降低训练成本的同时实现了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于锚点视频的相机控制方法依赖点云和相机轨迹估计，导致锚点视频不准确、训练成本高且效率低，模型被迫补偿渲染错位问题。

Method: 1) 基于首帧可见性对源视频进行掩码，构建高精度对齐的锚点视频，无需相机/点云估计；2) 引入Anchor-ControlNet轻量模块，在可见区域集成锚点视频引导至预训练视频扩散模型。

Result: 在RealEstate10K和MiraData的I2V相机控制任务上达到SOTA性能；在V2V场景下展现出强大的零样本泛化能力；训练所需参数、步数和数据量大幅减少。

Conclusion: EPiC通过无需估计的锚点视频构建和轻量级控制模块，实现了高效、精确且鲁棒的3D-informed相机控制，为视频生成中的相机控制提供了更实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent approaches for video generation with camera control often create anchor videos (i.e., rendered videos that approximate desired camera motions) to guide diffusion models as a structured prior, by rendering from estimated point clouds following camera trajectories. However, errors in point cloud and camera trajectory estimation often lead to inaccurate anchor videos with higher training cost and low efficiency, as the model is forced to compensate for rendering misalignments. To address these limitations, we introduce EPiC, an efficient and precise camera control learning framework that constructs well-aligned training anchor videos without the need for camera pose or point cloud estimation. Concretely, we create highly precise anchor videos by masking source videos based on first-frame visibility, which ensures strong alignment, eliminates the need for camera/point cloud estimation, and thus can be readily applied to any in-the-wild video. Furthermore, we introduce Anchor-ControlNet, a lightweight module that integrates anchor video guidance in visible regions to pretrained video diffusion models, with less than 1% of additional parameters. EPiC achieves efficient training with substantially fewer parameters, training steps, and less data, and generalizes robustly to anchor videos made with point clouds at test time, enabling precise 3D-informed camera control. EPiC achieves SoTA performance on RealEstate10K and MiraData for I2V camera control task. Notably, EPiC also exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to video-to-video (V2V) scenarios.

</details>


### [145] [VRAG: Learning World Models for Interactive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21996)
*Taiye Chen,Xun Hu,Zihan Ding,Chi Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出视频检索增强生成（VRAG）方法，通过显式全局状态条件解决自回归视频生成中的累积误差和记忆机制不足问题，从而构建具有交互能力和时空一致性的基础世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频生成模型缺乏有效的世界建模能力，主要面临两大挑战：累积误差（在自回归视频生成中本质不可约）和记忆机制不足（导致世界模型时空不连贯），亟需提升模型在动作选择下的未来规划能力。

Method: 1) 在图像到视频模型中引入额外动作条件与自回归框架以赋予交互能力；2) 提出视频检索增强生成（VRAG），通过显式全局状态条件降低长期累积误差并提升时空一致性；3) 对比分析朴素自回归生成、扩展上下文窗口及传统检索增强生成的局限性。

Result: VRAG显著降低了长期累积误差，提升了世界模型的时空一致性；而朴素自回归生成和传统RAG因当前视频模型上下文学习能力有限而效果欠佳。

Conclusion: 揭示了视频世界模型中的基础性挑战（累积误差的不可约性、记忆机制不足），并建立了评估视频生成模型世界建模能力的综合基准。

Abstract: Foundational world models must be both interactive and preserve spatiotemporal coherence for effective future planning with action choices. However, present models for long video generation have limited inherent world modeling capabilities due to two main challenges: compounding errors and insufficient memory mechanisms. We enhance image-to-video models with interactive capabilities through additional action conditioning and autoregressive framework, and reveal that compounding error is inherently irreducible in autoregressive video generation, while insufficient memory mechanism leads to incoherence of world models. We propose video retrieval augmented generation (VRAG) with explicit global state conditioning, which significantly reduces long-term compounding errors and increases spatiotemporal consistency of world models. In contrast, naive autoregressive generation with extended context windows and retrieval-augmented generation prove less effective for video generation, primarily due to the limited in-context learning capabilities of current video models. Our work illuminates the fundamental challenges in video world models and establishes a comprehensive benchmark for improving video generation models with internal world modeling capabilities.

</details>


### [146] [SAGE: Segment-Aware Gloss-Free Encoding for Token-Efficient Sign Language Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09266)
*JianHe Low,Ozge Mercanoglu Sincan,Richard Bowden*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于分段的视觉标记化框架用于无词汇注释手语翻译，通过将连续视频转换为离散的、由手语信息引导的视觉标记，将输入序列长度减少50%，内存使用降低2.67倍，并在PHOENIX14T基准上超越现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无词汇注释手语翻译（SLT）虽取得快速进展，但模型复杂度增加和计算需求高昂带来了可扩展性问题，尤其在大型手语数据集日益普及的背景下。

Method: 提出分段感知视觉标记化框架，利用手语分段将连续视频转化为离散的、含手语信息的视觉标记；引入令牌到令牌对比对齐目标，结合双层级监督（语言嵌入和中间隐藏状态对齐）以增强跨模态对齐。

Result: 输入序列长度减少50%，内存使用降低2.67倍，在PHOENIX14T基准上超越现有最先进方法；在相同序列长度下性能也优于先前工作。

Conclusion: 所提出的标记化与对齐策略能有效降低计算开销并提升翻译性能，验证了其在大型手语数据集上的可扩展性和有效性。

Abstract: Gloss-free Sign Language Translation (SLT) has advanced rapidly, achieving strong performances without relying on gloss annotations. However, these gains have often come with increased model complexity and high computational demands, raising concerns about scalability, especially as large-scale sign language datasets become more common. We propose a segment-aware visual tokenization framework that leverages sign segmentation to convert continuous video into discrete, sign-informed visual tokens. This reduces input sequence length by up to 50% compared to prior methods, resulting in up to 2.67x lower memory usage and better scalability on larger datasets. To bridge the visual and linguistic modalities, we introduce a token-to-token contrastive alignment objective, along with a dual-level supervision that aligns both language embeddings and intermediate hidden states. This improves fine-grained cross-modal alignment without relying on gloss-level supervision. Our approach notably exceeds the performance of state-of-the-art methods on the PHOENIX14T benchmark, while significantly reducing sequence length. Further experiments also demonstrate our improved performance over prior work under comparable sequence-lengths, validating the potential of our tokenization and alignment strategies.

</details>


### [147] [MENTOR: Efficient Multimodal-Conditioned Tuning for Autoregressive Vision Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09574)
*Haozhe Zhao,Zefan Cai,Shuzheng Si,Liang Chen,Jiuxiang Gu,Wen Xiao,Minjia Zhang,Junjie Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MENTOR是一个自回归多模态图像生成框架，采用两阶段训练范式（多模态对齐+多模态指令微调），在不依赖辅助适配器或交叉注意力模块的情况下，实现多模态输入与图像输出的细粒度token级对齐，在DreamBench++基准上以较小模型规模和有限资源取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型在精确视觉控制、多模态输入平衡方面存在困难，且复杂多模态图像生成需要大量训练。作者旨在解决这些局限性，提出一个高效的多模态条件图像生成框架。

Method: MENTOR采用自回归图像生成器，结合两阶段训练范式：(1) 多模态对齐阶段——建立像素级和语义级对齐；(2) 多模态指令微调阶段——平衡多模态输入融合并增强生成可控性。无需辅助适配器或交叉注意力模块，实现token级细粒度对齐。

Result: 在DreamBench++基准上，尽管模型规模较小、基础组件非最优、训练资源有限，MENTOR仍优于竞争基线，在概念保留和提示遵循方面表现突出。同时实现更优的图像重建保真度、广泛的任务适应性和更高的训练效率。

Conclusion: MENTOR为多模态条件图像生成提供了一种高效的AR框架，证明了无需复杂模块即可实现精细的多模态控制，且训练效率优于扩散方法。

Abstract: Recent text-to-image models produce high-quality results but still struggle with precise visual control, balancing multimodal inputs, and requiring extensive training for complex multimodal image generation. To address these limitations, we propose MENTOR, a novel autoregressive (AR) framework for efficient Multimodal-conditioned Tuning for Autoregressive multimodal image generation. MENTOR combines an AR image generator with a two-stage training paradigm, enabling fine-grained, token-level alignment between multimodal inputs and image outputs without relying on auxiliary adapters or cross-attention modules. The two-stage training consists of: (1) a multimodal alignment stage that establishes robust pixel- and semantic-level alignment, followed by (2) a multimodal instruction tuning stage that balances the integration of multimodal inputs and enhances generation controllability. Despite modest model size, suboptimal base components, and limited training resources, MENTOR achieves strong performance on the DreamBench++ benchmark, outperforming competitive baselines in concept preservation and prompt following. Additionally, our method delivers superior image reconstruction fidelity, broad task adaptability, and improved training efficiency compared to diffusion-based methods. Dataset, code, and models are available at: https://github.com/HaozheZhao/MENTOR

</details>


### [148] [Finding DoRI: Discovery of Retained Images in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.16880)
*Antoni Kowalczuk,Dominik Hintersdorf,Lukas Struppek,Kristian Kersting,Adam Dziedzic,Franziska Boenisch*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文挑战了文本到图像扩散模型中记忆化可被定位（即通过修剪特定权重来消除）的假设，证明即使经过修剪，对文本嵌入的微小扰动也能重新触发数据复制。多项分析表明记忆化本质上并非局部性的，并提出通过对抗性微调实现更鲁棒的缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法基于记忆化可被定位的假设，通过识别和修剪触发训练数据复制的权重来缓解隐私和知识产权问题。作者质疑这一假设的有效性，试图揭示记忆化的真实本质。

Method: 通过对抗性扰动已缓解提示的文本嵌入来测试记忆化是否重新触发；分析记忆化图像在文本嵌入空间中的触发分布、同一复制图像对应不同嵌入的模型激活差异，以及不同修剪方法识别出的记忆相关权重的交集一致性。

Result: （1）记忆化图像的复制触发点在文本嵌入空间中广泛分布；（2）产生相同复制图像的不同嵌入导致模型激活发散；（3）不同修剪方法对同一图像识别出的记忆相关权重不一致。绕过局部性假设的对抗性微调能实现更鲁棒的缓解。

Conclusion: 文本到图像扩散模型中的记忆化本质上并非局部现象，依赖局部性假设的缓解方法脆弱易被攻破。未来应基于这一新认识开发更可靠的记忆化缓解方法。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models (DMs) have achieved remarkable success in image generation. However, concerns about data privacy and intellectual property remain due to their potential to inadvertently memorize and replicate training data. Recent mitigation efforts have focused on identifying and pruning weights responsible for triggering verbatim training data replication, based on the assumption that memorization can be localized. We challenge this assumption and demonstrate that, even after such pruning, small perturbations to the text embeddings of previously mitigated prompts can re-trigger data replication, revealing the fragility of such methods. Our further analysis then provides multiple indications that memorization is indeed \textit{not} inherently local: (1) replication triggers for memorized images are distributed throughout text embedding space; (2) embeddings yielding the same replicated image produce divergent model activations; and (3) different pruning methods identify inconsistent sets of memorization-related weights for the same image. Finally, we show that bypassing the locality assumption enables more robust mitigation through adversarial fine-tuning. These findings provide new insights into the fundamental nature of memorization in text-to-image DMs and inform the future development of more reliable mitigation methods against DM memorization.

</details>


### [149] [HM-Talker: Hybrid Motion Modeling for High-Fidelity Talking Head Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.10566)
*Shiyu Liu,Kui Jiang,Junjun Jiang,Xianming Liu,Xiaocheng Feng,Hongxun Yao,Qi Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HM-Talker通过协同整合显式发音线索与隐式韵律特征，在实现音频驱动泛化的同时捕捉身份特定动态，在视觉真实感和唇形同步精度上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频驱动说话头生成方法在个性化与泛化之间存在根本性权衡：隐式模型泛化强但结构一致性差，导致头部运动不稳定和唇形同步不准；显式方法（如3DMM、AU）虽引入几何和解剖先验，但易产生过于中性的表情或泛化能力受限。为解决这一冲突，提出HM-Talker框架。

Method: HM-Talker包含两大核心模块：1) 跨模态映射模块(CMMM)，从音频和视频中提取全面的运动线索词汇表；2) 混合运动建模模块(HMMM)，采用随机特征配对(SFP)策略动态融合成对的隐式和显式特征进行运动合成。通过交替优化身份特定与身份无关（仅音频）目标，实现下半脸运动的迭代优化。

Result: 大量实验表明，HM-Talker在多种设置下，在视觉真实感和唇形同步精度两个指标上均优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: HM-Talker通过显式发音线索与隐式韵律特征的协同整合，有效解决了个性化与泛化之间的冲突，为音频驱动说话头生成提供了一种更优的解决方案。

Abstract: Audio-driven talking head generation faces a fundamental trade-off between personalization and generalization, limiting its practical application. Implicit models often achieve generalization at the cost of structural incoherence, resulting in unstable head motion and inaccurate lip synchronization. While explicit methods incorporate geometric and anatomical priors such as 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs), which parameterize facial geometry, or Action Units (AUs), which code facial muscle movements--they tend to produce overly neutral expressions or suffer from limited generalization. To resolve this conflict, we present HM-Talker, an audio-driven talking head framework that synergistically integrates explicit articulatory cues with implicit prosodic features to characterize identity-specific dynamics while enabling audio-driven generalization. Its distinctive features can be summarized as: i) the Cross-Modal Mapping Module (CMMM) that extracts a comprehensive vocabulary of motion cues from audio and video, and ii) the Hybrid Motion Modeling Module (HMMM) that employs a Stochastic Feature Pairing (SFP) strategy to dynamically merge paired implicit and explicit features for motion synthesis. This design facilitates an iterative optimization of the lower face motion, alternating between identity-specific and identity-agnostic (audio-only) objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HM-Talker outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both visual realism and lip-sync accuracy across diverse settings.

</details>


### [150] [Scalable RF Simulation in Generative 4D Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.12176)
*Zhiwei Zheng,Dongyin Hu,Mingmin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WaveVerse是一个基于提示的可扩展框架，通过语言引导的4D世界生成器和物理信号模拟器，生成动态室内场景中带有人体运动的逼真RF信号，无需手动轨迹设计。该框架采用相位相干光线追踪器保持时空相位一致性，在相位敏感基准测试中表现高保真度，并用于数据增强可显著提升RF成像和人体活动识别等下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在动态多样化环境中构建高质量的RF传感数据集面临重大挑战，现有方法难以高效、可扩展地生成多样化的RF信号数据。

Method: 提出WaveVerse框架，包含语言引导的4D世界生成器（自动生成室内场景与人体运动路径）和基于物理的信号模拟器（采用相位相干光线追踪器，保持时空相位一致性）。

Result: 模拟信号在相位敏感基准测试中展示高保真度，与真实数据及商业电磁求解器结果高度一致；用于数据增强时，在RF成像和人体活动识别任务中性能持续提升，且增益随模拟数据量增长，超越现有方法。

Conclusion: WaveVerse提供了一种可扩展、无需手动设计的RF信号数据生成方案，有效解决了RF感知领域的数据稀缺问题，并在下游任务中验证了其数据增强的有效性。

Abstract: Radio Frequency (RF) sensing has emerged as a powerful, privacy-preserving alternative to vision-based methods for various perception tasks. However, building high-quality RF datasets in dynamic and diverse environments remains a major challenge. To address this, we introduce WaveVerse, a prompt-based, scalable framework that simulates realistic RF signals from generated indoor scenes with human motions guided by spatial paths, enabling diverse and feasible behaviors without manual trajectory design. WaveVerse features a language-guided 4D world generator and a physics-based signal simulator that enables realistic simulation of RF signals in diverse environments. It employs a phase-coherent ray tracer that preserves both spatial and temporal phase consistency. The simulated signals show high fidelity on phase-sensitive benchmarks, and closely align with both real-world collected measurements and simulations from a proprietary electromagnetic solver. When used for data augmentation, WaveVerse consistently improves performance in downstream tasks like RF imaging and human activity recognition, with gains that grow with the amount of simulated data and surpass existing methods. Code and additional materials are available on the webpage.

</details>


### [151] [Multimodal LLMs See Sentiment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.16873)
*Neemias B. da Silva,John Harrison,Rodrigo Minetto,Myriam R. Delgado,Bogdan T. Nassu,Thiago H. Silva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在图像情感分析中的表现，提出了一种两阶段MLLM描述中介流水线（MLLM生成描述+LLM进行情感分析），并通过微调LLM显著提升了预测精度，在多个评估设置下超越词典、CNN和Transformer基线模型，最高提升分别达30.9%、64.8%和42.4%，且在跨数据集评估中无需训练即可超越领域内最佳基线超过8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字图像主导的背景下，理解视觉内容如何传达情感日益重要，但情感感知依赖于复杂的场景级语义，使得计算模型面临挑战。本文旨在系统评估MLLM在图像情感分析中的表现，探索其有效性边界。

Method: 采用评估驱动的研究方法，从三个视角展开：(i) MLLM直接对图像进行情感分类；(ii) 基于MLLM生成的图像描述，使用预训练LLM进行情感分析；(iii) 在情感标注的描述数据上微调这些LLM以评估性能和泛化能力。构建了两阶段MLLM描述中介流水线。

Result: 两阶段MLLM描述中介流水线在多个评估设置下显著提升预测精度，微调LLM组件后效果最佳。强配置在基准上超越词典、CNN和Transformer基线分别达30.9%、64.8%和42.4%。跨数据集评估中，无需在目标数据集上训练/微调即超越领域内最佳基线8%以上。

Conclusion: 研究提供了MLLM描述中介情感分析的综合评估，阐明了其有效条件、失败场景及与传统视觉方法的对比，同时提供了可复现的基准资源供未来研究使用。

Abstract: Understanding how visual content conveys sentiment is increasingly important in a digital landscape dominated by imagery. However, sentiment perception depends on complex scene-level semantics, making this a challenging task for computational models. This paper examines how Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) perform sentiment analysis in images through a systematic, evaluation-driven study encompassing three perspectives: (i) direct sentiment classification from images using MLLMs; (ii) sentiment analysis on MLLM-generated descriptions using pre-trained LLMs; and (iii) fine-tuning these LLMs on sentiment-labeled descriptions to assess performance and generalization. Experiments on a recent benchmark show that a two-stage MLLM description-mediated pipeline can substantially improve prediction accuracy under several evaluation settings, particularly when the LLM component is fine-tuned. Across different agreement thresholds and sentiment granularities, the strongest configurations of this pipeline outperform lexicon-, CNN-, and Transformer-based baselines in our benchmark by up to 30.9%, 64.8%, and 42.4%, respectively. In cross-dataset evaluation, the proposed pipeline - without training or fine-tuning on the target dataset - still surpasses the best in-domain baseline by over 8%. Overall, the study provides a comprehensive assessment of MLLM description-mediated sentiment analysis, clarifying the conditions under which it is effective, the scenarios in which it fails, and its comparison with traditional vision-based approaches, while also providing a reproducible benchmark resource for future research.

</details>


### [152] [Resolution as a Direction: Vector-Panning Feature Alignment for Cross-Resolution Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)
*Zanwu Liu,Chao Yuan,Bo Li,Xiaowei Zhang,Guanglin Niu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过分析发现低分辨率与高分辨率特征之间存在一致的语义方向差异，并提出轻量级后处理模块VPFA，通过沿该方向"平移"低分辨率特征实现跨分辨率行人重识别对齐，在多个基准上取得SOTA且计算开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际监控场景中相机质量与拍摄距离导致查询图像（低分辨率）与库图像（高分辨率）之间存在显著分辨率差距，现有超分辨率或不变性表示学习方法复杂且无法直接解决特征不匹配问题。

Method: 提出Vector Panning Feature Alignment (VPFA)，一个轻量级后处理模块。首先通过统计分析（CCA和Pearson相关分析）验证了HR-LR特征差异存在一致的、与分辨率相关的语义方向；然后学习沿该方向"平移"LR特征以获得伪HR表示，可直接集成到现有ReID系统中。

Result: 在多个CR-ReID基准上，VPFA取得SOTA性能，同时相比基于超分辨率或联合训练的方法效率更高，计算开销可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 通过揭示特征空间中分辨率退化导致的语义方向偏移，提出一种简单高效的后处理对齐方法，在不增加系统复杂度的前提下有效解决跨分辨率行人重识别问题。

Abstract: Cross-resolution person re-identification (CR-ReID) remains challenging in practical surveillance, where camera quality and capture distance lead to substantial resolution gaps between low-resolution (LR) queries and high-resolution (HR) gallery images. Prior approaches commonly rely on super-resolution (SR) or resolution-invariant representation learning, which often increases system complexity and may not directly address the feature mismatch induced by resolution degradation. In this work, we report a new empirical finding from a dedicated analysis in which identity-specific variation is averaged out: the HR--LR feature discrepancy produced by standard ReID backbones exhibits a consistent, resolution-related semantic direction in the embedding space. We further support this observation with statistical analyses based on Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) and Pearson correlation analysis. Motivated by this finding, we propose Vector Panning Feature Alignment (VPFA), a lightweight post-hoc module that learns to pan LR features along the learned resolution direction to obtain pseudo-HR representations. VPFA operates after feature extraction and can be integrated into existing ReID systems with negligible overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple CR-ReID benchmarks show that VPFA achieves state-of-the-art performance while improving efficiency compared to SR-based or jointly trained alternatives.

</details>


### [153] [Streaming Drag-Oriented Interactive Video Manipulation: Drag Anything, Anytime!](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03550)
*Junbao Zhou,Yuan Zhou,Kesen Zhao,Qingshan Xu,Beier Zhu,Richang Hong,Hanwang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出REVEL任务（流式拖拽交互视频操控）和DragStream方法，通过自适应分布自纠正和空间-频率选择性优化机制，解决自回归视频扩散模型在流式拖拽操作中的潜在分布漂移和上下文干扰问题，实现无需训练的精细视频拖拽编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散模型难以实现流式、细粒度的输出控制，无法确保生成结果持续符合用户期望。虽然已有DragVideo和SG-I2V等工作，但缺乏统一支持平移、变形、旋转等多功能拖拽操作的流式交互方案。

Method: 提出DragStream，包含两个核心组件：1) 自适应分布自纠正策略，利用相邻帧的统计量约束潜在嵌入的分布漂移；2) 空间-频率选择性优化机制，通过沿生成方向选择性传播视觉线索，充分利用上下文信息同时减少干扰。

Result: 该方法可无缝集成到现有自回归视频扩散模型中，大量实验证明了DragStream的有效性。

Conclusion: REVEL统一了拖拽式视频操控中的编辑与动画化功能，DragStream作为无需训练的方案有效解决了流式拖拽中的两个关键问题（潜在分布漂移和上下文干扰），为自回归视频扩散模型提供了细粒度交互控制能力。

Abstract: Achieving streaming, fine-grained control over the outputs of autoregressive video diffusion models remains challenging, making it difficult to ensure that they consistently align with user expectations. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{stReaming drag-oriEnted interactiVe vidEo manipuLation (REVEL)}, a new task that enables users to modify generated videos \emph{anytime} on \emph{anything} via fine-grained, interactive drag. Beyond DragVideo and SG-I2V, REVEL unifies drag-style video manipulation as editing and animating video frames with both supporting user-specified translation, deformation, and rotation effects, making drag operations versatile. In resolving REVEL, we observe: \emph{i}) drag-induced perturbations accumulate in latent space, causing severe latent distribution drift that halts the drag process; \emph{ii}) streaming drag is easily disturbed by context frames, thereby yielding visually unnatural outcomes. We thus propose a training-free approach, \textbf{DragStream}, comprising: \emph{i}) an adaptive distribution self-rectification strategy that leverages neighboring frames' statistics to effectively constrain the drift of latent embeddings; \emph{ii}) a spatial-frequency selective optimization mechanism, allowing the model to fully exploit contextual information while mitigating its interference via selectively propagating visual cues along generation. Our method can be seamlessly integrated into existing autoregressive video diffusion models, and extensive experiments firmly demonstrate the effectiveness of our DragStream.

</details>


### [154] [LoCoT2V-Bench: Benchmarking Long-Form and Complex Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.26412)
*Xiangqing Zheng,Chengyue Wu,Kehai Chen,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LoCoT2V-Bench基准和LoCoT2V-Eval评估框架，用于长视频生成的多维度评估；实验发现现有模型在感知质量上表现良好，但在细粒度文本-视频对齐和角色一致性方面存在显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到视频生成方法在短视频上表现优异，但对长视频生成（LVG）在复杂文本输入下的评估仍缺乏系统性的基准和方法。

Method: 构建LoCoT2V-Bench基准数据集（基于真实视频的多场景提示，含层级元数据）；提出LoCoT2V-Eval多维评估框架（感知质量、文本-视频对齐、时间质量、动态质量、人类期望实现度HERD）。

Result: 对17个代表性LVG模型的实验显示不同评估维度上能力差异显著；感知质量和背景一致性较强，但细粒度文本-视频对齐和角色一致性明显较弱。

Conclusion: 提升提示忠实度和身份保持仍是长视频生成的关键挑战。

Abstract: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have achieved impressive performance on short clips, yet evaluating long-form generation under complex textual inputs remains a significant challenge. In response to this challenge, we present LoCoT2V-Bench, a benchmark for long video generation (LVG) featuring multi-scene prompts with hierarchical metadata (e.g., character settings and camera behaviors), constructed from collected real-world videos. We further propose LoCoT2V-Eval, a multi-dimensional framework covering perceptual quality, text-video alignment, temporal quality, dynamic quality, and Human Expectation Realization Degree (HERD), with an emphasis on aspects such as fine-grained text-video alignment and temporal character consistency. Experiments on 17 representative LVG models reveal pronounced capability disparities across evaluation dimensions, with strong perceptual quality and background consistency but markedly weaker fine-grained text-video alignment and character consistency. These findings suggest that improving prompt faithfulness and identity preservation remains a key challenge for long-form video generation. Our code and data are released at https://github.com/XqZeppelinhead0702/LoCoT2V-Bench

</details>


### [155] [Modality Alignment across Trees on Heterogeneous Hyperbolic Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.27391)
*Wei Wu,Xiaomeng Fan,Yuwei Wu,Zhi Gao,Pengxiang Li,Yunde Jia,Mehrtash Harandi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Alignment across Trees方法，通过构建图像和文本的树状层次特征并在双曲流形中对齐，解决了视觉-语言模型中模态对齐不对称的问题，在开放集分类任务上取得优异表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM方法从文本提取层次特征，但图像仅用单一特征表示，导致对齐不对称且次优。

Method: (1) 提出语义感知的视觉特征提取框架，利用交叉注意力机制从Transformer中间层的视觉类标记中提取粗到细的层次特征；(2) 将双模态的特征树嵌入到不同曲率的双曲流形中；(3) 定义异质流形间的KL散度，学习中间流形进行对齐，并证明其存在唯一性。

Result: 在多个图像数据集上的分类开放集任务中，在少样本和跨域设置下一致优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过对称构建双模态树状层次特征并利用异质双曲流形对齐，有效改善了视觉-语言模型的模态对齐质量。

Abstract: Modality alignment is critical for vision-language models (VLMs) to effectively integrate information across modalities. However, existing methods extract hierarchical features from text while representing each image with a single feature, leading to asymmetric and suboptimal alignment. To address this, we propose Alignment across Trees, a method that constructs and aligns tree-like hierarchical features for both image and text modalities. Specifically, we introduce a semantic-aware visual feature extraction framework that applies a cross-attention mechanism to visual class tokens from intermediate Transformer layers, guided by textual cues to extract visual features with coarse-to-fine semantics. We then embed the feature trees of the two modalities into hyperbolic manifolds with distinct curvatures to effectively model their hierarchical structures. To align across the heterogeneous hyperbolic manifolds with different curvatures, we formulate a KL distance measure between distributions on heterogeneous manifolds, and learn an intermediate manifold for manifold alignment by minimizing the distance. We prove the existence and uniqueness of the optimal intermediate manifold. Experiments on taxonomic open-set classification tasks across multiple image datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines under few-shot and cross-domain settings.

</details>


### [156] [OmniAID: Decoupling Semantic and Artifacts for Universal AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08423)
*Yuncheng Guo,Junyan Ye,Chenjue Zhang,Hengrui Kang,Haohuan Fu,Conghui He,Weijia Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniAID提出了解耦的混合专家架构，分离了内容相关的语义缺陷与内容无关的通用伪造痕迹，配合两阶段训练策略和Mirage数据集，在AI生成图像检测任务上达到了新的最优水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIGI检测器将内容相关缺陷与内容无关伪造痕迹耦合在一起学习，导致泛化能力受限；同时现有基准数据集过时，无法评估对现代生成模型的检测能力。

Method: 提出解耦的MoE架构：(1) 可路由专用语义专家处理不同内容域的语义缺陷；(2) 固定通用伪造专家处理内容无关的通用伪影。采用两阶段训练策略：先通过域特定硬采样独立训练各专家，再训练轻量级门控网络进行输入路由。同时构建了Mirage大规模现代数据集。

Result: OmniAID在多个基准上超越现有检测器，对现代、在野的AI生成图像威胁展现出鲁棒的泛化能力，建立了新的检测标准。

Conclusion: 通过显式解耦"生成内容是什么"（内容特定缺陷）与"内容如何生成"（通用伪造痕迹），OmniAID实现了对多样化生成模型和语义内容的强泛化能力。

Abstract: A truly universal AI-Generated Image (AIGI) detector must simultaneously generalize across diverse generative models and varied semantic content. Current methods learn a single, entangled forgery representation, conflating content-dependent flaws with content-agnostic artifacts, and are further constrained by outdated benchmarks. We propose OmniAID, a novel framework centered on a decoupled Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that separates: (1) semantic flaws across distinct content domains via Routable Specialized Semantic Experts, and (2) content-agnostic universal artifacts from content-dependent flaws via a Fixed Universal Artifact Expert. A two-stage training strategy first specializes experts independently with domain-specific hard-sampling, then trains a lightweight gating network for effective input routing. By explicitly decoupling "what is generated" (content-specific flaws) from "how it is generated" (universal artifacts), OmniAID achieves robust generalization. We also introduce Mirage, a large-scale, contemporary dataset comprising a modern training set and a challenging test set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniAID surpasses existing detectors, establishing a new standard for AIGI detection against modern, in-the-wild threats. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/OmniAID.

</details>


### [157] [An accuracy-aware extension to LRP-based pruning for CNNs to prevent cascading accuracy degradation in data-scarce transfer learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.10861)
*Daisuke Yasui,Toshitaka Matsuki,Hiroshi Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对小数据环境下使用预训练CNN作为固定特征提取器时存在的冗余滤波器问题，本文提出了一种基于LRP的精度感知剪枝控制机制，通过动态调整剪枝率和剪枝顺序（使用类别精度的调和平均）来抑制级联精度下降，在VGG16上使平均精度-剪枝率曲线下面积（AUC）提升了约15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练CNN在小数据环境下作为固定特征提取器时，存在大量对目标任务无贡献的冗余滤波器，导致模型效率低下，而现有的LRP剪枝方法会引发级联精度下降问题。

Method: 提出精度感知的剪枝控制机制：利用类别精度的调和平均动态调整剪枝率和剪枝顺序，以抑制级联精度下降，同时在小数据环境下保持目标任务性能。

Result: 该控制机制有效缓解了级联精度下降；在VGG16上，相较于传统LRP剪枝方法，类别平均精度-剪枝率曲线下面积（AUC）提升了约15%。

Conclusion: 所提出的精度感知剪枝控制机制能够有效抑制级联精度下降，在保持任务性能的同时压缩预训练模型，在小数据环境下取得比现有LRP剪枝方法更高的分类精度。

Abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) pre-trained on large-scale datasets such as ImageNet are widely used as feature extractors to construct high-accuracy classification models from scarce data for specific tasks. In such scenarios, fine-tuning the pre-trained CNN is difficult due to data scarcity, necessitating the use of fixed weights. However, when the weights are kept fixed, many filters that do not contribute to the target task remain in the model, leading to unnecessary redundancy and reduced efficiency. Therefore, effective methods are needed to reduce model size by pruning filters that are unnecessary for inference. To address this, approaches utilizing Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) have been proposed. LRP quantifies the contribution of each filter to the inference result, enabling the pruning of filters with low relevance. However, existing LRP-based pruning methods have been observed to cause cascading accuracy degradation. In this study, we introduce an accuracy-aware pruning control mechanism for existing LRP-based filter pruning methods, which suppresses cascading accuracy degradation by dynamically adjusting the pruning rate and the pruning order using the harmonic mean of class accuracy, and compresses the pre-trained model while preserving task-specific performance in a small-data environment. We demonstrate that this control mechanism effectively mitigates cascading accuracy degradation and achieves higher classification accuracy compared to existing LRP-based pruning methods, improving the class-averaged area under the accuracy-pruning-rate curve (AUC) of VGG16 by approximately 15\% over conventional LRP-based approaches.

</details>


### [158] [Evaluating Dataset Watermarking for Fine-tuning Traceability of Customized Diffusion Models: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Removal Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.19316)
*Xincheng Wang,Hanchi Sun,Wenjun Sun,Kejun Xue,Wangqiu Zhou,Jianbo Zhang,Wei Sun,Dandan Zhu,Xiongkuo Min,Jun Jia,Zhijun Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型微调中的数据集水印技术，建立了统一威胁模型与评估框架（涵盖通用性、可传递性和鲁棒性），实验发现现有方法在通用性和可传递性上表现良好，但在真实威胁场景下鲁棒性不足，并进一步提出了一种实用的水印去除方法，揭示了该领域的核心挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型微调技术能复现特定图像集，带来版权和安全风险；现有数据集水印方法虽可追溯，但缺乏统一的评估框架，难以系统衡量其有效性。

Method: 建立通用威胁模型，提出包含通用性（Universality）、可传递性（Transmissibility）和鲁棒性（Robustness）的三维评估框架；并设计了一种实用的水印去除方法以暴露现有方法的脆弱性。

Result: 现有方法在通用性和可传递性上表现良好，对常见图像处理操作具有部分鲁棒性，但在真实威胁场景下效果不足；提出的水印去除方法能彻底消除数据集水印且不影响微调效果。

Conclusion: 现有数据集水印技术在面对真实攻击时存在显著漏洞，亟需开发更鲁棒的水印方案以应对实际威胁。

Abstract: Recent fine-tuning techniques for diffusion models enable them to reproduce specific image sets, such as particular faces or artistic styles, but also introduce copyright and security risks. Dataset watermarking has been proposed to ensure traceability by embedding imperceptible watermarks into training images, which remain detectable in outputs even after fine-tuning. However, current methods lack a unified evaluation framework. To address this, this paper establishes a general threat model and introduces a comprehensive evaluation framework encompassing Universality, Transmissibility, and Robustness. Experiments show that existing methods perform well in universality and transmissibility, and exhibit some robustness against common image processing operations, yet still fall short under real-world threat scenarios. To reveal these vulnerabilities, the paper further proposes a practical watermark removal method that fully eliminates dataset watermarks without affecting fine-tuning, highlighting a key challenge for future research.

</details>


### [159] [AlignVid: Training-Free Attention Scaling for Semantic Fidelity in Text-Guided Image-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01334)
*Yexin Liu,Wen-Jie Shu,Zile Huang,Haoze Zheng,Yueze Wang,Jingjin Zhu,Manyuan Zhang,Ser-Nam Lim,Harry Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AlignVid提出了一种无需训练的注意力校准方法，通过注意力缩放调制（ASM）和引导调度（GS）解决文本引导图像到视频生成中因视觉主导导致的新语义融入困难问题，并发布了OmitI2V基准以评估对象增删改等复杂编辑任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本引导图像到视频生成方法在处理需要大幅改变参考图像（如添加、移除或修改对象）的编辑任务时表现不佳，根源在于参考图像带来的视觉主导效应——注意力分散导致模型难以融入新的语义信息。

Method: 提出AlignVid，一种无需训练的干预方法。从能量视角看待注意力机制，包含两个核心组件：(1) 注意力缩放调制（ASM），通过降低注意力熵将关注聚焦于语义token；(2) 引导调度（GS），维持生成过程的稳定性。

Result: 在OmitI2V基准上的大量实验表明，AlignVid在几乎不增加计算开销的条件下有效提升了语义保真度。

Conclusion: AlignVid成功解决了图像到视频生成中视觉信息主导导致的语义编辑困难问题，为复杂文本引导的视频编辑提供了一种高效且无需额外训练的解决方案。

Abstract: Text-guided image-to-video generation has made substantial progress, yet it still struggles to execute text-specified edits that require substantial changes to a reference image (\textit{e.g., object addition, removal, or modification}). Empirically, our analysis reveals that this stems from \textbf{visual dominance}, where the reference image causes severe attention dispersion, inhibiting the model's ability to incorporate new semantic information. To address this, we propose \textbf{AlignVid}, a training-free intervention that re-calibrates the model's internal attention distribution. Drawing on an energy-based perspective of attention, AlignVid employs Attention Scaling Modulation (\textbf{ASM}) to reduce attention entropy and concentrate focus on semantic tokens, alongside Guidance Scheduling (\textbf{GS}) to maintain generation stability. To rigorously assess this capability, we present \textbf{OmitI2V}, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating prompt adherence across object modification, addition, and deletion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AlignVid effectively enhances semantic fidelity with negligible computational overhead. Code and the OmitI2V benchmark are available at https://github.com/LAW1223/AlignVid.

</details>


### [160] [E3AD: An Emotion-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for Human-Centric End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.04733)
*Yihong Tang,Haicheng Liao,Tong Nie,Junlin He,Ao Qu,Kehua Chen,Wei Ma,Zhenning Li,Lijun Sun,Chengzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出E3AD，一种情感感知的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过连续VAD情感模型和双路径空间推理模块，使自动驾驶系统能够理解自然语言指令中的情感并规划符合情感意图的轨迹，在真实数据集上实现了视觉定位、路径规划和情感估计的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的端到端自动驾驶系统（VLA模型）忽略了乘客的情感状态，而情感状态直接影响乘坐舒适度和自动驾驶接受度。作者提出开放域端到端（OD-E2E）自动驾驶概念，要求AV理解自由形式自然语言命令、推断情感并规划物理可行的轨迹。

Method: 提出E3AD框架，包含三个核心组件：1）连续VAD（Valence-Arousal-Dominance）情感模型，从语言中捕捉语气和紧迫感；2）双路径空间推理模块，融合自我中心（egocentric）和世界中心（allocentric）视角实现类人空间认知；3）一致性导向训练方案，结合模态预训练和偏好对齐，强化情感意图与驾驶行为之间的一致性。

Result: 在真实世界数据集上，E3AD在视觉定位和路径规划任务上取得提升，并在情感估计的VAD相关性上达到SOTA水平。实验表明，将情感注入VLA风格的驾驶能带来更符合人类期望的定位、规划和反馈。

Conclusion: 将情感融入VLA自动驾驶框架可以有效提升系统与人类对齐的程度，在视觉定位、路径规划和情感反馈方面均优于现有方法，证明了情感感知对于下一代自动驾驶系统的重要性。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving (AD) systems increasingly adopt vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet they typically ignore the passenger's emotional state, which is central to comfort and AD acceptance. We introduce Open-Domain End-to-End (OD-E2E) autonomous driving, where an autonomous vehicle (AV) must interpret free-form natural-language commands, infer the emotion, and plan a physically feasible trajectory. We propose E3AD, an emotion-aware VLA framework that augments semantic understanding with two cognitively inspired components: a continuous Valenc-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) emotion model that captures tone and urgency from language, and a dual-pathway spatial reasoning module that fuses egocentric and allocentric views for human-like spatial cognition. A consistency-oriented training scheme, combining modality pretraining with preference-based alignment, further enforces coherence between emotional intent and driving actions. Across real-world datasets, E3AD improves visual grounding and waypoint planning and achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) VAD correlation for emotion estimation. These evaluation results show that injecting emotion into VLA-style driving yields more human-aligned grounding, planning, and feedback.

</details>


### [161] [MATANet: A Multi-context Attention and Taxonomy-Aware Network for Fine-Grained Underwater Recognition of Marine Species](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03729)
*Donghwan Lee,Byeongjin Kim,Geunhee Kim,Hyukjin Kwon,Nahyeon Maeng,Wooju Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MATANet框架，通过多尺度环境注意力建模和层级感知表示学习，实现海洋生物细粒度分类，在FathomNet2025等数据集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有海洋生物识别方法主要依赖目标或ROI中心表征，在复杂水下场景中因忽视环境上下文线索导致判别性能不足，亟需融合形态特征与环境信息的细粒度识别方法。

Method: 提出MATANet框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 多尺度环境注意力模块(MCEAM)，建模ROI与多尺度环境区域间的交叉注意力；2) 层级感知表示学习模块(HRLM)，利用分类层级结构作为辅助监督，正则化表示学习，鼓励层次化语义嵌入。

Result: 在FathomNet2025、LifeCLEF2015-Fish数据集上持续优于现有方法；在FAIR1M上验证了框架在非水下场景的泛化能力；在CVPR 2025 FGVC12 FathomNet 2025挑战赛中排名第一。

Conclusion: 联合建模生物外观、环境上下文和层级分类结构可学习更具判别性的细粒度表示，环境上下文在细粒度视觉识别中具有重要作用。

Abstract: Fine-grained recognition of marine organisms is important for ecological research, biodiversity monitoring, habitat conservation, and evidence-based policy-making. However, many existing approaches primarily rely on object- or ROI-centered representations. These limitations can reduce discriminative performance in challenging underwater scenes, where visually similar organisms often appear under diverse environmental conditions. To address these challenges, we propose MATANet (Multi-context Attention and Taxonomy-Aware Network), a framework for fine-grained taxonomic recognition of marine organisms. MATANet is motivated by expert taxonomic identification practices, in which both organism-level morphology and contextual cues are considered during recognition. The framework consists of two main components. First, the Multi-Context Environmental Attention Module (MCEAM) models cross-attention between the primary region of interest (ROI) and multi-scale surrounding environmental regions, thereby combining local morphological cues with habitat-level contextual information. Second, the Hierarchy-Aware Representation Learning Module (HRLM) uses taxonomic hierarchy as auxiliary supervision to regularize representation learning and encourage semantically structured embeddings across taxonomic levels. By jointly modeling organism appearance, environmental context, and taxonomic structure, MATANet learns more discriminative representations for fine-grained taxonomic recognition. Experiments on FathomNet2025 and LifeCLEF2015-Fish demonstrate that MATANet consistently improves recognition performance over existing methods. Additional experiments on FAIR1M further examine the applicability of the proposed framework beyond underwater imagery. Notably, MATANet ranked first in the FathomNet 2025 Challenge at the CVPR 2025 FGVC12 workshop.

</details>


### [162] [Multi-Scale Local Speculative Decoding for Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05149)
*Elia Peruzzo,Guillaume Sautière,Amirhossein Habibian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MuLo-SD通过多分辨率草稿与空间感知验证机制，将自回归图像生成加速最高达5倍，在保持语义一致性和感知质量的同时，超越了现有推测解码和并行解码基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归图像生成模型虽然表现出色，但其序列生成特性导致严重的延迟瓶颈。现有推测解码方法受限于token级模糊性和缺乏空间感知能力，加速效果有限。

Method: 提出多尺度局部推测解码框架：1) 低分辨率草稿模型配合上采样生成候选token；2) 高分辨率目标模型并行验证；3) 引入局部拒绝与重采样机制，在空间邻域内高效修正草稿错误，而非首次拒绝后即进行光栅扫描重采样。

Result: 在GenEval、DPG-Bench、MS-COCO 5k验证集上，MuLo-SD实现最高5倍加速，优于推测解码和并行解码基线；语义对齐和感知质量与基线持平；消融实验验证了上采样设计、概率池化、局部拒绝与重采样及邻域扩展的有效性。

Conclusion: MuLo-SD在图像合成推测解码领域达到了新SOTA，有效弥合了效率与保真度之间的差距。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models have achieved remarkable success in image synthesis, yet their sequential nature imposes significant latency constraints. Speculative Decoding offers a promising avenue for acceleration, but existing approaches are limited by token-level ambiguity and lack of spatial awareness. In this work, we introduce Multi-Scale Local Speculative Decoding (MuLo-SD), a novel framework that combines multi-resolution drafting with spatially informed verification to accelerate AR image generation. Our method leverages a low-resolution drafter paired with an up-sampling step to propose candidate image tokens, which are then verified in parallel by a high-resolution target model. Crucially, we incorporate a local rejection and resampling mechanism, enabling efficient correction of draft errors by focusing on spatial neighborhoods rather than raster-scan resampling after the first rejection. When integrated with parallel decoding resampling, MuLo-SD achieves substantial speedups -- up to $\mathbf{5\times}$ -- outperforming both speculative decoding and parallel decoding baselines in terms of acceleration, while maintaining comparable semantic alignment and perceptual quality. These results are validated using GenEval, DPG-Bench, and FID/HPSv2 on the MS-COCO 5k validation split. Extensive ablations highlight the impact of up-sampling design, probability pooling, and local rejection and resampling with neighborhood expansion. Our approach sets a new state-of-the-art in speculative decoding for image synthesis, bridging the gap between efficiency and fidelity. Project page is available at https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/mulo-sd-webpage/ .

</details>


### [163] [Video Individual Counting and Tracking from Moving Drones: A Benchmark and Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12500)
*Yaowu Fan,Jia Wan,Tao Han,Andy J. Ma,Wanli Ouyang,Antoni B. Chan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了MovingDroneCone++（最大规模的无人机视频密集人群计数与跟踪数据集）以及两个新方法：GD3A（基于全局密度图分解与组描述符关联的视频个体计数方法）和DVTrack（基于描述符投票的 pedestrians 跟踪方法）。在快速移动无人机拍摄的密集人群场景中，计数错误降低47.4%，跟踪准确率提升64.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多依赖固定摄像头数据集，场景覆盖有限，无法满足大规模场景下密集人群的分析需求。为填补这一空白，需要针对快速移动无人机拍摄的、覆盖不同飞行高度、角度和光照条件的密集人群视频数据进行研究。

Method: 1) GD3A：通过最优传输与自适应dustbin分数建立帧间像素级描述符对应，再利用组关联引导全局密度图分解为共享、流入和流出密度图。2) DVTrack：将描述符级匹配通过描述符投票转换为实例级关联。两种方法均基于每个pedestrian的组内多描述符关联结果，而非单一向量，组内匹配错误不影响最终计数和跟踪结果。

Result: 在密集人群和复杂运动的移动无人机视频上，计数错误降低47.4%，跟踪准确率提升64.6%。

Conclusion: 所提出的数据集和方法在无人机航拍密集人群计数与跟踪任务上显著优于现有方法，证明了组级多描述符关联策略在挑战性航空条件下的鲁棒性和有效性。

Abstract: Counting and tracking dense crowds in large-scale scenes is a highly practical yet challenging problem. Existing methods mostly rely on fixed-camera datasets with limited scene coverage, making them inadequate for crowd analysis in large-scale scenes. To bridge this gap, we introduce MovingDroneCrowd++, the largest video-level dataset dedicated to dense crowd counting and tracking with fast-moving drones, captured under diverse flight altitudes, camera angles, and illumination conditions. Existing methods, however, still fail to achieve satisfactory video individual counting or tracking performance under these challenging aerial conditions. To this end, we propose GD3A (Global Density map Decomposition via group-wise Descriptor Association), a video individual counting method that first establishes pixel-level correspondences between pedestrian descriptors across frames via optimal transport with an adaptive dustbin score. Then, group-wise association is adopted to guide the decomposition of the global density map into shared, inflow, and outflow density maps. We further introduce a pedestrian tracking method, DVTrack (Descriptor Voting Track), which converts descriptor-level matching into instance-level association through descriptor voting. Our methods rely on the association results of group-wise multiple descriptors for each pedestrian rather than a single vector. Since intra-group matching errors do not affect the final counting and tracking results, our methods are more robust in dense crowds and challenging aerial conditions. Experiments show that our methods achieve substantial gains in both crowd counting and tracking on moving-drone videos with dense crowds and complex motions, reducing counting error by 47.4% and improving tracking accuracy by 64.6%. Code, dataset, and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/fyw1999/MovingDroneCrowd.

</details>


### [164] [4DPC$^2$hat: Towards Dynamic Point Cloud Understanding with Failure-Aware Bootstrapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03890)
*Xindan Zhang,Weilong Yan,Yufei Shi,Xuerui Qiu,Tao He,Ying Li,Ming Li,Hehe Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了4DPC²hat，首个针对动态点云理解的多模态大语言模型，通过构建大规模跨模态数据集4DPC²hat-200K（含44K动态序列、700K帧、200K QA对），引入Mamba增强的时间推理模块以及失败感知的自举学习策略，在动作理解和时间推理上显著优于现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要关注静态点云对象，而动态点云序列理解尚未被充分探索，主要受限于缺乏大规模跨模态数据集以及难以在时空上下文中对运动进行建模。

Method: 1) 构建两阶段流水线：拓扑一致的4D点云构建和两级标题生成，产出44K动态序列和200K QA对；2) 提出Mamba增强的时间推理多模态大语言模型，捕获点云序列的长程依赖和动态模式；3) 提出失败感知的自举学习策略，迭代识别模型缺陷并生成针对性QA监督以强化推理能力。

Result: 4DPC²hat在动作理解和时间推理任务上相比现有模型取得显著提升，为4D动态点云理解建立了坚实基础。

Conclusion: 首个面向动态点云理解的多模态大语言模型，通过大规模数据集、Mamba时序建模和自举学习策略有效解决了动态点云理解中的关键挑战。

Abstract: Point clouds provide a compact and expressive representation of 3D objects, and have recently been integrated into multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods primarily focus on static objects, while understanding dynamic point cloud sequences remains largely unexplored. This limitation is mainly caused by the lack of large-scale cross-modal datasets and the difficulty of modeling motions in spatio-temporal contexts. To bridge this gap, we present 4DPC$^2$hat, the first MLLM tailored for dynamic point cloud understanding. To this end, we construct a large-scale cross-modal dataset 4DPC$^2$hat-200K via a meticulous two-stage pipeline consisting of topology-consistent 4D point construction and two-level captioning. The dataset contains over 44K dynamic object sequences, 700K point cloud frames, and 200K curated question-answer (QA) pairs, supporting inquiries about counting, temporal relationship, action, spatial relationship, and appearance. At the core of the framework, we introduce a Mamba-enhanced temporal reasoning MLLM to capture long-range dependencies and dynamic patterns among a point cloud sequence. Furthermore, we propose a failure-aware bootstrapping learning strategy that iteratively identifies model deficiencies and generates targeted QA supervision to continuously strengthen corresponding reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our 4DPC$^2$hat significantly improves action understanding and temporal reasoning compared with existing models, establishing a strong foundation for 4D dynamic point cloud understanding.

</details>


### [165] [PipeMFL-240K: A Large-scale Dataset and Benchmark for Object Detection in Pipeline Magnetic Flux Leakage Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07044)
