*Tianyi Qu,Songxiao Yang,Haolin Wang,Huadong Song,Xiaoting Guo,Wenguang Hu,Guanlin Liu,Honghe Chen,Yafei Ou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了 PipeMFL-240K，一个大规模、 meticulously 标注的管道磁通泄漏检测伪彩色图像数据集和基准，包含 249,320 张图像和 200,020 个边界框标注，覆盖 12 个类别，揭示了长尾分布、小目标和类内差异大等挑战，实验表明现有检测器仍有较大改进空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管深度学习在自动化 MFL 检测解释方面具有潜力，但缺乏大规模公开数据集和基准，导致公平比较和可重复评估困难，阻碍了可靠模型的进展。

Method: 构建了包含 249,320 张图像和 200,020 个高质量边界框标注的数据集，覆盖 12 个管道类别，来自约 1,530 km 的 12 条管道；使用最先进的物体检测器进行广泛实验以建立基线。

Result: 实验结果表明，现代检测器在处理 MFL 数据的固有特性（极端长尾分布、小目标、类内差异大）时仍存在困难，存在较大改进空间。

Conclusion: PipeMFL-240K 是首个该规模和范围的管道 MFL 检测公共数据集和基准，为高效管道诊断和维护规划提供了关键基础，有望加速 MFL 管道完整性评估领域的算法创新和可重复研究。

Abstract: Pipeline integrity is critical to industrial safety and environmental protection, with Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL) detection being a primary non-destructive testing technology. Despite the promise of deep learning for automating MFL interpretation, progress toward reliable models has been constrained by the absence of a large-scale public dataset and benchmark, making fair comparison and reproducible evaluation difficult. We introduce \textbf{PipeMFL-240K}, a large-scale, meticulously annotated dataset and benchmark for complex object detection in pipeline MFL pseudo-color images. PipeMFL-240K reflects real-world inspection complexity and poses several unique challenges: (i) an extremely long-tailed distribution over \textbf{12} categories, (ii) a high prevalence of tiny objects that often comprise only a handful of pixels and (iii) substantial intra-class variability. The dataset contains \textbf{249,320} images and \textbf{200,020} high-quality bounding-box annotations, collected from 12 pipelines spanning approximately \textbf{1,530} km. Extensive experiments are conducted with state-of-the-art object detectors to establish baselines. Results show that modern detectors still struggle with the intrinsic properties of MFL data, highlighting considerable headroom for improvement, while PipeMFL-240K provides a reliable and challenging testbed to drive future research. As the first public dataset and the first benchmark of this scale and scope for pipeline MFL inspection, it provides a critical foundation for efficient pipeline diagnostics as well as maintenance planning and is expected to accelerate algorithmic innovation and reproducible research in MFL-based pipeline integrity assessment.

</details>


### [166] [SAVAA: Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs via Step-wise Adaptive Visual Attention Amplification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13600)
*Jiacheng Zhang,Feng Liu,Chao Du,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SAVAA，一种自适应视觉注意力放大框架，通过视觉接地熵（VGE）估计幻觉风险，动态调整视觉注意力放大强度，有效缓解LVLM中的幻觉问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VAA方法使用固定的注意力放大因子，导致某些生成步骤放大不足（幻觉未解决）而另一些步骤放大过度（引入新幻觉）的双重失败模式。

Method: 提出SAVAA框架，包含两个核心组件：1）视觉接地熵（VGE），一种轻量级幻觉风险估计器，结合预测熵与视觉接地信息评估当前token的幻觉风险；2）基于VGE估计的风险自适应调整下一生成步骤的视觉注意力放大强度，高风险步骤使用强放大，低风险步骤使用弱放大。

Result: 在LLaVA-NeXT-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B和InternVL3.5-8B三个模型上，SAVAA在CHAIR、SHR和AMBER等幻觉基准上显著优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 自适应视觉注意力放大能够有效解决固定放大因子的双重失败模式，为视觉语言模型幻觉缓解提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: A line of recent training-free methods for mitigating hallucinations in large vision-language models (LVLMs) operates by amplifying attention to visual tokens during autoregressive generation within a single forward pass. We refer to this paradigm as visual attention amplification (VAA). In this paper, we identify a dual failure pattern in existing VAA methods caused by their use of a fixed amplification factor across generation steps: it can be too weak at some steps, leaving hallucinations unresolved, while too strong at others, introducing new hallucinations. Motivated by this finding, we propose Step-wise Adaptive Visual Attention Amplification (SAVAA), a new VAA framework that estimates hallucination risk for each generated token and uses the estimated risk to adaptively amplify visual attention at the next generation step. Specifically, we introduce Visual Grounding Entropy (VGE), a lightweight hallucination-risk estimator that augments predictive entropy with visual grounding, assigning higher risk to tokens that are uncertain, weakly grounded in the image, or both. Guided by VGE, SAVAA uses the estimated risk to calibrate the VAA factor for the next generation step, applying stronger amplification to higher-risk steps and weaker amplification to lower-risk steps. Across LLaVA-NeXT-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and InternVL3.5-8B, SAVAA significantly outperforms baseline methods on generative hallucination benchmarks such as CHAIR, SHR and AMBER. Code is available at: https://github.com/JiachengZ01/SAVVA.

</details>


### [167] [Multi-Turn Adaptive Prompting Attack on Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14399)
*In Chong Choi,Jiacheng Zhang,Feng Liu,Yiliao Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多轮自适应提示攻击（MAPA），通过文本-视觉交替攻击和跨轮迭代优化，成功提升了对大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的多轮越狱攻击成功率15-30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多轮越狱攻击主要针对纯文本大语言模型，如何有效将其扩展到视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）尚未被充分探索。此外，简单引入视觉输入反而会使多轮越狱更容易被防御。

Method: MAPA包含两层设计：(1) 轮内层面：每轮交替使用文本和视觉攻击动作以诱导最具恶意性的回复；(2) 跨轮层面：通过迭代式的来回精调来调整攻击轨迹，逐步放大回复的恶意性。

Result: 在LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-Vision-11B-Instruct和GPT-4o-mini上，MAPA相比现有最优方法将攻击成功率提升了15-30%。

Conclusion: MAPA通过两层次设计有效利用视觉模态特性，在保持攻击隐蔽性的同时显著提升了多轮越狱攻击的效果，揭示了当前LVLMs安全对齐的脆弱性。

Abstract: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have proven effective against text-only large language models (LLMs), where malicious content is gradually introduced to bypass safety alignment. However, effectively extending such attacks to large vision-language models (LVLMs) remains underexplored. In this paper, we find that naively incorporating visual inputs can make multi-turn jailbreaks easier to defend against; for example, overly malicious visual content will easily trigger the defense mechanism in safety-aligned LVLMs, resulting in more conservative responses. Based on this finding, we propose multi-turn adaptive prompting attack (MAPA) that 1) at each turn, alternates text-vision attack actions to elicit the most malicious response; and 2) across turns, adjusts the attack trajectory through iterative back-and-forth refinement to gradually amplify response maliciousness. This two-level design enables MAPA to consistently outperform state-of-the-art methods, improving attack success rates by 15-30% on recent benchmarks against LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-Vision-11B-Instruct and GPT-4o-mini. Our code is available at: https://github.com/thomaschoi143/MAPA.

</details>


### [168] [GASS: Geometry-Aware Spherical Sampling for Disentangled Diversity Enhancement in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17200)
*Ye Zhu,Kaleb S. Newman,Johannes F. Lutzeyer,Adriana Romero-Soriano,Michal Drozdzal,Olga Russakovsky*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出几何感知球面采样（GASS），通过将CLIP嵌入中的多样性分解为与提示相关的语义方向和与提示无关的正交方向（如背景），并在两个方向上扩大几何投影分布来增强T2I生成多样性，实验证明该方法在保持图像保真度和语义对齐的同时有效提升多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的T2I模型虽然在语义对齐上表现良好，但生成的图像多样性不足。现有方法主要依赖基于熵的引导来增加样本差异性，缺乏对多样性来源的显式控制。

Method: 提出GASS方法：(1) 将CLIP嵌入中的多样性度量分解为两个正交方向——文本嵌入方向（捕获与提示相关的语义变化）和与之正交的方向（捕获提示无关的变化，如背景）；(2) 沿着这两个轴增加生成图像嵌入的几何投影扩散；(3) 通过沿生成轨迹的扩展预测来引导T2I采样过程。

Result: 在多个冻结T2I骨干网络（U-Net和DiT，扩散和流匹配）和基准测试上验证了该方法在解耦多样性增强方面的有效性，且对图像保真度和语义对齐的影响最小。

Conclusion: 通过几何视角显式控制多样性的不同来源（提示相关和提示无关），可以在不牺牲图像质量和语义一致性的前提下有效提升T2I生成多样性。

Abstract: Despite high semantic alignment, modern text-to-image (T2I) generative models still struggle to synthesize diverse images from a given prompt. In this work, we enhance the T2I diversity through a geometric lens. Unlike most existing methods that rely primarily on entropy-based guidance to increase sample dissimilarity, we introduce Geometry-Aware Spherical Sampling (GASS) to enhance diversity by explicitly controlling both prompt-dependent and prompt-independent sources of variation. Specifically, we decompose the diversity measure in CLIP embeddings using two orthogonal directions: the text embedding, which captures semantic variation related to the prompt, and an identified orthogonal direction that captures prompt-independent variation (e.g., backgrounds). Based on this decomposition, GASS increases the geometric projection spread of generated image embeddings along both axes and guides the T2I sampling process via expanded predictions along the generation trajectory. Our experiments on different frozen T2I backbones (U-Net and DiT, diffusion and flow) and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of disentangled diversity enhancement with minimal impact on image fidelity and semantic alignment.

</details>


### [169] [JAEGER: Joint 3D Audio-Visual Grounding and Reasoning in Simulated Physical Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18527)
*Zhan Liu,Changli Tang,Yuxin Wang,Zhiyuan Zhu,Youjun Chen,Yiwen Shao,Tianzi Wang,Lei Ke,Zengrui Jin,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JAEGER 是一个将音视频大语言模型扩展到3D空间的框架，通过融合RGB-D观测和多声道一阶环境声，结合神经强度向量（Neural IV）实现空间定位与推理；配套的 SpatialSceneQA 基准包含6.1万条指令微调样本，实验表明该方法在空间感知任务上全面超越2D基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频大语言模型仅支持2D感知（RGB视频+单声道音频），无法实现3D环境中的可靠声源定位与空间推理，存在维度不匹配的根本性局限。

Method: 提出JAEGER框架：（1）融合RGB-D观测与多声道一阶环境声作为输入；（2）提出神经强度向量（Neural IV）作为学习型空间音频表示，编码鲁棒的方向线索以增强到达方向（DOA）估计，尤其在多源重叠的恶劣声学场景下有效；（3）构建SpatialSceneQA基准（6.1万条指令微调样本），基于模拟物理环境生成。

Result: 在多种空间感知与推理任务上，JAEGER一致性地超越了基于2D的基线方法，验证了显式3D建模的必要性。

Conclusion: 将音视频大语言模型扩展到3D空间是提升AI在物理环境中能力的必要方向，JAEGER通过多模态3D融合与Neural IV表示有效解决了这一挑战。

Abstract: Current audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) are predominantly restricted to 2D perception, relying on RGB video and monaural audio. This design choice introduces a fundamental dimensionality mismatch that precludes reliable source localization and spatial reasoning in complex 3D environments. We address this limitation by presenting JAEGER, a framework that extends AV-LLMs to 3D space, to enable joint spatial grounding and reasoning through the integration of RGB-D observations and multi-channel first-order ambisonics. A core contribution of our work is the neural intensity vector (Neural IV), a learned spatial audio representation that encodes robust directional cues to enhance direction-of-arrival estimation, even in adverse acoustic scenarios with overlapping sources. To facilitate large-scale training and systematic evaluation, we propose SpatialSceneQA, a benchmark of 61k instruction-tuning samples curated from simulated physical environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently surpasses 2D-centric baselines across diverse spatial perception and reasoning tasks, underscoring the necessity of explicit 3D modelling for advancing AI in physical environments. Our source code, pre-trained model checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://github.com/liuzhan22/JAEGER.

</details>


### [170] [Structure-Aware Text Recognition for Ancient Greek Critical Editions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02803)
*Nicolas Angleraud,Antonia Karamolegkou,Benoît Sagot,Thibault Clérice*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLMs）在复杂历史学术文献（古希腊文评注版）中的结构感知文本识别能力，构建了大规模合成语料库和真实扫描基准，发现现有VLM在零样本场景下显著弱于传统软件，但Qwen3VL-8B在真实扫描上达到1.0%的中位字符错误率，展现了潜力与局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在端到端文档理解方面取得了进展，但面对具有密集参考层级和大量边注注释的历史学术文本（如古希腊文评注版）时，其复杂布局语义的解读能力尚不清楚，缺乏相关基准和评估。

Method: 构建了两个新资源：①从TEI/XML源生成含可控排版和布局变化的18.5万页合成语料；②跨越一个多世纪编辑和排版实践的真实扫描评注版基准。基于这些数据集，在零样本和微调设置下评估了三个最先进的VLM。

Result: 零样本场景下，大多数VLM显著弱于现有成熟软件；Qwen3VL-8B模型在真实扫描上达到最优，中位字符错误率为1.0%。

Conclusion: 当前VLM架构在处理高度结构化的历史文档时存在实质性局限，但同时也展现出未来发展的潜力，为结构感知的复杂学术文档识别提供了方向。

Abstract: Recent advances in visual language models (VLMs) have transformed end-to-end document understanding. However, their ability to interpret the complex layout semantics of historical scholarly texts remains limited. This paper investigates structure-aware text recognition for Ancient Greek critical editions, which have dense reference hierarchies and extensive marginal annotations. We introduce two novel resources: (i) a large-scale synthetic corpus of 185,000 page images generated from TEI/XML sources with controlled typographic and layout variation, and (ii) a curated benchmark of real scanned editions spanning more than a century of editorial and typographic practices. Using these datasets, we evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs under both zero-shot and fine-tuning regimes. Our experiments reveal substantial limitations in current VLM architectures when confronted with highly structured historical documents. In zero-shot settings, most models significantly underperform compared to established off-the-shelf software. Nevertheless, the Qwen3VL-8B model achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a median Character Error Rate of 1.0\% on real scans. These results highlight both the current shortcomings and the future potential of VLMs for structure-aware recognition of complex scholarly documents.

</details>


### [171] [MOO: A Multi-view Oriented Observations Dataset for Viewpoint Analysis in Cattle Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04314)
*William Grolleau,Achraf Chaouch,Astrid Sabourin,Guillaume Lapouge,Catherine Achard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出大规模合成数据集MOO（多视角定向观测），包含1000头牛从128个均匀采样视角拍摄的128,000张标注图像，用于研究航空-地面视角下动物再识别的几何变化影响，发现存在关键仰角阈值，超过该阈值模型对未见视角泛化能力显著提升，并在四个真实数据集上验证了合成几何先验的迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集缺乏精确角度标注，无法系统分析视角变化（尤其航空-地面视角间剧烈高度变化）对动物再识别的影响。

Method: 构建MOO合成数据集，包含1000头牛从128个均匀采样视角的128,000张标注图像；利用该数据集量化仰角影响并识别关键仰角阈值；在零样本和监督设置下验证合成几何先验向真实数据集的迁移能力。

Result: 识别出关键仰角阈值，超过该阈值模型对未见视角的泛化能力显著提升；在四个真实牛数据集上验证了合成几何先验在零样本和监督设置下的性能增益。

Conclusion: MOO数据集与分析为跨视角动物再识别的未来模型开发奠定了基础，合成几何先验能有效弥合领域鸿沟。

Abstract: Animal re-identification (ReID) faces critical challenges due to viewpoint variations, particularly in Aerial-Ground (AG-ReID) settings where models must match individuals across drastic elevation changes. However, existing datasets lack the precise angular annotations required to systematically analyze these geometric variations. To address this, we introduce the Multi-view Oriented Observation (MOO) dataset, a large-scale synthetic AG-ReID dataset of $1,000$ cattle individuals captured from $128$ uniformly sampled viewpoints ($128,000$ annotated images). Using this controlled dataset, we quantify the influence of elevation and identify a critical elevation threshold, above which models generalize significantly better to unseen views. Finally, we validate the transferability to real-world applications in both zero-shot and supervised settings, demonstrating performance gains across four real-world cattle datasets and confirming that synthetic geometric priors effectively bridge the domain gap. Collectively, this dataset and analysis lay the foundation for future model development in cross-view animal ReID. MOO is publicly available at https://github.com/TurtleSmoke/MOO.

</details>


### [172] [X-GS: An Extensible Framework for Perceiving and Thinking via 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09632)
*Yueen Ma,Zenglin Xu,Irwin King*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: X-GS是一个可扩展的3D高斯溅射框架，包含感知器（统一多种3DGS技术实现实时在线SLAM和语义蒸馏）和思考器（集成多模态模型完成下游任务）两个核心组件，在多个基准测试中展现了高效性和新的多模态能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS方法大多孤立运行，专注于特定领域，缺乏统一框架来整合多种3DGS技术并与多模态模型协同完成下游任务。

Method: 提出X-GS框架，包含X-GS-Perceiver（利用视觉基础模型改进在线SLAM，采用三种关键机制加速语义蒸馏）和X-GS-Thinker（基于对比式和生成式视觉语言模型，利用感知器的语义高斯溅射实现3D视觉定位和场景描述）。

Result: 在多个不同基准测试上验证了X-GS框架的效率和新的多模态能力。

Conclusion: X-GS通过解耦感知与推理，成功统一了多种3DGS技术并实现了与多模态模型的无缝对接，为3D场景理解和交互提供了可扩展的统一框架。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful technique for novel view synthesis, subsequently extending into numerous spatial AI applications. However, most existing 3DGS methods operate in isolation, focusing on specific domains. In this paper, we introduce X-GS, an extensible framework consisting of two major components. The X-GS-\textit{Perceiver} unifies a broad range of 3DGS techniques to enable real-time online SLAM with semantic distillation. The X-GS-\textit{Thinker} accommodates multimodal models, enabling them to seamlessly interface with the \textit{Perceiver} to complete downstream tasks. In our implementation of X-GS, the \textit{Perceiver} leverages the latest vision foundation models to improve online SLAM performance and employs three key mechanisms to accelerate semantic distillation. The \textit{Thinker} can be built upon both contrastive and generative vision-language models and utilizes the \textit{Perceiver}'s semantic Gaussian splats to unlock capabilities such as 3D visual grounding and scene captioning. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate the efficiency and newly unlocked multimodal capabilities of the X-GS framework.

</details>


### [173] [SDF-Net: Structure-Aware Disentangled Feature Learning for Opticall-SAR Ship Re-identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12588)
*Furui Chen,Han Wang,Yuhan Sun,Jianing You,Yixuan Lv,Zhuang Zhou,Hong Tan,Shengyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SDF-Net，通过引入几何一致性约束和结构感知解耦特征学习，有效地解决了光学与SAR图像间跨模态船舶重识别的辐射差异问题，在HOSS-ReID数据集上取得了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学与SAR图像之间存在严重的辐射差异（被动光学成像与主动雷达 sensing 之间的根本差异），现有方法主要依赖统计分布对齐或语义匹配，忽略了船舶作为刚性物体在不同模态下几何结构保持稳定这一关键物理先验。

Method: 基于ViT骨干网络，提出结构感知解耦特征学习网络（SDF-Net）：(1) 引入结构一致性约束，从中间层提取尺度不变梯度能量统计量，以鲁棒地对齐表征；(2) 在末端将学习到的表征解耦为模态不变的身份特征和模态特定的属性特征；(3) 通过无参数的加性残差融合整合解耦后的线索以增强判别力。

Result: 在HOSS-ReID数据集上的大量实验表明，SDF-Net consistently优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 利用船舶的几何结构稳定性这一物理先验，通过结构感知的解耦特征学习，可以有效克服跨模态辐射差异，提升光学-SAR船舶重识别性能。代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: Cross-modal ship re-identification (ReID) between optical and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery is fundamentally challenged by the severe radiometric discrepancy between passive optical imaging and coherent active radar sensing. While existing approaches primarily rely on statistical distribution alignment or semantic matching, they often overlook a critical physical prior: ships are rigid objects whose geometric structures remain stable across sensing modalities, whereas texture appearance is highly modality-dependent. In this work, we propose SDF-Net, a Structure-Aware Disentangled Feature Learning Network that systematically incorporates geometric consistency into optical--SAR ship ReID. Built upon a ViT backbone, SDF-Net introduces a structure consistency constraint that extracts scale-invariant gradient energy statistics from intermediate layers to robustly anchor representations against radiometric variations. At the terminal stage, SDF-Net disentangles the learned representations into modality-invariant identity features and modality-specific characteristics. These decoupled cues are then integrated through a parameter-free additive residual fusion, effectively enhancing discriminative power. Extensive experiments on the HOSS-ReID dataset demonstrate that SDF-Net consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The code and trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/cfrfree/SDF-Net.

</details>


### [174] [Getting to the Point: Pointing Improves LVLMs at Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21746)
*Simone Alghisi,Massimo Rizzoli,Seyed Mahed Mousavi,Giuseppe Riccardi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于指向（pointing）的方法如何提升大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的视觉推理能力，聚焦于零样本计数任务。实验表明，Point-then-Count（PtC）方法通过让模型首先生成目标对象的点坐标再预测数量，在准确率上优于多种微调与免训练方法，且94%以上的预测点正确接地。机制分析显示增益源于坐标中的空间信息，但存在空间偏差；PtC还能改善分布外泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于指向的方法虽被证明能提升LVLM的视觉推理性能，但其内部机制尚不明确。本文旨在探究指向方法为何以及如何提升LVLM的视觉推理能力，特别是在零样本计数任务中。

Method: 在零样本计数任务中，对多种SOTA LVLM进行多种微调与免训练方法的实验，重点比较Point-then-Count（PtC）方法——模型首先生成目标对象的点坐标，再基于这些点预测数量。同时进行机制分析，包括接地性能评估（F1-score）和空间偏差分析。

Result: PtC在评估方法中准确率最高，预测点正确接地率超过94%（基于F1-score）。机制分析表明增益来源于预测坐标编码的空间信息，但接地性能在不同图像区域存在空间偏差。PtC在合成数据和真实数据上均改善了分布外泛化。

Conclusion: 指向方法通过空间坐标信息提升LVLM的视觉推理能力，坐标有助于模型更好地进行计数；但模型存在空间偏差，未来需关注如何缓解这一问题。

Abstract: Pointing-based methods decompose complex tasks as sequential grounding and reasoning steps. Given a query, the model first grounds the relevant objects by generating their coordinates, and then predicts an answer conditioned on these points. While this approach has been shown to increase the performance of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), it remains unclear why and how it improves the models' visual reasoning. In this work, we evaluate pointing-based methods in the task of zero-shot counting in visual scenes. We experiment with multiple fine-tuning and training-free approaches on state-of-the-art LVLMs, and compare them with Point-then-Count (PtC), where models first generate point coordinates for the target objects and then predict their count. Our results show that PtC achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated approaches, with predicted points correctly grounded in the image in more than 94% of cases (based on F1-score). Mechanistic analyses show that gains arise from spatial information encoded in the predicted coordinates. Nevertheless, grounding performance varies across image regions, revealing spatial biases. Finally, the results indicate that PtC improves out-of-distribution generalization on both synthetic and real data, suggesting the potential of coordinates to help LVLMs improve their counting skills.

</details>


### [175] [RHO: Robust Holistic OSM-Based Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27758)
*Junwei Zheng,Ruize Dai,Ruiping Liu,Zichao Zeng,Yufan Chen,Fangjinhua Wang,Kunyu Peng,Kailun Yang,Jiaming Zhang,Rainer Stiefelhagen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了面向全景图与OpenStreetMap的度量交叉视角地理定位任务，构建了包含270万+图像的大规模基准数据集CV-RHO，并设计了带有Split-Undistort-Merge模块和位置-朝向融合机制的RHO模型，相比现有方法性能提升高达20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有度量交叉视角地理定位（MCVGL）方法多基于针孔相机图像和卫星图像，缺乏对全景图像和OpenStreetMap（OSM）的鲁棒性研究，且缺少大规模、涵盖多种天气/光照条件及传感器噪声的基准数据集。

Method: 1) 构建CV-RHO数据集（270万+图像，含多种天气、光照条件和传感器噪声）；2) 提出RHO模型，采用双分支Pin-Pan架构；设计Split-Undistort-Merge (SUM)模块处理全景畸变；引入Position-Orientation Fusion (POF)机制提升定位精度。

Result: 在CV-RHO数据集上，RHO模型相比当前最先进基线方法实现了高达20%的性能提升，证明了数据集和模型的有效性。

Conclusion: 全景图与OSM结合可用于鲁棒的度量交叉视图地理定位，CV-RHO数据集和RHO模型为该方向提供了有效基准和解决方案。

Abstract: Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization (MCVGL) aims to estimate the 3-DoF camera pose (position and heading) by matching ground and satellite images. In this work, instead of pinhole and satellite images, we study robust MCVGL using holistic panoramas and OpenStreetMap (OSM). To this end, we establish a large-scale MCVGL benchmark dataset, CV-RHO, with over 2.7M images under different weather and lighting conditions, as well as sensor noise. Furthermore, we propose a model termed RHO with a two-branch Pin-Pan architecture for accurate visual localization. A Split-Undistort-Merge (SUM) module is introduced to address the panoramic distortion, and a Position-Orientation Fusion (POF) mechanism is designed to enhance the localization accuracy. Extensive experiments prove the value of our CV-RHO dataset and the effectiveness of the RHO model, with a significant performance gain up to 20% compared with the state-of-the-art baselines. Project page: https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/RHO.

</details>


### [176] [Detecting Unknown Objects via Energy-based Separation for Open World Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29954)
*Jun-Woo Heo,Keonhee Park,Gyeong-Moon Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DEUS是一个针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）的新框架，通过ETF-子空间未知分离（EUS）和基于能量的已知区分（EKD）损失，分别解决了未知物体检测能力不足和记忆回放中新旧类知识干扰的问题，在OWOD基准上取得了优异的未知检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OWOD方法严重依赖检测器已知类预测来检测未知物体，导致难以有效学习和识别未知物体表征；同时记忆回放虽缓解了旧类遗忘，但常牺牲新学类的知识。

Method: 提出DEUS框架，包含两个核心组件：1) ETF-子空间未知分离（EUS），利用等角紧框架（ETF）的几何特性构建正交子空间，通过两个空间的能量更清晰分离已知和未知物体表征；2) 基于能量的已知区分（EKD）损失，强制分离新旧分类器，减少记忆回放中前后类别的知识干扰。

Result: 在OWOD基准上验证，DEUS在未知检测任务中取得显著性能提升，同时保持了竞争力的已知类性能。

Conclusion: DEUS通过能量分离策略有效解决了OWOD中未知物体检测和类别间知识干扰两大核心挑战。

Abstract: In this work, we tackle the problem of Open World Object Detection (OWOD). This challenging scenario requires the detector to incrementally learn to classify known objects without forgetting while identifying unknown objects without supervision. Previous OWOD methods have enhanced the unknown discovery process and employed memory replay to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. However, since existing methods heavily rely on the detector's known class predictions for detecting unknown objects, they struggle to effectively learn and recognize unknown object representations. Moreover, while memory replay mitigates forgetting of old classes, it often sacrifices the knowledge of newly learned classes. To resolve these limitations, we propose DEUS (Detecting Unknowns via energy-based Separation), a novel framework that addresses the challenges of Open World Object Detection. DEUS consists of Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF)-Subspace Unknown Separation (EUS) and an Energy-based Known Distinction (EKD) loss. EUS leverages ETF-based geometric properties to create orthogonal subspaces, enabling cleaner separation between known and unknown object representations. Unlike prior energy-based approaches that consider only the known space, EUS utilizes energies from both spaces to better capture distinct patterns of unknown objects. Furthermore, EKD loss enforces the separation between previous and current classifiers, thus minimizing knowledge interference between previous and newly learned classes during memory replay. We thoroughly validate DEUS on OWOD benchmarks, demonstrating outstanding performance improvements in unknown detection while maintaining competitive known class performance.

</details>


### [177] [ReSpinQuant: Efficient Layer-Wise LLM Quantization via Subspace Residual Rotation Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11080)
*Suyoung Kim,Sunghyun Wee,Hyeonjin Kim,Kyomin Hwang,Hyunho Lee,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReSpinQuant提出了一种基于残差子空间旋转的量化框架，通过离线激活旋转融合和基匹配，在保持层间适应高表达性的同时，消除了在线计算开销，在W4A4和W3A3量化上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局旋转方法将激活旋转融合到注意力块和FFN块中实现了推理效率，但由于跨层共享单一可学习旋转矩阵，表达能力受限；层间变换方法虽然精度更高，但无法将旋转矩阵融合到权重中，需要在线计算，带来显著开销。因此需要一种既能保持层间适应高表达性，又能实现旋转融合以消除在线开销的方法。

Method: 提出ReSpinQuant框架，利用离线激活旋转融合和基于残差子空间旋转的基匹配（basis matching）技术，实现层间适应的高表达性与低推理开销的统一。

Result: 在W4A4和W3A3量化设置下，ReSpinQuant达到最先进性能，超越全局旋转方法，并与计算昂贵的层间方法精度持平，同时仅引入可忽略的推理开销。

Conclusion: ReSpinQuant通过残差子空间旋转设计，成功解决了层间PTQ方法中表达性与效率之间的矛盾，为大语言模型的后训练量化提供了一种兼顾精度与速度的有效方案。

Abstract: Rotation-based Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising solution for mitigating activation outliers in the quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs). Global rotation methods achieve inference efficiency by fusing activation rotations into attention and FFN blocks, but suffer from limited expressivity as they are constrained to use a single learnable rotation matrix across all layers. To tackle this, layer-wise transformation methods emerged, achieving superior accuracy through localized adaptation. However, layer-wise methods cannot fuse activation rotation matrices into weights, requiring online computations and causing significant overhead. In this paper, we propose ReSpinQuant, a quantization framework that resolves such overhead by leveraging offline activation rotation fusion and matching basis using efficient residual subspace rotation. This design reconciles the high expressivity of layer-wise adaptation with only negligible inference overhead. Extensive experiments on W4A4 and W3A3 quantization demonstrate that ReSpinQuant achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming global rotation methods and matching the accuracy of computationally expensive layer-wise methods with minimal overhead.

</details>


### [178] [A Multi-Agent Feedback System for Detecting and Describing News Events in Satellite Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12772)
*Madeline Anderson,Mikhail Klassen,Ash Hoover,Kerri Cahoy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SkyScraper，一种迭代式多智能体工作流，通过地理编码新闻文章并为卫星图像序列合成描述，构建了包含5,000个序列的多时相事件描述数据集，相比传统方法发现的事件数量提升5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感领域缺乏多时相事件描述数据集（至少每序列两张图像），因为从卫星图像中搜索可见事件以及标注多时相序列既费时又费力。

Method: 提出SkyScraper，一种迭代式多智能体工作流，通过对新闻文章进行地理编码，并为对应的卫星图像序列合成描述，自动构建多时相描述数据集。

Result: SkyScraper相比传统地理编码方法发现的事件数量提升5倍，构建了包含5,000个序列的多时相描述数据集。

Conclusion: 智能体反馈是发现卫星图像中新的多时相事件的有效策略，该方法还可支持新闻报道和调查工作。

Abstract: Changes in satellite imagery often occur over multiple time steps. Despite the emergence of bi-temporal change captioning datasets, there is a lack of multi-temporal event captioning datasets (at least two images per sequence) in remote sensing. This gap exists because (1) searching for visible events in satellite imagery and (2) labeling multi-temporal sequences require significant time and labor. To address these challenges, we present SkyScraper, an iterative multi-agent workflow that geocodes news articles and synthesizes captions for corresponding satellite image sequences. Our experiments show that SkyScraper successfully finds 5x more events than traditional geocoding methods, demonstrating that agentic feedback is an effective strategy for surfacing new multi-temporal events in satellite imagery. We apply our framework to a large database of global news articles, curating a new multi-temporal captioning dataset with 5,000 sequences. By automatically identifying imagery related to news events, our work also supports journalism and reporting efforts.

</details>


### [179] [PrecisionCUA: Iterative Visual Refinement for Pixel-Precise Cursor Grounding in Code Editors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13019)
*Himangi Mittal,Gaurav Mittal,Nelson Daniel Troncoso,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了编码界面中像素级光标定位问题，提出了一种基于迭代视觉反馈的闭环接地机制，通过多轮精确定位替代单次坐标预测，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CUA方法在密集编码界面（如VS Code、Cursor）中依赖单次坐标预测，缺乏纠错机制，无法满足子像素级精度要求，导致在复杂IDE元素交互中频繁失败。

Method: 提出迭代精炼流程：智能体根据先前尝试的视觉反馈，逐步修正位移误差并适应动态UI变化，形成闭环接地机制，实现自纠正和多轮逼近目标元素。

Result: 在Claude、Qwen、GPT上评估，多轮精炼方法在点击精度和任务成功率上均显著超越当前最先进的单次预测模型。

Conclusion: 迭代视觉推理是构建可靠软件工程智能体的关键组件，为下一代CUA系统提供了重要方向。

Abstract: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) fundamentally rely on graphical user interface (GUI) grounding to translate language instructions into executable screen actions, but editing-level grounding in dense coding interfaces (such as VS Code and Cursor), where sub-pixel accuracy is required to interact with dense IDE elements, remains underexplored. Existing approaches typically rely on single-shot coordinate prediction, which lacks a mechanism for error correction and often fails in high-density interfaces. In this technical report, we conduct an empirical study of pixel-precise cursor localization in coding environments. Instead of a single-step execution, our agent engages in an iterative refinement process, utilizing visual feedback from previous attempts to reach the target element. This closed-loop grounding mechanism allows the agent to self-correct displacement errors and adapt to dynamic UI changes. We evaluate our approach across Claude, Qwen, and GPT on a suite of complex coding benchmarks, demonstrating that multi-turn refinement significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-shot models in both click precision and overall task success rate. Our results suggest that iterative visual reasoning is a critical component for the next generation of reliable software engineering agents. Code: https://github.com/microsoft/precision-cua-bench/tree/main.

</details>


### [180] [UDM-GRPO: Stable and Efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization for Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18518)
*Jiaqi Wang,Haoge Deng,Ting Pan,Yang Liu,Chengyuan Wang,Fan Zhang,Yonggang Qi,Xinlong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出UDM-GRPO框架，首次将强化学习与均匀离散扩散模型（UDM）结合，通过将最终干净样本作为动作、利用前向过程重建轨迹等关键策略，解决了朴素GRPO在离散扩散模型中训练不稳定、性能提升有限的问题，在T2I任务上取得SOTA结果（GenEval从69%到96%，PickScore从20.46到23.81，OCR准确率从8%到57%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UDM作为离散生成模型的新范式，与强化学习的结合尚未被探索；直接应用GRPO会导致训练不稳定和性能收益有限。

Method: 提出UDM-GRPO框架，核心包括：(i) 将最终干净样本作为动作信号，提供更准确稳定的优化信号；(ii) 通过扩散前向过程重建轨迹，更好地对齐概率路径与预训练分布；(iii) 引入Reduced-Step和CFG-Free策略提升训练效率。

Result: 在多个T2I任务上显著提升：GenEval从69%提升至96%，PickScore从20.46提升至23.81，均达到离散和连续设置下的SOTA；OCR基准测试准确率从8%提升至57%。

Conclusion: UDM-GRPO成功实现了离散扩散模型与强化学习的有效集成，验证了该框架的泛化能力，在多项生成任务中取得了领先性能。

Abstract: Uniform Discrete Diffusion Model (UDM) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for discrete generative modeling; however, its integration with reinforcement learning remains largely unexplored. We observe that naively applying GRPO to UDM leads to training instability and marginal performance gains. To address this, we propose UDM-GRPO, the first framework to integrate UDM with RL. Our method is guided by two key insights: (i) treating the final clean sample as the action provides more accurate and stable optimization signals; and (ii) reconstructing trajectories via the diffusion forward process better aligns probability paths with the pretraining distribution. Additionally, we introduce two strategies, Reduced-Step and CFG-Free, to further improve training efficiency. UDM-GRPO significantly improves base model performance across multiple T2I tasks. Notably, GenEval accuracy improves from $69\%$ to $96\%$ and PickScore increases from $20.46$ to $23.81$, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both continuous and discrete settings. On the OCR benchmark, accuracy rises from $8\%$ to $57\%$, further validating the generalization ability of our method. Code is available at https://github.com/Yovecent/UDM-GRPO.

</details>


### [181] [Causal Disentanglement-Inspired Degradation Representation Learning for Full-Reference Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.21654)
*Zhen Zhang,Jielei Chu,Tian Zhang,Lin Ma,Fengmao Lv,Weide Liu,Tianrui Li,Yuming Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于因果推断和去耦表示学习的新型全参考图像质量评估（FR-IQA）范式，通过将退化估计视为因果解缠过程，利用内容不变性解耦退化与内容表征，并引入视觉掩蔽模块建模内容与退化特征的因果关系，最终在监督、少标签和无标签设置下均实现竞争性能，且在跨域泛化上优于现有无训练FR-IQA模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于深度网络的FR-IQA模型通常采用参考图像与失真图像深度特征逐对比较的方式，缺乏对退化过程因果结构的建模，难以在跨域、少数据场景下有效泛化。

Method: (1) 利用参考图像与失真图像之间的内容不变性，解耦退化表征与内容表征；(2) 受人类视觉掩蔽效应启发，设计掩蔽模块建模图像内容与退化特征之间的因果关系，提取受内容影响的退化特征；(3) 通过有监督回归或无标签降维方法从退化特征预测质量分数。

Result: 在标准IQA基准上，在全监督、少标签和无标签三种设置下均取得高度竞争性能；在水下、放射线、医学、中子及屏幕内容等非标准自然图像域中，因无需标注数据即可进行场景特定训练，展现出优于现有无训练FR-IQA模型的跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 基于因果推断的去耦表示学习范式为FR-IQA提供了一种新思路，有效缓解了传统特征比较方法在数据稀缺场景下的局限性，具有良好的跨域迁移潜力。

Abstract: Existing deep network-based full-reference image quality assessment (FR-IQA) models typically work by performing pairwise comparisons of deep features from the reference and distorted images. In this paper, we approach this problem from a different perspective and propose a novel FR-IQA paradigm based on causal inference and decoupled representation learning. Unlike typical feature comparison-based FR-IQA models, our approach formulates degradation estimation as a causal disentanglement process guided by intervention on latent representations. We first decouple degradation and content representations by exploiting the content invariance between the reference and distorted images. Second, inspired by the human visual masking effect, we design a masking module to model the causal relationship between image content and degradation features, thereby extracting content-influenced degradation features from distorted images. Finally, quality scores are predicted from these degradation features using either supervised regression or label-free dimensionality reduction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves highly competitive performance on standard IQA benchmarks across fully supervised, few-label, and label-free settings. Furthermore, we evaluate the approach on diverse non-standard natural image domains with scarce data, including underwater, radiographic, medical, neutron, and screen-content images. Benefiting from its ability to perform scenario-specific training and prediction without labeled IQA data, our method exhibits superior cross-domain generalization compared to existing training-free FR-IQA models.

</details>


### [182] [Beyond Chain-of-Thought: Rewrite as a Universal Interface for Generative Multimodal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22280)
*Peixi Wu,Ke Mei,Feipeng Ma,Bosong Chai,Zhibin Lan,Chenxi Zhao,Shannan Yan,Jie Chen,Zhangchi Hu,Yansong Peng,Bo Lin,Junjie Zhou,Dacheng Yin,Tianyi Wang,Fengyun Rao,Jing Lyu,Hebei Li,Xiaoyan Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RIME框架，通过检索友好的重写和跨模态对齐，在减少推理长度的同时提升多模态嵌入性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的推理驱动生成式多模态嵌入在检索场景中存在CoT推理冗余和语义歧义问题。

Method: 提出RIME框架，包含：(1) 检索友好的重写机制；(2) 跨模态对齐(CMA)桥接生成与判别嵌入空间；(3) 精炼强化学习(Refine-RL)以判别嵌入作为语义锚点指导重写优化。

Result: 在MMEB-V2、MRMR和UVRB三个基准上显著优于现有生成式嵌入模型，同时大幅缩短推理长度。

Conclusion: RIME通过重写驱动的统一框架有效解决了生成式多模态嵌入的冗余和歧义问题，实现了效率与精度的平衡。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a promising foundation for universal multimodal embeddings. Recent studies have shown that reasoning-driven generative multimodal embeddings can outperform discriminative embeddings on several embedding tasks. However, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning tends to generate redundant thinking steps and introduce semantic ambiguity in the summarized answers in broader retrieval scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Rewrite-driven Multimodal Embedding (RIME), a unified framework that jointly optimizes generation and embedding through a retrieval-friendly rewrite. Meanwhile, we present the Cross-Mode Alignment (CMA) to bridge the generative and discriminative embedding spaces, enabling flexible mutual retrieval to trade off efficiency and accuracy. Based on this, we also introduce Refine Reinforcement Learning (Refine-RL) that treats discriminative embeddings as stable semantic anchors to guide the rewrite optimization. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2, MRMR and UVRB demonstrate that RIME substantially outperforms prior generative embedding models while significantly reducing the length of thinking.

</details>


### [183] [SpaMEM: Benchmarking Dynamic Spatial Reasoning via Perception-Memory Integration in Embodied Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22409)
*Chih-Ting Liao,Xi Xiao,Chunlei Meng,Zhangquan Chen,Yitong Qiao,Weilin Zhou,Tianyang Wang,Xu Zheng,Xin Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpaMEM，一个大规模诊断基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在具身空间推理中维护长程空间信念的能力。基准包含15个三层级诊断任务和超过1000万张高保真图像，揭示了当前VLM在坐标对齐和视觉记忆方面的显著瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在静态视觉-空间推理上表现良好，但在具身环境中，模型需要从自我中心观测持续更新信念并应对环境变化，这类长程空间连贯性推理能力尚缺乏系统性评估和诊断工具。

Method: 构建包含10,601,392张图像的物理数据集（RGB、深度、实例、语义分割四模态），通过动作条件场景变换（生成、放置、移除）在1000个程序化生成房屋中采集25,000+交互序列。形式化定义三层级空间推理层次：L1原子空间感知、L2时序推理（提供oracle文本状态历史）、L3端到端信念维护。设计15项诊断任务和两类评估（短步骤更新、长片段重建）。

Result: 主流开源VLM存在一致的堆叠瓶颈：坐标对齐是硬天花板；L2到L3的显著性能下降暴露了符号化脚手架依赖——模型在文本记账任务中表现良好，但难以维持鲁棒的视觉记忆。

Conclusion: SpaMEM为具身空间推理提供了细粒度诊断标准，推动对状态表示、信念修正和长程片段整合等显式机制的研究。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced static visual--spatial reasoning, yet they often fail to preserve long-horizon spatial coherence in embodied settings where beliefs must be continuously revised from egocentric observations under environmental change. We introduce SpaMEM (Spatial Memory from Action Sequences), a large-scale diagnostic benchmark that isolates the mechanics of spatial belief evolution via action-conditioned scene transformations (spawn, place, remove) over long interaction horizons. SpaMEM is built on a physically grounded dataset with 10,601,392 high-fidelity images across four modalities (RGB, depth, instance, semantic segmentation), collected from 25,000+ interaction sequences in 1,000 procedurally generated houses. We formalize embodied spatial reasoning as a three-level hierarchy with 15 diagnostic tasks: Level 1 measures atomic spatial perception from single observations; Level 2 probes temporal reasoning with oracle textual state histories to factor out perceptual noise; and Level 3 requires end-to-end belief maintenance from raw visual streams under the same task dimensions. We further evaluate both short-term (step-wise) updates and long-term (episodic) reconstruction. Benchmarking representative open-source VLM families reveals a consistent stacked bottleneck: coordinate-consistent grounding remains a hard ceiling, and the sharp collapse from Level 2 to Level 3 exposes a pronounced symbolic scaffolding dependency, where models succeed with text-based bookkeeping but struggle to sustain robust visual memory. SpaMEM provides a granular diagnostic standard and motivates explicit mechanisms for state representation, belief revision, and long-horizon episodic integration. A subset of SpaMEM is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mill-ct-liao/SpaMEM.

</details>


### [184] [LabBuilder: Protocol-Grounded 3D Layout Generation for Interactable and Safe Laboratory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02288)
*Jianbao Cao,Zhangrui Zhao,Bohan Feng,Zixuan Hu,Rui Li,Haiyuan Wan,Chenxi Li,Jingyuan Li,Wenzhe Cai,Lei Bai,Wanli Ouyang,Lingyu Duan,Di Huang,Minting Pan,Sha Zhang,Xinzhu Ma,Shixiang Tang,Dongzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LabBuilder是一个端到端系统，能从简洁文本说明自动生成并验证3D实验室布局，通过三个组件（LabForge、LabGen、LabTouchstone）协同工作，在几何、化学安全和导航约束下生成比现有方法更真实有效的实验室环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化实验室的部署受限于安全且可执行的实验环境设计困难，现有3D场景生成方法主要针对家庭环境优化视觉合理性，忽视了科学实验所需的协议依据和布局级安全约束。

Method: 提出LabBuilder系统，包含三个组件：1) LabForge：构建带有标注资产和化学知识的元数据集，将自然语言规范转化为结构化协议；2) LabGen：基于协议通过迭代、约束感知的优化策略合成实验室布局；3) LabTouchstone：统一基准评估生成的布局。

Result: 实验表明LabBuilder在生成现实且有效的实验室环境方面显著优于现有最先进方法，满足几何、化学安全和导航约束。

Conclusion: LabBuilder通过端到端的方式将文本规范转化为符合多重约束的3D实验室布局，为自动化科学发现中安全实验环境的设计提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Automated laboratories hold the promise of accelerating scientific discovery, yet their deployment is bottlenecked by the difficulty of designing safe and executable environments. While simulator-based design offers scalability, existing 3D scene generation methods are primarily tailored for household settings, optimizing for visual plausibility while neglecting the protocol grounding and layout-level safety constraints essential for scientific experimentation. We present LabBuilder, an end-to-end system that generates and verifies 3D laboratory layouts from concise textual specifications. It operates through three tightly coupled components: LabForge first curates a meta-dataset of annotated assets and chemical knowledge, translating natural language specifications into structured protocols; building on these protocols, LabGen synthesizes laboratory layouts via an iterative, constraint-aware optimization strategy; finally, LabTouchstone evaluates the resulting layouts as a unified benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LabBuilder significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, producing laboratory environments that are realistic and valid under modeled geometric, chemical-safety, and navigation constraints.

</details>


### [185] [Linearizing Vision Transformer with Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02772)
*Yining Li,Dongchen Han,Zeyu Liu,Hanyi Wang,Yulin Wang,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将预训练Softmax注意力Transformer（Stable Diffusion 3.5）高效转换为线性复杂度TTT架构的方法，通过结构对齐（TTT与Softmax注意力的双层动态形式匹配）和表征对齐（关键实例归一化与局部性增强模块），仅需1小时微调即可实现媲美原始模型的图像质量，同时推理速度提升1.32-1.47倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性复杂度注意力机制虽能克服Softmax注意力的二次方瓶颈，但其从头训练成本过高；从预训练Transformer继承权重是捷径，但Softmax与线性注意力之间存在根本性的表征鸿沟，导致权重无法有效迁移。

Method: 1）架构对齐：识别TTT（Test-Time Training）为线性复杂度架构，其双层动态公式与Softmax注意力在结构上对齐，可直接继承预训练注意力权重；2）表征对齐：引入关键实例归一化（key instance normalization）解决键移位不变性问题，引入轻量级局部性增强模块弥补局部性缺失。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5上验证，将模型线性化为SD3.5-T⁵，仅需4×H20 GPU上1小时微调，即可达到与微调后Softmax模型可比的文本到图像质量，同时在1K和2K分辨率下分别实现1.32倍和1.47倍的推理加速。

Conclusion: 通过结构对齐与表征对齐的双重策略，成功实现了从预训练Softmax注意力到线性复杂度TTT架构的高效转换，大幅降低了训练成本并提升了推理效率。

Abstract: While linear-complexity attention mechanisms offer a promising alternative to Softmax attention for overcoming the quadratic bottleneck, training such models from scratch remains prohibitively expensive. Inheriting weights from pretrained Transformers provides an appealing shortcut, yet the fundamental representational gap between Softmax and linear attention prevents effective weight transfer. In this work, we address this conversion challenge from two perspectives: architectural alignment and representational alignment. We identify Test-Time Training (TTT) as a linear-complexity architecture whose two-layer dynamic formulation is structurally aligned with Softmax attention, enabling direct inheritance of pretrained attention weights. To further align representational properties, including key shift-invariance and locality, we introduce key instance normalization and a lightweight locality enhancement module. We validate our approach by linearizing Stable Diffusion 3.5 and introduce SD3.5-T$^5$ (Transformer To Test Time Training). With only 1 hour of fine-tuning on 4$\times$H20 GPUs, SD3.5-T$^5$ achieves comparable text-to-image quality to the fine-tuned Softmax model, while accelerating inference by 1.32$\times$ and 1.47$\times$ at 1K and 2K resolutions. Code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/Transformer-to-TTT.

</details>


### [186] [LIVEditor-14B: Lightning Unified Video Editing via In-Context Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04569)
*Shitong Shao,Zikai Zhou,Haopeng Li,Yingwei Song,Wenliang Zhong,Lichen Bai,Zeke Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ISA（上下文稀疏注意力）框架，通过冗余上下文剪枝和动态查询分组实现接近无损的加速，并构建了LIVEditor-14B闪电视频编辑模型，在降低60%注意力延迟的同时超越现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频编辑向上下文学习(ICL)范式演进导致二次注意力复杂度成为计算瓶颈，现有方法无法兼顾效率与质量。

Method: 提出ISA框架：1）基于上下文token显著性低于源token的发现，设计高效预选策略剪枝冗余上下文；2）理论证明并实证查询尖锐度与近似误差相关，据此实现动态查询分组，将高误差查询分配全注意力、低误差查询分配0阶泰勒稀疏注意力；3）构建1.7M高质量视频编辑数据集及LIVEditor-14B模型。

Result: 注意力模块延迟降低约60%，在EditVerseBench、IVE-Bench、VIE-Bench三个基准上全面超越现有SOTA方法，实现接近无损的加速且不牺牲视觉保真度。

Conclusion: ISA是首个针对ICL视频编辑的接近无损的经验稀疏框架，验证了通过上下文剪枝与查询分组可有效突破ICL范式下的计算瓶颈。

Abstract: Video editing has evolved toward In-Context Learning (ICL) paradigms, yet the resulting quadratic attention costs create a critical computational bottleneck. In this work, we propose In-context Sparse Attention (ISA), the first near-lossless empirical sparse framework tailored for ICL video editing. Our design is grounded in two key insights: first, context tokens exhibit significantly lower saliency than source tokens; second, we theoretically prove and empirically validate that Query sharpness correlates with approximation error. Motivated by these findings, ISA implements an efficient pre-selection strategy to prune redundant context, followed by a dynamic query grouping mechanism that routes high-error queries to full attention and low-error ones to a computationally efficient 0-th order Taylor sparse attention. Furthermore, we build \textbf{\texttt{LIVEditor-14B}} , a novel lightning video editing model via ISA and a proposed video-editing data pipeline that curated a 1.7M high-quality dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIVEditor-14B achieves a $\sim$60% reduction in attention-module latency while surpassing state-of-the-art methods across EditVerseBench, IVE-Bench, and VIE-Bench, delivering near-lossless acceleration without compromising visual fidelity.

</details>


### [187] [Aes3D: Aesthetic Assessment in 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05155)
*Chuanzhi Xu,Boyu Wei,Haoxian Zhou,Xuanhua Yin,Zihan Deng,Haodong Chen,Qiang Qu,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Aes3D，首个面向3D神经渲染场景美学评估的系统性框架，包含专用数据集Aesthetic3D和轻量级模型Aes3DGSNet，可直接从3D高斯原语预测场景级美学分数，无需渲染多视图图像，在保持轻量设计的同时实现了强性能，为3D场景美学评估建立了新基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D场景评估方法主要关注重建保真度和感知真实感，忽视了构图、和谐度、视觉吸引力等高层次美学属性。主要挑战在于：(1)缺乏带美学标注的通用3DGS数据集；(2)3DGS作为底层基元表示难以捕捉高层美学特征。

Method: 提出了Aes3D框架，包含：Aesthetic3D数据集（首个专门用于3D场景美学评估的数据集，基于提出的3D场景美学标注策略构建）和Aes3DGSNet（轻量级模型，直接操作3D高斯原语预测美学分数，无需渲染多视图图像，通过多视图3DGS场景表示的美学监督学习捕捉高层美学线索）。

Result: 实验表明该方法在保持轻量设计的同时实现了强性能，为3D场景美学评估建立了新基准。

Conclusion: Aes3D填补了3DGS美学评估领域的空白，验证了直接从3D高斯原语预测美学分数的可行性，降低了计算成本和硬件要求。

Abstract: As 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) gains attention in immersive media and digital content creation, assessing the aesthetics of 3D scenes becomes important in helping creators build more visually compelling 3D content. However, existing evaluation methods for 3D scenes primarily emphasize reconstruction fidelity and perceptual realism, largely overlooking higher-level aesthetic attributes such as composition, harmony, and visual appeal. This limitation comes from two key challenges: (1) the absence of general 3DGS datasets with aesthetic annotations, and (2) the intrinsic nature of 3DGS as a low-level primitive representation, which makes it difficult to capture high-level aesthetic features. To address these challenges, we propose Aes3D, the first systematic framework for assessing the aesthetics of 3D neural rendering scenes. Aes3D includes Aesthetic3D, the first dataset dedicated to 3D scene aesthetic assessment, built on our proposed annotation strategy for 3D scene aesthetics. In addition, we present Aes3DGSNet, a lightweight model that directly predicts scene-level aesthetic scores from 3DGS representations. Notably, our model operates solely on 3D Gaussian primitives, eliminating the need for rendering multi-view images and thus reducing computational cost and hardware requirements. Through aesthetics-supervised learning on multi-view 3DGS scene representations, Aes3DGSNet effectively captures high-level aesthetic cues and accurately regresses aesthetic scores. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves strong performance while maintaining a lightweight design, establishing a new benchmark for 3D scene aesthetic assessment. Code and datasets will be made available in a future version.

</details>


### [188] [InfoGeo: Information-Theoretic Object-Centric Learning for Cross-View Generalizable UAV Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07099)
*Hongyang Zhang,Maonnan Wang,Ziyao Wang,Hongrui Yin,Man On Pun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出InfoGeo，一个基于信息论和物体中心学习的跨视角地理定位框架，通过最大化视角不变的结构关系信息并最小化视角特异性噪声，显著提升了在GPS受限环境中（特别是无人机场景）的定位鲁棒性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法依赖全局特征对齐，但难以应对不同区域纹理和天气条件带来的域偏移，尤其在无人机场景中，宽广视角引入的密集细粒度物体造成严重视觉杂乱，导致性能下降。

Method: 受物体中心学习启发，将优化问题重构为信息瓶颈过程，包含两个核心目标：(i) 通过对齐跨视角的物体中心结构关系来最大化视角不变信息；(ii) 通过跨视角知识约束来最小化视角特异性噪声信号。

Result: 在多个基准数据集和具有挑战性的场景下的广泛评估表明，InfoGeo显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: InfoGeo通过信息论视角和物体中心结构对齐，有效解决了CVGL中的域偏移和视觉杂乱问题，为GPS缺失环境下的精确定位提供了鲁棒且泛化能力强的解决方案。

Abstract: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) is fundamental for precise localization and navigation in GPS-denied environments, aiming to match ground or UAV imagery with satellite views. Existing approaches often rely on global feature alignment, but they suffer from substantial domain shifts induced by varying regional textures and weather conditions. This issue becomes even more pronounced in UAV-based scenarios, where the broader perspective inevitably introduces dense, fine-grained objects, creating significant visual clutter. To address this, we draw inspiration from Object-Centric Learning (OCL) and propose InfoGeo, an information-theoretic framework designed to enhance robustness and generalization. InfoGeo reformulates the optimization as an information bottleneck process with two core objectives: (i) maximizing view-invariant information by aligning the object-centric structural relations across views, and (ii) minimizing view-specific noisy signals through cross-view knowledge constraints. Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks and challenging scenarios demonstrate that InfoGeo significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [189] [CaC: Advancing Video Reward Models via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Concentrating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11723)
*Jiyuan Wang,Huan Ouyang,Jiuzhou Lin,Chunyu Lin,Dewen Fan,Boheng Zhang,Haonan Fan,Fei Zuo,Jia Sun,Huaiqing Wang,Honglie Wang,Yiyang Fan,Zhenlong Yuan,Zijun Li,Yongrui Heng,Guosheng Lin,Fan Yang,Tingting Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CaC，一种基于视觉语言模型的粗到细异常奖励模型。通过全局时间扫描定位异常时间窗口、细粒度空间定位以及结构化时空思维链推理，结合首次构建的大规模带逐帧边界框标注的视频异常数据集和三阶段渐进式训练范式（单/多帧监督微调+双轮GRPO强化学习），并引入时序和空间IoU奖励，在细粒度异常基准上提升25.7%准确率，作为奖励信号可减少11.7%的生成视频异常并提升整体视频质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频异常检测方法在细粒度时空定位和可解释性推理方面存在不足，缺乏能够同时进行全局时间感知、局部空间定位和结构化推理的统一模型，且缺少带有精细标注的大规模视频异常数据集。

Method: 提出CaC模型，采用粗到细的两阶段推理：全局时间扫描锚定异常时间窗口→细粒度空间定位。构建首个大规模带逐帧边界框、时间窗口和归因标签的视频异常数据集。设计三阶段训练：单帧SFT→多帧SFT→双轮GRPO强化学习，除准确率奖励外引入时序IoU和空间IoU奖励以监督中间定位过程。

Result: 在细粒度异常基准上准确率提升25.7%；作为奖励信号使生成视频异常减少11.7%，同时提升整体视频质量。

Conclusion: CaC能够稳定聚焦于细微异常，实现可解释的时空推理，并在异常检测和视频生成质量提升方面均取得显著效果。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose Concentrate and Concentrate (CaC), a coarse-to-fine anomaly reward model based on Vision-Language Models. During inference, it first conducts a global temporal scan to anchor anomalous time windows, then performs fine-grained spatial grounding within the localized interval, and finally derives robust judgments via structured spatiotemporal Chain-of-Thought reasoning. To equip the model with these capabilities, we construct the first large-scale generated video anomaly dataset with per-frame bounding-box annotations, temporal anomaly windows, and fine-grained attribution labels. Building on this dataset, we design a three-stage progressive training paradigm. The model initially learns spatial and temporal anchoring through single- and multi-frame supervised fine-tuning, and then is optimized by a reinforcement learning strategy based on two-turn Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Beyond conventional accuracy rewards, we introduce Temporal and Spatial IoU rewards to supervise the intermediate localization process, effectively guiding the model toward more grounded and interpretable spatiotemporal reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CaC can stably concentrate on subtle anomalies, achieving a 25.7% accuracy improvement on fine-grained anomaly benchmarks and, when used as a reward signal, CaC reduces generated-video anomalies by 11.7% while improving overall video quality.

</details>


### [190] [ProtoMedAgent: Multimodal Clinical Interpretability via Privacy-Aware Agentic Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14113)
*Alvaro Lopez Pellicer,Plamen Angelov,Marwan Bukhari,Yi Li,Eduardo Soares,Jemma Kerns*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProtoMedAgent是一种用于多模态临床报告生成的框架，通过神经符号瓶颈将原型网络的连续输出转化为语义结构化的文本，在4160名患者队列上实现了91.2%的比较集忠实度，并且通过ℓ-多样性相变机制将成员推理风险降低了9.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释原型网络在临床诊断中提供了基于案例的推理，但其原始连续输出缺乏医学文档所需的语义结构。标准的RAG方法会引发“检索谄媚”问题，即LLM生成事后合理化文本来对齐视觉预测，导致幻觉。

Method: ProtoMedAgent将多模态临床报告形式化为一个迭代、零梯度的测试时优化问题，通过严格的神经符号瓶颈约束。在冻结的原型骨干上，将潜在视觉和表格特征蒸馏为离散语义记忆。在线生成受精确集合论差分和反思性Scribe-Critic循环约束，并引入由k-匿名性和ℓ-多样性控制的语义隐私门。

Result: 在4160名患者队列上，ProtoMedAgent达到91.2%的比较集忠实度，显著优于标准RAG的46.2%。ℓ-多样性相变机制将工件级成员推理风险绝对降低9.8%。

Conclusion: ProtoMedAgent通过神经符号瓶颈有效解决了检索谄媚问题，在提升临床报告忠实度的同时保护了数据隐私。

Abstract: While interpretable prototype networks offer compelling case-based reasoning for clinical diagnostics, their raw continuous outputs lack the semantic structure required for medical documentation. Bridging this gap via standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) routinely triggers ``retrieval sycophancy,'' where Large Language Models (LLMs) hallucinate post-hoc rationalizations to align with visual predictions. We introduce ProtoMedAgent, a framework that formalizes multimodal clinical reporting as an iterative, zero-gradient test-time optimization problem over a strict neuro-symbolic bottleneck. Operating on a frozen prototype backbone, we distill latent visual and tabular features into a discrete semantic memory. Online generation is strictly constrained by exact set-theoretic differentials and a reflective Scribe-Critic loop, mathematically precluding unsupported narrative claims. To safely bound data disclosure, we introduce a semantic privacy gate governed by $k$-anonymity and $\ell$-diversity. Evaluated on a 4,160-patient clinical cohort, ProtoMedAgent achieves 91.2% Comparison Set Faithfulness where it fundamentally outperforms standard RAG (46.2%). ProtoMedAgent additionally leverages a binding $\ell$-diversity phase transition to systematically reduce artifact-level membership inference risks by an absolute 9.8%.

</details>


### [191] [Diagnosing and Correcting Concept Omission in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14270)
*Kanghyun Baek,Jaihyun Lew,Chaehun Shin,Jungbeom Lee,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出**遗漏信号干预（OSI）**方法，通过线性探测发现文本嵌入中存在表征目标概念缺失的“遗漏信号”，并放大该信号以主动催化缺失概念的生成，在FLUX.1-Dev和SD3.5-Medium上显著缓解了多模态扩散Transformer中的概念遗漏问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiTs）在文本到图像生成中常出现**概念遗漏**（指定对象或属性未能出现在生成图像中），现有方法未能有效解决该问题。

Method: 1. 对文本token进行**线性探测**，发现文本嵌入中可区分出表征目标概念缺失的“遗漏信号”；2. 提出**遗漏信号干预（OSI）**，通过放大该信号来主动催化缺失概念的生成。

Result: 在FLUX.1-Dev和SD3.5-Medium上，OSI显著缓解了概念遗漏问题，即使在极端场景下也有效。

Conclusion: 文本嵌入中的“遗漏信号”可作为概念缺失的指示器，通过主动干预该信号能有效提升生成图像的完整性。

Abstract: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have achieved remarkable progress in text-to-image generation, yet they frequently suffer from concept omission, where specified objects or attributes fail to emerge in the generated image. By performing linear probing on text tokens, we demonstrate that text embeddings can distinguish a characteristic `omission signal' representing the absence of target concepts. Leveraging this insight, we propose Omission Signal Intervention (OSI), which amplifies the omission signal to actively catalyze the generation of missing concepts. Comprehensive experiments on FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Medium demonstrate that OSI significantly alleviates concept omission even in extreme scenarios.

</details>


### [192] [GHOST: Geometry-Hierarchical Online Streaming Token Eviction for Efficient 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15852)
*Leyang Chen,Junyi Wu,Zhiteng Li,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GHOST是一个训练无关的KV缓存管理框架，利用模型自身的3D几何输出在线驱逐冗余token，在保持重建质量的同时将KV缓存减半并实现1.75倍的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从长单目视频序列进行流式3D重建时，KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，造成严重的内存瓶颈。现有方法要么将缓存截断为固定锚点帧导致重建质量下降，要么依赖与3D场景结构无关的注意力分数启发式方法，无法保留几何上重要的token。

Method: GHOST包含三个相互强化的创新：1）层次化双层重要性评分机制；2）保护特殊token不被驱逐的特权机制；3）余弦相似度引导的逐层预算分配。

Result: 在各种基准测试上，GHOST在保持优异重建质量的同时，将KV缓存削减近一半，相比现有方法实现了1.75倍的推理加速。

Conclusion: GHOST通过利用模型自身的3D几何输出来指导token驱逐，成功解决了长视频流式3D重建中的缓存瓶颈问题，是一种训练无关的高效解决方案。

Abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction from long monocular video sequences requires maintaining a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory bottleneck. Existing approaches either truncate the cache to a fixed set of anchor frames, leading to reconstruction quality degradation, or rely on attention-score heuristics that are agnostic to 3D scene structure, failing to preserve geometrically valuable tokens. To address these problems, we present GHOST (Geometry-Hierarchical Online Streaming Token Eviction), a training-free KV cache management framework that exploits the model's own 3D geometry outputs to evict redundant tokens online. GHOST introduces three mutually reinforcing innovations: a hierarchical dual-level importance scoring scheme, a privilege mechanism that protects special tokens from eviction, and a cosine-similarity-guided layer-wise budget allocation. Experiments on various benchmarks show that GHOST preserves excellent reconstruction quality while cutting the KV cache by nearly half and delivering 1.75x faster inference compared to state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/lokiniuniu/GHOST.

</details>


### [193] [Hilbert-Geo: Solving Solid Geometric Problems by Neural-Symbolic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16385)
*Ruoran Xu,Haoyu Cheng,Bin Dong,Qiufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Hilbert-Geo，首个面向立体几何的统一形式化语言框架，包含谓词库和定理库，并基于此提出Parse2Reason方法（先解析后推理），在立体几何和平面几何任务上均达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何推理工作主要聚焦平面几何，在立体几何上因3D空间图和复杂推理而表现不佳，缺乏统一的形式化语言框架来桥接这一问题。

Method: 提出Hilbert-Geo形式化语言框架（含谓词库和定理库），并设计Parse2Reason方法：解析阶段使用条件描述语言(CDL)将文本描述和视觉图像统一表示为形式化谓词；推理阶段利用形式化CDL和定理库进行关系推理和代数计算，生成可验证的推理过程。

Result: 在SolidFGeo2k上达77.3%（SOTA），MathVerse-Solid上达84.1%（SOTA），显著超越Gemini-2.5-pro(54.2%)和GPT-5(62.9%)；在平面几何PlaneFGeo3k上达80.2%（SOTA）。

Conclusion: Hilbert-Geo框架和Parse2Reason方法在立体几何和平面几何上均表现出色，验证了该形式化框架的通用性和有效性。

Abstract: Geometric problem solving, as a typical multimodal reasoning problem, has attracted much attention and made great progress recently, however most of works focus on plane geometry while usually fail in solid geometry due to 3D spatial diagrams and complex reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce Hilbert-Geo, the first unified formal language framework for solid geometry, including an extensive predicate library and a dedicated theorem bank. Based on this framework, we propose a Parse2Reason method containing two steps of first parsing then reasoning. In the parsing step, we utilize conditional description language (CDL), a formalized language composed of predicates specifically designed to construct geometric conditions, to represent both problem description (natural text) and solid diagrams (visual image). In the reasoning step, we leverage those formal CDL and the theorem bank to perform relational inference and algebraic computation, generating strictly correct, verifiable, and human-readable reasoning processes. Notably, our proposed Hilbert-Geo is also applicable to plane geometry. To advance geometric reasoning, we curate two expert-annotated dataset SolidFGeo2k and PlaneFGeo3k, which are furnished with geometric formal language annotations, solutions and answers. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method achieves the state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance 77.3% in SolidFGeo2k and 84.1% in MathVerse-Solid (one small subset in MathVerse dedicated to solid geometry), substantially outperforming leading MLLMs, such as Gemini-2.5-pro (54.2% on SolidFGeo2k) and GPT-5 (62.9% on MathVerse-Solid). In addition, our method achieves the SOTA accuracy 80.2% in PlaneFGeo3k, demonstrating the generality of the Hilbert-Geo in geometric reasoning. Our code and datasets will be publicly available.

</details>


### [194] [Diffusion Models, Denoiser Architecture and Creativity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16415)
*Itamar Levine,Yair Weiss*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验表明，扩散模型的创造性源于去噪器架构与目标分布之间的交互作用，只有当去噪器的归纳偏置与真实目标分布高度对齐时，模型才能成功生成逼真的图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释扩散模型为何能生成与训练数据不同的逼真图像（即创造性），尽管理论上贝叶斯最优去噪器只会复制训练样本。

Method: 理论分析三种不同去噪器架构（线性、多项式、瓶颈）下生成样本分布与目标分布的关系；实验上对经典UNET架构进行微小改动，观察创造性表现的变化。

Result: 理论给出了不同架构下生成样本分布的显式形式；实验表明UNET架构的微小改动会导致截然不同的创造性形式，且常产生高度非真实的样本。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的成功依赖于去噪器架构的归纳偏置与真实目标分布的强对齐，创造性是这种交互作用的产物，而非模型自身的固有属性。

Abstract: The creativity of diffusion models refers to their ability to generate highly realistic images that are different from their training data. Creativity is somewhat surprising since it is known that if the denoiser used in the diffusion model is the Bayes optimal denoiser for a given training set, then the model will simply copy the training samples. In this paper we present empirical and theoretical results that suggest that creativity in diffusion models is due to an interaction between the denoiser architecture and the target distribution. Theoretically, we give explicit forms for the distribution of generated samples as a function of the target distribution and the denoiser architecture for three different denoiser architectures (linear, polynomial, bottleneck). Empirically, we show that small changes in the popular UNET denoiser architecture leads to very different forms of creativity, and these small changes often yield samples that are highly nonrealistic. Taken together, our results show that diffusion models will only be successful if the inductive bias of the denoiser architecture is in strong alignment with the true target distribution.

</details>


### [195] [HyperVision: A Channel-Adaptive Ground-Based Hyperspectral Vision Pre-trained Backbone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17286)
*Guanyiman Fu,Jingtao Li,Zihang Cheng,Zhuanfeng Li,Diqi Chen,Yan Xu,Xiangyu Liu,Fengchao Xiong,Jianfeng Lu,Chengrong Chen,Jun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HyperVision是首个地面高光谱预训练骨干网络，采用通道自适应动态嵌入机制处理异构输入，通过多源伪标签融合空间与光谱信息，并利用跨模态知识蒸馏从RGB模型迁移语义知识。在15k图像上预训练后，仅需微调头部即可在三个下游任务上取得SOTA表现，语义分割Acc_M相对提升16.3%，跟踪AUC提升2.1%，显著目标检测MAE降低35.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地面高光谱成像缺乏通用的预训练骨干网络，面临三大挑战：不同传感器之间存在光谱配置差异、标签稀缺且不一致、现有数据集规模有限且场景多样性不足。

Method: 1) 通道自适应动态嵌入机制，将异构光谱输入映射到统一token空间；2) 无监督表示学习框架，包含多源伪标签方法（融合SAM2空间结构与HyperFree细粒度光谱信息）和跨模态知识蒸馏（从预训练RGB视觉模型迁移语义表示）。

Result: 在26个地面数据集共15k图像上预训练，仅需调整头部参数，在高光谱语义分割Acc_M上相对提升16.3%，目标跟踪AUC相对提升2.1%，显著目标检测MAE降低35.5%。

Conclusion: HyperVision作为首个地面高光谱预训练骨干，通过统一框架有效解决了传感器异构、标签缺失和场景局限等问题，展示了卓越的泛化能力，为高光谱通用感知奠定了基础。

Abstract: While hyperspectral imaging provides rich spatial-spectral information across hundreds of narrow wavelength bands for precise material identification, ground-based hyperspectral pre-trained backbones remain absent, constrained by varying spectral configurations across sensors, the scarcity and inconsistency of labels, and the limited scale and scene diversity of existing datasets. To address these challenges and enable universal perception, we propose HyperVision, the first ground-based hyperspectral pre-trained backbone. First, to handle varying spectral configurations, HyperVision adopts a channel-adaptive dynamic embedding mechanism to map heterogeneous inputs into a unified token space. Second, we develop an unsupervised representation learning framework. Specifically, to address label scarcity and inconsistency, a multi-source pseudo-labeling method is introduced to fuse spatial structures from SAM2 and fine-grained spectral material information from HyperFree. Furthermore, to enrich scene diversity and compensate for limited dataset scale, a cross-modal knowledge distillation mechanism is utilized to transfer rich semantic representations from a pre-trained RGB vision model to our backbone. Pre-trained on a collection of 15k images from 26 diverse ground-based datasets, HyperVision demonstrates exceptional generalization. Requiring only efficient head-only adaptation without adjusting backbone parameters, it achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to task-specific methods across three downstream tasks under varying sensor configurations, yielding up to a 16.3% relative improvement in hyperspectral semantic segmentation $\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{M}}$, a 2.1% relative gain in object tracking AUC, and a 35.5% reduction in salient object detection MAE. The source code and pre-trained model will be publicly available on https://github.com/lronkitty/HyperVision .

</details>


### [196] [TWINGS: Thin Plate Splines Warp-aligned Initialization for Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22069)
*Hyeseong Kim,Geonhui Son,Deukhee Lee,Dosik Hwang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TWINGS通过薄板样条（TPS）非刚性变形模型对齐反投影点与三角化3D控制点，为3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）提供几何精确的初始化，从而在稀疏视图输入下实现高质量的新视图合成，在DTU、LLFF和Mip-NeRF360数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视图输入下实现高质量场景重建面临点云稀疏性的挑战，现有方法难以在有限视角下保持结构细节和色彩保真度。

Method: 利用薄板样条（TPS）作为平滑非刚性变形模型，通过最小化弯曲能量从控制点对应关系估计全局一致扭曲，将估计深度反投影点与三角化3D控制点对齐，生成校准后的反投影点；再在这些控制点附近采样校准点，为3DGS提供快速且几何精确的初始化。

Result: 在DTU、LLFF和Mip-NeRF360数据集上的实验表明，TWINGS在稀疏视图场景下始终优于现有方法，重建场景的结构细节保留和色彩保真度均有提升。

Conclusion: TWINGS通过解决点云稀疏性问题有效增强了3DGS在稀疏视图下的表现，是一种高效且几何准确的新视图合成框架。

Abstract: Novel view synthesis from sparse-view inputs poses a significant challenge in 3D computer vision, particularly for achieving high-quality scene reconstructions with limited viewpoints. We introduce TWINGS, a framework that enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by directly addressing point sparsity. We employ Thin Plate Splines (TPS), a smooth non-rigid deformation model that minimizes bending energy to estimate a globally coherent warp from control-point correspondences, to align backprojected points from estimated depth with triangulated 3D control points, yielding calibrated backprojected points. By sampling these calibrated points near the control points, TWINGS provides a fast and geometrically accurate initialization for 3DGS, ultimately improving structural detail preservation and color fidelity in reconstructed scenes. Extensive experiments on DTU, LLFF, and Mip-NeRF360 demonstrate that TWINGS consistently outperforms existing methods, delivering detailed and accurate reconstructions under sparse-view scenarios.

</details>


### [197] [JMed48k: A Multi-Profession Japanese Medical Licensing Benchmark for Vision-Language Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22080)
*Yue Xun,Junyu Liu,Qian Niu,Xinyi Wang,Zheng Yuan,Zirui Li,Zequn Zhang,Bowen Zhao,Shujun Wang,Irene Li,Kan Hatakeyama-Sato,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了JMed48k，一个面向多职业日本医疗执照考试的视觉语言模型评估基准，包含48,862道考题和20,142张图片，涵盖2005-2025年间的11种国家资格考试。通过对21个模型（闭源、开源、医疗专用）的评估，发现闭源和开源模型能从图像中显著获益，而医疗专用系统对视觉证据的利用有限。配对图像移除审计显示，不同职业间图像影响的净效果差异可达七倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗视觉语言模型评估基准多局限于单一职业或缺乏高质量的视觉内容标注，难以全面评估模型在不同医疗职业场景下的多模态能力。

Method: 从日本厚生劳动省官方PDF材料中提取11种国家资格考试的48,862道题目和20,142张图像，构建8类视觉内容标注体系，并设计配对图像移除审计方法（评估同一问题在有/无图像时的答案转变状态）。

Result: 闭源和开源模型从图像中获益显著，而医疗专用系统对视觉证据利用有限（许多正确答案在移除图像后仍保持正确）。闭源模型中，图像移除的净效果在不同职业间差异达七倍（从医师的+5.7分到公共卫生护士的+39.8分）。

Conclusion: JMed48k可用于支持可复现的、按职业分层的视觉语言模型医疗执照评估，揭示了当前模型在视觉证据利用方面的显著差异。

Abstract: We introduce JMed48k, a multi-profession Japanese healthcare licensing benchmark for evaluating vision-language models. Built from official PDF materials released by the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, JMed48k contains 48,862 exam questions and 20,142 images from 11 national licensing examinations between 2005 and 2025, with visual content annotated under an 8-type taxonomy. From this corpus, we derive JMed48k-Eval, a recent five-year evaluation subset with 12,484 scored questions, including 9,905 text-only questions and 2,579 questions with images. We evaluate 21 proprietary, open-source, and medical-specific models, reporting text-only and with-image performance separately. Because these subsets contain different questions, we further introduce a paired image-removal audit that evaluates questions with images before and after removing visual content to explore four answer-transition states. The audit shows that proprietary and open source models gain substantially from images, whereas medical-specific systems show limited observable use of visual evidence, with many correct answers persisting after image removal. Even among proprietary models, the net image-removal effect varies sevenfold across professions, from +5.7 points on Physician questions to +39.8 points on Public Health Nurse questions. We release JMed48k to support reproducible, profession-stratified evaluation of vision-language models in medical licensing settings.

</details>


### [198] [Direct content-based retrieval from music scores images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22255)
*Noelia Luna-Barahona,Antonio Ríos-Vila,Félix Fuentes-Hurtado,David Rizo,Jorge Calvo-Zaragoza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了音乐乐谱图像的内容检索方法，对比了基于OMR的转录方法、免转录Transformer模型和LLM文本提示方法，发现不同方法在不同条件下各有优劣：OMR方法在域内检索表现更好，而免转录模型更能处理域间变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乐谱数字化对保存和可访问性至关重要，但目前信息检索主要依赖元数据（标题、作曲家等），而基于内容的乐谱图像检索仍未被充分探索，尽管它对音乐家、音乐学家和教育者具有潜在价值。

Method: 首先研究乐谱中哪些特征对检索最相关，并定义从标注语料库构建查询数据集的系统方法。实验对比了三类方法：(1) 基于OMR的转录方法，(2) 免转录的Transformer模型（直接从乐谱图像识别查询），(3) 文本提示的大语言模型。在四个不同规模、图像质量和排版方式的语料库上进行评估。

Result: 每种方法在不同条件下各有优势：基于OMR的流水线在域内检索中表现更好，而免转录模型处理域间变化时更有效。

Conclusion: 乐谱图像的内容检索没有通用最优方案，应根据具体应用场景（域内 vs. 跨域）选择合适的方法：OMR方法适合域内场景，免转录模型适合跨域场景。

Abstract: The digitization of musical scores plays a crucial role in their preservation and accessibility, yet information retrieval still depends mainly on metadata searches, such as by title or composer. Content based search in music score images remains underexplored compared to text documents, despite its potential value for musicians, musicologists, and educators. This work contributes to the field by first studying which characteristics of a score are most relevant for search and by defining a systematic method to build query datasets from any annotated corpus. We also consider diverse methods for content-based search on music score images, ranging from transcription-based approaches relying on Optical Music Recognition (OMR), to a transcription-free Transformer model trained to recognize queries directly from score images, and a text-prompted Large Language Model. Our experiments evaluate these models on four corpora exhibiting diverse characteristics in terms of dataset size, image quality, and typesetting mechanisms. Overall, each method excels under different conditions: OMR-based pipelines achieve higher in-domain retrieval, whereas transcription-free models handle domain variability more effectively.

</details>


### [199] [SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23345)
*Zizhao Tong,Yeying Jin,Hongfeng Lai,Zeqing Wang,Zhaohu Xing,Kexu Cheng,Haoran Xu,Zhao Pu,Shangwen Zhu,Ruili Feng,Jian Zhao,Yan Zhang,Hao Tang,Ling Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SCOPE模型，通过空间选择性条件机制在预训练视频扩散模型中分离FPS游戏的局部动作影响与全局场景生成，并构建CrossFPS跨游戏数据集，实现零样本跨游戏泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FPS交互式世界模型在密集输入下失效，因为全局注入动作的方式无法处理每帧高频重叠的控制信号，且仅针对单一游戏训练，缺乏跨游戏泛化能力。

Method: 1）SCOPE：在每个Transformer块中插入条件模块，将特征重塑为逐像素时序序列，使每个位置根据局部视觉内容计算动作响应，实现无需分割标签的局部效果分离；2）CrossFPS：首个多游戏FPS数据集，包含7个游戏69K片段、10自由度控制器信号，经策划去除游戏玩法偏差。

Result: 模型展现出强动作响应性、精确的作用域分离以及有效的跨游戏泛化能力，在未见场景上实现零样本迁移。

Conclusion: 通过空间选择性条件机制，视频扩散模型能够学习通用视觉-动作映射，而非游戏特定模式，从而在FPS交互世界建模中实现跨游戏泛化。

Abstract: Interactive world models for first-person shooter (FPS) games must resolve high-frequency overlapping control signals at every frame without disrupting unaffected regions. Existing methods inject actions globally and train on single titles, failing under dense FPS inputs. We observe that FPS actions are spatially selective: discrete events such as firing or reloading affect only a localized region around the weapon (the scope), while continuous camera and movement signals govern stable surroundings. We propose SCOPE, which inserts a conditioning module into each transformer block of a pretrained video diffusion model. It reshapes features into per-pixel temporal sequences so that each position computes its action response from local visual content. This separates in-scope effects from out-of-scope generation without segmentation labels. We also introduce CrossFPS, the first multi-game FPS dataset with frame-aligned action telemetry. It comprises 69K clips from 7 titles with 10-DoF controller signals, curated to remove gameplay bias. The model learns general visual-to-action mappings rather than game-specific patterns, enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen scenes. Experiments confirm strong action responsiveness, precise scope separation, and effective cross-game generalization.

</details>


### [200] [PixIE: Prompted Pixel-Space Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23531)
*Ruirui Lin,Guoxi Huang,David Bull,Nantheera Anantrasirichai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixIE提出了一种基于视觉基础模型语义提示的像素级低光照图像增强框架，通过跨尺度去噪、DINO提示像素块、空间通道压缩和多感受野像素嵌入等技术，在去噪和细节恢复上显著超越现有方法，PSNR提升1.9-15.0%，LPIPS降低8.5-44.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光照图像同时存在严重噪声、对比度损失和语义模糊问题，增强需要联合解决去噪和细节恢复，现有方法在两者兼顾上存在不足。

Method: 提出PixIE框架：(1) 跨尺度去噪模块抑制噪声并保持结构；(2) DINO提示像素块(DPPB)利用DINOv3中间特征通过逐像素调制注入语义信息；(3) 空间通道压缩(SCC)联合减少空间token网格和通道维度以提升跨尺度注意力效率；(4) 多感受野像素嵌入(MRPE)提供邻域感知的像素表示，增强对信号相关噪声的鲁棒性。

Result: 在LLIE基准测试上，PixIE将平均PSNR提升1.9-15.0%，LPIPS降低8.5-44.4%，定性比较显示更清晰的细节和更稳定的纹理。

Conclusion: PixIE通过语义提示的像素级处理有效联合解决了低光照图像的去噪和细节恢复问题，在重建保真度和感知质量上均取得显著提升。

Abstract: Low-light images suffer from severe noise, contrast loss, and semantic ambiguity, making enhancement a joint problem of denoising and detail recovery. We propose PixIE, a feed-forward pixel-space LLIE framework semantically prompted by a vision foundation model. PixIE first performs cross-scale denoising to suppress noise and preserve structure, then refines details using DINO-Prompted Pixel Blocks (DPPBs), which inject intermediate DINOv3 features through patch-conditioned, spatially continuous per-pixel modulation. To make pixel-space attention efficient across scales, we introduce Spatial-Channel Compaction (SCC), which jointly reduces the spatial token grid and channel dimension. We further propose Multi-Receptive-Field Pixel Embedding (MRPE) to provide neighborhood-aware pixel representations before semantic prompting, improving robustness to signal-dependent noise beyond point-wise embeddings. Experiments on LLIE benchmarks show that PixIE improves average PSNR by 1.9-15.0% over recent state-of-the-art methods and reduces LPIPS by 8.5-44.4%. Qualitative comparisons further show sharper details and more stable textures, improving both reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality.

</details>


### [201] [Nano World Models: A Minimalist Implementation of Future Video Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23993)
*Siqiao Huang,Partha Kaushik,Michael Chen,Hengkai Pan,Kaiwen Geng,Omar Chehab,Fernando Moreno-Pino,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Nano World Models 是一个极简的代码库，基于 diffusion forcing 实现未来视频预测，提供统一的接口用于研究生成目标、模型规模、动作条件机制、潜观测空间、数据集、评估协议和长程 rollout 过程，并通过简单控制环境、游戏模拟和真实机器人数据验证了预测参数化、架构规模、动作注入、采样预算和领域复杂度对视频预测质量与自回归 rollout 行为的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管工业界在交互式视频生成方面进展迅速，但研究社区仍然缺乏紧凑、可复现且易于扩展的实现来研究现代世界模型的设计选择，因此需要一个统一的实验平台来解耦并系统研究世界模型中的各个组件。

Method: 基于 diffusion forcing 构建极简代码库，提供统一的接口整合生成目标、模型规模、动作条件机制、潜观测空间、数据集、评估协议和长程 rollout 过程。

Result: 在简单控制环境、游戏模拟和真实机器人数据上，系统研究了预测参数化、架构规模、动作注入、采样预算和领域复杂度对视频预测质量和自回归 rollout 行为的影响。

Conclusion: Nano World Models 提供了一个紧凑且可扩展的实验平台，旨在推动开放、可复现和科学化的世界模型研究。

Abstract: World models have become a central paradigm for learning predictive simulators that support generation, planning, and decision-making. Yet, despite rapid progress in industry-scale interactive video generation, the broader research community still lacks compact, reproducible, and easily extensible implementations for studying the design choices underlying modern world models. We introduce Nano World Models, a minimalist codebase for future video prediction centered around diffusion forcing. Nano World Models provides a unified interface for generative objectives, model scales, action-conditioning mechanisms, latent observation spaces, datasets, evaluation protocols, and long-horizon rollout procedures. This design enables controlled studies of world-modeling components that are often entangled across separate implementations. Through experiments across simple control environments, game simulation, and real-robot data, we examine how prediction parameterization, architecture scale, action injection, sampling budget, and domain complexity affect video prediction quality and autoregressive rollout behavior. By releasing code, configurations, evaluation scripts, and pretrained checkpoints, Nano World Models aims to provide a compact yet extensible experimental substrate for open, reproducible, and scientific world-model research.

</details>


### [202] [Coarse-to-Fine Domain Incremental Learning with Attentive Distillation for Mining Footprint Segmentation in Multispectral Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24460)
*Alif Tri Handoyo,Vincent C. S. Lee,Rizka Widyarini Purwanto,Alex M. Lechner,Deanna Kemp,Muhamad Risqi U. Saputra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MineC2FNet，一种粗到细的域增量学习框架，利用粗粒度标注数据改进细粒度采矿足迹分割，通过教师-学生架构和注意力蒸馏有效处理域偏移，并在219张精细标注图像数据集上取得优于SOTA的性能。
