<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化的全球采矿足迹分割对监测采矿的社会环境风险至关重要，但细粒度标注数据稀缺，而粗粒度数据广泛存在却存在域偏移问题，限制了其在细粒度分割任务中的应用。

Method: 提出MineC2FNet，采用教师-学生架构，在特征和预测层面进行注意力蒸馏，选择性迁移粗域通用知识，同时利用有限细粒度数据实现边界细化。

Result: 在219张精细标注图像数据集上，MineC2FNet在域适应和域增量学习方法中均取得最优性能，有效处理了域偏移问题。

Conclusion: 粗到细的域增量学习框架能够有效利用粗粒度数据提升细粒度分割性能，数据集和代码已公开。

Abstract: Automatically mapping and segmenting global mining footprints using remote sensing and deep learning is critical for monitoring the socio-environmental risks and impacts of mining, yet its progress is hindered by the scarcity of fine-grained annotated data. Although large-scale datasets with coarse boundaries are widely available, leveraging them to improve fine-grained segmentation is challenging due to significant domain shift. To address this, we propose MineC2FNet, a coarse-to-fine domain incremental learning framework that exploits abundant coarse data to enhance fine-grained mining footprint segmentation. MineC2FNet adopts a teacher-student architecture with attentive distillation at both the feature and prediction levels, selectively transferring generalized knowledge from the coarse domain while enabling boundary refinement using limited fine-grained data (fine domain). We further introduce an expertly validated dataset of 219 images with precise boundary annotations across diverse geographies and commodities. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art approaches, including domain adaptation and domain incremental learning methods, demonstrate that MineC2FNet achieves superior performance while effectively handling domain shift. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/risqiutama/MineC2FNet.

</details>


### [203] [SRUG: Shadow-Guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24700)
*Yonghao Zhao,Zexin Yin,Jian Yang,Beibei Wang,Jin Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SRUG是一个利用阴影引导3D补全模型恢复不可见区域几何、结合迭代材质分解方案和大材质模型实现可重光照城市场景的框架，在视图合成和重光照任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市场景通常无界且超出可见区域，不可见部分会向可见区域投射阴影，但稀疏输入视图和复杂光照条件导致材质分解存在严重歧义，使得创建可重光照城市场景极具挑战性。

Method: 1) 阴影引导的3D补全模型用于恢复不可见区域几何，生成物理合理的阴影；2) 迭代材质分解方案，利用大材质模型提供材质监督并逐步分解场景材质属性；3) 基于物理的光照模型捕捉城市复杂光照，支持可靠重光照。

Result: 定量评估和视觉比较表明，SRUG在新视图合成和重光照任务上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: SRUG通过阴影引导补全不可见区域几何和迭代材质分解，有效解决了城市场景重光照中的阴影建模和材质分解难题，实现了优于现有方法的性能。

Abstract: Creating relightable urban scenes from images or videos is widely useful but highly ill-posed. Urban environments are typically unbounded and extend beyond the visible regions. As a result, many portions of the scene remain unobserved, yet these invisible regions can cast shadows onto visible areas. Reasonably modeling shadows cast by such invisible regions is challenging and poses a significant obstacle to creating relightable urban scenes. At the same time, sparse input views and complex illumination conditions further complicate relighting, as they introduce severe ambiguities in material decomposition. In this paper, we propose Shadow-guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation model (SRUG), a novel framework designed to address relighting challenges in urban scenes. SRUG leverages shadows to guide a 3D completion model for recovering the geometry of invisible regions, promoting the synthesis of physically reasonable shadows. In addition, SRUG employs an iterative material decomposition scheme that applies the large material model (LMM) to provide material supervision and iteratively decompose the scene's material properties, enabling robust material decomposition. Building upon these components, we introduce a physically-based lighting model that captures the complex illumination of urban scenes and supports reliable relighting. Extensive quantitative evaluations and visual comparisons demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both novel view synthesis and relighting tasks.

</details>


### [204] [VEOcc: Voxel-Centric Online Semantic Occupancy Prediction For Embodied Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25059)
*Ruoyu Wang,Yong Liu,Sheng Tao,Yuhang Lin,Yukai Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VEOcc是一种基于体素中心的在线3D占用预测与建图框架，通过递归感知-同化范式消除对场景尺寸先验的依赖，并提出时空感知在线更新策略（TLA、RCM、CSU），在Occ-ScanNet和EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet上达到SOTA，且具备零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯的方法在结构边界保真度上存在不足，且严重依赖预定义的场景尺寸先验，限制了自主探索中的操作效率。为消除对初始尺度估计的需求并实现高效、开放的建图扩展，提出了VEOcc框架。

Method: 提出基于体素中心的递归感知-同化范式（VEOcc），无需初始尺度估计即可实现流线型、开放式建图扩展；提出时空感知在线更新策略，包含三部分：跨时间步逻辑聚合（TLA）维护时间一致性、可靠性感知置信度调制（RCM）进行空间不确定性校准、置信度驱动增量状态更新（CSU）实现鲁棒全局状态同化。

Result: 在Occ-ScanNet和EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet上，VEOcc在局部和具身设置下均达到SOTA性能；在自采视频序列上的零样本评估进一步验证了其在完全未见真实环境中的鲁棒分布外泛化能力。

Conclusion: VEOcc为自主探索提供了一种准确且高效的在线3D占用建图解决方案，消除了对场景先验的依赖，并具有较强的泛化能力。

Abstract: Crucial for autonomous exploration, online 3D occupancy prediction and mapping incrementally constructs dense spatial representations on the fly. However, recent Gaussian-centric methods struggle with structural boundary fidelity and rely heavily on predefined scene-size priors, fundamentally limiting their operational efficiency. In this work, we present VEOcc, a voxel-centric framework formulated as a recursive perception-and-assimilation paradigm. By eliminating the need for initial scale estimation, VEOcc enables highly streamlined, open-ended map expansion. Furthermore, to robustly aggregate noisy temporal observations within the discrete voxel space, we propose a Spatio-Temporal-Aware Online Update Strategy. It integrates Cross-Temporal Logit Aggregation (TLA) for temporal consistency, Reliability-Aware Confidence Modulation (RCM) for spatial uncertainty calibration, and Confidence-Driven Incremental State Update (CSU) for robust global state assimilation. % Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings, providing an accurate and efficient solution for real-world exploration. Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings. Notably, zero-shot evaluations on self-collected video sequences further confirm its robust out-of-distribution generalization capability in completely unseen real-world environments. Ultimately, our framework provides an accurate and highly efficient solution for autonomous exploration. Code and supplementary visualizations are available on our project page: https://wryzju.github.io/VEOcc/.

</details>


### [205] [A Principled Self-Referenced Early Stopping Approach for Deep Image Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25299)
*Chaoyan Huang,Cheng-Han Huang,Ismail R. Alkhouri,Rongrong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对深度图像先验（DIP）在逆成像问题中因过参数化导致过拟合噪声的问题，提出基于构建伪自参考图像的过拟合检测框架，通过三种IIP特定算法实现接近最优的早停，在多种图像恢复任务中优于现有方法，且无需噪声水平估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DIP在解决逆成像问题时因网络过参数化会过拟合噪声测量值，现有基于运行方差的早停方法中，波动可能过早出现导致重建不稳定，因此需要更鲁棒的早停策略。

Method: 首先证明当存在两幅独立带噪退化图像副本时可实现接近最优的早停；进而提出基于构建伪自参考图像的过拟合检测框架，衍生出三种针对不同IIP的算法，并辅以单参考验证、伪验证估计及共享噪声影响的理论分析。

Result: 在自然图像恢复和医学图像重建等多种逆成像任务中，在不同噪声水平和噪声类型下，所提方法均持续优于现有DIP早停方法，且无需精确估计噪声水平。

Conclusion: 通过构造伪自参考图像进行过拟合检测，能够有效解决DIP早停中波动过早出现的问题，实现无需噪声水平估计的鲁棒且接近最优的早停。

Abstract: Recently, Deep Image Prior (DIP) has demonstrated strong capabilities for solving inverse imaging problems (IIPs) by optimizing a randomly initialized convolutional neural network in a training-data-free regime. However, DIP suffers from overfitting to noisy measurements due to network over-parameterization, making early stopping (ES) essential. The most successful ES method tracks fluctuations in the running variance of the network output to detect overfitting. However, in many applications, these fluctuations may appear prematurely, leading to unstable reconstructions. In this paper, we first show that nearly optimal DIP early stopping can be achieved when two independent noisy copies of the degraded image are available. Motivated by this observation, and since obtaining two fully independent copies is infeasible, we propose an overfitting detection framework based on constructing pseudo self-referenced images, resulting in three IIP-specific algorithms. Our approach is further supported by theoretical results on single-reference validation, pseudo-validation estimation, and the impact of shared noise. Across different IIPs, ranging from natural image restoration to medical image reconstruction, and under varying noise levels and noise types, our methods consistently outperform existing DIP early stopping approaches, all without requiring an accurate estimate of the noise level.

</details>


### [206] [Paris 2.0: A Decentralized Diffusion Model for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26064)
*Ali Rouzbayani,Bidhan Roy,Marcos Villagra,Zhiying Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Paris 2.0是首个通过去中心化计算预训练的视频生成模型，在低分辨率文本到视频训练中，相比同数据同算力的集中式模型，FVD从561.04降至279.01（~2倍提升），并提升了CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证明去中心化训练不仅可以用于图像生成，也能实现时序连贯的视频生成，解决去中心化训练下视频生成这一开放问题。

Method: 基于Paris 1.0（首个开源去中心化扩散模型DDM）的训练方案，扩展至视频生成任务，在低分辨率文本到视频设置下进行去中心化预训练。

Result: 与同数据同算力的集中式模型相比：FVD从561.04降至279.01（~2.0倍提升）；CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学评分均更高。

Conclusion: Paris 2.0首次证明去中心化训练能够实现高质量的视频生成，且效果优于同等条件下的集中式模型。

Abstract: We present Paris 2.0, the first video generation model pre-trained through decentralized computation. Its training recipe builds upon Paris 1.0 (arXiv:2510.03434), the first ever open-weight Decentralized Diffusion Model (DDM), which showed that image generation can be trained without a monolithic GPU cluster. However, temporally coherent video generation had remained an open problem under decentralized training, and Paris 2.0 closes it.
  In low-resolution text-to-video training, against a monolithic model trained on the same data under a matched total compute budget, Paris 2.0 cuts Frechet Video Distance (FVD) from 561.04 to 279.01, a ~2.0x improvement, and lifts CLIP text-video similarity and aesthetic score.

</details>


### [207] [Reinforcing Few-step Generators via Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26108)
*Yushi Huang,Xiangxin Zhou,Ruoyu Wang,Chi Zhang,Jun Zhang,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RTDMD，一个两阶段框架，将分布匹配蒸馏与奖励引导强化学习统一用于少步流生成器，在SD3、SD3.5和FLUX.2上以4步推理取得SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步扩散蒸馏虽能实现高效图像生成，但将这些模型与人类偏好对齐仍具挑战性，现有方法难以同时兼顾分布匹配与奖励最大化。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段提出AC-DMD，进行子区间分布匹配并引入一致性正则化；第二阶段联合优化分布匹配与奖励最大化项，推导混合策略梯度，结合GRPO风格估计器与直接奖励反向传播，并引入SubGRPO降低方差。

Result: 在SD3、SD3.5和FLUX.2上，仅用4步推理即在偏好、美学和组合性指标上超越此前少步文生图方法，达到新SOTA。

Conclusion: RTDMD有效统一了分布匹配蒸馏与奖励引导强化学习，为少步流生成器的偏好对齐提供了高效框架。

Abstract: Recent advances in few-step diffusion distillation have enabled efficient image generation, yet aligning these models with human preferences remains challenging. We propose Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation (RTDMD), a two-stage framework that unifies distribution matching distillation with reward-guided reinforcement learning for few-step flow generators. We show that minimizing the KL divergence to a reward-tilted teacher distribution naturally decomposes into a distribution matching term and a reward maximization term. In the first stage, we introduce Ambient-Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (AC-DMD), which performs subinterval-wise distribution matching and augments the fake score objective with a consistency regularizer to help the fake score model track the shifting generator distribution under limited updates. In the second stage, we jointly optimize both terms: for the reward maximization term, we derive a hybrid policy gradient that combines a GRPO-style estimator for the stochastic intermediate transitions with direct reward backpropagation through the deterministic final step, and further introduce step-subset GRPO (SubGRPO) to reduce variance. Experiments on SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.2 demonstrate that RTDMD establishes new state-of-the-art results across preference, aesthetic, and compositional metrics with only 4 inference steps, outperforming previous few-step text-to-image generation methods. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Harahan/RTDMD.

</details>


### [208] [ChartAct: A Benchmark for Dynamic Chart Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26994)
*Muye Huang,Lin Wu,Lingling Zhang,Hang Yan,Zhiyuan Wang,Yumeng Fu,Zesheng Yang,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了ChartAct，一个用于评估动态图表理解能力的交互式基准测试。它收集了673个真实动态图表，构建了1,440个问答样本，并在两种环境中进行评估。实验表明现有多模态模型和GUI代理在动态图表理解上仍有明显局限，最强模型Claude-Opus-4.7的成功率为84.5%，而多数模型低于60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图表理解基准主要关注静态图表，但现实中的图表往往是动态和交互式的，关键信息需要通过悬停、点击、缩放等操作才能获取。现有模型在动态图表理解方面的能力尚未得到充分评估。

Method: 收集并筛选了来自8个真实图表网站的673个动态图表，涵盖7种常见图表类型，构建了1,440个高质量的问答样本。每个样本在动态图表和仪表板图表两种环境中实例化，系统评估了11种先进多模态模型和GUI代理。

Result: 最强模型Claude-Opus-4.7平均成功率为84.5%，而大多数模型成功率低于60%。现有模型在动态图表理解方面存在明显的局限性。

Conclusion: ChartAct为研究真实交互环境中的图表理解提供了新的基准，揭示了现有模型在动态图表理解方面的不足。

Abstract: Charts are widely used to present complex data for analysis and decision making. Existing chart understanding benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, but real-world charts are often dynamic and interactive. Key information may only appear after actions such as hovering, clicking, zooming, or dragging. Dynamic chart understanding therefore requires models to identify visible content, choose proper interactions, and reason over changing chart states. To evaluate this ability, we propose ChartAct, an interactive benchmark for dynamic chart understanding. ChartAct collects and filters 673 dynamic charts from 8 real chart websites, covers 7 common chart types, and constructs 1,440 high-quality question-answer samples. Each sample is instantiated in two environments, Dynamic Chart and Dashboard Chart, to evaluate dynamic chart understanding under different contexts. Based on ChartAct, we systematically evaluate 11 advanced multimodal models and GUI agents. Experimental results show that existing models still have clear limitations in dynamic chart understanding. The strongest model, Claude-Opus-4.7, achieves an average success rate of 84.5\%, while most models remain below 60\%. We also conduct detailed failure attribution and case analysis. ChartAct provides a new benchmark for studying chart understanding in real interactive environments. Codes at https://github.com/wulin-wulin/OSWorld_Chart

</details>


### [209] [Structure over Pixels: Learning Variable-Length Visual Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27696)
*Piotr Wyrwiński,Kacper Dobek,Krzysztof Krawiec*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STROP是一种离散视觉分词器架构，通过四阶段课程学习和基于DINOv3特征的局部率-失真监督，能同时学习每幅图像的最佳程序长度，并形成结构化场景表示，无需像素级重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应分词器要么需要事后搜索，要么在预训练的离散码率中选择，而非学习与模型和场景耦合的连续图像序列长度；且通常使用像素重建损失训练，强调纹理而非结构。

Method: 提出STROP架构，包含一个专用的长度头，通过四阶段课程学习，以冻结的DINOv3特征为监督进行局部率-失真探测，在单次前向传播中估计活动前缀长度。码本完全由高层潜在表示的质量塑造，绕过像素级重建梯度。

Result: 程序长度随场景复杂度增长，在下游密集预测迁移任务和直接检验学习的码本词汇中均出现了组合结构的迹象。

Conclusion: STROP能够学习与场景复杂度匹配的可变长度结构表示，无需像素重建即可形成具有组合性的离散视觉编码。

Abstract: Discrete visual tokenizers translate images into ordered sequences of codes, providing a natural representation for structural description of scenes. Yet existing adaptive tokenizers either require post-hoc search or select among a discrete set of pre-trained rates, rather than learning a continuous per-image sequence length coupled to the model and scene, and they typically train against pixel reconstruction, emphasizing texture rather than structure. We propose STROP, a discrete visual tokenizer architecture that forms structural scene representations and simultaneously learns how long an image's visual program should be. Using a four-phase curriculum supervised by local rate--distortion probes against frozen DINOv3 features, STROP optimizes a dedicated length head that estimates the active prefix length in a single forward pass. By bypassing pixel-level reconstruction gradients, the codebook is shaped entirely by the quality of higher-level latent representations. Program length grows with scene complexity, and signs of compositional structure emerge both in downstream dense-prediction transfer and in direct inspection of the learned code vocabulary.

</details>


### [210] [ROVER: Routing Object-Centric Visual Evidence for Grounded Multi-Image Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27959)
*Guannan Lv,Ren Nie,Hongjian Dou,Tingting Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ROVER，一种轻量级可学习插件，通过路由基于目标的视觉证据，实现多图像推理中高效的全局视觉证据选择，在MM-GCoT和VideoEspresso等基准上显著提升了答案准确率和定位准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在定位推理中存在两类局限：基于RoI的方法削弱了整体场景理解与物体间关系，且解码成本随RoI数量和尺寸增长；自适应视觉特征选择需要细粒度监督或复杂启发式规则。ROVER旨在克服这些不足，实现高效全局视觉证据路由。

Method: ROVER在每个目标定位预测时注入步骤特定的token三元组，完成三项协同功能：(i) 聚合当前推理上下文；(ii) 通过基于目标的差异化注意力将图像内线索提取到视觉工作空间中；(iii) 在该空间内跨物体和图像路由并整合历史感知证据。模型集成到Qwen2.5-VL-7B，采用SFT到GRPO的交错训练流程。

Result: 在MM-GCoT上答案准确率提升4.8%，定位准确率提升14.6%；在VideoEspresso上答案准确率提升8.6%。VideoEspresso训练模型展现强迁移性，在多样基准上平均超过基线4.7%。

Conclusion: ROVER通过轻量级插件设计有效解决了多图像推理中视觉证据路由的效率与效果问题，且具有良好的跨任务迁移能力。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have increasingly localized and interleaved visual evidence for deliberative reasoning. Grounding-based approaches typically focus on regions of interest (RoIs) by injecting cropped image patches or RoI-specific features into the reasoning context. However, such designs can weaken holistic scene understanding and inter-object relations, while incurring decoding costs that scale with the number and size of RoIs. Alternatively, adaptive visual feature selection often requires fine-grained supervision or complex heuristics. To address these limitations, we propose ROVER (Routing Object-centric Visual Evidence for grounded multi-image Reasoning), a lightweight, learnable plugin for efficient global visual evidence routing. Upon each object grounding prediction, ROVER injects a step-specific token triplet to synergistically: (i) aggregate the ongoing reasoning context, (ii) distill intra-image cues into a visual working space via object-centric differential attention, and (iii) route and integrate history-aware evidence across objects and images within this space for subsequent reasoning. We integrate ROVER into Qwen2.5-VL-7B and develop an interleaved SFT-to-GRPO training pipeline. Strictly adhering to the original datasets and evaluation protocols, our method achieves the best performance on MM-GCoT (+4.8% answer accuracy, +14.6% grounding accuracy) and VideoEspresso (+8.6% answer accuracy). The VideoEspresso-trained model demonstrates strong transferability, outperforming the base model by +4.7% on average across diverse benchmarks.

</details>


### [211] [Resolution-free neural surrogates for geometric parameterization and mapping with spatially varying fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28551)
*Yanwen Huang,Lok Ming Lui,Gary P. T. Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无分辨率依赖的神经代理模型，用于解决由空间变化参数场驱动的几何参数化与映射问题，通过多分辨率几何编码和几何感知约束（无需标签数据）实现任意点集上的映射预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统几何映射方法（变分模型、扩散过程、椭圆PDE）在参数场逐实例变化时，高分辨率系统重复求解的计算成本过高。

Method: 1) 构建神经代理模型，输入为空间变化参数场p(Ω→ℝ^m)和查询位置{x_i}，输出映射位置{u(x_i)}；2) 采用多分辨率几何编码策略，将坐标增强的参数场样本作为网络条件；3) 无需标注数据，通过变分能量、扩散密度均衡、拟共形理论等几何感知约束进行训练。

Result: 在拟共形映射和密度均衡映射两个任务上的实验验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提方法实现了与分辨率无关的几何映射求解，避免了逐实例重复求解高分辨率系统的高昂计算代价。

Abstract: Many imaging problems require computing spatial transformations induced by spatially varying intensity, feature, or density fields. Canonical examples include distortion correction, deformable image registration, atlas-based segmentation, and deformation-driven image analysis. These tasks can be formulated as geometric mapping problems in which the transformation is constrained to preserve local structure, control boundary behavior, or regulate angular distortion. Such formulations typically lead to variational models, diffusion processes, or elliptic partial differential equations. However, repeatedly solving high-resolution systems becomes computationally expensive when the underlying parameter fields vary across instances. In this work, we propose a resolution-free neural surrogate for geometric parameterization and mapping problems. Given a spatially varying parameter field $p:Ω\to\mathbb{R}^m$ and query locations $\{x_i\}_{i=1}^N\subsetΩ$, the model predicts mapped locations $\{u(x_i)\}_{i=1}^N$ on arbitrary structured or unstructured point sets. To avoid dependence on a fixed grid, we use a multi-resolution geometric encoding strategy that conditions the network on coordinate-augmented samples of the parameter field. The model is trained without labeled solution data by enforcing geometry-aware constraints derived from variational energies, diffusion-based density equalization, and quasi-conformal theory. Experimental results on quasi-conformal mapping and density-equalizing mapping problems are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [212] [One Mask to Rule Them All: On Hidden Facts after Editing and How to Find Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28839)
*Ali Holmov,Paul Youssef,Nandi Schoots,Christin Seifert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现ROME和MEMIT等知识编辑方法虽修改不同的MLP权重，但都作用于一个共同的权重复合结构。通过训练二值掩码可逆转80%以上的编辑效果，并揭示编辑机制是通过抑制后层过度注意力来实现，而非真正覆盖知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识编辑方法（如ROME、MEMIT）在行为评估上表现良好，但其内部机制尚不明确，特别是不同事实编辑是否共享相同的底层机制尚未被探索。

Method: 训练一个紧凑的二值掩码来识别编辑后权重中维持编辑效果的关键子集；通过在训练集和测试集上测试掩码逆转编辑的能力，以及将掩码注入编辑过程观察编辑成功率的变化，验证共同功能结构的存在。

Result: 掩码在训练集上逆转80%的编辑，测试集上逆转70%以上；注入掩码使编辑成功率从98%降至38%；编辑机制实际上是抑制后层过度注意力而非覆盖原有知识。

Conclusion: 不同事实编辑共享共同的权重复合结构；编辑本质是对知识的抑制而非改写，这解释了ROME和MEMIT无法将更改传播到相关事实的原因；该发现可用于检测和防御不当编辑。

Abstract: Knowledge editing methods such as ROME and MEMIT update factual associations in transformer models by modifying MLP weights. While evaluated mainly by output behavior, their internal mechanism remains underexplored. We investigate whether edits rely on a common mechanism, regardless of which fact is modified. Despite fact-specific weight changes, we argue that ROME and MEMIT target the same subset of weights critical for maintaining edits. To isolate this subset, we train a compact binary mask over the edited weights. The mask reverses 80% of edits on the training set and over 70% on the test set, confirming that diverse edits share a common functional structure. Our analysis reveals that the mask reverses edits by eliminating overattention in later layers. Additionally, we show that injecting the mask during editing drops editing success from 98% to 38%, demonstrating that this mechanism is necessary for edits to succeed. Our finding that edits suppress rather than overwrite knowledge explains why ROME and MEMIT fail to propagate changes to related facts. The identified common functional subspace informs detection and defense against unwanted edits.

</details>


### [213] [Representation Signatures and Risk-Feedback Alignment in LLM Trading Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28850)
*Weicheng Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过TradeArena金融交易测试平台，分析了LLM智能体在金融决策中的行为对齐与表征动态，发现规划嵌入漂移、有效秩收缩等预失败信号，并验证了风险反馈作为外部对齐信号的作用，同时揭示了多资产配置中的相关性盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM智能体在金融决策环境中的行为对齐与表征动态，特别是在市场压力下的规划嵌入、头寸与干预的演化模式，旨在识别LLM金融推理是否在对齐、漂移或失败。

Method: 使用TradeArena可审计交易测试平台，通过80个滚动失败锚点（跨8条LLM轨迹），结合哈希、LSA、Transformer和白盒隐藏状态探针进行嵌入分析；采用CoT-free目标权重、词汇控制、OHLCV噪声和虚假审计报告进行压力测试；进行51只股票日内实验，以滚动Markowitz基线作为协方差参考。

Result: 发现可测量的预失败信号：规划嵌入从正常状态质心漂移、融合计划-风险表征区分正常与预回撤状态、有效秩收缩；无推理链时推理层收缩消失但意图层收缩仍存；结构化风险反馈可作为外部对齐信号但非通用性能提升器；多资产实验揭示LLM推理常为耦合资产提供集中敞口的理由。

Conclusion: 可审计的风险反馈与表征轨迹能够揭示LLM金融推理何时在对齐、漂移或失败，本研究支持的是研究主张而非盈利主张。

Abstract: We study behavioral alignment and representation dynamics of large language model (LLM) agents in financial decision environments. Using TradeArena, an auditable trading-agent testbed with risk reports, execution simulation, memory, and replayable trajectories, we analyze how rationales, positions, and interventions evolve under market stress. We find measurable pre-failure signatures: planning embeddings drift from normal-state centroids, fused plan-risk representations separate normal from pre-drawdown states, and manifold diagnostics show effective-rank contraction before failures. To address small-sample and embedding-choice concerns, we use 80 rolling failure anchors across eight LLM trajectories and show that contraction persists across hash, LSA, Transformer, and white-box hidden-state probes. Stress tests with CoT-free target weights, lexical controls, OHLCV noise, and false-audit reports indicate that rationale-level contraction can vanish without rationales, while intent-space contraction may remain; lexical diversity does not collapse; and fused signatures remain informative under noise. We also find that structured risk feedback can act as an external alignment signal without fine-tuning, but not as a universal performance enhancer: true audit feedback improves calibration for some models, return and drawdown for others, and reveals cases where hidden or placebo feedback has higher short-horizon return but weaker alignment diagnostics. Finally, a 51-stock intraday experiment reveals a correlation blind spot: LLM rationales often justify concentrated exposure to coupled assets that the risk layer repeatedly clips, with a rolling Markowitz baseline as a covariance reference. These results support a research claim rather than a profitability claim: auditable risk feedback and representation trajectories reveal when LLM financial reasoning is aligning, drifting, or failing.

</details>


### [214] [Emergent Semantic Representations in World Models through Physical Interaction without Linguistic Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28865)
*Jiayi Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，基于VAE的世界模型在无语言监督的随机物理探索中，其潜在空间会自动发展出与物理几何结构高度一致的空间语义结构。研究表明，预测性能与语义对齐共同优化（Spearman r=-0.61, p=0.004），且KL正则化（beta=0.1）会同时破坏两者，而降低beta（0.001）可恢复，证实物理世界几何结构是世界模型表征的组织原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究世界模型在无语言监督条件下从物理探索中学到的表征结构，特别是其潜在空间是否以及如何组织语义信息。

Method: 训练基于VAE的世界模型进行随机具身探索，通过方向准确率、位置RSA等指标评估潜在空间与物理几何结构的一致性；设置20个时间检查点追踪预测性能与语义对齐的共变关系；进行双敲除实验（调节KL正则化beta值）验证共享驱动假说。

Result: 训练后的世界模型潜在空间展现出显著的几何结构对齐（方向准确率0.677±0.029 vs 随机基线0.547；位置RSA 0.192±0.047 vs 0.029，提升6.6倍）。预测性能与语义对齐显著相关（Spearman r=-0.61, p=0.004）。标准KL正则化（beta=0.1）在50000步内同时破坏两者，降低beta至0.001可恢复。

Conclusion: 物理世界几何结构是世界模型表征的核心组织原则，为设计具有语义基底的具身智能体提供了直接启示。

Abstract: What does a world model learn from physical exploration, without any linguistic supervision? We argue the answer is organized by a single principle: the geometric structure of the physical world. Training a VAE-based world model on random embodied exploration, we find that its latent space develops spatial semantic structure that mirrors physical geometry -- direction accuracy 0.677+-0.029 versus 0.547 for a randomly initialized encoder, and position RSA 0.192+-0.047 versus 0.029 for random encoders (6.6x improvement), showing that training induces genuine structural organization beyond CNN inductive bias. Across 20 temporal checkpoints, prediction performance and semantic alignment co-improve (Spearman r=-0.61, p=0.004), consistent with the shared-driver account. We confirm this through a double knockout: standard KL regularization (beta=0.1) forces the encoder away from geometric structure, and both prediction performance and semantic alignment collapse simultaneously to near-chance by step 50,000 -- exactly as the shared-driver account predicts. Reducing beta to 0.001 restores geometric access and recovers both capabilities together. These findings establish physical world geometry as the organizing principle of world model representations, with direct implications for the design of semantically grounded embodied agents.

</details>


### [215] [Continuity and Ordinality Matter: Constraining Time Series Tokens for Effective Time Series Analysis with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28866)
*Musheng Li,Ziying Zhang,Cheng jin,Yuantao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出COM策略，通过在初始化和训练阶段引入几何约束来保留时间序列token的连续性和有序性，显著提升了基于token的时间序列大语言模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于token的时间序列大语言模型忽视了时间序列token固有的连续性和有序性，导致模型性能受限。

Method: 提出COM（Continuity and Ordinality Matter）策略，在token嵌入的初始化和训练阶段整合几何约束，以保留时间序列token的连续性和有序性。

Result: 在多个时间序列分析基准上，COM一致性地提升了基于token的TS-LLMs的性能，取得了具有竞争力的结果和强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 保留时间序列token的连续性和有序性对于基于token的TS-LLMs的有效性至关重要，COM策略是一种有效且泛化性强的改进方法。

Abstract: Token-based time series large language models (TS-LLMs) have emerged as a promising direction for time series analysis and reasoning. However, prior studies largely overlook the inherent continuity and ordinality of time series tokens, which substantially limits model performance. In this paper, we argue that preserving these properties in time series token embeddings is crucial for the effectiveness of token-based TS-LLMs. To this end, we propose COM (Continuity and Ordinality Matter), a continuity- and ordinality-aware strategy that integrates geometric constraints into both the initialization and training stages. Empirical results on multiple time series analysis benchmarks demonstrate that COM consistently improves the performance of token-based TS-LLMs, achieving competitive results and strong generalizability. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/COM .

</details>


### [216] [PrismFlow: Residual Dynamics for Flow Matching in Time-Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28867)
*Junru Zhang,Lang Feng,Jinbo Wang,Xu Guo,Yucheng Wang,Han Yu,Min Wu,Yabo Dong,Duanqing Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PrismFlow提出了一种基于Koopman动力学的流匹配方法，通过多个专家模块学习残差校正，并使用置信感知的胜者全得目标实现模式特异性专业化，有效缓解了标准流匹配中因单一时空场估计器导致的光谱收缩和多模态退化问题，在时间序列生成、预测和插补任务上取得了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界时间序列常呈现多模态模式和多尺度动态（如振荡和高频变化），标准流匹配方法依赖单一有限容量的全局向量场估计器，在多模态异质分布中会产生过度平滑的传输场近似，导致分支特异性动态衰减、频谱失真和模式覆盖不足。

Method: 提出PrismFlow，包含Koopman启发的动态专家模块：每个专家在潜空间中学习残差校正，将局部非线性时间演化近似为线性变换；采用置信感知的胜者全得（WTA）目标，仅更新与样本最匹配的专家并掩蔽其他专家的梯度；采样时，选中的专家向全局传输场添加残差动态校正，在保持流匹配稳定性的同时恢复细粒度和高频时序结构。

Result: 在多个基准上，PrismFlow有效缓解了标准流匹配的光谱收缩问题，Context-FID提升15.6%，判别分数改进38.6%，在低数据设置下保持鲁棒性，并有效适用于预测和插补任务。

Conclusion: PrismFlow通过多专家协同与Koopman线性化策略，在保持流匹配稳定性的前提下显著提升了多模态时间序列的生成质量，为复杂时序数据的生成建模提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Generating high-quality time-series data is challenging because real-world signals often exhibit multimodal patterns and multiscale dynamics, including oscillations and high-frequency variations. Flow Matching (FM) offers an efficient alternative to diffusion models, but practical implementations typically rely on a single finite-capacity global vector-field estimator. In such heterogeneous temporal distributions, distinct regimes may pass through nearby flow states while requiring incompatible conditional velocities. A monolithic estimator trained with the standard $\ell_2$ velocity-matching objective may therefore learn an overly smoothed approximation of the local transport field. This estimator-level smoothing can attenuate branch-specific dynamics, leading to spectral distortion and poor mode coverage. To address this, we propose PrismFlow, a new FM method with Koopman-inspired dynamical experts. Each expert learns residual corrections in a latent space where local nonlinear temporal evolution can be approximated by linear transitions. We further propose a confidence-aware Winner-Take-All (WTA) objective that updates only the expert best aligned with each sample while masking gradients to the others, encouraging mode-specific specialization. During sampling, the selected expert adds a residual dynamical correction to the global transport field, preserving FM stability while recovering fine-grained and high-frequency temporal structures. Across various benchmarks, PrismFlow effectively mitigates the spectral contraction in standard FM and achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a 15.6% gain in Context-FID and a 38.6% improvement in Discriminative Score, while remaining robust in low-data settings and effective for forecasting and imputation.

</details>


### [217] [TaxDistill: Improving Metagenomic Taxonomic Annotation via Distilled Genomic Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28868)
*Rongye Ye,Lun Li,Zheng Luo,Yiran Zhan,Shuhui Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TaxDistill，一个基于知识蒸馏的宏基因组分类框架。它利用500M参数的基因组基础模型GenomeOcean作为教师网络，提取深层语义特征并生成基于置信度的软标签，通过蒸馏将软标签知识传递给轻量级学生网络，有效减少初始检索工具引入的标签噪声。在7个CAMI2数据集上，TaxDistill优于现有基线，例如在Gastrointestinal数据集上将MMseqs2的F1分数从0.763提升至0.941。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统宏基因组分类方法依赖序列相似性搜索，受限于微生物高多样性和参考数据库不完整。现有学习方法（如Taxometer）虽进行后验校正，但训练时依赖相似性搜索工具生成的标签，不可避免地引入噪声，损害表征学习和分类性能。

Method: 提出TaxDistill知识蒸馏框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) GenomeOcean——500M参数的基因组基础模型作为教师网络，提取深层语义特征并根据置信度生成软标签；(2) 轻量级学生网络，通过蒸馏教师网络的软标签信息进行训练，从而减少初始检索工具引入的标签噪声。

Result: 在7个CAMI2数据集上的实验表明，TaxDistill在多数场景下优于现有基线。例如在Gastrointestinal数据集上，将MMseqs2的F1分数从0.763提升至0.941，优于Taxometer基线。

Conclusion: TaxDistill为复杂宏基因组分析中的标签校正提供了一种可靠方法，通过知识蒸馏有效降低了标签噪声，提升了分类性能。

Abstract: Metagenomic taxonomic annotation aims to identify the microbial origins of DNA fragments in environmental samples. Traditional methods that rely on sequence similarity are often constrained by the high microbial diversity and the incompleteness of reference databases, which has motivated the development of learning approaches such as Taxometer that perform post hoc correction to learn more informative metagenomic sequence representations. However, these methods typically rely on labels derived from similarity search tools during training, which inevitably introduces noise that can impair representation learning and degrade classification performance. To address this issue, we propose TaxDistill, a knowledge distillation framework for metagenomic classification. We introduce GenomeOcean, a 500M parameter genomic foundation model, as the teacher network to extract deep semantic features and generate soft labels based on confidence. By distilling this soft label information into a lightweight student network, TaxDistill effectively reduces the label noise introduced by initial retrieval tools. Comprehensive experiments on seven diverse CAMI2 datasets demonstrate that TaxDistill outperforms existing baselines in most scenarios. For instance, on the Gastrointestinal dataset, it improves the F1 score of MMseqs2 from 0.763 to 0.941, outperforming the Taxometer baseline. Overall, TaxDistill provides a reliable method for label correction in complex metagenomic analysis.

</details>


### [218] [Balancing Multimodal Learning through Label Space Reshaping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28869)
*Xiaoyu Ma,Weijie Zhang,Yuanhao Gao,Han Miao,Yongjian Deng,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出平衡多模态标签重塑方法(BMLR)，通过重塑跨模态标签空间来均衡各模态的映射难度，解决多模态学习中因模态间映射难度差异导致的学习不平衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态学习中存在模态不平衡问题，即某些模态收敛更快而主导优化过程，其他模态训练不足。现有方法主要通过增强弱模态或调整梯度来缓解，但未从模态层面分析不平衡产生的根本原因，且往往以牺牲强模态的优化能力为代价。

Method: 提出BMLR方法，这是首个从标签侧设计促进多模态平衡的方法。通过重塑跨模态标签空间来均衡各模态的映射难度，从而促进模态交互并将更丰富的类间信息注入每个模态。

Result: 在多种架构上的大量实验表明，BMLR持续提升多模态性能，并与多种模型设计具有良好的兼容性。

Conclusion: 从标签侧设计入手解决多模态不平衡问题是有效的，BMLR通过均衡映射难度而非削弱强模态的方式，实现了模态间的更好平衡。

Abstract: Multimodal learning often suffers from modality imbalance, where modalities that converge faster dominate optimization while others remain undertrained. Existing approaches typically mitigate this issue by strengthening the weak modality or adjusting optimization gradients. However, such strategies mainly compensate for optimization rate discrepancies, often at the expense of the strong modality's optimization capacity, without analyzing how these discrepancies arise at the modality level. Based on theoretical insights and empirical observations, we argue that the discrepancy of learning pace arises from differences in the mapping difficulty between modality-specific feature space and the shared label space. To address this issue, we propose Balanced Multimodal Label Reshaping (BMLR), the first method that promotes multimodal balance from the label-side design. BMLR reshapes the cross-modal label space to equalize mapping difficulty across modalities, thereby facilitating modality interaction and injecting richer inter-class information into each modality. Extensive experiments across multiple architectures demonstrate that BMLR consistently improves multimodal performance and exhibits strong compatibility with diverse model designs. The source code will be released soon.

</details>


### [219] [Representation Alignment Rests on Linear Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28870)
*Kiril Bangachev,Guy Bresler,Yury Polyanskiy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过信号、偏差和噪声的三部分统计框架研究柏拉图表征假说（PRH），提出柏拉图对齐源于物体-属性的普适关系在线性表征假说（LRH）中线性编码，并通过稀疏自编码器提取特征验证了跨模态对齐；发现中心化和归一化可缓解架构偏差，而数据稀缺导致表征噪声（词频与对齐正相关）；最终提出一个统计模型细化LRH并解释多种现代AI架构中的表征对齐现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究柏拉图表征假说（PRH）的内在机制，即为什么不同AI模型会趋向于学习相似的表征空间。

Method: 提出信号、偏差和噪声的三部分统计框架：信号部分基于线性表征假说（LRH）和稀疏自编码器提取线性物体-属性特征；偏差部分通过中心化和归一化缓解架构差异；噪声部分分析词频与对齐的相关性。

Result: 稀疏表征比密集表征展现出更强的跨模态对齐；中心化和归一化可一致提升跨模型对齐；词频与对齐之间存在强正相关，表明数据稀缺是表征噪声的驱动因素。

Conclusion: 提出一个统计模型细化线性表征假说，能够解释多种现代AI架构中表征对齐的现象。

Abstract: We investigate the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) through a tripartite statistical framework of representations: signal, bias, and noise. {1) Signal:} We propose that Platonic alignment arises from the universal relationship between objects and attributes, which is encoded linearly in representations according to the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH). We provide evidence that LRH helps explain PRH by extracting linear object-attribute features with sparse autoencoders and showing that these sparse representations often exhibit stronger cross-modal alignment than their dense counterparts. {2) Bias:} Models have different implicit biases due to the diverse architectures and training procedures used. We show that this difference can be partially mitigated. Centering and normalization consistently improve cross-model alignment. {3) Noise:} Finite-sample training leads to noise in representations. We provide evidence that representational noise is driven by data scarcity by revealing a strong and consistent positive correlation between word frequency and alignment in LLMs and text embedding models. Synthesizing signal, bias, and noise, we propose a statistical model that refines the Linear Representation Hypothesis and explains further phenomena related to the alignment of representations emerging from diverse modern AI architectures.

</details>


### [220] [Pre-Registering the Detectable Effect: A Paired-MDE Budget for 4-bit Quantization Benchmarks, with a Pilot Audit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28873)
*Zexin Zhuang,Yanhang Li,Zhichao Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将经典配对二项样本量计算方法（Miettinen, 1968）适配到量化基准评估中，提出了一个保守的最小可检测效应（MDE）界δ* ≤ (z_{1-α/2}+z_{1-β})√(ρ_d/m)，将量化声明的可靠性转化为基准设计者可在运行前承诺的“一行预算”。实验表明，在n=100子样本上，大部分“基准不可靠性”方差实为二项抽样噪声；提示模板引入的方差（2-10 pp）达到或超过最大的量化差异（3.2 pp）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化基准评估中缺乏一个形式化的方法来衡量量化声明的统计可靠性，研究者常将二项抽样噪声误判为基准不可靠性，且提示模板方差与量化噪声混淆，影响量化效果的评估。

Method: 将Miettinen(1968)的配对二项样本量计算适配到量化基准场景，推导出基于配对项目数m和FP16-NF4不一致率ρ_d的MDE界；在4个模型×4个基准（k=5次分割，n=100）上验证，并结合MMLU提示模板对照研究。

Result: 所有观测的NF4-FP16差异均低于ρ_d=0.10设定下的MDE；大部分跨分割标准差在±1.5个百分点内符合二项参考√(p(1-p)/n)；提示模板范围（2-10 pp）达到或超过最大量化差异（3.2 pp）；提供了五行的预注册模板。

Conclusion: 量化基准中的大部分方差为二项抽样噪声，提示模板方差主导量化噪声，量化审计必须在固定提示模板后进行；提出的MDE界为基准设计提供了明确的事前统计规划工具。

Abstract: This is a planning-method note with an unpaired pilot audit. We adapt the classical paired-binary sample-size calculation (Miettinen, 1968) to quantization benchmarks, giving a conservative minimum detectable effect (MDE) bound $δ^{*} \le (z_{1-α/2}+z_{1-β})\sqrt{ρ_d/m}$ in the paired item count $m$ and the FP16-NF4 disagreement rate $ρ_d$. The bound turns "how reliable is my quantization claim?" into a one-line budget a benchmark designer can commit to before running. We illustrate the bound on four models and four benchmarks ($k=5$ splits of $n=100$), and add a parallel MMLU prompt-template study to put the bound's quantization-noise scale alongside the prompt-noise scale. Assuming $ρ_d=0.10$ (an unmeasured planning value), all observed NF4-FP16 deltas fall below the implied MDE, and most cross-split SDs lie within $\pm 1.5$ pp of the binomial reference $\sqrt{p(1-p)/n}$, so much of the variance reported as "benchmark unreliability" on $n=100$ subsamples is binomial sampling noise. The single borderline cell (OPT-WinoGrande, $|Δ|=3.2$ pp) is below the implied MDE at $ρ_d=0.10$ but above it at $ρ_d=0.05$, illustrating the planning trade-off the bound makes explicit. On MMLU, prompt-template ranges of 2-10 pp meet or exceed the largest observed quantization delta (3.2 pp), so a quantization audit that does not first fix the prompt template absorbs template variance into its noise floor. We complement the bound with a five-line pre-registration template.

</details>


### [221] [Towards Continuous-time Causal Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28880)
*Dennis Thumm,Ruben Wiedemann,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出连续时间因果先验数据拟合网络（Prior-data Fitted Networks）的精密连续性准则——轨迹定律对观测时间表的不变性，构建三层分类体系（离散、朴素观测网格积分、细粒度解耦观测积分），并通过随机DAG上的OU或小MLP非线性漂移实现顶层架构，在8/8个实验单元中细粒度积分均优于朴素积分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将离散时间因果先验数据拟合网络扩展至连续时间时，若SDE在每个观测间隙只积分一次，轨迹定律会依赖于观测时间，导致先验仍是离散时间马尔可夫模型。需要一种精确的连续性准则来保证模型在观测时间表变化下的不变性。

Method: 提出轨迹定律对观测时间表不变性的连续性准则；构建三层分类体系（离散、朴素观测网格积分、细网格解耦观测积分）；采用随机DAG结构，以OU过程或小型MLP作为非线性漂移，支持不规则观测时间表以及硬/软/时变干预；通过2×2编码器×积分器消融实验在线性和非线性先验上进行验证。

Result: 细网格积分在全部8个实验单元中均优于朴素积分（符号一致性p<1/256），且优势随评估网格细化而扩大；在细积分条件下编码器轴无效，而在朴素积分条件下时间感知编码器占优。

Conclusion: 发布相关先验模型及药代动力学和物理系统数据上的初步零样本协议，验证了所提方法的有效性。

Abstract: Extending discrete-time causal Prior-data Fitted Networks for time series to continuous time invites writing the mechanism as a stochastic differential equation (SDE) -- but if the SDE is integrated \emph{once per observation gap}, the trajectory law depends on when it is observed, and the prior remains a discrete-time Markov model in SDE clothing.
  We propose a precise continuity criterion -- trajectory-law invariance to the observation schedule -- together with a three-tier taxonomy (discrete; naive observation-grid integration; fine-grid integration with decoupled observation) and a construction realising the top tier on a random DAG with OU or small-MLP nonlinear drifts, irregular observation schedules, and hard / soft / time-varying interventions.
  A $2 \times 2$ encoder $\times$ integrator ablation, run independently on a linear and a nonlinear prior, finds fine-grid integration beats naive on 8/8 cells (sign-consistency $p < 1/256$) with the gap growing as the eval grid refines; the encoder axis is null with fine integration but time-aware-leading with naive.
  We release the prior and a preliminary zero-shot protocol on pharmacokinetic and physical-system data.

</details>


### [222] [Context Distillation as Latent Memory Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28889)
*Ziyang Zheng,Zeju Li,Xiangyu Wen,Jianyuan Zhong,Junhua Huang,Lei Chen,Mingxuan Yuan,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将上下文蒸馏视为潜在记忆管理问题，通过独立LoRA适配器构建模块化记忆库，结合检索、路由和自门控机制实现安全、高效的记忆激活，实验证明该方法在非oracle场景下显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文蒸馏方法将上下文信息压缩到模型参数中，但忽略了多个蒸馏后的潜在记忆应如何存储、检索以及在非oracle场景下安全激活的问题。

Method: 1) 将每个上下文蒸馏成独立的LoRA适配器，构建模块化记忆库；2) 对查询检索候选记忆并路由到最合适的适配器；3) 使用自门控(Self-Gating)机制决定是否激活潜在记忆；4) 引入缓存共享减少推理时的管理开销。

Result: 该方法在检索场景下显著优于基线，自门控机制通过停用不必要的潜在记忆提升了鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 将上下文蒸馏建模为潜在记忆管理问题，并设计模块化记忆库与自门控机制，是解决多记忆存储、检索和安全激活问题的有效方案。

Abstract: Context distillation compresses contextual information into model parameters, yet existing methods often ignore how multiple distilled latent memories should be stored, retrieved, and safely activated in non-oracle settings. We formulate context distillation as a latent memory management problem. We distill each context into an independent LoRA adapter, forming a modular memory bank that enables explicit memory selection. Given a query, our framework retrieves candidate memories, routes the query to the most suitable adapter, and uses a Self-Gating mechanism to decide whether latent memory should be activated. To improve efficiency, we further introduce cache sharing to reduce management overhead during inference. Experiments show that our method substantially outperforms baselines with retrieval, while Self-Gating improves robustness by deactivate unnecessary latent memories.

</details>


### [223] [Feature Geometry of LoRA Adapters: A Sparse Autoencoder Analysis of Representational Divergence in Fine-Tuned Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28896)
*Prasanth K K*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过稀疏自编码器（SAEs）研究LoRA微调对大型语言模型内部表示几何结构的影响，发现LoRA诱导的特征字典与预训练SAE特征之间存在较弱的几何对齐，表明LoRA更新在残差流中占据部分独特的表征结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA微调已被广泛采用，但其内部表征变化仍未被充分理解，作者希望揭示LoRA微调过程中模型内部表示几何结构的本质变化。

Method: 提出delta激活框架隔离LoRA适配器对残差流的贡献；在Gemma-2-9B上使用秩4/8/16/32的LoRA训练适配器专用SAE；采用余弦相似度、主角度分析和中心核对齐（CKA）评估表征对齐程度。

Result: LoRA诱导的特征字典与预训练SAE特征几何对齐较弱；适配器专用SAE能更有效重建delta激活；特征密度随秩和深度增加而增加，但几何分歧在不同秩之间保持相对稳定。

Conclusion: LoRA微调会诱导出预训练可解释性词典无法完全捕捉的特征结构，这对机械可解释性、适配分析和微调语言模型的安全审计具有重要启示。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a widely adopted approach for adapting large language models, yet the internal representational changes induced by LoRA fine-tuning remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we investigate the geometry of LoRA-induced representations using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs). We introduce a delta activation framework that isolates the adapter-specific contribution to the residual stream.
  Using Gemma-2-9B with LoRA ranks 4, 8, 16, and 32, we train adapter-specific SAEs across multiple transformer layers and compare their learned feature spaces with pretrained SAE dictionaries. We evaluate representational alignment using cosine similarity between decoder directions, principal-angle analysis of feature subspaces, and Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) between activation representations.
  Across layers and ranks, we consistently observe comparatively weak geometric alignment between LoRA-induced feature dictionaries and pretrained SAE features. Adapter-specific SAEs also reconstruct delta activations more effectively than pretrained SAEs, suggesting that LoRA updates occupy partially distinct representational structure within the residual stream. Additionally, feature density increases with rank and depth, while geometric divergence remains relatively stable across ranks.
  These findings provide empirical evidence that LoRA fine-tuning can induce feature structures that are not fully captured by pretrained interpretability dictionaries, with implications for mechanistic interpretability, adaptation analysis, and safety auditing of fine-tuned language models.

</details>


### [224] [Spectral Guidance for Flexible and Efficient Control of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28900)
*Gabriel Moreira,Manuel Marques,João Paulo Costeira,Chenyan Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Spectral Guidance框架，利用生成过程的固有几何结构控制扩散模型，通过条件期望算子的奇异函数实现无需重训练或反向传播的高保真控制，在CIFAR-10上提升37个百分点的条件准确率并实现4倍加速采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型中数据被噪声逐步破坏时，仅有少部分特征对控制仍然有效，现有方法需要重训练或反向传播，效率低下且不稳定。

Method: 将有效控制特征刻画为条件期望算子的奇异函数，通过自监督目标学习该基函数，然后将任意引导信号（标签、CLIP嵌入、掩码等）直接投影到采样轨迹上。

Result: 在CIFAR-10上条件准确率提升37个百分点，采样速度提升4倍；同一表示既支持标签/CLIP引导，也支持空间控制（如掩码引导），无需辅助模型。

Conclusion: 揭示了生成过程中的相变现象，精准定位了有效引导的最优时间窗口，为扩散模型的高效可控生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: We introduce Spectral Guidance, a framework for controlling diffusion models by leveraging the intrinsic geometry of the generative process. As data is progressively corrupted by noise, only a small number of features remain informative for control. We characterize them as the singular functions of a conditional expectation operator and show that they can be learned via a self-supervised objective. Once recovered, this basis enables the projection of arbitrary guidance signals, such as labels, CLIP embeddings, or masks, directly onto the sampling trajectory. This approach allows for stable, high-fidelity control without retraining or denoiser backpropagation during sampling. Empirically, we improve conditional accuracy on CIFAR-10 by 37 percentage points over the strongest training-free baseline while offering $4\times$ faster sampling. Moreover, the same representations that support label and CLIP guidance also enable spatial control, such as mask-based guidance, without auxiliary models. Finally, our framework reveals a phase transition in the generative process, pinpointing the optimal time window for effective guidance.

</details>


### [225] [Sequential Physics-Constrained Neural Operator Forward Modeling for the $\textit{Norne}$ Reservoir System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28909)
*Clement Etienam,Juntao Yang,Oleg Ovcharenko,Nick Luiken,Tsubasa Onishi,Nefeli Moridis,Issam Said*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了基于神经算子（特别是FNO和PINO）的三相黑油油藏动态序贯代理建模的完整数学与计算框架，在Norne基准油藏上实现了R²>0.99（油）、R²>0.90（气）、R²≈0.80（压力）的精度，并在单GPU上实现了相比传统模拟器约10⁴倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统油藏数值模拟计算成本极高，尤其是大规模油藏（如Norne油藏113,344个网格单元）的时序模拟和多成员集合分析（如1000个成员）。因此需要开发高效且准确的代理模型来替代昂贵的有限体积模拟器，同时保证长时间步长自回归推演的稳定性和精度。

Method: (1) 在乘积Sobolev空间中进行泛函分析形式化，证明隐式时间步映射的适定性和局部Lipschitz估计；(2) 协变量偏移量化，证明Wasserstein-2距离增长界；(3) 物理约束谱稳定性分析，证明PINO训练可将学习到的Jacobian谱半径降低，实现uniform-in-time的 rollout误差界；(4) K步TBPTT梯度分析，推导几何偏置衰减、最优窗口和Adam收敛率。实证中采用8块NVIDIA B200 GPU在Norne油藏（46×112×22网格，30时间步，3298天）上训练自回归PINO代理模型。

Result: 自回归PINO代理模型在3298天完整时间跨度上：油R²>0.99，气R²>0.90，压力R²≈0.80，水相R²单调提升。训练时间小于1小时（8块B200 GPU），1000成员集合模拟在单块B200 GPU上不到1分钟完成，相比OPM有限体积模拟器实现了约10⁴倍的墙钟加速。

Conclusion: 本文构建的神经算子代理框架在理论上严格证明了长时间自回归推演的稳定性和收敛性，实证上在大规模真实油藏数据上达到了高精度和极显著的加速比，为油藏快速模拟和不确定性量化提供了可行的深度学习方法。

Abstract: We develop a comprehensive mathematical and computational framework for sequential surrogate modeling of three-phase black-oil reservoir dynamics using neural operators, with particular emphasis on Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) and their physics-informed variant (PINO). The application focus is the Norne benchmark reservoir, defined on a heterogeneous $46\times112\times22$ grid ($N=113,344$ cells), with a production history spanning $T=30$ timesteps covering 3298 days. Our theoretical contributions are organized around four interlocking problems: (1) functional-analytic formulation in a product-Sobolev-space setting, including well-posedness of the implicit timestep map and sharp local Lipschitz estimates; (2) covariate shift quantification, proving that the Wasserstein-2 distance grows as $W_2 \leq \varepsilon(L^n-1)/(L-1)$, with exponential population-risk discrepancy for $L>1$; (3) physics-constrained spectral stability, showing PINO training with $λ_R \geq λ^*_R$ reduces the learned Jacobian spectral radius to $ρ_F + Cλ_R^{-1/2}$, yielding uniform-in-time rollout error $|δ_n| \leq \varepsilon/(1-ρ)$; and (4) $K$-step TBPTT gradient analysis, deriving geometric bias decay $O(ρ^K)$, optimal window $K^ = O(\log(T/σ^2))$, and Adam convergence $O(1/\sqrt{t}) + O(ρ^{K^*})$. Empirical validation confirms all theoretical predictions: autoregressive PINO surrogates sustain $R^2>0.99$ (oil), $R^2>0.90$ (gas), $R^2\approx 0.80$ (pressure), and monotonically improving $R^2$ (water) across the full 3298-day horizon, trained on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs in under one hour. A 1000-member ensemble runs in under one minute on a single B200 GPU, giving a ${\sim}10^4\times$ wall-clock speedup over the OPM finite-volume simulator.

</details>


### [226] [Cycle-Space Informed Detection of Autoencoded Blind False Data Injection Attacks on Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28912)
*Xin Li,Chenhan Xiao,Jonathan Cohen,Aviad Elyashar,Yang Weng,Rami Puzis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑循环空间的虚假数据注入攻击检测方法（CSD），利用电网拓扑的循环空间约束替代纯数值零空间估计，有效检测数据驱动的盲FDIA攻击，在多个IEEE标准系统上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于统计或数据驱动的FDIA检测方法容易受到攻击者利用相同数据结构构造的隐蔽扰动欺骗，尤其是当攻击者通过自编码器学习测量流形并沿雅可比零空间方向生成扰动时，传统残差检测器和时序异常检测器均会失效。

Method: 提出拓扑信息循环空间检测器（CSD），利用电网拓扑的循环空间（Cycle-Space）施加结构约束以增强零空间估计；通过最小循环基（MCB）实现最优泛化误差；该方法不依赖精确线路参数。

Result: 在IEEE 14、30、57、118节点系统上的仿真结果表明，所提方法在存在实际测量噪声的条件下，能够有效检测数据驱动的FDIA攻击。

Conclusion: 基于拓扑循环空间的方法通过结构约束提升了对隐蔽攻击的检测能力，相比纯数据驱动方法具有更好的鲁棒性和泛化性能，且不需要精确的线路参数，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: The rapid growth of AI-driven data centers and large-scale energy storage systems is increasing the reliance of power system operation on real-time measurement data and automated decision-making. However, many existing detection methods rely on statistical or data-driven analysis of measurements and can fail when attackers exploit the same data structure to craft stealthy perturbations. To illustrate this limitation, we demonstrate a blind False Data Injection Attack (FDIA) in which an Autoencoder learns the measurement manifold and generates perturbations aligned with the Jacobian null space, thereby allowing the attack to evade both residual-based baddata detectors and time-series anomaly detectors. To mitigate data-driven FDIAs which exploit the null space, we propose a topology-informed Cycle-Space Detector (CSD) that leverages the Cycle-Space of the network to impose structural constraints that enhance null space estimation. In addition, we prove that by using the Minimum Cycle Basis (MCB), the proposed CSD achieves the optimal generalization error for attack detection. By exploiting topology-derived cycle constraints rather than relying solely on numerical null space estimation, the proposed method does not require precise line parameters and improves the separation between normal and attacked measurements. Simulation results on IEEE 14-, 30-, 57-, and 118-bus systems demonstrate that the proposed method effectively detects data-driven FDIAs under realistic measurement noise.

</details>


### [227] [When LLM Reward Design Fails: Diagnostic-Driven Refinement for Sparse Structured RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28918)
*Youting Wang,Yuan Tang,Bowen Liu,Xuan Liu,Dingyan Shang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将LLM生成的奖励塑形视为调试过程而非一次性生成，通过诊断驱动的迭代精炼显著提升稀疏结构化强化学习任务的性能，在DoorKey-8x8和KeyCorridor任务上分别从2.3%提升至97.6%、从31.2%提升至86.7%，并通过控制实验和消融分析证实了调试解释的有效性，同时揭示了该方法在连续控制任务中的边界条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对稀疏结构化强化学习任务中LLM生成奖励塑形的一次性生成失败率高的问题，提出将其重新框架化为调试过程，通过诊断驱动的迭代精炼来系统性地修正奖励函数中的错误模式。

Method: 利用MiniGrid作为核心评估环境、MuJoCo作为边界压力测试，使用PPO训练智能体。首先审计发现两种主要的一次性失败模式（奖励洪泛和语义/API误解）以及一种罕见的弱塑形情况，然后提出基于训练诊断和失败模式分类学的迭代精炼方法，引导奖励函数的针对性修订。

Result: DoorKey-8x8从2.3%提升至97.6%，KeyCorridor从31.2%提升至86.7%（高种子间方差）。控制实验表明增益来自调试而非重试或额外训练：仅基于指标的重提示性能大幅下降，静态词汇控制恢复了大部分差距（87.6%；70.7%），预算匹配和Best-of-3对比分离了精炼与选择及训练时间效应。

Conclusion: 该方法适用于具有可靠接口的稀疏结构化PPO任务，调试解释得到组件移除测试、敏感度分析和人工审计的收敛证据支持，但在密集奖励的连续控制任务中性能边界明显——基于成功率的诊断可能失效，返回趋势反馈可消除一个假阳性机制但无法带来稳健增益。

Abstract: For sparse, structured reinforcement-learning tasks with semantic reward-function interfaces, LLM-generated reward shaping is better framed as debugging than one-shot generation. We study PPO-trained agents using MiniGrid as core evaluation and MuJoCo as boundary stress test. Our audit finds two dominant one-shot failure modes -- reward flooding and semantic/API misunderstanding -- plus a rarer weak-shaping case. We propose diagnostic-driven iterative refinement, where training diagnostics and a failure-mode taxonomy guide targeted reward-function revision. Refinement improves DoorKey-8x8 from 2.3% to 97.6% and KeyCorridor from 31.2% to 86.7% with high seed-to-seed variance. Controls show these gains are not from retrying or extra training: metrics-only re-prompting yields large drops, while a static-vocabulary control recovers much of the gap (87.6%; 70.7%), showing the taxonomy prompt is a major mechanism and dynamic labels provide only partially isolated incremental evidence. Budget-matched and Best-of-3 comparisons separate refinement from selection and training-time effects. Component-removal tests, sensitivity analyses, and an audit against author labels provide converging evidence for the debugging interpretation while revealing calibration limits. Continuous-control results show the boundary: success-based diagnostics can misfire in dense-reward locomotion, and return-trend feedback removes one false-positive mechanism without robust gains. The low-call protocol is a cost contrast with population-based reward search, not a benchmark comparison. In four crossed-variance-design environments, point estimates suggest larger gains when LLM reward-function variance dominates but bootstrap intervals are wide. The method is bounded to sparse structured tasks with reliable interfaces under PPO; fields like event_text may help, hurt, or be neutral.

</details>


### [228] [CosmicFish-HRM: Adaptive Reasoning via Hierarchical Recurrent Mechanisms in Compact Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28919)
*Venkat Akhil Lakkapragada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CosmicFish-HRM是一种紧凑型语言模型，通过分层推理模块动态分配计算资源，在不同任务和输入上自适应调整推理深度，避免了固定计算开销，为轻量级模型增强推理能力提供了新思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型具备强推理能力，但通常以巨大的参数量和昂贵的推理成本为代价。本文旨在探索一种不同的方向：在紧凑型语言模型中实现自适应推理深度，从而在不依赖大规模参数的情况下提升推理能力，降低推理成本。

Method: 提出CosmicFish-HRM模型，核心是分层推理模块（HRM），该模块在推理过程中动态分配计算资源，通过高层和低层推理循环迭代，并学习根据输入复杂度决定何时停止推理。模型还融合了Grouped Query Attention、RoPE和SwiGLU等现代Transformer组件。

Result: 模型学会了非均匀的推理行为，在不同任务和输入上分配不同数量的推理步骤。虽然小规模时推理基础设施带来一定开销，但假设随着模型规模增大，HRM核心的相对成本会降低，这种权衡变得更为有利。

Conclusion: 自适应推理深度可能为依赖参数规模来获取推理能力提供了一种有前景的替代方案，在紧凑模型中实现高效推理是可行的方向。

Abstract: Large language models have achieved strong reasoning capabilities, though often at the cost of massive parameter counts and expensive inference. In this work, we explore a different direction: adaptive reasoning depth in compact language models. We present CosmicFish-HRM, a compact language model built around a Hierarchical Reasoning Module (HRM) that dynamically allocates computational effort during inference. Instead of applying fixed computation to every input, the model iterates through high-level and low-level reasoning cycles and learns when to halt based on input complexity. CosmicFish-HRM combines this adaptive reasoning core with modern transformer components including Grouped Query Attention, RoPE, and SwiGLU activations. While the additional reasoning infrastructure introduces overhead at small scale, we hypothesize that this tradeoff becomes increasingly favorable as model size grows and the relative cost of the HRM core diminishes. Our results show that the model learns non-uniform reasoning behavior, allocating different numbers of reasoning steps across tasks and inputs. These findings suggest that adaptive reasoning depth may offer a promising alternative to relying solely on parameter scale for reasoning capability.

</details>


### [229] [Conf-Gen: Conformal Uncertainty Quantification for Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28920)
*Gabriel Loaiza-Ganem,Kevin Zhang,Wei Cui,Marc T. Law,Kin Kwan Leung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Conformal Generation (Conf-Gen)框架，将保形预测与保形风险控制扩展到生成式AI任务（如大语言模型、图像生成器），在放宽理论假设的同时提供形式化保证，并在图像去记忆化、对话系统提问充分性、AI智能体正确性等新领域验证了其灵活性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有保形预测和保形风险控制主要针对监督学习，无法直接应用于无监督生成式模型（如LLMs和图像生成器），需要一种通用的框架来为生成式AI提供形式化的不确定性量化保证。

Method: 提出Conf-Gen框架，通过调整CRC使其适应生成式任务并放宽理论假设；该框架统一并泛化了之前将CP应用于LLMs的尝试，并将其扩展到全新领域。

Result: 在图像生成器防止记忆化、对话系统询问足够澄清问题、AI智能体输出正确性等新应用场景中验证了Conf-Gen的有效性。

Conclusion: Conf-Gen为生成式AI提供了一种通用的形式化保证框架，填补了保形方法在无监督生成任务中的空白，并展示了在多个新兴AI领域的适用性。

Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) and its extension, conformal risk control (CRC), are established frameworks for quantifying uncertainty in supervised machine learning through formal guarantees. However, recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence (AI) have been driven by unsupervised generative models, such as large language models (LLMs) and image generators, which are not directly compatible with CP or CRC. In this work we introduce conformal generation (Conf-Gen), a general framework adapting CRC to generative tasks while relaxing its theoretical assumptions. Conf-Gen unifies and generalizes previous attempts to apply CP to LLMs, and extends conformal methodology to entirely new domains. We demonstrate the flexibility of Conf-Gen through some novel applications, including obtaining conformal guarantees on: image generators producing non-memorized images, conversational AI systems having asked enough clarifying questions, and the output of AI agents being correct.

</details>


### [230] [A Training-Time Diagnostic for Generalization via the Log-Alignment Ratio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28975)
*Ali Shehper,Ashish Vaswani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了log-alignment ratio（LAR），将其重新表述为权重谱与激活谱之间的重叠，并证明LAR能追踪记忆与泛化之间的转变，在grokking实验中预测学习函数的有效维度，在语言模型预训练中跟踪泛化差距，且计算开销极小，无需验证数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解神经网络中参数与激活之间的对齐关系，并利用这种对齐度量来追踪模型从记忆到泛化的转变过程。

Method: 将LAR重新表述为权重谱（权重矩阵归一化平方奇异值的分布）与激活谱（输入在其奇异方向上的归一化平方投影的分布）之间的重叠；通过grokking和3B参数语言模型预训练两个实验验证LAR与泛化行为的关系。

Result: 在grokking中，LAR预测有效维度为k ≈ n^{2(1-LAR)}；在语言模型预训练中，LAR与泛化差距相关，其下降速率在过拟合临近时增加。

Conclusion: LAR是一种高效、无需验证数据的度量，可用于追踪模型泛化状态和检测过拟合。

Abstract: We study the log-alignment ratio (LAR), a measure of parameter-activation alignment, introduced in parameterization theory. We reformulate it as the overlap between a weight spectrum $p$ of the normalized squared singular values of a matrix and an activation spectrum $q$ of the normalized squared projections of inputs onto its singular directions. We show that unembedding LAR tracks the transition between memorization and generalization in two different settings by capturing the spread of $p$ and $q$ during training. In grokking, LAR predicts the effective dimension of the learned function: $k \approx n^{2(1-\text{LAR})}$, where $n$ is the input dimension of the matrix. In 3B-parameter language model pre-training, its deviation from a non-overfitting baseline tracks the generalization gap, and its rate of decline increases as overfitting approaches. LAR is computable from quantities available during the forward pass with negligible computational overhead, and requires no held-out validation data.

</details>


### [231] [Comparing Post-Hoc Explainable AI Methods for Interpreting Black-Box EEG Models in Depression Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28977)
*Antonia Šarčević,Nikolina Frid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了多种事后可解释性方法（DeepSHAP、Integrated Gradients、GradCAM、Occlusion、Permutation Feature Importance）在基于InceptionTime架构的EEG抑郁症检测模型中的应用，发现不同方法在额叶、颞叶、后部脑区（尤其是右半球）上呈现部分收敛的归因模式，但方法间存在显著差异，强调了事后可解释性在精神疾病EEG分类器解释中的有用性与局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在EEG-based抑郁症检测中性能不断提升，但其高容量模型的决策过程难以解释，缺乏可解释性研究来揭示模型的内部工作机制。

Method: 在InceptionTime架构上应用五种事后可解释性方法（DeepSHAP、Integrated Gradients、GradCAM、Occlusion、Permutation Feature Importance），并在受试者级别分层5折交叉验证框架下进行全局归因聚合分析。

Result: 不同可解释性方法揭示了部分收敛的归因模式，重点关注额叶、颞叶和后部脑区（尤其是右半球）；梯度法和扰动法之间一致性较高，DeepSHAP则产生显著不同的归因分布；方法间的变异性反映了方法论假设对解释结果的影响。

Conclusion: 事后可解释性方法在EEG深度学习模型中捕获了部分重叠的相关性结构，观察到的归因模式与以往MDD的EEG研究大致一致，但应视为探索性分析而非明确的神经生理生物标志物或临床适用证据；研究同时凸显了事后可解释性的有用性和局限性。

Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning have enabled increasingly accurate electroencephalography (EEG)-based classification of Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), but the decision-making processes of high-capacity models remain difficult to interpret. This study investigates multiple post-hoc explainability methods applied to an InceptionTime architecture trained for EEG-based MDD detection. The analysis includes Shapley-based, gradient-based, and perturbation-based attribution approaches: DeepSHAP, Integrated Gradients, GradCAM, Occlusion, and Permutation Feature Importance. Explainability analysis was performed within a subject-level stratified 5-fold cross-validation framework using global attribution aggregation across EEG segments and subjects. The evaluated methods revealed partially convergent attribution patterns, with recurring emphasis on frontal, temporal, and posterior EEG regions, particularly in the right hemisphere. Quantitative comparison demonstrated substantial agreement between gradient- and perturbation-based approaches, while DeepSHAP produced comparatively distinct attribution distributions. At the same time, variability between explainability methods highlighted the influence of methodological assumptions on the resulting explanations. Overall, the results suggest that different post-hoc explainability approaches capture partially overlapping relevance structures in EEG-based deep learning models for depression detection. Although the observed attribution patterns are broadly consistent with several previous EEG studies of MDD, the analysis should be interpreted as exploratory rather than evidence of definitive neurophysiological biomarkers or clinical applicability. The study highlights both the usefulness and limitations of post-hoc explainability for interpreting black-box EEG classifiers in psychiatric applications.

</details>


### [232] [The Hamilton-Jacobi Theory of Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28983)
*Jose Marie Antonio Miñoza,Erika Fille T. Legara,Christopher P. Monterola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明神经网络训练等价于求解Hamilton-Jacobi初始值问题，其中梯度下降选择与观测数据最佳匹配的粘性Hopf-Cole传播子；推理时输入为解的空间点，初始条件编码于权重中。该对应关系对log-sum-exp层精确成立，对残差网络、Transformer、循环架构（RNN、LSTM、SSM）结构性成立，统一于含形变参数ε的交换图。量化结果包括：minimax最优泛化率O(n^{-1/(d+2)})、ε控制的对抗鲁棒性、残差网络的反向传播对应Pontryagin最大值原理的协态方程、与数据本征维数一致的标度指数、以及闭式O(N)影响函数（softmax注意力权重π_j）及其熵景观随ε增加出现的折叠分岔。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建立神经网络训练与Hamilton-Jacobi偏微分方程之间的精确对应关系，将网络架构、热带代数、粘性PDE和凸优化统一在同一理论框架下，从而为神经网络的泛化、鲁棒性、反向传播机制和注意力解释提供定量分析工具。

Method: 通过建立梯度下降步骤与Hopf-Cole传播子选择之间的映射，证明log-sum-exp层与粘性Hamilton-Jacobi方程的精确对应；对残差网络、Transformer、RNN/LSTM/SSM等架构，证明其离散化同一类Hamilton-Jacobi方程（仅Hamiltonian和粘性系数因架构而异）。引入单一形变参数ε连接网络、热带代数、粘性PDE和凸优化四个视角，构成闭交换图。

Result: (1) 固定t时的minimax最优泛化率O(n^{-1/(d+2)})；(2) 对抗鲁棒性由ε控制；(3) 残差网络的反向传播等价于Hamilton系统的协态方程（Pontryagin最大值原理）；(4) 通过PDE求积得到与数据本征维数一致的标度指数；(5) 闭式O(N)影响函数（softmax注意力权重π_j），其熵景观随ε增大出现折叠分岔，合并注意力量盆地。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了神经网络训练与粘性Hamilton-Jacobi理论，为理解深度学习提供了精确的数学基础，具有泛化界、鲁棒性、可解释性等多方面的定量结论，揭示了不同架构背后的共同偏微分方程本质。

Abstract: In this paper, training a neural network is identified, exactly, as a search through Hamilton--Jacobi initial-value problems: each gradient step selects the initial data of a viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equation whose Hopf--Cole propagator best fits the observations; at inference, the input is the spatial point at which that solution is evaluated and the initial condition is already encoded in the weights. The correspondence is exact for log-sum-exp layers and structural for broader architectures: residual networks, transformers, and recurrent architectures (RNNs, LSTMs, SSMs) each discretize the same class of Hamilton--Jacobi equations, with architecture-dependent Hamiltonian and viscosity. A single deformation parameter $\varepsilon$ unifies all four perspectives (network, tropical algebra, viscous PDE, convex optimization) in a commutative diagram closed under Lipschitz conditions. Quantitative consequences include: the minimax optimal generalization rate $O(n^{-1/(d+2)})$ for fixed $t$; adversarial robustness controlled by $\varepsilon$; backpropagation as the co-state equation of the Hamiltonian system for residual networks (Pontryagin Maximum Principle); scaling exponents consistent with data intrinsic dimension via PDE quadrature; and a closed-form $O(N)$ influence function (softmax attribution weights $π_j$) whose entropy landscape undergoes fold bifurcations as $\varepsilon$ increases, each merging attribution basins.

</details>


### [233] [Learning Robust and Task-Invariant Functional Representation from fMRI through Siamese Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28990)
*Jiyao Wang,Peiyu Duan,Nicha C. Dvornek,Lawrence H. Staib,Denis Sukhodolsky,Pamela Ventola,James S. Duncan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BrainSimSiam是一种轻量级自监督表征学习框架，通过正样本对学习鲁棒特征，在数据有限的fMRI任务中超越全监督基线并逼近大规模模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI数据获取成本高、样本量小、标签质量不一，且数据高维易导致模型过拟合；现有fMRI基础模型预训练和微调的计算资源需求过高。

Method: 提出BrainSimSiam，一种数据高效的自监督表征学习框架，仅利用正样本对（positive-only data pairs）进行学习。

Result: 所学表征在多个下游分类和回归任务上表现强劲，超越全监督基线，性能逼近大规模模型。

Conclusion: BrainSimSiam展示了轻量级自监督框架在数据有限的神经影像应用中的潜力，能够高效学习通用且鲁棒的表征。

Abstract: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is a powerful tool for investigating human brain function. However, the high cost of data acquisition and the inherent subjectivity of psychiatric rating scales often lead to datasets with small sample sizes and variable label quality, especially when targeting a specific neurological condition. Combined with the inherently high dimensionality of fMRI data, these limitations substantially increase the risk of model overfitting. Recent years have seen growing interest in developing fMRI foundation models by combining multiple datasets; however, the computational resources needed for pretraining and fine-tuning are often prohibitive. We show that a lightweight self-supervised framework yields representations that generalize across diverse downstream tasks, outperforming fully supervised baselines and approaching the performance of large-scale models. We introduce BrainSimSiam, a data-efficient self-supervised representation learning framework that leverages positive-only data pairs to learn robust and generalizable features. We demonstrate that the learned representations achieve strong performance across multiple downstream classification and regression tasks, highlighting the potential of BrainSimSiam for data-limited neuroimaging applications.

</details>


### [234] [FormInv: A Measurement Protocol for Semantic Invariance in Mathematical Reasoning Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29001)
*Nishal Thomas,Noel Thomas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现并审计了 MathCheck (ICLR 2025) 中的释义质量问题：3.1%的语义错误释义会改变模型排名（GPT-4o从第2降至第4），且标准单模型评估无法察觉。通过跨模型一致性协议（<$10）可自动检测。作者进一步揭示了更大的测量鸿沟：模型间准确率差异很小（86-96%），但语义一致性率（SCR）差异巨大（50-82%），并形式化证明了“无免费基准”推论——基准设计者选择的释义族隐含决定了哪个模型获胜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试未充分审计释义质量，且标准准确率指标无法揭示模型在面对语义等价但表述不同的定理时的表现不一致性，导致排名不可靠。

Method: 提出FormInv审计协议，利用跨模型一致性自动检测语义错误的释义（MathCheck中≥3/4模型一致，主评估中≥6/9模型一致）；引入SCR（语义一致性率）和每定理Cochran's Q作为主要不变性度量；在Lean4验证的定理上使用9个模型进行评估（366-811项）。

Result: MathCheck中3.1%的释义语义错误导致GPT-4o排名下降；Claude Haiku 4.5准确率86%但SCR仅50%；9模型准确率范围86-96%但SCR范围50-82%，存在32个百分点的差距；形式化证明了无免费基准推论。

Conclusion: 标准基准测试严重低估了模型对语义等价变体的敏感性；SCR等不变性指标比准确率更能揭示模型真实能力；基准设计者不应仅依赖准确率排名，需引入跨模型释义审计和不变性度量。

Abstract: A paraphrase-quality audit of MathCheck (ICLR 2025) detected 4 semantically incorrect paraphrases in 129 groups (3.1%); removing them drops GPT-4o from rank 2 to rank 4 and elevates Claude Haiku and DeepSeek V3 above it; these ranking changes are invisible to any single-model evaluation. Cross-model unanimity found these errors automatically (>= 3/4 models for MathCheck; >= 6/9 for our primary evaluation) for under $10; in our own dataset the same protocol found that 47% of auto-generated connective-variation paraphrases were semantically incorrect. That flaw compounds a deeper measurement gap: Claude Haiku 4.5 achieves 86% accuracy yet SCR=50%, meaning half its theorems are answered differently under semantically equivalent restatements, while aggregate accuracy across 9 models spans only 86-96% yet Semantic Consistency Rates (SCR) span 50-82% -- a 32-point gap invisible to standard benchmarks. Formally, for any target ranking over 9 frontier models there exists a weighting over paraphrase families that realizes it (No-Free-Benchmark corollary), because no model Pareto-dominates all families -- so benchmark designers who select families are implicitly choosing which model wins. FormInv supplies the audit protocol (replicated on external benchmarks at 100% recall), SCR and per-theorem Cochran's Q as primary invariance measures evaluated on 9 models across 366-811 items (on Lean4-verified theorems), and FormInvSelector for regime-aware model selection.

</details>


### [235] [FedQHD: Closed-Form Function-Space Federated Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29002)
*Yuchen Hou,Yongshan Chen,Zhuowen Zou,Calvin Yeung,Mohsen Imani,Tian Lan,Mahdi Imani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedQHD，一种使用超维随机特征编码器和线性读出层的联邦Q学习方法，实现函数空间一致的参数聚合，并理论分析了联邦间隙的分解与条件，在连续状态控制任务中表现优于或持平基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FedAvg风格的平均参数在函数空间上不一致——当客户端使用异构编码器或相同非线性网络时，平均参数并不对应任何共同函数空间中客户端值函数的加权平均。需要一种能保持函数空间一致性的联邦强化学习方法。

Method: 使用超维（随机特征）状态编码器结合线性读出层，使Q函数在状态上非线性但在可训练参数上线性。同构编码器下直接加权平均局部读出矩阵；异构编码器下，服务器在共享锚点状态集上平均客户端Q值构建全局教师，各客户端通过单次岭投影将教师编译到本地表征中。

Result: 在四个连续状态离散动作控制基准上，FedQHD匹配或超越了FedAvg风格基线及基于蒸馏的替代方法，且计算量显著更少。联邦间隙对编码器维度的经验依赖性与理论分析一致。

Conclusion: 形式化了联邦间隙——将联邦教师编译到异构客户端表征时的误差——并将其分解为子空间错位、锚点集条件数和正则化偏差。确定了锚点与维度比m ≥ D_i为良态区域，此时间隙缩减为编码器异构性底数的倍数。

Abstract: Federated reinforcement learning enables decentralized agents to collaboratively improve policies or value estimates without exchanging raw trajectories. However, FedAvg-style parameter averaging is not function-space consistent: when clients use heterogeneous encoders or even identical nonlinear networks, averaged parameters need not correspond to the weighted average of client value functions in any common function space. We propose FedQHD, a federated Q-learning method using hyperdimensional (random-feature) state encoders with a linear readout, so that Q-functions are nonlinear in state yet linear in trainable parameters. This linear structure enables closed-form aggregation. With a shared encoder, the function-space consensus update coincides exactly with weighted averaging of local readout matrices. With heterogeneous encoders, the server constructs a global teacher by averaging client Q-values on a shared anchor-state set, and each client compiles this teacher into its local representation via a single ridge projection. We formalize the federation gap -- the error incurred when compiling a federated teacher into a heterogeneous client representation -- relative to a client-specific oracle projection. We show that this gap decomposes into subspace misalignment, anchor-set conditioning, and regularization bias. We further identify the anchor-to-dimension ratio $m \geq D_i$ as the well-conditioned regime in which the gap reduces to a multiple of the encoder heterogeneity floor. On four continuous-state, discrete-action control benchmarks, FedQHD matches or outperforms FedAvg-style baselines and distillation-based alternatives while requiring substantially less computation, and the empirical dependence of the federation gap on encoder dimension matches our theoretical analysis.

</details>


### [236] [LoRe: Adaptive Interaction-Evaluation Routing with Per-Step Interaction Budgets for Iterative Graph Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29005)
*Jintao Li,Yong-Yi Wang,Zheng-An Wang,Heng Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LoRe，一种无需训练、推理时即插即用的方法，通过动态预算分配机制仅评估固定比例的高冲突/高不确定交互，显著提升扩散组合优化求解器的可扩展性。在MIS上实现3倍以上规模扩展、~8倍加速和~12倍显存节约；在TSP上实现~15倍加速和44倍显存节约，且解质量保持竞争性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散神经求解器在每次迭代中反复评估密集的边/因子交互，导致推理在墙钟时间上昂贵且在大规模下受内存瓶颈限制。

Method: 受多体物理计算方法启发，提出LoRe——一种训练无关的推理时包装器。核心思想是在每次迭代中仅评估固定比例的交互，通过动态路由计算资源到高冲突或高不确定性的交互上，而非使用静态稀疏化（如固定kNN图或静态掩码）。

Result: 在MIS问题上，超越基线内存限制3倍以上，实现~8倍加速和~12倍峰值显存降低，解质量保持；在TSP（n=1000）上实现~15倍加速和44倍显存降低，零样本鲁棒于拓扑偏移，巡回质量具有竞争性。

Conclusion: LoRe是一种高效的推理时交互预算控制方法，在保持求解质量的同时大幅提升扩散组合优化求解器的可扩展性和速度，且具备跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Diffusion-based neural solvers for combinatorial optimization repeatedly re-evaluate dense edge/factor interactions, making inference expensive in wall-clock time and often memory-bound at scale. Inspired by the computational methodologies of many-body physics, we introduce LoRe, a training-free, inference-time drop-in wrapper that enforces per-step interaction-evaluation budgeting: at each iteration, it evaluates only a fixed fraction of interactions by dynamically routing computation to high-conflict or high-uncertainty interactions, instead of using a fixed sparsification (e.g., static kNN graphs or static masks). Under fully inclusive end-to-end wall-clock accounting, LoRe substantially improves scalability on the Maximum Independent Set (MIS) problem, extending feasible inference more than $3\times$ beyond the baseline's out-of-memory limit, delivering a $\sim 8\times$ speedup and a $\sim 12\times$ peak-memory reduction, with solution quality preserved in this regime. Demonstrating cross-task generality on the large-scale Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) and zero-shot robustness to topology shifts, LoRe achieves a $\sim 15\times$ speedup at $n=1000$ with a $44\times$ memory reduction and competitive tour quality.

</details>


### [237] [Causal Intelligence for Constraint-Aware Intervention Design to Induce State Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29008)
*Zixuan Song,Uwe Mueller,Dimitris V. Manatakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: COAST是一种因果智能方法，通过学习上下文特定的因果图和结构因果模型，结合约束感知的多目标优化，为诱导系统状态转换设计最优干预策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测模型缺乏机制层面的解释性，也没有用于决策的因果框架，无法有效设计从一种状态到另一种状态的定向干预。

Method: COAST整合了特征选择、因果发现、因果建模、干预识别与评估等模块化组件，通过约束感知的多目标优化平衡转换效能、干预复杂性和目标状态稳定性。

Result: 在合成基准和真实生物数据集上，COAST成功恢复了关键因果驱动因素，并识别出稳健的单目标和多目标干预策略，实现了期望的状态转换。

Conclusion: COAST提供了一种领域无关的因果推理框架，能够为状态转换设计透明、可解释且可实验验证的干预方案。

Abstract: Driving a system from one state to another through targeted interventions is a fundamental challenge in science, yet most predictive models offer limited mechanistic insight and no principled framework for decision-making. Here we present COAST (Causally Optimal Actions for State Transitions), a causal-intelligence approach for the in-silico design of constrained interventions that induce user-defined state transitions. Given data characterizing source and target states, COAST learns context-specific causal graphs and structural causal models, attributes observed distributional shifts to mechanism-level causal drivers, and introduces a novel constraint-aware multi-objective optimization formulation that balances transition efficacy, intervention complexity, and target-state stability. The approach is modular and domain-agnostic, integrating feature selection, causal discovery, causal modeling, and intervention identification and evaluation through interchangeable components. Across synthetic benchmarks and real biological datasets, COAST recovers key causal drivers and identifies robust single- and multi-target intervention strategies that achieve desired state transitions, accompanied by transparent mechanistic rationales to guide experimental validation.

</details>


### [238] [Label-Free Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Model Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29009)
*Matt Gorbett,Hossein Shirazi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出跨模型熵（CME），即生成器输出在独立验证器模型下的平均对数似然，作为无标签奖励信号用于强化学习后训练，在开放指令遵循任务上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL后训练方法依赖可验证奖励（局限于数学、代码等领域）或昂贵且易被奖励篡改的人类偏好标签；无标签方法使用自参照信号（如多数投票、token熵）但会强化模型自身错误。

Method: CME定义为生成器响应在独立验证器模型上的平均对数似然。验证器无需训练，信号连续且独立于生成器，无法通过自一致性作弊。将CME作为奖励信号集成到GRPO框架中，不修改训练循环其他部分。

Result: 在开放指令遵循任务（UltraFeedback提示，AlpacaEval 2.0评估）上，CME奖励在Qwen、Llama、Gemma、OLMo四个模型族及预训练、SFT、指令微调三个训练阶段中，头对头LLM裁判对比均优于未训练基线，调整平局后的胜率范围为52.5%至71.4%。

Conclusion: CME将无标签RL扩展至自参照信号不适用或不适配的开放指令遵循场景，是一种有效的无标签奖励信号方案。

Abstract: Post-training large language models with reinforcement learning is bottlenecked by the reward signal. Existing approaches require either ground-truth verifiable rewards, restricting training to domains with automatic correctness checks (e.g., mathematics, code execution), or human preference labels, which are expensive to collect and prone to reward hacking.
