Result: 相比当前最先进的 TTFT 方法，HullFT 在更低的运行时间内实现了更低的 bits-per-byte，提升了质量-效率权衡。

Conclusion: HullFT 通过几何方法有效解决了 TTFT 中检索多样性与计算效率之间的根本矛盾，为实用化的测试时微调提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Test-time finetuning (TTFT) is a rapidly evolving paradigm that adapts a language model to each prompt by retrieving related sequences, updating the model on them, and then evaluating the prompt. However, TTFT is only practical if it is fast: selection and finetuning both happen per query, making each a direct bottleneck. Existing methods trade speed for quality: fast retrieval is often redundant, while stronger diversity-aware selection adds prohibitive per-query cost. We introduce HullFT, a geometric approach to TTFT that addresses both bottlenecks. Given a query, HullFT first represents the query embedding as a sparse convex combination of few training sequences, using efficient projection-free Frank-Wolfe optimization. This yields a support set that is inherently relevant and diverse. We then convert the fractional convex weights into an exact integer multiset for finetuning through a geometric integerization procedure. The resulting multiplicities naturally create repeated examples, which we exploit with Gradient Reuse to amortize forward-backward computation across repeated finetuning steps. Our experiments show that HullFT improves the quality-efficiency tradeoff over current state-of-the-art TTFT methods, achieving lower bits-per-byte at substantially lower total runtime.

</details>


### [388] [MATNet: Multi-Level Fusion Transformer-Based Model for Day-Ahead PV Generation Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.10356)
*Matteo Tortora,Francesco Conte,Gianluca Natrella,Paolo Soda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MATNet，一种基于Transformer的多模态架构，通过融合历史PV数据与历史/预报天气数据，采用多级联合融合与软注意力机制，实现多步日前PV发电功率预测，在Ausgrid数据集上RMSE达0.0445，相对最优基线提升约65%，并展示了强大的零样本泛化能力和计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI预测模型虽能捕捉复杂数据模式，但忽略了物理先验知识，从而限制了预测性能与鲁棒性。

Method: 提出MATNet变压器多模态架构，采用多级联合融合方式，融合历史PV功率数据、历史气象数据及预报气象数据，并在多个融合阶段应用软注意力机制，实现多步日前预测。

Result: 在Ausgrid数据集上RMSE为0.0445，相对最优基线提升约65%；消融实验、缺失数据敏感性分析、跨站点零样本泛化评估（5个外部数据集）及计算复杂度分析均验证了模型的有效性、鲁棒性与效率。

Conclusion: MATNet是一种可靠且高效的PV功率预测解决方案，能够有效促进光伏能源并入电网。

Abstract: Accurate forecasting of renewable generation is crucial to facilitate the integration of Renewable Energy Sources into the power system. Focusing on photovoltaic (PV) units, forecasting methods can be divided into two main categories: physics-based and data-based strategies, with Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based models providing state-of-the-art performance. However, while these AI-based models can capture complex patterns and relationships in the data, they ignore the underlying physical prior knowledge of the phenomenon. Therefore, in this paper, we propose MATNet, a novel transformer-based multimodal architecture for multi-step day-ahead PV power generation forecasting. The model is fed with historical PV data and historical and forecast weather data through a multi-level joint fusion approach, employing a soft-attention mechanism at multiple fusion stages. We evaluate the effectiveness of MATNet on the Ausgrid benchmark dataset, where it significantly outperforms various baseline models, achieving an RMSE of 0.0445, corresponding to a relative improvement of approximately 65% compared to the best-performing baseline method. The analysis is further enriched by a comprehensive set of ablation studies, a sensitivity analysis on missing data, which highlights MATNet's resilience to input degradation, a cross-site zero-shot generalization evaluation on five external PV datasets, demonstrating MATNet's robustness under significant domain shifts, and an assessment of the model's computational complexity, confirming its favorable balance between predictive accuracy and computational efficiency. These results highlight MATNet's potential as a reliable and efficient solution to facilitate the integration of PV energy into the power grid. The code is available at https://github.com/arco-group/MATNet.

</details>


### [389] [Promoting Generalization for Exact Solvers via Adversarial Instance Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.14161)
*Haoyang Liu,Yufei Kuang,Jie Wang,Xijun Li,Yongdong Zhang,Feng Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdaSolver通过对抗性实例增强（将非可微的实例增强建模为上下文赌博机问题）来提升学习型MILP求解器在不同分布上的泛化能力，这是首个通用的、同时适用于IL和RL分支定界求解器的泛化框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型MILP求解器在未见实例（特别是大规模扰动环境下的实例）上性能严重下降，因为训练分布多样性有限。现有方法缺乏通用且有效的方式来提升泛化能力。

Method: 提出AdaSolver框架：使用二部图表示MILP实例，通过学习到的增强策略对图结构进行增强来正则化求解器；将非可微的实例增强建模为上下文赌博机问题，通过对抗训练联合训练求解器和增强策略，实现增强策略的高效梯度训练。

Result: 广泛实验表明，AdaSolver通过产生多种增强实例，在不同分布上显著提升了求解效率。

Conclusion: AdaSolver是首个通用且有效的框架，能够理解和提升基于模仿学习和强化学习的分支定界求解器的泛化能力。

Abstract: Machine learning has been successfully applied to improve the efficiency of Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solvers. However, the learning-based solvers often suffer from severe performance degradation on unseen MILP instances -- especially on large-scale instances from a perturbed environment -- due to the limited diversity of training distributions. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel approach, which is called Adversarial Instance Augmentation and does not require to know the problem type for new instance generation, to promote data diversity for learning-based branching modules in the branch-and-bound (B&B) Solvers (AdaSolver). We use the bipartite graph representations for MILP instances and obtain various perturbed instances to regularize the solver by augmenting the graph structures with a learned augmentation policy. The major technical contribution of AdaSolver is that we formulate the non-differentiable instance augmentation as a contextual bandit problem and adversarially train the learning-based solver and augmentation policy, enabling efficient gradient-based training of the augmentation policy. To the best of our knowledge, AdaSolver is the first general and effective framework for understanding and improving the generalization of both imitation-learning-based (IL-based) and reinforcement-learning-based (RL-based) B&B solvers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that by producing various augmented instances, AdaSolver leads to a remarkable efficiency improvement across various distributions.

</details>


### [390] [Matrix Completion with Hypergraphs:Sharp Thresholds and Efficient Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.08197)
*Zhongtian Ma,Qiaosheng Zhang,Zhen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于子采样矩阵条目以及观测到的社交图和超图进行评分矩阵补全的问题，发现了矩阵精确补全的相变现象，并量化了超图对降低采样概率的贡献，提出了一个计算高效且优于现有算法的矩阵补全方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在矩阵补全任务中引入超图信息能否降低所需采样概率，并量化超图对采样概率的减少量，同时证明存在一个精确补全的尖锐阈值（相变现象）。

Method: 理论推导了矩阵精确补全的相变阈值条件（采样概率关于超图"质量"的函数表达式），并设计了一个能有效利用观测图和超图的计算高效矩阵补全算法。

Result: 理论上证明了当采样概率超过阈值时算法以高概率成功，合成实验验证了理论结果，真实社交网络数据集上的实验表明算法优于其他先进的矩阵补全算法。

Conclusion: 利用超图信息可以显著降低矩阵补全所需的采样概率，超图的"质量"与所需采样概率之间存在明确的量化关系，所提算法在理论和实践上均有效。

Abstract: This paper considers the problem of completing a rating matrix based on sub-sampled matrix entries as well as observed social graphs and hypergraphs. We show that there exists a \emph{sharp threshold} on the sample probability for the task of exactly completing the rating matrix -- the task is achievable when the sample probability is above the threshold, and is impossible otherwise -- demonstrating a phase transition phenomenon. The threshold can be expressed as a function of the ``quality'' of hypergraphs, enabling us to \emph{quantify} the amount of reduction in sample probability due to the exploitation of hypergraphs. This also highlights the usefulness of hypergraphs in the matrix completion problem. En route to discovering the sharp threshold, we develop a computationally efficient matrix completion algorithm that effectively exploits the observed graphs and hypergraphs. Theoretical analyses show that our algorithm succeeds with high probability as long as the sample probability exceeds the aforementioned threshold, and this theoretical result is further validated by synthetic experiments. Moreover, our experiments on a real social network dataset (with both graphs and hypergraphs) show that our algorithm outperforms other state-of-the-art matrix completion algorithms.

</details>


### [391] [An Empirical Study of the Influence of Adversarial Fine-Tuning on Compressed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.09441)
*Hallgrimur Thorsteinsson,Valdemar J Henriksen,Daniel I R Cruz,Raghavendra Selvan,Tong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络压缩对对抗鲁棒性的影响，发现对压缩模型进行对抗微调可以在保持计算效率的同时获得与对抗训练相当的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型易受对抗攻击，而对抗训练虽能提升鲁棒性但计算成本高昂，导致鲁棒性与计算效率之间存在冲突。

Method: 对压缩后的神经网络模型进行对抗微调（adversarial fine-tuning），并在多个基准数据集上进行实验，比较标准微调与对抗微调的效果差异。

Result: 对抗微调压缩模型能显著提升其对抗鲁棒性，达到与完整对抗训练模型相当的鲁棒性能，同时改善了计算效率。

Conclusion: 压缩模型的对抗微调是一种有效平衡鲁棒性与计算效率的策略，能够在降低计算成本的同时保持较高的鲁棒性。

Abstract: As deep learning (DL) models are increasingly being integrated into our everyday lives, ensuring their safety by making them robust against adversarial attacks has become increasingly critical. DL models have been found to be susceptible to adversarial attacks by introducing small, targeted perturbations to disrupt the input data. Adversarial training has been presented as a mitigation strategy that can result in more robust models. This adversarial robustness comes with additional computational costs required to design adversarial attacks during training. The two objectives -- adversarial robustness and computational efficiency -- then appear to be in conflict with each other. In this work, we explore the effects of neural network compression on adversarial robustness. We specifically explore the effects of fine-tuning on compressed models, and present the trade-off between standard fine-tuning and adversarial fine-tuning. Our results show that adversarial fine-tuning of compressed models can yield large improvements to their robustness performance. We present experiments on several benchmark datasets showing that adversarial fine-tuning of compressed models can achieve robustness performance comparable to adversarially trained models, while also improving computational efficiency. Source code is available here: https://github.com/saintslab/Adver-Fine.

</details>


### [392] [Certified Causal Defense with Generalizable Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.15451)
*Yiran Qiao,Yu Yin,Chen Chen,Jing Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GLEAN框架，从因果视角解决认证防御在分布偏移下的鲁棒泛化问题，通过解耦因果关联与虚假关联，实现跨域鲁棒泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有认证防御方法虽然能提供对输入扰动的理论鲁棒性保证，但难以在存在分布偏移的数据域中泛化其鲁棒性，根源在于难以消除不同域中虚假关联对鲁棒性的负面影响。

Method: 提出GLEAN框架，包含：(1) 可认证的因果因子学习组件，用于解耦输入与标签之间的因果关联和虚假关联；(2) 基于因果关系的认证防御策略，处理针对潜在因果因子的对抗攻击，从而排除虚假关联对防御的负面影响。

Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验验证了GLEAN框架在不同数据域中鲁棒性泛化的优越性。

Conclusion: GLEAN框架不仅能在训练分布下抵御恶意噪声，还能将鲁棒性泛化到存在分布偏移的其他数据域，为认证防御的泛化问题提供了有效的因果解决方案。

Abstract: While machine learning models have proven effective across various scenarios, it is widely acknowledged that many models are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Recently, there have emerged numerous efforts in adversarial defense. Among them, certified defense is well known for its theoretical guarantees against arbitrary adversarial perturbations on input within a certain range (e.g., $l_2$ ball). However, most existing works in this line struggle to generalize their certified robustness in other data domains with distribution shifts. This issue is rooted in the difficulty of eliminating the negative impact of spurious correlations on robustness in different domains. To address this problem, in this work, we propose a novel certified defense framework GLEAN, which incorporates a causal perspective into the generalization problem in certified defense. More specifically, our framework integrates a certifiable causal factor learning component to disentangle the causal relations and spurious correlations between input and label, and thereby exclude the negative effect of spurious correlations on defense. On top of that, we design a causally certified defense strategy to handle adversarial attacks on latent causal factors. In this way, our framework is not only robust against malicious noises on data in the training distribution but also can generalize its robustness across domains with distribution shifts. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the superiority of our framework in certified robustness generalization in different data domains. Code is available in the supplementary materials.

</details>


### [393] [Dataset-Driven Channel Masks in Transformers for Multivariate Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.23222)
*Seunghan Lee,Taeyoung Park,Kibok Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出部分通道依赖（PCD）概念，通过通道掩码（CMs）融入Transformer注意力矩阵，利用数据集特定信息优化多变量时间序列的通道依赖建模，在多种任务和数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于注意力的方法虽广泛用于捕获多变量时间序列的通道依赖，但主要关注架构修改，忽视了数据集特定特征的重要性。

Method: 提出部分通道依赖（PCD）概念，设计通道掩码（CMs）通过逐元素乘法集成到Transformer注意力矩阵中；CMs包含相似度矩阵（捕获通道间关系）和数据集特定、可学习的域参数（优化相似度矩阵）。

Result: 在多种任务和数据集上使用不同骨干网络验证了PCD的有效性。

Conclusion: 利用数据集特定信息细化通道依赖建模可有效提升Transformer模型在多变量时间序列上的表现。

Abstract: Recent advancements in foundation models have been successfully extended to the time series (TS) domain, facilitated by the emergence of large-scale TS datasets. However, previous efforts have primarily Capturing channel dependency (CD) is essential for modeling multivariate time series (TS), and attention-based methods have been widely employed for this purpose. Nonetheless, these methods primarily focus on modifying the architecture, often neglecting the importance of dataset-specific characteristics. In this work, we introduce the concept of partial channel dependence (PCD) to enhance CD modeling in Transformer-based models by leveraging dataset-specific information to refine the CD captured by the model. To achieve PCD, we propose channel masks (CMs), which are integrated into the attention matrices of Transformers via element-wise multiplication. CMs consist of two components: 1) a similarity matrix that captures relationships between the channels, and 2) dataset-specific and learnable domain parameters that refine the similarity matrix. We validate the effectiveness of PCD across diverse tasks and datasets with various backbones. Code is available at this repository: https://github.com/YonseiML/pcd.

</details>


### [394] [KAN-AD: Time Series Anomaly Detection with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.00278)
*Quan Zhou,Changhua Pei,Fei Sun,Jing Han,Zhengwei Gao,Dan Pei,Haiming Zhang,Gaogang Xie,Jianhui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KAN-AD，通过截断傅里叶展开替代B样条函数实现时间序列平滑建模，在四个TSAD基准上平均提升15%检测准确率，参数量不足1000，推理速度比原始KAN快50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预测模型的时间序列异常检测方法倾向于过度拟合微小波动，而有效的TSAD应专注于通过平滑局部模式对"正常"行为进行建模。

Method: 将时间序列建模重构为用平滑单变量函数逼近序列；提出KAN-AD，用截断傅里叶展开替代B样条函数，引入轻量级学习机制以强调全局模式并对局部扰动保持鲁棒。

Result: 在四个TSAD基准上平均提升15%检测准确率（峰值超过27%）；参数量少于1000；推理速度比原始KAN快50%。

Conclusion: KAN-AD通过全局平滑建模和轻量化设计，在TSAD任务上实现了高效、准确的异常检测，验证了方法的实用性和效率优势。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) underpins real-time monitoring in cloud services and web systems, allowing rapid identification of anomalies to prevent costly failures. Most TSAD methods driven by forecasting models tend to overfit by emphasizing minor fluctuations. Our analysis reveals that effective TSAD should focus on modeling "normal" behavior through smooth local patterns. To achieve this, we reformulate time series modeling as approximating the series with smooth univariate functions. The local smoothness of each univariate function ensures that the fitted time series remains resilient against local disturbances. However, a direct KAN implementation proves susceptible to these disturbances due to the inherently localized characteristics of B-spline functions. We thus propose KAN-AD, replacing B-splines with truncated Fourier expansions and introducing a novel lightweight learning mechanism that emphasizes global patterns while staying robust to local disturbances. On four popular TSAD benchmarks, KAN-AD achieves an average 15% improvement in detection accuracy (with peaks exceeding 27%) over state-of-the-art baselines. Remarkably, it requires fewer than 1,000 trainable parameters, resulting in a 50% faster inference speed compared to the original KAN, demonstrating the approach's efficiency and practical viability.

</details>


### [395] [Learning Locally, Revising Globally: Global Reviser for Federated Learning with Noisy Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00452)
*Yuxin Tian,Mouxing Yang,Yuhao Zhou,Jian Wang,Qing Ye,Tongliang Liu,Gang Niu,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedGR方法，利用联邦学习全局模型对噪声标签的慢记忆特性，通过三个模块协同修正噪声标签并正则化局部训练，在标签噪声和数据异构场景下显著优于8个基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习依赖高质量标签，但现实场景中标签噪声普遍存在，且联邦学习的数据异构性会加剧标签噪声问题，亟需一种能够在不依赖外部干净数据的情况下鲁棒处理标签噪声的联邦学习方法。

Method: 提出FedGR方法，包含三个模块：(1) 利用全局模型对噪声标签的慢记忆特性；(2) 协同修正噪声标签；(3) 正则化局部训练，以自包含方式提升联邦学习对标签噪声的鲁棒性。

Result: 在三个广泛使用的F-LN基准数据集上，FedGR在严重标签噪声和数据异构场景下均持续优于8个最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: 联邦学习全局模型具有对噪声标签的慢记忆特性，利用这一内在属性可以有效地提升联邦学习在标签噪声场景下的鲁棒性，FedGR方法简单有效且无需外部干净数据。

Abstract: Conventional federated learning (FL) heavily depends on high-quality labels, which are often impractical in the real world, leading to the federated label-noise (F-LN) problem. Worse still, the F-LN problem is exacerbated by the heterogeneity of FL, whereas clients experience different label-noise types, ratios, and data distribution. In this study, we first observe an intriguing phenomenon that the global model of FL exhibits a slow memorization of noisy labels, suggesting its ability to maintain reliable predictions and robust representations in FL. Motivated by this, we propose a novel method termed Federated Global Reviser (\method), a straightforward yet effective method comprising three modules that collaboratively rectify noisy labels and regularize local training. By exploiting this inherent property, \method\ improves the label-noise robustness of FL in a self-contained manner. Extensive experiments on three widely used F-LN benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of FedGR, consistently outperforming eight state-of-the-art baselines even in severe label-noise and data heterogeneity. Code: https://github.com/cs-yuxintian/FedGR-ICML26

</details>


### [396] [A Quotient Homology Theory of Representation in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01360)
*Kosio Beshkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用ReLU神经网络的分段线性性质，定义了基于局部秩和像交集的重叠分解$\mathcal{O}_\Phi$，证明了在输入流形与多面体交为凸集时，神经表示的贝蒂数可由商同调群$H_k(\mathcal{M}/\mathcal{O}_\Phi)$计算，并开发了线性规划和并查集数值算法。实验表明该方法比持久同调更纯地捕捉拓扑特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的研究表明ReLU神经网络等价于分段线性连续映射，且输入域被超平面排列分割为凸多面体，每个多面体上网络以仿射方式运算。本文利用这些性质，旨在定义一种不依赖外部度量的内在方法，以计算神经表示（神经网络隐层输出）的拓扑不变量（贝蒂数），从而捕捉纯拓扑特征而非几何特征。

Method: 1) 在输入数据集上定义等价关系$\sim_\Phi$，构造商空间；2) 根据局部秩$\Phi_J$和像交集$\cap \text{Im}\Phi_{J_i}$将商空间划分为重叠分解$\mathcal{O}_\Phi$；3) 证明当输入流形与各凸多面体的交为凸集时，神经表示的同调群同构于商同调群$H_k(\mathcal{M}/\mathcal{O}_\Phi)$；4) 通过线性规划计算各多面体上的仿射映射的秩，利用并查集算法合并具有非空像交集的多面体子集，实现重叠分解的数值计算。

Result: 在玩具数据集上的实验表明，基于重叠同调计算的贝蒂数与标准持久同调相比，更纯粹地追踪拓扑特征而非几何特征。此外，通过在分类问题上训练过程中追踪重叠分解的演化，揭示了网络内部表征拓扑结构的变化规律，同时也指出了方法的若干局限性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的重叠同调框架为理解深层神经网络的内部表征提供了一种不依赖外部度量的纯拓扑分析工具，能够有效计算神经表示的贝蒂数。然而该方法存在一些不足，如对输入流形凸性条件的依赖以及数值计算上的挑战，有待进一步改进。

Abstract: Previous research has proven that the set of maps implemented by neural networks with a ReLU activation function is identical to the set of piecewise linear continuous maps. Furthermore, such networks induce a hyperplane arrangement splitting the input domain of the network into convex polyhedra $G_J$ over which a network $Φ$ operates in an affine manner.
  In this work, we leverage these properties to define an equivalence relation $\sim_Φ$ on top of an input dataset, which defines a quotient space that can be split into two sets related to the local rank of $Φ_J$ and the intersections $\cap \text{Im}Φ_{J_i}$. We refer to the latter as the \textit{overlap decomposition} $\mathcal{O}_Φ$ and prove that if the intersections between each polyhedron and an input manifold are convex, the homology groups of neural representations are isomorphic to quotient homology groups $H_k(Φ(\mathcal{M})) \simeq H_k(\mathcal{M}/\mathcal{O}_Φ)$. This lets us intrinsically calculate the Betti numbers of neural representations without the choice of an external metric. We develop methods to numerically compute the overlap decomposition through linear programming and a union-find algorithm.
  Using this framework, we perform several experiments on toy datasets showing that, compared to standard persistent homology, our overlap homology-based computation of Betti numbers tracks purely topological rather than geometric features. Finally, we study the evolution of the overlap decomposition during training on several classification problems and discuss some shortcomings of our method.

</details>


### [397] [Looking around you: external information enhances representations for event sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10205)
*Petr Sokerin,Maria Kovaleva,Ekaterina Boyarina,Pavel Tikhomirov,Denis Vorobiyov,Alexey Zaytsev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在多个共现事件序列中聚合用户表示的方法，通过学习注意力机制和均值池化等技术，显著提升了序列编码器的性能，在九个不同领域的数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的事件序列表示学习通常孤立处理每个序列，忽略了在时间上共现的其他序列的上下文信息，这在快速变化的环境（如金融、电商）或某些序列缺乏近期事件时尤为不利。

Method: 提出在多个共现事件序列场景下，从多个用户表示中聚合信息来增强特定用户表示的方法。考虑了从简单池化到可学习注意力聚合等多种聚合方式，可运行在现有编码器之上并支持高效微调。

Result: 在包含金融、电商、娱乐等九个不同事件序列数据集上，可学习注意力在有无微调的情况下均提升了指标分数；均值池化也有较小但显著的提升。

Conclusion: 聚合共现序列的用户表示能够有效提升表示学习质量，其中可学习注意力机制效果最优，为处理快速变化场景下的序列建模提供了可行的改进方向。

Abstract: Representation learning produces models in different domains, such as store purchases, client transactions, and general people's behavior. However, such models for event sequences usually process each sequence in isolation, ignoring context from those that co-occur in time. This limitation is particularly problematic in domains with fast-evolving conditions, like finance and e-commerce, or when certain sequences lack recent events.
  We develop a method that aggregates information from multiple user representations, augmenting a specific user's representation in a setting with multiple co-occurring event sequences, achieving better quality than processing each sequence independently. Our study considers diverse aggregation approaches, ranging from simple pooling techniques to Learnable attention aggregation, that can highlight more complex information flow among other users. The proposed methods operate on top of an existing encoder and support its efficient fine-tuning. Across nine diverse event sequence datasets (finance, e-commerce, entertainment, etc.) and downstream tasks, Learnable attention improves metric scores, both with and without fine-tuning, while mean pooling yields a smaller but still significant gain.

</details>


### [398] [Diffusion-based learning framework for Constrained Nonconvex Optimization with Weighted Bootstrapped Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10330)
*Shutong Ding,Yimiao Zhou,Ke Hu,Xi Yao,Junchi Yan,Xiaoying Tang,Ye Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DiOpt，一种基于扩散模型的约束非凸优化框架，通过两阶段训练（监督预热+自举训练）解决监督扩散求解器的分布偏移问题，在保证约束满足的同时提升解的最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的优化方法依赖监督学习且缺乏约束满足机制，导致生成解在可行域上的概率质量较低（分布偏移问题），无法满足实际应用中的约束需求。

Method: 提出DiOpt两阶段框架：1) 监督学习预热阶段，学习从噪声到约束区域的映射；2) 自举训练阶段，迭代优化解的质量。推理阶段采用解选择技术进一步提升最优性。

Result: 在多种非凸优化任务上，DiOpt在最优性和约束满足率两方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: DiOpt首次成功将扩散求解器集成到约束非凸优化中，为扩散模型在带约束优化问题中的应用提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models show promising potential to accelerate nonconvex problem solving by leveraging their multimodality. However, most existing diffusion-based optimization approaches rely on supervised learning and lack a mechanism to enforce constraint satisfaction, which is required in real-world applications. In that case, we investigate and theoretically analyze the inherent problem of supervised diffusion solvers and identify the distributional misalignment problem, i.e., the generated solution distribution often exhibits low probability mass on the feasible region. To resolve this issue, we propose DiOpt, a new diffusion-based learning framework for constrained nonconvex optimization, which effectively learns the mapping from noise to the constraint region. Specifically, this framework operates in two distinct phases: an initial warm-start phase, implemented via supervised learning, followed by a bootstrapping training phase. This dual-phase architecture is designed to iteratively refine solutions, thereby improving the objective function with high constraint satisfaction. Finally, we also employ a solution selection technique in inference for better optimality. Notably, DiOpt is the first successful integration of the diffusion solver in constrained nonconvex optimization. Evaluations on diverse nonconvex tasks demonstrate the superiority of DiOpt in both optimality and constraint satisfaction. Our official page is released at https://dingsht.tech/diopt-webpage.

</details>


### [399] [A Composable Multimodal Framework for cine CMR-Text-Driven Prediction of Heart Failure Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.16548)
*Jianzhou Chen,Jinyang Sun,Xiumei Wang,Xi Chen,Heyu Chu,Guo Song,Yuji Luo,Xingping Zhou,Rong Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一种针对心力衰竭的综合评估与治疗优化组合策略框架，该框架通过多模态算法整合心脏磁共振影像、结构化临床指标和非结构化文本数据，在预后预测方面优于单模态AI算法，并支持个性化治疗方案的制定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心力衰竭是全球主要死亡原因之一，尽管治疗取得进展，但由于其复杂性和多因素特征，仍存在大量未满足的临床需求。现有方法缺乏对患者数据的全面整合，亟需更全面的评估和治疗优化策略。

Method: 采用多模态算法框架，显式整合三种数据源：电影心脏磁共振序列、结构化临床指标（如实验室结果、人口统计信息）以及非结构化文本记录（如病史、处方信息），实现综合评估与优化治疗方案的制定。

Result: 多模态框架在心力衰竭预后预测方面展现出优于单模态AI算法的准确性，并能够详细评估多种病理指标对心衰结局的影响。

Conclusion: 通过系统整合异质性临床数据，该方法支持更全面的预后评估，并有助于为心力衰竭患者制定优化、个性化的治疗计划。

Abstract: Objective. Heart failure is one of the leading causes of death worldwide, with millions of deaths each year, according to data from the World Health Organization (WHO) and other public health agencies. While significant progress has been made in the field of heart failure, leading to improved survival rates and improvement of ejection fraction, there remains substantial unmet needs, due to the complexity and multifactorial characteristics. This study aims to propose and evaluate a composable strategy framework for assessment and treatment optimization in heart failure, designed to provide more holistic patient evaluation and management. Approach. The framework leverages multi-modal algorithms to analyze a comprehensive range of patient data, explicitly integrating cine cardiac magnetic resonance (cine CMR) sequences, structured clinical metrics (e.g., lab results, demographics), and unstructured textual records (e.g., medical history, prescriptions). By integrating these various data sources, our framework offers a more holistic evaluation and optimized treatment plan for patients. Main results. The multi-modal framework demonstrates superior accuracy in HF prognosis prediction compared to single-modal AI algorithms. Additionally, it enables a detailed evaluation of the impact of various pathological indicators on HF outcomes. Significance. By integrating heterogeneous clinical data in a systematic manner, this approach supports more comprehensive prognosis assessment and facilitates optimized, personalized treatment planning for heart failure patients.

</details>


### [400] [Robust and Efficient Writer-Independent IMU-Based Handwriting Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.20954)
*Jindong Li,Tim Hamann,Jens Barth,Peter Kämpf,Dario Zanca,Björn Eskofier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于CNN编码器和BiLSTM解码器的模型，用于惯性测量单元数据的笔迹识别，在未见书写者的独立场景下取得了7.37%的字符错误率和15.12%的词错误率，展现出良好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 惯性测量单元数据的笔迹识别因书写风格多变且数据集有限而极具挑战，尤其是面对未见书写者的独立识别场景，现有方法泛化能力不足。

Method: 采用CNN编码器提取IMU数据的空间特征，结合BiLSTM解码器捕捉序列时序依赖关系，构建端到端的手写识别模型。

Result: 在公共OnHW数据集上达到7.37%的CER和15.12%的WER；在自建词数据集上达到9.44%的CER和32.17%的WER；跨年龄组鲁棒性评估中表现优于现有方法；句子级数据集验证了全句识别的潜力。

Conclusion: 该模型在性能与效率之间取得了良好平衡，为构建更适应实际应用的可扩展笔迹识别系统提供了支持。

Abstract: Handwriting recognition (HWR) using inertial measurement unit (IMU) data remains challenging due to variations in writing styles and the limited availability of datasets. Previous approaches often struggle with handwriting from unseen writers, making writer-independent (WI) recognition a crucial yet difficult problem. This paper presents a model designed to improve WI HWR on IMU data, using a CNN encoder and BiLSTM-based decoder. Our approach demonstrates strong robustness to unseen handwriting styles, outperforming existing methods on the WI splits of both the public OnHW dataset and our word-based dataset, achieving character error rates (CERs) of 7.37% and 9.44%, and word error rates (WERs) of 15.12% and 32.17%, respectively. Robustness evaluation shows that our model maintains superior performance across different age groups, with knowledge learned from one group generalizing better to another compared to other approaches. Evaluation on our sentence-based dataset further demonstrates the potential for recognizing full sentences. Through comprehensive ablation studies, we show that our design choices achieve a strong balance between performance and efficiency. These findings support the development of more adaptable and scalable HWR systems for real-world applications.

</details>


### [401] [Neural Logistic Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.02069)
*Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对神经逻辑bandit问题，提出了一种新型的伯恩斯坦型自归一化向量值鞅不等式，消除了对特征维度的直接依赖，并基于此设计了NeuralLog-UCB-1和NeuralLog-UCB-2两种算法，分别实现了$\widetilde{O}(\widetilde{d}\sqrt{κT})$和$\widetilde{O}(\widetilde{d}\sqrt{T/κ})$的遗憾上界，改进了现有结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经逻辑bandit方法要么对$κ$（奖励分布最小方差相关参数）依赖不佳，要么直接依赖于特征维度$d$，而在神经网络场景下$d$可能极大，限制了实际应用效果。

Method: 提出了一种新型伯恩斯坦型自归一化向量值鞅不等式，该不等式能够绕过对特征维度的直接依赖，转而使用有效维度$\widetilde{d}$来衡量复杂度。基于该不等式设计了两类算法：NeuralLog-UCB-1和NeuralLog-UCB-2。

Result: NeuralLog-UCB-1达到$\widetilde{O}(\widetilde{d}\sqrt{κT})$遗憾上界，NeuralLog-UCB-2达到$\widetilde{O}(\widetilde{d}\sqrt{T/κ})$遗憾上界，均优于现有方法。在合成数据和真实数据上的数值实验验证了理论结果。

Conclusion: 所提出的不等式和算法成功缓解了特征维度依赖问题，在保持对$κ$最小化依赖的同时实现了更优的遗憾界，为神经逻辑bandit问题提供了更高效的理论框架。

Abstract: We study the problem of neural logistic bandits, where the main task is to learn an unknown reward function within a logistic link function using a neural network. Existing approaches either exhibit unfavorable dependencies on $κ$, where $1/κ$ represents the minimum variance of reward distributions, or suffer from direct dependence on the feature dimension $d$, which can be huge in neural network-based settings. In this work, we introduce a novel Bernstein-type inequality for self-normalized vector-valued martingales that is designed to bypass a direct dependence on the ambient dimension. This lets us deduce a regret upper bound that grows with the effective dimension $\widetilde{d}$, not the feature dimension, while keeping a minimal dependence on $κ$. Based on the concentration inequality, we propose two algorithms, NeuralLog-UCB-1 and NeuralLog-UCB-2, that guarantee regret upper bounds of order $\widetilde{O}(\widetilde{d}\sqrt{κT})$ and $\widetilde{O}(\widetilde{d}\sqrt{T/κ})$, respectively, improving on the existing results. Lastly, we report numerical results on both synthetic and real datasets to validate our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [402] [Connecting Independently Trained Modes via Layer-Wise Connectivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.02604)
*Yongding Tian,Zaid Al-Ars,Maksim Kitsak,Peter Hofstee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的经验算法，能够在独立训练的神经网络模型之间建立连续的低损失连接路径，该方法不仅适用于传统架构（如CNN、VGG、ResNet），还扩展到MobileNet、ShuffleNet、EfficientNet、RegNet、DLA和CCT等现代网络，且在不同训练超参数下仍能保持一致的连接性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有经验方法无法可靠连接独立训练的模式，且仅在基础CNN、VGG和ResNet等有限架构上评估，对更新网络的有效性尚不明确。

Method: 提出一种新的经验算法，用于连接独立训练的模态，该算法能泛化到传统架构之外的更广泛网络（包括MobileNet、ShuffleNet、EfficientNet、RegNet、DLA、CCT），并在不同训练超参数下保持一致性。

Result: 该方法在广泛网络架构上实现了更一致的连接路径，且支持不同训练超参数下获得的模态连接。

Conclusion: 所提算法在连接独立训练模态方面具有更广泛的适用性和更高的可靠性，超越了现有方法在架构覆盖和连接一致性上的局限。

Abstract: Empirical studies have shown that continuous low-loss paths can be constructed between independently trained neural network models. This phenomenon, known as mode connectivity, refers to the existence of such paths between distinct modes-i.e., well-trained solutions in parameter space. However, existing empirical methods do not reliably connect independently trained modes and have been evaluated mainly on a narrow set of architectures (e.g., basic CNNs, VGG, and ResNet), leaving their effectiveness on newer models unclear. In this work, we propose a new empirical algorithm for connecting independently trained modes that generalizes beyond traditional architectures and supports a broader range of networks, including MobileNet, ShuffleNet, EfficientNet, RegNet, Deep Layer Aggregation (DLA), and Compact Convolutional Transformers (CCT). In addition to broader applicability, the proposed method yields more consistent connectivity paths across independently trained mode pairs and supports connecting modes obtained with different training hyperparameters.

</details>


### [403] [Cooperative Variance Estimation and Bayesian Neural Networks for Disentangling Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.02743)
*Jiaxiang Yi,Miguel A. Bessa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种协同训练方差估计网络与贝叶斯神经网络的方法，能够同时分离数据的偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，并改善均值估计，方法简单、鲁棒且可扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界数据包含偶然不确定性（噪声），均值-方差估计网络能学习但需特殊正则化且无法预测认知不确定性；贝叶斯神经网络能预测认知不确定性但难以训练。现有方法无法同时高效地处理两种不确定性。

Method: 协同训练一个方差估计网络（用于偶然不确定性）与一个贝叶斯神经网络（用于认知不确定性），通过联合优化使两种不确定性相互解耦，同时改善均值预测。

Result: 在多个数据集上验证了该方法能有效分离偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，提升了均值估计性能；在作者自建的含已知偶然不确定性的时序异方差回归数据集上也表现良好。

Conclusion: 该方法实现简单、鲁棒性强，可适配多种模型架构，为不确定性估计提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Real-world data contains aleatoric uncertainty - irreducible noise arising from imperfect measurements or from incomplete knowledge about the data generation process. Mean-variance estimation networks can learn this type of uncertainty but require ad-hoc regularization strategies to avoid overfitting and are unable to predict epistemic uncertainty (model uncertainty). Conversely, Bayesian neural networks predict epistemic uncertainty but are notoriously difficult to train due to the approximate nature of Bayesian inference. We propose to cooperatively train a variance estimation network with a Bayesian neural network and empirically demonstrate that the resulting model disentangles aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties while improving the mean estimation. We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of this method across a diverse range of datasets, including a time-dependent heteroscedastic regression dataset we created where the aleatoric uncertainty is known. The proposed method is straightforward to implement, robust, and adaptable to various model architectures.

</details>


### [404] [Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning via Sequential Score Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.05968)
*Dan Qiao,Wenhao Li,Shanchao Yang,Hongyuan Zha,Baoxiang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于分数函数分解和扩散模型的离线多智能体强化学习方法，通过从联合行为策略中蒸馏每个智能体的正则化信号，解决离线MARL中由于多均衡特性导致的策略分布偏移问题，在多个基准上取得了最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线合作式多智能体强化学习面临独特的分布偏移挑战，其根本困难在于合作任务的多均衡特性导致联合行为策略空间高度多模态且行为数据质量异质，使得个体策略正则化难以对齐一致的协调模式，引发策略分布偏移问题。

Method: 1) 设计顺序分数函数分解方法，从联合行为策略中蒸馏每个智能体的正则化信号，在分散执行约束下诱导协调模态选择；2) 利用基于扩散的生成式模型从多模态离线数据中学习这些分数函数；3) 将分数函数集成到联合动作评论家中，在共享团队奖励下引导策略更新朝向高奖励、在分布内的区域。

Result: 在多个粒子环境和Multi-agent MuJoCo基准上一致地取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 这是首个明确解决离线与在线MARL之间分布差距的工作，为更可泛化的基于策略的离线MARL方法铺平了道路。

Abstract: Offline cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) faces unique challenges due to distributional shifts, particularly stemming from the high dimensionality of joint action spaces and the presence of out-of-distribution joint action selections. In this work, we highlight that a fundamental challenge in offline MARL arises from the multi-equilibrium nature of cooperative tasks, which induces a highly multimodal joint behavior policy space coupled with heterogeneous-quality behavior data. This makes it difficult for individual policy regularization to align with a consistent coordination pattern, leading to the policy distribution shift problems. To tackle this challenge, we design a sequential score function decomposition method that distills per-agent regularization signals from the joint behavior policy, which induces coordinated modality selection under decentralized execution constraints. Then we leverage a flexible diffusion-based generative model to learn these score functions from multimodal offline data, and integrate them into joint-action critics to guide policy updates toward high-reward, in-distribution regions under a shared team reward. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple particle environments and Multi-agent MuJoCo benchmarks consistently. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explicitly address the distributional gap between offline and online MARL, paving the way for more generalizable offline policy-based MARL methods.

</details>


### [405] [Explaining Concept Shift with Interpretable Feature Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20634)
*Ruiqi Lyu,Alistair Turcan,Bryan Wilder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SGShift方法，通过将概念漂移重构为特征选择任务，利用广义加性模型、knockoffs和吸收等统计工具，在表格数据中准确识别导致模型性能下降的稀疏漂移特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念漂移发生时，特征与标签的条件分布在不同领域间发生变化，导致已训练的ML模型在新领域上校准失效。识别这些漂移特征有助于理解不同领域间特征-标签关系的差异，但目前缺乏高效准确的识别方法。

Method: 将概念漂移问题重构为特征选择任务，学习能够解释源域和目标域模型性能差异的特征子集。集成广义加性模型、knockoffs和吸收等统计工具，设计SGShift框架用于表格数据中的稀疏漂移特征归因。

Result: 在合成数据和真实数据上的大量实验表明，SGShift在识别漂移特征方面显著优于基线方法，仅需少量漂移域样本即可工作，且对复杂概念漂移场景具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SGShift能够有效、准确且高效地识别导致概念漂移的关键特征，为理解跨领域特征-标签关系变化提供方法论支持。

Abstract: Concept shift occurs when the distribution of labels conditioned on the features changes between domains, which can make even a well-tuned ML model miscalibrated on a new domain. Identifying these shifted features provides unique insight into how feature-label relationships differ between domains, considering the difference may be across a scientifically relevant dimension, such as time, disease status, population, etc. In this paper, we propose SGShift, a method for attributing performance degradation under concept shift in tabular data to a sparse set of shifted features. We frame concept shift as a feature selection task to learn the features that can explain performance differences between models in the source and target domain. This framework enables SGShift to adapt powerful statistical tools such as generalized additive models, knockoffs, and absorption towards identifying these shifted features. We conduct extensive experiments in synthetic and real data across various ML models and find SGShift can identify shifted features much more accurately than baseline methods, requires few samples in the shifted domain, and is robust to complex cases of concept shift.

</details>


### [406] [Accelerating Sparse Transformer Inference on GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.06095)
*Wenhao Dai,Haodong Deng,Mengfei Rong,Xinyu Yang,Hongyu Liu,Fangxin Liu,Hailong Yang,Qianwen Cao,Qingxiao Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STOF是一个针对稀疏Transformer的GPU优化框架，通过灵活的掩码操作和算子融合，在多头注意力计算和端到端推理上分别实现最高1.6倍和1.4倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作很少关注稀疏Transformer的性能优化，且当前的静态算子融合方案无法适应多样化的应用场景。

Method: STOF针对多头注意力结构，通过分析建模将计算映射为行式或块式内核并采用独特存储格式；针对下游算子，将融合方案映射到编译模板，并通过两阶段搜索确定最优运行配置。

Result: 相比现有最优工作，STOF在多头注意力计算上取得最高1.6倍加速，在端到端推理上取得最高1.4倍加速。

Conclusion: STOF通过灵活的掩码操作和算子融合有效优化了稀疏Transformer的性能，提升了GPU上的计算效率。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are popular around the world due to their powerful understanding capabilities. As the core component of LLMs, accelerating Transformer through parallelization has gradually become a hot research topic. Mask layers introduce sparsity into Transformer to reduce calculations. However, previous works rarely focus on the performance optimization of sparse Transformer. In addition, current static operator fusion schemes fail to adapt to diverse application scenarios. To address the above problems, we propose STOF, a framework that incorporates optimizations for Sparse Transformer that enables flexible masking and Operator Fusion on GPU. For multi-head attention (MHA) structure, STOF maps the computation to row-wise or blockwise kernels with unique storage formats according to analytical modeling. For downstream operators, STOF maps the fusion scheme to compilation templates and determines the optimal running configuration through two-stage searching. The experimental results show that compared to the stateof-the-art work, STOF achieves maximum speedups of 1.6x in MHA computation and 1.4x in end-to-end inference.

</details>


### [407] [TrojanTO: Action-Level Backdoor Attacks against Trajectory Optimization Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.12815)
*Yang Dai,Oubo Ma,Longfei Zhang,Xingxing Liang,Xiaochun Cao,Shouling Ji,Jiaheng Zhang,Jincai Huang,Li Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TrojanTO，首个针对轨迹优化（TO）模型的行动级后门攻击方法，通过交替训练增强触发-目标动作关联，结合轨迹过滤精确投毒与批次投毒保持触发一致性，在仅污染0.3%轨迹的低预算下实现高效攻击，并适用于DT、GDT、DC等多种TO架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL后门攻击基于奖励操纵，对具有序列建模特性的TO模型基本无效；高维动作空间进一步加剧了动作操纵的难度，需探索针对TO模型的有效后门攻击方法。

Method: 提出TrojanTO，包含三个关键策略：1）交替训练以增强触发器与目标动作的关联；2）轨迹过滤实现精确投毒，保持正常性能；3）批次投毒保证触发一致性。

Result: 在多种任务和攻击目标下高效植入后门，仅需0.3%的轨迹投毒预算；在DT、GDT、DC等不同TO模型架构上均表现出广泛适用性。

Conclusion: TrojanTO揭示了TO模型在安全方面的脆弱性，为后续防御研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Recent advances in Trajectory Optimization (TO) models have achieved remarkable success in offline reinforcement learning. However, their vulnerabilities against backdoor attacks are poorly understood. We find that existing backdoor attacks in reinforcement learning are based on reward manipulation, which are largely ineffective against the TO model due to its inherent sequence modeling nature. Moreover, the complexities introduced by high-dimensional action spaces further compound the challenge of action manipulation. To address these gaps, we propose TrojanTO, the first action-level backdoor attack against TO models. TrojanTO employs alternating training to enhance the connection between triggers and target actions for attack effectiveness. To improve attack stealth, it utilizes precise poisoning via trajectory filtering for normal performance and batch poisoning for trigger consistency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that TrojanTO effectively implants backdoor attacks across diverse tasks and attack objectives with a low attack budget (0.3\% of trajectories). Furthermore, TrojanTO exhibits broad applicability to DT, GDT, and DC, underscoring its scalability across diverse TO model architectures.

</details>


### [408] [Model Fusion via Retrofitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00037)
*Phoomraphee Luenam,Andreas Spanopoulos,Amit Sant,Thomas Hofmann,Sotiris Anagnostidis,Sidak Pal Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一类以神经元为中心的模型融合算法，将融合问题形式化为有原则的表征匹配问题，通过神经元分组和子网络近似实现零样本、非IID场景下多个模型的融合，并在VGG、ResNet、ViT上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型融合方法受限于置换不变性、随机初始化和异构训练数据导致的表征发散问题，在零样本和非IID数据分布下表现不佳，且通常局限于特定架构或只能两两融合。

Method: 提出以神经元为中心的融合算法族：将父模型中的中间神经元分组为"目标表征"，然后训练融合模型中对应的子网络去逼近这些目标表征；引入神经元归因分数来偏向对齐显著特征；适用于任何可模块化为DAG（有向无环图）层次的架构。

Result: 在VGG、ResNet、ViT上的实验表明，该方法在标准基准测试中持续优于现有融合方法，在零样本和非IID场景下增益最大。

Conclusion: 以神经元为中心的融合算法通过表征匹配和显著性偏置，有效解决了零样本和非IID场景下的多模型融合问题，且具有架构通用性。

Abstract: Model fusion seeks to combine independently trained neural networks into a single model without retraining, but is complicated by representational divergence arising from permutation invariance, random initialization, and heterogeneous training data. Existing methods struggle particularly in zero-shot settings under non-IID data distributions, and are often limited to specific architectures or pairwise fusion. We introduce a neuron-centric family of fusion algorithms that frames fusion as a principled representation-matching problem: intermediate neurons across parent models are grouped into target representations, which the fused model's corresponding sub-networks are then trained to approximate. Unlike prior work, our approach incorporates neuron attribution scores to bias alignment toward salient features, and can be applied to any architecture modularizable as a DAG of levels -- empirically validated on VGGs, ResNets, and ViTs. Experiments across standard benchmarks show consistent improvements over existing fusion methods, with the largest gains in zero-shot and non-IID scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/AndrewSpano/model-fusion-via-retrofitting.

</details>


### [409] [Solved in Unit Domain: JacobiNet for Differentiable Coordinate-Transformed PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02537)
*Xi Chen,Jianchuan Yang,Junjie Zhang,Runnan Yang,Xu Liu,Hong Wang,Tinghui Zheng,Ziyu Ren,Wenqi Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JacobiNet提出了一种基于学习的坐标变换PINN框架，通过端到端可微架构统一域映射和PDE求解，利用自动微分直接计算雅可比矩阵，无需特例网格、显式雅可比计算存储或手动PDE重构，解决了不规则边界域上PINN不稳定和收敛慢的问题，相对L2误差从0.11-0.73降至0.01-0.09，平均精度提升15.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN在不规则边界域上存在不稳定和收敛慢的问题，根源在于几何各向异性导致的归一化不一致、边界强制不精确以及损失项竞争不平衡。现有映射方法依赖特例网格、在固定节点定义雅可比、通过链式法则重构PDE，与现代自动微分和基于张量的框架不兼容。

Method: 提出JacobiNet，一种基于学习的坐标变换PINN框架。采用端到端可微架构，通过自动微分直接计算雅可比矩阵，共享计算图与下游PINN，避免特例网格划分、显式雅可比计算/存储和手动PDE重构，同时支持几何编辑操作。

Result: 在多种PDE上，相对L2误差从0.11-0.73降至0.01-0.09，平均精度提升15.6倍。在形状变化的血管状域上，对未见几何的映射推理达毫秒级，预测精度平均提升3.65倍，速度提升超过10倍。

Conclusion: JacobiNet通过将物理建模与几何复杂度分离，解决了原始各向异性坐标中的归一化挑战、促进了边界条件的硬强制、缓解了损失项长期存在的失衡问题，展现出强泛化能力、高精度和高效率。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a powerful framework for solving PDEs by embedding physical laws into the learning process. However, when applied to domains with irregular boundaries, PINNs often suffer from instability and slow convergence, which stems from (1) inconsistent normalization due to geometric anisotropy, (2) inaccurate boundary enforcement, and (3) imbalanced loss term competition. A common workaround is to map the domain to a regular space. Yet, conventional mapping methods rely on case-specific meshes, define Jacobians at pre-specified fixed nodes, reformulate PDEs via the chain rule-making them incompatible with modern automatic differentiation, tensor-based frameworks. To bridge this gap, we propose JacobiNet, a learning-based coordinate-transformed PINN framework that unifies domain mapping and PDE solving within an end-to-end differentiable architecture. JacobiNet enables direct Jacobian computation via autograd, shares computation graph with downstream PINNs, thereby avoiding case-specific meshing, explicit Jacobian computation/storage, and manual PDE reformulation while unlocking geometric-editing operations. Separating physical modeling from geometric complexity, JacobiNet (1) addresses normalization challenges in the original anisotropic coordinates, (2) facilitates the hard enforcement of boundary conditions, and (3) mitigates the long-standing imbalance among loss terms. Evaluated on various PDEs, JacobiNet reduces the relative L2 error from 0.11-0.73 to 0.01-0.09, achieving an average 15.6x improvement in accuracy. In vessel-like domains with varying shapes, JacobiNet enables millisecond-level mapping inference for unseen geometries, improves prediction accuracy by an average of 3.65x, while delivering over 10x speedup-demonstrating strong generalization, accuracy, and efficiency.

</details>


### [410] [Multi-level Collaborative Distillation Meets Global Workspace Model: A Unified Framework for OCIL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.08677)
*Shibin Su,Guoqiang Liang,De Cheng,Shizhou Zhang,Lingyan Ran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于全局工作空间理论（GWT）的在线类增量学习方法，通过构建全局工作空间模型（GWM）作为共享隐式记忆，融合多个学生模型参数并周期性广播回学生模型，结合多级协同蒸馏机制，在严格内存约束下有效平衡稳定性与可塑性，在三个标准OCIL基准上取得了显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线类增量学习（OCIL）中，非独立同分布数据流只能被学习一次，导致稳定性与可塑性的平衡更加困难；现有基于回放的方法在严格内存约束下效果不佳，而集成方法虽提升了可塑性但稳定性不足。

Method: 受全局工作空间理论启发，提出全局工作空间模型（GWM），在每个训练批次中融合多个学生模型的参数形成共享隐式记忆，捕捉历史学习轨迹；GWM周期性广播回学生模型以稳定学习并促进跨任务一致性；引入多级协同蒸馏机制，强制学生间保持同行一致性，并通过每个学生与GWM的对齐来保留历史知识。

Result: 在三个标准OCIL基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在不同内存预算下均能为多种OCIL模型带来显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: 所提GWM方法通过全局工作空间机制有效平衡了稳定性与可塑性，使学生模型在学习新任务时保持对已学知识的记忆，是一种有效的在线类增量学习方法。

Abstract: Online Class-Incremental Learning (OCIL) enables models to learn continuously from non-i.i.d. data streams. Since samples of the data streams can be seen only once, it is more suitable for real-world scenarios compared to offline learning. However, this constraint intensifies the challenge for OCIL in maintaining an appropriate balance between stability and plasticity. Moreover, under stricter memory buffer constraints in real world, current replay-based methods are less effective. While ensemble methods improve plasticity, they often struggle with stability. Inspired by the Global Workspace Theory (GWT), we propose a novel approach that enhances ensemble learning through a Global Workspace Model (GWM)-a shared, implicit memory that guides the learning of multiple student models. The GWM is formed by fusing the parameters of all students within each training batch, capturing the historical learning trajectory and serving as a dynamic anchor for knowledge consolidation. Like the broadcasting mechanism of GWT, the GWM is redistributed periodically to students, stabilizing learning and promoting cross-task consistency. In addition, we introduce a multi-level collaborative distillation mechanism. It enforces peer-to-peer consistency among students and preserves historical knowledge by aligning each student with the GWM. As a result, student models remain adaptable to new tasks while maintaining previously learned knowledge, striking a better balance between stability and plasticity. Extensive experiments on three standard OCIL benchmarks show that our method delivers significant performance improvement for several OCIL models across various memory budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/susususushi/GWM.

</details>


### [411] [Prescribe-then-Select: Adaptive Policy Selection for Contextual Stochastic Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.08194)
*Caio de Prospero Iglesias,Kimberly Villalobos Carballo,Dimitris Bertsimas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Prescribe-then-Select (PS)框架，用于解决上下文随机优化中的策略选择问题。该框架先构建可行候选策略库，再通过学习元策略根据观测协变量选择最优策略。在报童问题和两阶段运输规划两个基准问题上，PS在协变量空间存在异质性时持续优于最佳单一策略，在无异质性时收敛于主导策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在上下文随机优化中，不同建模范式产生的多个候选策略在协变量空间上表现异质，没有任何单一策略能全局占优。因此需要一种数据驱动的方法来根据观测到的协变量选择最佳策略。

Method: 提出Prescribe-then-Select (PS)模块化框架：(1) 先构建可行候选策略库；(2) 通过学习元策略选择最优策略。元策略采用最优策略树集成(Optimal Policy Trees ensembles)，通过训练集上的交叉验证实现完全数据驱动的策略选择。

Result: 在单阶段报童问题和两阶段运输规划两个基准CSO问题上，PS在协变量空间存在异质性区域时持续优于最优单一策略；当协变量空间不存在异质性时，PS收敛于主导策略。

Conclusion: PS框架能有效处理CSO中的策略选择问题，自适应地根据协变量选择最优策略，提升整体决策性能。

Abstract: We address the problem of policy selection in contextual stochastic optimization (CSO), where covariates are available as contextual information and decisions must satisfy hard feasibility constraints. In many CSO settings, multiple candidate policies--arising from different modeling paradigms--exhibit heterogeneous performance across the covariate space, with no single policy uniformly dominating. We propose Prescribe-then-Select (PS), a modular framework that first constructs a library of feasible candidate policies and then learns a meta-policy to select the best policy for the observed covariates. We implement the meta-policy using ensembles of Optimal Policy Trees trained via cross-validation on the training set, making policy choice entirely data-driven. Across two benchmark CSO problems--single-stage newsvendor and two-stage shipment planning--PS consistently outperforms the best single policy in heterogeneous regimes of the covariate space and converges to the dominant policy when such heterogeneity is absent. All the code to reproduce the results can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Prescribe-then-Select-TMLR.

</details>


### [412] [Active Learning for Machine Learning Driven Molecular Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.17208)
*Kevin Bachelor,Sanya Murdeshwar,Daniel Sabo,Razvan Marinescu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对粗粒化神经网络势能模型的主动学习框架，通过RMSD驱动的帧选择和在线数据生成，解决了CG势能在未采样构象空间中的退化问题，在Chignolin蛋白上实现了TICA空间W1距离33.05%的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习粗粒化势能在模拟中随时间退化，尤其是在遇到欠采样的生物分子构象时；而生成足够的全原子数据来应对这一问题在计算上不可行。

Method: 基于CGSchNet模型，采用RMSD驱动的帧选择方法，在MD模拟过程中实时查询Oracle生成数据，主动识别并填补构象空间的覆盖空白。

Result: 在Chignolin蛋白基准测试中，主动学习框架使CGSchNet模型在TICA空间的Wasserstein-1距离指标上获得33.05%的改进。

Conclusion: 该框架能够在保持CG级别效率的同时，探索未见的构象并训练模型覆盖构象空间中的未探索区域，有效解决了CG势能随时间退化的问题。

Abstract: Machine-learned coarse-grained (CG) potentials are fast, but degrade over time when simulations reach under-sampled bio-molecular conformations, and generating widespread all-atom (AA) data to combat this is computationally infeasible. We propose a novel active learning (AL) framework for CG neural network potentials in molecular dynamics (MD). Building on the CGSchNet model, our method employs root mean squared deviation (RMSD)-based frame selection from MD simulations in order to generate data on-the-fly by querying an oracle during the training of a neural network potential. This framework preserves CG-level efficiency while correcting the model at precise, RMSD-identified coverage gaps. By training CGSchNet, a coarse-grained neural network potential, we empirically show that our framework explores previously unseen configurations and trains the model on unexplored regions of conformational space. Our active learning framework enables a CGSchNet model trained on the Chignolin protein to achieve a 33.05\% improvement in the Wasserstein-1 (W1) metric in Time-lagged Independent Component Analysis (TICA) space on an in-house benchmark suite.

</details>


### [413] [GRPO is Secretly a Process Reward Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21154)
*Michael Sullivan,Alexander Koller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论证明了GRPO算法与ORM在特定条件下等价于PRM，并指出GRPO在奖励不平衡场景下的缺陷，提出λ-GRPO改进方案，显著提升推理任务性能且几乎不增加训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示GRPO算法中隐含的PRM结构，并利用这一结构在不引入显式PRM的情况下提升模型性能。

Method: 通过理论证明GRPO+ORM等价于PRM感知的RL目标；识别GRPO在步长和奖励不平衡时的探索-利用缺陷；提出λ-GRPO修正算法。

Result: λ-GRPO训练的LLM在推理任务中优于标准GRPO，且更快达到峰值性能，训练时间和成本几乎不变。

Conclusion: 利用GRPO内置的隐式PRM结构可在不引入显式PRM的情况下提升模型性能，λ-GRPO是高效、低成本的改进方案。

Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) allow for fine-grained credit assignment in reinforcement learning (RL), and seemingly contrast with outcome reward models (ORMs), which assign a single reward to an entire trajectory. However, we provide theoretical proof in this work that the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) RL algorithm equipped with an ORM is in fact equivalent to a PRM-aware RL objective equipped with a non-trivial, Monte-Carlo-based PRM (given mild assumptions). Leveraging the framework of GRPO-as-a-PRM, we identify a flaw in the GRPO objective that interacts with imbalanced process steps and rewards to hinder both exploration and exploitation (under different conditions). We propose a simple modification to the algorithm to mitigate this defect ($λ$-GRPO), and show that LLMs tuned with $λ$-GRPO outperform LLMs tuned with standard GRPO on downstream reasoning tasks\textemdash and reach peak performance more rapidly. These results show that we can leverage the hidden, built-in PRM structure within the vanilla GRPO algorithm to boost model performance without employing an explicit PRM, and with a negligible impact on training time and cost.

</details>


### [414] [Towards Foundation Models for Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection: Leveraging Synthetic Data and Relative Context Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21190)
*Tian Lan,Hao Duong Le,Jinbo Li,Wenjun He,Meng Wang,Chenghao Liu,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TimeRCD提出了一种新的相对上下文差异（RCD）预训练范式，通过检测相邻时间窗口间的显著差异而非重建输入来实现时间序列异常检测的零样本泛化，在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于重建目标的时间序列基础模型存在根本性的目标不匹配问题：难以识别细微异常，同时常将复杂正常模式误判为异常，导致高假阴性和假阳性率。

Method: 提出RCD预训练范式，模型通过标准Transformer架构学习检测相邻时间窗口之间的相对上下文差异来识别异常；并构建了带有token级异常标注的大规模多样化合成语料库进行预训练。

Result: 在多个数据集上的零样本异常检测任务中，TimeRCD显著优于现有的通用和专用于异常检测的基础模型。

Conclusion: 验证了RCD范式在时间序列异常检测中的优越性，为构建鲁棒且可泛化的时间序列异常检测基础模型开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is a critical task, but developing models that generalize to unseen data in a zero-shot manner remains a major challenge. Prevailing foundation models for TSAD predominantly rely on reconstruction-based objectives, which suffer from a fundamental objective mismatch: they struggle to identify subtle anomalies while often misinterpreting complex normal patterns, leading to high rates of false negatives and positives. To overcome these limitations, we introduce \texttt{TimeRCD}, a novel foundation model for TSAD built upon a new pre-training paradigm: Relative Context Discrepancy (RCD). Instead of learning to reconstruct inputs, \texttt{TimeRCD} is explicitly trained to identify anomalies by detecting significant discrepancies between adjacent time windows. This relational approach, implemented with a standard Transformer architecture, enables the model to capture contextual shifts indicative of anomalies that reconstruction-based methods often miss. To facilitate this paradigm, we develop a large-scale, diverse synthetic corpus with token-level anomaly labels, providing the rich supervisory signal necessary for effective pre-training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \texttt{TimeRCD} significantly outperforms existing general-purpose and anomaly-specific foundation models in zero-shot TSAD across diverse datasets. Our results validate the superiority of the RCD paradigm and establish a new, effective path toward building robust and generalizable foundation models for time series anomaly detection.

</details>


### [415] [Towards Understanding the Shape of Representations in Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24895)
*Kosio Beshkov,Anders Malthe-Sørenssen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用SRV表示和图过滤两种方法，研究蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）如何将整个序列空间转换为度量空间，揭示不同层编码结构信息的规律：PLMs优先编码局部残基关系，且最结构忠实编码出现在靠近但非最后一层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PLM可解释性工作仅关注单个序列如何被转换，尚未理解PLM如何转换整个序列空间及其中的关系。

Method: 将蛋白质结构与SRV表示关联，利用图过滤构建度量空间，在SCOP数据集上分析ESM2模型不同层的Karcher均值和有效维度，以及用图过滤研究上下文长度对结构特征编码的影响。

Result: SRV形状空间的Karcher均值和有效维度随ESM2层数呈现非线性变化；PLM优先编码局部残基关系，大上下文长度时性能下降；最结构忠实编码出现在靠近但非最后一层。

Conclusion: PLM的结构编码规律表明，在靠近但非最后一层之上训练折叠模型可能带来更好的折叠性能。

Abstract: While protein language models (PLMs) are one of the most promising avenues of research for future de novo protein design, the way in which they transform sequences to hidden representations, as well as the information encoded in such representations is yet to be fully understood. Several works have attempted to propose interpretability tools for PLMs, but they have focused on understanding how individual sequences are transformed by such models. Therefore, the way in which PLMs transform the whole space of sequences along with their relations is still unknown. In this work we attempt to understand this transformed space of sequences by identifying protein structure and representation with square-root velocity (SRV) representations and graph filtrations. Both approaches naturally lead to a metric space in which pairs of proteins or protein representations can be compared with each other.
  We analyze different types of proteins from the SCOP dataset and show that the Karcher mean and effective dimension of the SRV shape space follow a non-linear pattern as a function of the layers in ESM2 models of different sizes. Furthermore, we use graph filtrations as a tool to study the context lengths at which models encode the structural features of proteins. We find that PLMs preferentially encode immediate as well as local relations between residues, but start to degrade for larger context lengths. The most structurally faithful encoding tends to occur close to, but before the last layer of the models, indicating that training a folding model ontop of these layers might lead to improved folding performance.

</details>


### [416] [In-Place Feedback: Reliable Refinement for Multi-Turn Expert-LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00777)
*Youngbin Choi,Minjong Lee,Saemi Moon,Seunghyuk Cho,Chaehyeon Chung,MoonJeong Park,Dongwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"原地反馈"交互范式——用户直接编辑模型之前的回答，模型从编辑后的上下文继续生成。该范式在五个推理密集型基准上始终优于标准的多轮反馈，且消耗更少token，用户研究也证实了其更高的满意度和更低的疲劳度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的草稿常包含细微的事实或逻辑错误，而先前研究表明模型难以可靠地整合旨在修复这些错误的多轮反馈。

Method: 提出"原地反馈"（in-place feedback）交互范式：用户直接编辑模型之前的回答，模型从编辑后的上下文继续生成。在五个推理密集型基准上进行评估，并进行用户研究。

Result: 原地反馈在五个基准上一致优于标准多轮反馈，消耗更少token；更可靠地应用修正并将修正传播到后续推理；用户研究中参与者报告更高的最终输出满意度和更低的疲劳度；混合策略（原地+多轮）在所有维度上得分最高。

Conclusion: 直接编辑错误是专家与LLM协作的更有效范式。

Abstract: LLM-generated drafts often contain subtle factual or logical errors, yet prior work shows that models struggle to reliably integrate multi-turn feedback aimed at fixing them. We propose in-place feedback, an interaction paradigm in which the user directly edits the model's previous response and the model continues generation from the edited context. In-place feedback consistently outperforms standard multi-turn feedback across five reasoning-intensive benchmarks while requiring fewer tokens, and our fine-grained analysis shows that it applies corrections more reliably and propagates them to subsequent reasoning. A user study with domain experts refining LLM-generated summaries corroborates these findings: participants report higher final-output satisfaction and substantially lower fatigue with in-place feedback, and a mixed strategy combining in-place and multi-turn feedback scores highest on every measured dimension. These results suggest that editing errors directly is a more effective paradigm for expert-LLM collaboration.

</details>


### [417] [Distributional Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03013)
*Feiyang Wu,Ye Zhao,Anqi Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个分布化离线逆强化学习框架，通过最小化一阶随机占优违反并整合扭曲风险测度，联合建模奖励函数与回报的完整分布，在理论收敛性与实证性能上均达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统逆强化学习仅恢复确定性奖励估计或匹配期望回报，无法捕捉专家行为中丰富的分布结构，尤其缺乏对奖励分布和风险感知策略的学习能力。

Method: 构建分布化离线IRL框架，通过最小化一阶随机占优（FSD）违反来联合建模奖励函数与回报完整分布，并将扭曲风险测度（DRMs）整合到策略学习中，实现奖励分布与分布感知策略的联合恢复。

Result: 算法收敛复杂度为𝒪(ε⁻²)；在合成数据、神经行为学真实数据及MuJoCo控制任务上，方法恢复了表达性奖励表征并取得了SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 所提分布化框架能有效捕捉专家行为中的分布结构，适用于行为分析和风险感知模仿学习，理论分析与实证结果共同验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: We propose a distributional framework for offline Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) that jointly models uncertainty over reward functions and full distributions of returns. Unlike conventional IRL approaches that recover a deterministic reward estimate or match only expected returns, our method captures richer structure in expert behavior, particularly in learning the reward distribution, by minimizing first-order stochastic dominance (FSD) violations and thus integrating distortion risk measures (DRMs) into policy learning, enabling the recovery of both reward distributions and distribution-aware policies. This formulation is well-suited for behavior analysis and risk-aware imitation learning. Theoretical analysis shows that the algorithm converges with $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ iteration complexity. Empirical results on synthetic benchmarks, real-world neurobehavioral data, and MuJoCo control tasks demonstrate that our method recovers expressive reward representations and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [418] [Provable Affine Identifiability of Nonlinear CCA under Latent Distributional Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04758)
*Zhiwei Han,Stefan Matthes,Hao Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了非线性CCA恢复潜在因子（仿射变换意义下）的充分条件，将双变量分布的正交多项式展开从观测空间扩展到源空间，证明了仿射可识别性；严格论证了白化对学习映射有界性和良态性的必要性，证明了岭正则化经验CCA在有限样本下收敛到总体版本，为基于相关性的非对比学习提供了理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为非线性CCA在表示学习中的理论可识别性建立严格基础，解释基于相关性的非对比学习方法的经验成功。

Method: 将分析从观测空间迁移到源空间，扩展双变量分布的正交多项式展开理论，结合岭正则化经验CCA的有限样本收敛分析，并在合成图像和渲染图像上通过消融实验验证。

Result: 证明了在特定分布先验下非线性CCA可达到仿射可识别性，白化是保证映射有界和良态的必要条件，岭正则化经验CCA在有限样本下收敛到总体版本。

Conclusion: 为非线性CCA提供了严格的理论基础，解释了基于相关性的非对比学习的成功机制，同时通过实验揭示了假设违反时的失效模式。

Abstract: In this work, we establish the sufficient conditions under which nonlinear Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) recovers ground-truth latent factors up to an affine transformation. By transporting the analysis from the observation space to the source space, we extend classical statistical results on orthogonal polynomial expansions of bivariate distributions to representation learning, proving affine identifiability under specific distributional priors. We formally demonstrate that whitening is strictly necessary to ensure the boundedness and well-conditioning of the learned mappings. Furthermore, we bridge the gap between theory and practice by proving that ridge-regularized empirical CCA converges to its population counterpart in the finite-sample regime. Finally, our findings provide a rigorous theoretical foundation explaining the empirical success of recent correlation-based non-contrastive learning methods. Experiments on synthetic and rendered image datasets, alongside systematic ablations, validate the predicted recovery behavior and illustrate the failure modes that arise when the assumptions are violated.

</details>


### [419] [The Impact of Semantic Pairs on Self-Supervised Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08722)
*Mohammad Alkhalefi,Georgios Leontidis,Mingjun Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过控制变量实验，系统研究了自监督学习中语义正样本对（同一类别的不同实例）相比传统数据增强正样本对（同一图像的不同增强视图）的优势。实验表明，语义正样本对能更好地去除背景、纹理等干扰相关性，在迁移学习和目标检测任务中表现更优，其中对比学习方法（尤其是SimCLR）受益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督学习（SSL）主要通过同一图像的不同增强视图作为正样本对来学习表征，但这种方法保留了背景、纹理、光照和物体细节等干扰相关性。虽然已有研究尝试使用语义正样本对（同一类别的不同实例），但它们往往混合了增强正样本或错误匹配的语义对（假邻居），导致难以单独评估语义配对的效果。因此，作者希望进行严格控制的研究来隔离和分析语义正样本对在SSL中的实际作用。

Method: 从ImageNet-1K中构建了两个匹配的子集：一个传统的增强正样本对基线（augmented-pair baseline）和一个手动筛选的语义正样本对数据集（semantic-pair dataset），两者具有相同的类别组成和训练样本对数量。在此匹配条件下，比较了代表性对比学习（如SimCLR）和非对比性SSL方法（如BYOL）的性能，并在迁移学习和目标检测任务上评估。此外进行了消融实验分析语义对诱导的不变性。

Result: 1）语义正样本对预训练在迁移学习和目标检测任务中一致优于增强正样本对预训练；2）语义对能够诱导超越标准数据增强流程的不变性；3）对比学习方法从语义对中受益最大，其中SimCLR的相对提升最为显著。

Conclusion: 该研究厘清了语义正样本对在自监督学习中的作用，为选择或设计能够有效利用语义对信息的框架提供了指导，表明语义配对是对传统数据增强配对的补充而非替代，且对比学习框架更适合利用这种语义信息。

Abstract: Instance discrimination learns visual representations by treating different augmented views of the same image as positive pairs. While this encourages invariance to handcrafted transformations, same-image positives can preserve nuisance correlations such as background, texture, illumination, and object-specific details. Semantic positive pairs, i.e., different same-class instances, may reduce these correlations by presenting objects across diverse contexts. However, previous studies often combine semantic pairs with augmented positives or false neighbors (i.e., incorrectly mapped semantic pairs), making it difficult to isolate the effect of semantic pairing. We present a controlled empirical study of semantic positive pairs for self-supervised representation learning. From ImageNet-1K, we construct two matched subsets: an augmented-pair baseline and a manually curated semantic-pair dataset with the same class composition and training-pair count. We use these datasets to compare representative contrastive and non-contrastive SSL methods under matched training conditions. Across transfer learning and object detection evaluations, semantic-pair pretraining consistently improves generalisation over augmented-pair pretraining. Additional ablations show that semantic pairs induce invariances beyond the standard transformation pipeline. Among the evaluated methods, contrastive learning benefits most strongly from semantic pairs, with SimCLR showing the largest relative improvement. These results clarify the role of semantic positive pairs in SSL and provide guidance for selecting and designing frameworks that can exploit semantic pair information effectively

</details>


### [420] [Offline Reinforcement Learning with Generative Trajectory Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11499)
*Xinsong Feng,Leshu Tang,Chenan Wang,Haipeng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出生成轨迹策略（GTP），通过统一视角将扩散模型、流匹配和一致性模型视为ODE连续时间生成轨迹的实例，并学习整个ODE解映射，在D4RL基准上实现了SOTA性能，在多个AntMaze任务上取得完美分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习中的生成策略存在两难困境：慢速迭代模型（如扩散策略）计算昂贵，快速单步模型（如一致性策略）性能退化。论文旨在弥合这一差距，通过统一视角超越个体方法的局限性。

Method: 将扩散模型、流匹配和一致性模型统一视为学习由常微分方程（ODE）控制的连续时间生成轨迹的实例，在此基础上提出GTP，学习整个ODE解映射，并引入两种理论上自适应的关键改进以适用于离线RL。

Result: 在D4RL基准上达到SOTA性能，显著优于先前的生成策略，在多个困难的AntMaze任务上取得完美分数。

Conclusion: 通过统一视角和ODE解映射学习，可以弥合快速单步生成策略与慢速迭代策略之间的性能差距，实现两者兼顾。

Abstract: Generative models have emerged as a powerful class of policies for offline reinforcement learning (RL) due to their ability to capture complex, multi-modal behaviors. However, existing methods face a stark trade-off: slow, iterative models like diffusion policies are computationally expensive, while fast, single-step models like consistency policies often suffer from degraded performance. In this paper, we demonstrate that it is possible to bridge this gap. The key to moving beyond the limitations of individual methods, we argue, lies in a unifying perspective that views modern generative models, including diffusion, flow matching, and consistency models, as specific instances of learning a continuous-time generative trajectory governed by an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE). This principled foundation provides a clearer design space for generative policies in RL and allows us to propose Generative Trajectory Policies (GTPs), a new and more general policy paradigm that learns the entire solution map of the underlying ODE. To make this paradigm practical for offline RL, we further introduce two key theoretically principled adaptations. Empirical results demonstrate that GTP achieves state-of-the-art performance on D4RL benchmarks - it significantly outperforms prior generative policies, achieving perfect scores on several notoriously hard AntMaze tasks.

</details>


### [421] [Beyond Accuracy: Are Time Series Foundation Models Well-Calibrated?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.16060)
*Coen Adler,Yuxin Chang,Felix Draxler,Samar Abdi,Padhraic Smyth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了五个时间序列基础模型和两个基线的校准特性，发现时间序列基础模型在预测校准方面优于基线，且不会出现系统性过度自信或信心不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管时间序列基础模型在预测性能上取得了显著进展，但其校准特性（即模型置信度是否与实际准确性匹配）尚未得到充分研究，而校准能力对于许多实际应用至关重要。

Method: 对五个近期时间序列基础模型和两个竞争基线进行系统评估，包括模型校准（过度自信或信心不足）、不同预测头的影响以及长期自回归预测下的校准表现。

Result: 时间序列基础模型在校准方面 consistently 优于基线模型，且不会出现系统性过度自信或信心不足的倾向，这与许多其他深度学习模型常见的过度自信现象形成对比。

Conclusion: 时间序列基础模型不仅预测性能优越，其校准特性也更好，为实际应用中需要可靠不确定性估计的场景提供了支持。

Abstract: The recent development of foundation models for time series data has generated considerable interest in using such models across a variety of applications. Although foundation models achieve state-of-the-art predictive performance, their calibration properties remain relatively underexplored, despite the fact that calibration can be critical for many practical applications. In this paper, we investigate the calibration-related properties of five recent time series foundation models and two competitive baselines. We perform a series of systematic evaluations assessing model calibration (i.e., over- or under-confidence), effects of varying prediction heads, and calibration under long-term autoregressive forecasting. We find that time series foundation models are consistently better calibrated than baseline models and tend not to be either systematically over- or under-confident, in contrast to the overconfidence often seen in other deep learning models.

</details>


### [422] [Leak@$k$: Unlearning Does Not Make LLMs Forget Under Probabilistic Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.04934)
*Hadi Reisizadeh,Jiajun Ruan,Yiwei Chen,Soumyadeep Pal,Sijia Liu,Mingyi Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有的大模型遗忘方法在概率解码下会泄露已删除的敏感信息，本文提出leak@k指标量化这一风险，并设计了RULE算法实现更可靠的遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遗忘方法在确定性解码下看似有效，但在实际使用的概率解码（采样）中，已"遗忘"的敏感信息会重新出现，缺乏对遗忘可靠性的系统评估。

Method: 提出leak@k元评估指标，量化模型在生成k个样本时遗忘知识重新出现的概率；基于该指标设计了RULE（Robust Unlearning under LEak@k metric）算法。

Result: 在TOFU、MUSE、WMDP三个基准上大规模实验表明：几乎所有现有遗忘方法都存在知识泄露；RULE在TOFU上实现零泄露，在MUSE上超越SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 当前SOTA遗忘技术仅提供有限的遗忘效果，概率解码下的知识泄露是普遍问题；leak@k是更可靠的安全性评估指标，RULE提供了更鲁棒的遗忘方案。

Abstract: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) is critical for regulatory compliance and for building ethical generative AI systems that avoid producing private, toxic, illegal, or copyrighted content. Despite rapid progress, in this work, we show that \textit{almost all} existing unlearning methods fail to achieve true forgetting in practice. Specifically, while evaluations of these `unlearned' models under deterministic (greedy) decoding often suggest successful knowledge removal using standard benchmarks, we show that sensitive information reliably resurfaces when models are sampled with standard probabilistic decoding. To rigorously capture this vulnerability, we introduce \texttt{leak@$k$}, a new meta-evaluation metric that quantifies the likelihood of forgotten knowledge reappearing when generating $k$ samples from the model under realistic decoding strategies. Using three widely adopted benchmarks, TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, we conduct the first large-scale, systematic study of unlearning reliability using \texttt{leak@$k$} metric. Our findings demonstrate that knowledge leakage persists across methods and tasks, underscoring that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) unlearning techniques provide only limited forgetting. We propose an algorithm, termed Robust Unlearning under LEak@$k$ metric (\texttt{RULE}) to address this concern. We demonstrate that \texttt{RULE} provides an unlearned model for TOFU benchmark with no information leakage for a large number of generation samples. On the MUSE benchmark, \texttt{RULE} outperforms SOTA unlearning methods under the \texttt{leak@$k$} metric across most sampling budgets $k$. Codes are available at https://github.com/OptimAI-Lab/Leak-k.

</details>


### [423] [DiScoFormer: Plug-In Density and Score Estimation with Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.05924)
*Vasily Ilin,Peter Sushko,Ranjay Krishna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DiScoFormer，一种"一次训练、随处推断"的等变Transformer，能够从i.i.d.样本中同时估计概率密度和得分函数，且在分布和样本大小上具有泛化能力。理论证明自注意力可恢复归一化KDE，实验表明其收敛更快、精度更高，并可作为高保真得分预言器用于多种下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有密度和得分估计方法存在二分困境：经典KDE泛化性强但受维数灾难困扰，现代神经得分模型精度高但需针对每个目标分布重新训练。本文旨在设计一种能同时解决这两个问题的统一框架。

Method: 提出DiScoFormer，一种等变Transformer架构，将i.i.d.样本映射到密度值和得分向量。理论上证明自注意力机制可恢复归一化KDE，是核方法的函数式推广；实践中注意力头学习到多尺度、类核的行为模式。

Result: DiScoFormer在密度估计上比KDE收敛更快、精度更高；作为高保真得分预言器，可用于得分去偏KDE、Fisher信息计算和Fokker-Planck型PDE求解。

Conclusion: DiScoFormer实现了跨分布泛化的密度与得分联合估计，桥接了经典核方法与现代神经方法的鸿沟，为生成建模、贝叶斯推断和动力学理论提供了新的工具。

Abstract: Estimating probability density and its score from samples remains a core problem in generative modeling, Bayesian inference, and kinetic theory. Existing methods are bifurcated: classical kernel density estimators (KDE) generalize across distributions but suffer from the curse of dimensionality, while modern neural score models achieve high precision but require retraining for every target distribution. We introduce DiScoFormer (Density and Score Transformer), a ``train-once, infer-anywhere" equivariant Transformer that maps i.i.d. samples to both density values and score vectors, generalizing across distributions and sample sizes. Analytically, we prove that self-attention can recover normalized KDE, establishing it as a functional generalization of kernel methods; empirically, individual attention heads learn multi-scale, kernel-like behaviors. The model converges faster and achieves higher precision than KDE for density estimation, and provides a high-fidelity plug-in score oracle for score-debiased KDE, Fisher information computation, and Fokker-Planck-type PDEs.

</details>


### [424] [FarSkip-Collective: Unhobbling Blocking Communication in Mixture of Experts Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.11505)
*Yonatan Dukler,Guihong Li,Deval Shah,Jiang Liu,Vikram Appia,Emad Barsoum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FarSkip-Collective方法，通过修改MoE模型架构跳过连接，使通信与计算可重叠，在不显著损失精度的情况下（如Llama 4 Scout 109B精度损失<1%），实现训练和推理加速（推理TTFT加速32.6%，训练通信重叠达88.9%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式训练中MoE模型的阻塞通信是主要瓶颈，现有方法难以在不影响模型能力的前提下实现计算与通信的有效重叠。

Method: 修改MoE架构，跳跃模型中的连接（skip connections），使得通信操作可以与计算操作重叠；通过对大模型进行自蒸馏（self-distillation）来保持修改后模型的性能。

Result: 将16B-109B参数规模的多个SOTA模型成功转换，Llama 4 Scout (109B)在广泛下游评测中平均精度保持在1%以内；推理TTFT加速32.6%，预填充阶段通信-计算重叠达97.3%；训练中all-to-all通信重叠达88.9%。

Conclusion: FarSkip-Collective证明通过架构修改可以在大规模MoE模型中有效实现通信-计算重叠，显著提升分布式训练和推理效率，同时保持模型性能。

Abstract: Blocking communication presents a major hurdle in running MoEs efficiently in distributed settings. To address this, we present FarSkip-Collective which modifies the architecture of modern models to enable overlapping of their computation with communication. Our approach modifies the architecture to skip connections in the model and it is unclear a priori whether the modified model architecture can remain as capable, especially for large state-of-the-art models and while modifying all of the model layers. We answer this question in the affirmative and fully convert a series of state-of-the-art models varying from 16B to 109B parameters to enable overlapping of their communication while achieving accuracy that is comparable with their original open-source releases. For example, we convert Llama 4 Scout (109B) via self-distillation and achieve average accuracy within 1% of its instruction tuned release averaged over a wide range of downstream evaluations. In addition to demonstrating retained accuracy of the large modified models, we realize the benefits of FarSkip-Collective through optimized implementations that explicitly overlap communication with computation, accelerating both training and inference in existing frameworks. For inference, we demonstrate 32.6% speedup in Time To First Token when serving a converted DeepSeek-V3 architecture with expert parallelism in SGLang and achieve 97.3% communication-computation overlap during the prefill stage. During training, our approach enables 88.9% communication overlap of the all-to-all communication collectives when pre-training DeepSeek-V3 MoE layers with expert parallelism.

</details>


### [425] [MiAD: Mirage Atom Diffusion for De Novo Crystal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14426)
*Andrey Okhotin,Maksim Nakhodnov,Nikita Kazeev,Mikhail Lazarev,Andrey E Ustyuzhanin,Dmitry Vetrov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"Mirage Infusion"的技术，使扩散模型能够在晶体生成过程中改变原子数量（从存在到不存在或反之），从而大幅提升模型性能。基于此技术开发的MiAD模型在MP-20数据集上实现了8.2%的S.U.N.率，相较现有方法有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的扩散模型在生成稳定、唯一且新颖（S.U.N.）晶体材料方面表现出色，但大多数模型无法在生成过程中改变晶体中的原子数量，这限制了模型采样轨迹的多样性，导致生成质量受限。

Method: 提出Mirage Infusion技术，允许扩散模型在生成过程中将原子状态从存在变为不存在（幻影状态）或反之。基于此构建了MiAD（Mirage Atom Diffusion）模型，这是一个等变联合扩散模型，能够实现de novo晶体生成过程中原子数量的动态变化。

Result: MiAD在MP-20数据集上达到8.2%的S.U.N.率，显著超过现有最先进方法。与未修改的同一模型相比，该技术可将模型质量提升高达2.5倍。

Conclusion: Mirage Infusion是一种简单而有效的技术，能够突破现有晶体生成扩散模型中原子数量不可变的限制，大幅提升生成质量和多样性，为晶体材料发现提供了新的有力工具。

Abstract: In recent years, diffusion-based models have demonstrated exceptional performance in searching for simultaneously stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) crystalline materials.
