However, most of these models don't have the ability to change the number of atoms in the crystal during the generation process, which limits the variability of model sampling trajectories. In this paper, we demonstrate the severity of this restriction and introduce a simple yet powerful technique, mirage infusion, which enables diffusion models to change the state of the atoms that make up the crystal from existent to non-existent (mirage) and vice versa. We show that this technique improves model quality by up to x2.5 compared to the same model without this modification. The resulting model, Mirage Atom Diffusion (MiAD), is an equivariant joint diffusion model for de novo crystal generation that is capable of altering the number of atoms during the generation process. MiAD achieves an 8.2% S.U.N. rate on the MP-20 dataset, which substantially exceeds existing state-of-the-art approaches. Code: https://github.com/andrey-okhotin/miad.git

</details>


### [426] [ReflexGrad: Within-Episode Failure Recovery in LLM Agents via Progress-Gated Dual-Process Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14584)
*Ankush Kadu,Aswanth Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReflexGrad提出了一种双进程架构，使LLM智能体能够在单episode内从失败中恢复，无需演示。它在ALFWorld任务上将Qwen-3-8B的性能从35.1%提升至75.4%（+40.3个百分点），优于多种基线方法，且增益主要来自路由机制而非模型规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体架构无法在单episode内利用失败后的轨迹信息进行恢复——当智能体早期选择错误方法且耗尽步骤预算时，后失败轨迹包含逃脱所需的信息，但尚无架构能在单个episode内对此采取行动。

Method: 设计双进程架构：快进程（TextGrad风格，每k=3步连续优化）和慢进程（Reflexion风格，当连续m=5步低进度分数触发路由门时进行因果诊断）。通过确定性优先级合并保持自然语言策略的一致性，每次慢激活产生三个工件：可复现触发器、因果诊断和验证修复。

Result: 在ALFWorld 134个任务上（n=10种子，无演示），Qwen-3-8B从35.1%提升至75.4%（+40.3pp），超越1-shot LATS（+2.7pp, p≈0.01）、ToT（+5.7pp, p<10⁻⁴）和Self-Refine（+6.7pp, p<10⁻⁵）；GPT-5上从46.3%提升至88.1%（+41.8pp）。跨模型差异仅1.5pp（p≈0.13），表明路由机制而非模型规模是增益主要来源。

Conclusion: ReflexGrad通过双进程路由机制有效实现了无需演示的episode内失败恢复，且增益可跨模型泛化，核心贡献在于路由机制本身而非模型规模。

Abstract: We present ReflexGrad, a dual-process architecture for within-episode failure recovery in LLM agents without demonstrations. When agents commit to a wrong approach early and exhaust the step budget, the post-failure trajectory contains the information to escape -- but no published architecture acts on it within a single episode. ReflexGrad routes between a fast process (TextGrad-style continuous refinement every $k{=}3$ steps) and a slow process (Reflexion-style causal diagnosis when $m{=}5$ consecutive low-progress scores fire a routing gate). A deterministic priority merge keeps the natural-language policy coherent, and each slow activation emits three observable artifacts: a reproducible trigger, a causal diagnostic, and a verified fix. On ALFWorld 134 tasks, $n{=}10$ seeds, no demonstrations, ReflexGrad lifts Qwen-3-8B from $35.1\%$ to $75.4\%$ ($+40.3$pp), beating compute-matched 1-shot LATS by $+2.7$pp ($p{\approx}0.01$), ToT by $+5.7$pp ($p{<}10^{-4}$), and Self-Refine by $+6.7$pp ($p{<}10^{-5}$); on GPT-5 the lift is $46.3{\to}88.1\%$ ($+41.8$pp). The $1.5$pp cross-model difference is within seed noise ($p{\approx}0.13$), suggesting that the routing mechanism, rather than model scale, is the primary source of the gain. Code, prompts, per-seed logs, and sensitivity sweeps are released.

</details>


### [427] [NCSAM Noise-Compensated Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Noisy Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.19947)
*Jiayu Xu,Junbiao Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从优化角度研究标签噪声学习，提出噪声补偿锐度感知最小化（NCSAM），通过校正SAM扰动来抵消噪声标签引起的优化偏差，从而减少对噪声标签的记忆，实验表明该方法优于SAM基线且与主流方法竞争力相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实数据集常包含错误标注，现有方法多依赖标签校正或样本选择机制，本文旨在从优化视角理解并解决标签噪声问题。

Method: 建立标签噪声与SAM平坦性追求之间的理论联系，提出NCSAM，使用噪声补偿扰动来抵消噪声标签导致的优化偏差，修复被扭曲的SAM扰动。

Result: 在合成和真实噪声标签基准上，NCSAM一致优于SAM优化基线，且与代表性噪声标签学习方法竞争力相当。

Conclusion: 通过优化视角的扰动校正策略，NCSAM在保持优化方法简洁性的同时有效缓解了噪声标签记忆问题。

Abstract: Learning from Noisy Labels (LNL) remains a fundamental challenge in deep learning because real-world datasets often contain corrupted annotations. Most existing methods rely on label correction or sample selection mechanisms. In contrast, we study LNL from an optimization perspective by establishing a theoretical connection between label noise and the flatness-seeking behavior of Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM). Based on this analysis, we propose Noise-Compensated Sharpness-Aware Minimization (NCSAM), which uses a noise-compensated perturbation to counteract the optimization bias induced by noisy labels. By correcting distorted SAM perturbations, NCSAM mitigates the memorization of noisy labels during training while preserving the simplicity of optimization-based learning. Experiments on synthetic and real-world noisy-label benchmarks show that NCSAM consistently improves over SAM-based optimization baselines and remains competitive with representative noisy-label learning methods.

</details>


### [428] [BioArc: Discovering Optimal Neural Architectures for Biological Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00283)
*Yi Fang,Haoran Xu,Jiaxin Han,Sirui Ding,Yizhi Wang,Yue Wang,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BioArc框架，利用神经架构搜索（NAS）系统性地为生物数据发现高性能架构，并提炼出经验性设计原则，同时提出架构预测方法以高效适配新任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物学基础模型直接套用通用AI领域的架构，未考虑生物数据独特的物理化学和结构特性（如长程依赖、稀疏信息、复杂语法），导致性能次优。

Method: 提出BioArc框架，采用神经架构搜索（NAS）系统探索架构设计空间，分析架构、分词与训练策略之间的相互作用，并在此基础上提出多种架构预测方法。

Result: 发现了多种新型高性能架构，提炼出一套经验性设计原则，并验证了架构预测方法在高效适配新任务上的有效性。

Conclusion: BioArc为生物学基础模型的设计提供了原则性方法和基础资源，有望推动下一代任务特定模型和基础模型的发展。

Abstract: Foundation models have revolutionized various fields such as natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision (CV). While efforts have been made to transfer the success of the foundation models in general AI domains to biology, existing works focus on directly adopting the existing foundation model architectures from general machine learning domains without a systematic design considering the unique physicochemical and structural properties of each biological data modality. This leads to suboptimal performance, as these repurposed architectures struggle to capture the long-range dependencies, sparse information, and complex underlying ``grammars'' inherent to biological data. To address this gap, we introduce BioArc, a novel framework designed to move beyond intuition-driven architecture design towards principled, automated architecture discovery for biological foundation models. Leveraging Neural Architecture Search (NAS), BioArc systematically explores a vast architecture design space, evaluating architectures across multiple biological modalities while rigorously analyzing the interplay between architecture, tokenization, and training strategies. This large-scale analysis identifies novel, high-performance architectures, allowing us to distill a set of empirical design principles to guide future model development. Furthermore, to make the best of this set of discovered principled architectures, we propose and compare several architecture prediction methods that effectively and efficiently predict optimal architectures for new biological tasks. Overall, our work provides a foundational resource and a principled methodology to guide the creation of the next generation of task-specific and foundation models for biology.

</details>


### [429] [Rectified LpJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures with Sparse and Maximum-Entropy Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01456)
*Yilun Kuang,Yash Dagade,Tim G. J. Rudner,Randall Balestriero,Yann LeCun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种修正分布匹配正则化（RDMReg）方法，通过将JEPA模型的表示对齐到修正广义高斯分布，实现了对表示稀疏性的显式控制，并在此框架下得到Rectified LpJEPA模型，在图像分类任务上取得了稀疏性与下游性能的良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JEPA方法通过将表示正则化到各向同性高斯分布，虽然能防止坍缩，但倾向于学习稠密表示，忽视了高效表示中稀疏性这一关键属性。

Method: 提出RDMReg——一种基于切片的双样本分布匹配损失，将表示对齐到修正广义高斯（RGG）分布。RGG通过修正机制显式控制期望ℓ₀范数，其连续截断部分在期望ℓₚ范数和支撑集约束下具有最大熵特性。将该正则化器集成到JEPA中得到Rectified LpJEPA。

Result: Rectified LpJEPA学习到稀疏、非负的表示，在图像分类基准上展现出有利的稀疏性-性能权衡，且下游性能具有竞争力。

Conclusion: RDMReg能够在保留任务相关信息的同时有效施加稀疏性，且Rectified LpJEPA严格泛化了此前基于高斯先验的JEPA方法。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) learn view-invariant representations and admit projection-based distribution matching for collapse prevention. Existing approaches regularize representations towards isotropic Gaussian distributions, but inherently favor dense representations and fail to capture the key property of sparsity observed in efficient representations. We introduce Rectified Distribution Matching Regularization (RDMReg), a sliced two-sample distribution-matching loss that aligns representations to a Rectified Generalized Gaussian (RGG) distribution. RGG enables explicit control over expected $\ell_0$ norm through rectification, while its continuous truncated component admits a maximum-entropy characterization under expected $\ell_p$ norm and support constraints. Equipping JEPAs with RDMReg yields Rectified LpJEPA, which strictly generalizes prior Gaussian-based JEPAs. Empirically, Rectified LpJEPA learns sparse, non-negative representations with favorable sparsity--performance trade-offs and competitive downstream performance on image classification benchmarks, showing that RDMReg can enforce sparsity while preserving task-relevant information.

</details>


### [430] [E-valuator: Reliable Agent Verifiers with Sequential Hypothesis Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03109)
*Shuvom Sadhuka,Drew Prinster,Clara Fannjiang,Gabriele Scalia,Bonnie Berger,Aviv Regev,Hanchen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出e-valuator方法，将任意黑盒验证器分数转化为具有可证明误报率控制的决策规则，通过序贯假设检验实现对智能体轨迹的在线监控，在六个数据集和三个智能体上验证了其统计功效和误报控制优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM验证器和过程奖励模型等启发式分数缺乏正确性保证，无法可靠地判断智能体轨迹是否能产生成功输出，需要一种能提供统计保证的决策方法。

Method: 将区分成功与不成功轨迹的问题建模为序贯假设检验问题，利用e-process工具构建序贯假设检验，使得在智能体轨迹的每一步都能保持统计有效性，实现任意长动作序列的在线监控。

Result: 在六个数据集和三个智能体上，e-valuator相比其他策略具有更高的统计功效和更好的误报率控制；并能用于快速终止有问题的轨迹以节省token。

Conclusion: e-valuator提供了一种轻量级、模型无关的框架，将验证器启发式分数转化为具有统计保证的决策规则，从而支持更可靠的智能体系统部署。

Abstract: Agentic AI systems execute a sequence of actions, such as reasoning steps or tool calls, in response to a user prompt. To evaluate the success of their trajectories, researchers have developed verifiers, such as LLM judges and process-reward models, to score the quality of each action in an agent's trajectory. Although these heuristic scores can be informative, there are no guarantees of correctness when used to decide whether an agent will yield a successful output. Here, we introduce e-valuator, a method to convert any black-box verifier score into a decision rule with provable control of false alarm rates. We frame the problem of distinguishing successful trajectories (that is, a sequence of actions that will lead to a correct response to the user's prompt) and unsuccessful trajectories as a sequential hypothesis testing problem. E-valuator builds on tools from e-processes to develop a sequential hypothesis test that remains statistically valid at every step of an agent's trajectory, enabling online monitoring of agents over arbitrarily long sequences of actions. Empirically, we demonstrate that e-valuator provides greater statistical power and better false alarm rate control than other strategies across six datasets and three agents. We additionally show that e-valuator can be used for to quickly terminate problematic trajectories and save tokens. Together, e-valuator provides a lightweight, model-agnostic framework that converts verifier heuristics into decisions rules with statistical guarantees, enabling the deployment of more reliable agentic systems.

</details>


### [431] [DCFO: Density-Based Counterfactuals for Outliers -- Additional Material](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.10659)
*Tommaso Amico,Pernille Matthews,Lena Krieger,Arthur Zimek,Ira Assent*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了DCFO方法，专门为LOF异常检测算法生成反事实解释，通过在数据空间分区实现高效梯度优化，在50个OpenML数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反事实解释方法忽略了异常检测的独特挑战，未能针对经典且广泛使用的LOF算法提供可解释性，而LOF虽然应用广泛但缺乏可解释性。

Method: DCFO将数据空间划分为LOF行为平滑的区域，从而能够进行高效的基于梯度的优化，为LOF检测出的异常点生成反事实解释。

Result: 在50个OpenML数据集上的实验表明，DCFO在生成的反事实的邻近性和有效性方面 consistently 优于基准方法。

Conclusion: DCFO有效地解决了LOF缺乏可解释性的问题，为异常检测提供了高质量的反事实解释。

Abstract: Outlier detection identifies data points that significantly deviate from the majority of the data distribution. Explaining outliers is crucial for understanding the underlying factors that contribute to their detection, validating their significance, and identifying potential biases or errors. Effective explanations provide actionable insights, facilitating preventive measures to avoid similar outliers in the future. Counterfactual explanations clarify why specific data points are classified as outliers by identifying minimal changes required to alter their prediction. Although valuable, most existing counterfactual explanation methods overlook the unique challenges posed by outlier detection, and fail to target classical, widely adopted outlier detection algorithms. Local Outlier Factor (LOF) is one the most popular unsupervised outlier detection methods, quantifying outlierness through relative local density. Despite LOF's widespread use across diverse applications, it lacks interpretability. To address this limitation, we introduce Density-based Counterfactuals for Outliers (DCFO), a novel method specifically designed to generate counterfactual explanations for LOF. DCFO partitions the data space into regions where LOF behaves smoothly, enabling efficient gradient-based optimisation. Extensive experimental validation on 50 OpenML datasets demonstrates that DCFO consistently outperforms benchmarked competitors, offering superior proximity and validity of generated counterfactuals.

</details>


### [432] [Learning to Solve PDEs on Neural Shape Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21311)
*Lilian Welschinger,Yilin Liu,Zican Wang,Niloy Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无网格的神经局部更新算子方法，可以直接在神经表面表征上求解偏微分方程，无需显式网格提取或逐实例训练，实现了跨形状和拓扑的泛化，并保持可微性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PDE求解器基于多边形/三角网格，而现代3D资产越来越多地使用神经表征，导致无法直接在神经域中求解表面PDE，需要显式网格提取或逐实例残差训练，阻碍了端到端工作流。

Method: 学习一个以神经（局部）形状属性为条件的局部更新算子，该算子无缝集成到主流神经表面表征中，在单个代表性形状上训练一次，即可泛化到不同形状和拓扑。

Result: 在解析基准（球面上的热扩散和泊松方程）及多种形状和神经表面表征上，该方法在精度上媲美经典求解器，同时实现了神经与传统表面表征的统一端到端管线。

Conclusion: 提出的无网格神经算子方法有效弥合了神经表征与PDE求解之间的鸿沟，实现了无需网格化或逐实例优化的准确、快速推理，并保持可微性，适用于端到端形状分析任务。

Abstract: Solving partial differential equations (PDEs) on shapes underpins many shape analysis and engineering tasks; yet, prevailing PDE solvers operate on polygonal/triangle meshes while modern 3D assets increasingly live as neural representations. This mismatch leaves no suitable method to solve surface PDEs directly within the neural domain, forcing explicit mesh extraction or per-instance residual training, preventing end-to-end workflows. We present a novel, meshfree formulation that learns a local update operator conditioned on neural (local) shape attributes, enabling surface PDEs to be solved directly where the (neural) data lives. The operator integrates naturally with prevalent neural surface representations, is trained once on a single representative shape, and generalizes across shape and topology variations, enabling accurate, fast inference without explicit meshing or per-instance optimization while preserving differentiability. Across analytic benchmarks (heat diffusion and Poisson equations on the sphere) and on diverse shapes and neural surface representations, our method achieves accuracy comparable to classical solvers while enabling a unified, end-to-end pipeline across neural and traditional surface representations. Our source code and project page: https://welschinger.github.io/Learning-to-Solve-PDEs-on-Neural-Shape-Representations/.

</details>


### [433] [When the Same Coefficients Reach Different Places: Asymmetric Realizability in Transplanting Tokenizers across Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.00065)
*Xiaoze Liu,Weichen Yu,Matt Fredrikson,Xiaoqian Wang,Jing Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现跨词汇表模型组合中的tokenizer移植存在"非对称可实现性"几何结构漏洞：同一系数向量在捐赠者与基础模型的锚定跨度中会抵达不同集合。通过构造"破坏性令牌"（单一系数向量在捐赠者锚定跨度中统计惰性，但在基础模型中产生高显著性重建），可在65组捐赠者-基础模型对中实现攻击，且标准LoRA微调和频谱滤波均无法有效防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在开放权重模型的组合供应链中，跨词汇表模型组合（如tokenizer移植）存在潜在的安全漏洞，需要系统性地分析并揭示其几何结构特性。

Method: 基于OMP（正交匹配追踪）算法，在65组捐赠者-基础模型对上构建破坏性令牌；通过CLP、WECHSEL和FOCUS三种跨算子进行交叉验证；训练后通过权重合并验证方向保持性；使用标准LoRA微调和频谱滤波测试防御有效性。

Result: 同一Gemma-2-2B捐赠者检查点可对来自5个模型家族的13个不同下游基础模型成功构建破坏性令牌；破坏性方向在权重合并后保持不变；LoRA微调仅在训练分布匹配的提示上抑制破坏者，不足以完全防御；频谱滤波无法检测该非对称性漏洞。

Conclusion: 揭示了开放权重模型组合供应链中一种新型攻击面，现有防御措施（LoRA微调、频谱滤波）均不充分，需引起警惕。

Abstract: Tokenizer transplant in cross-vocabulary model composition reconstructs donor-only embedding rows as weighted combinations over shared lexical anchors and reuses those coefficients on the base. We identify a structural geometric property of this reconstruction: the same coefficient vector reaches different sets in the donor and base anchor spans, an \emph{asymmetric realizability} gap. Across 65 donor-base pairs under OMP, with cross-operator validation on CLP, WECHSEL, and FOCUS, we construct \textit{breaker tokens}: single coefficient vectors that remain statistically inert in the donor anchor span while producing a high-salience reconstruction in the base. The same Gemma-2-2B donor checkpoint admits this construction against 13 different downstream bases drawn from five model families. The planted direction passes weight-merging with a clean reference unchanged. In a deployer case study, standard LoRA fine-tuning suppresses the breaker primarily on prompts whose distribution matches the training corpus and is not a sufficient mitigation against this attack family in our setting. The tested spectral filters miss the asymmetry. We discuss potential misuse in the open-weight composition supply chain.

</details>


### [434] [Bridging the Semantic Gap for Categorical Data Clustering via Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01162)
*Zihua Yang,Xin Liao,Yiqun Zhang,Yiu-ming Cheung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BREVE框架，通过外部知识库为定性数据添加语义嵌入，结合独热编码保留原始特征，并利用自适应权重平衡两者，在8个基准数据集上平均ARI排名达1.3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有定性数据聚类依赖数据集内的共现统计来衡量属性值之间的相似性，但小样本场景下统计不可靠，且语义上下文未被充分利用。

Method: BREVE框架：从外部知识库为每个定性值提取密集语义嵌入进行扩展，同时附加轻量级独热编码保留原始身份，并通过聚类紧致度引导的自适应权重控制语义维度的贡献。

Result: 在8个基准数据集上，BREVE的平均ARI排名为1.3，超越了7个代表性对比方法。

Conclusion: 外部语义知识能有效弥补小样本下统计信息的不足，平衡的表示设计可避免原始信息被稀释，从而提升聚类性能。

Abstract: Qualitative data are widespread in domains such as healthcare, marketing, and bioinformatics, where clustering offers a fundamental tool for pattern discovery. A core difficulty of qualitative-data clustering lies in measuring similarity among attribute values that carry no inherent ordering or distance. To recover such relationships, existing studies typically rely on within-dataset co-occurrence statistics. This statistical route, however, becomes unreliable once the sample size is small, and the semantic context of each value is therefore left underexploited. Motivated by this limitation, this paper proposes BREVE (Balanced Representation via External Value Enrichment), a clustering framework that enriches each qualitative value with extra semantic dimensions drawn from an external knowledge base. That is, every unique value is expanded by a dense embedding that encodes its semantic content. To prevent the original value identity from being diluted by the added dimensions, a lightweight one-hot component is further appended. An adaptive weight, guided by cluster compactness, then determines how strongly the enrichment dimensions enter the final representation. With this design, experiments on eight benchmark datasets yield an average ARI rank of 1.3 against seven representative competitors.

</details>


### [435] [FedBiCross: Personalized One-Shot Federated Learning on Medical Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01901)
*Yuexuan Xia,Yinghao Zhang,Yalin Liu,Hong-Ning Dai,Yong Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedBiCross通过客户端聚类、双层跨簇优化和个性化蒸馏，解决了非独立同分布数据下无数据知识蒸馏单次联邦学习中预测冲突导致软标签信息量下降的问题，在四个医学图像数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无数据知识蒸馏的单次联邦学习方法在非独立同分布数据下，聚合所有客户端预测形成全局教师时，冲突的预测会在平均过程中相互稀释，产生信息量较少的软标签，削弱蒸馏效果。

Method: 提出FedBiCross框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 根据模型输出相似性对客户端聚类，形成一致的子集成；(2) 双层跨簇优化，学习自适应权重以选择性利用有益的跨簇知识，同时抑制负迁移；(3) 个性化蒸馏实现客户端特定适应。

Result: 在四个医学图像数据集上，FedBiCross在不同非独立同分布程度下均一致优于现有最先进基线方法。

Conclusion: FedBiCross通过聚类和自适应权重机制有效缓解了非独立同分布数据下的预测冲突问题，提升了单次联邦学习在医学图像任务中的性能。

Abstract: Data-free knowledge distillation-based one-shot federated learning (OSFL) trains a model in a single communication round without sharing raw data, making OSFL attractive for privacy-sensitive medical applications. However, existing methods aggregate predictions from all clients to form a global teacher. Under non-IID data, conflicting predictions dilute each other during averaging, yielding less informative soft labels that weaken distillation. We propose FedBiCross, a personalized OSFL framework with three stages: (1) clustering clients by model output similarity to form coherent sub-ensembles, (2) bi-level cross-cluster optimization that learns adaptive weights to selectively leverage beneficial cross-cluster knowledge while suppressing negative transfer, and (3) personalized distillation for client-specific adaptation. Experiments on four medical image datasets demonstrate that FedBiCross consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across different non-IID degrees.

</details>


### [436] [Horizon Activation Mapping for Neural Networks in Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02094)
*Krupakar Hans,V A Kandappan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Horizon Activation Mapping (HAM)，一种受grad-CAM启发的模型无关可视化可解释性技术，用于时间序列预测模型。HAM通过计算梯度范数平均值，研究不同子序列上的激活模式，支持因果和反因果模式，并引入比例线表示均匀分布。实验在ETTm2数据集上对多种模型（CycleNet、N-Linear、N-HITS、FEDformer、Pyraformer、SpaceTime、Multi-Resolution DDPM）进行验证，结果表明HAM可用于粒度模型选择、验证集选择和跨模型家族比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测神经网络的模型选择依赖误差指标和特定架构的可解释性方法，这些方法无法跨不同模型家族通用。需要一种与模型架构无关的可解释性技术来统一解释和比较各类时间序列预测模型。

Method: 受grad-CAM启发，提出Horizon Activation Mapping (HAM)。利用梯度范数平均值研究时间序列预测模型在预测视界上的子序列激活模式，引入因果模式和反因果模式计算梯度更新范数平均值，并定义比例线表示均匀分布。研究了批大小、早停、训练-验证-测试划分、架构选择、单变量预测和丢弃法等优化景观。

Result: 批大小差异引发的激活活动存在指数逼近潜力；NHITS的神经逼近定理和SpaceTime的指数自回归活动可归因于HAM图中的趋势；HAM可有效用于粒度模型选择、验证集选择和跨不同神经网络模型家族的比较。

Conclusion: HAM是一种有效的模型无关时间序列预测可视化可解释性技术，可用于不同架构族之间的细粒度模型选择与比较，弥补了传统误差指标和特定架构方法的不足。

Abstract: Neural networks for time series forecasting have relied on error metrics and architecture-specific interpretability approaches for model selection that don't apply across models of different families. To interpret forecasting models agnostic to the types of layers across state-of-the-art model families, we introduce Horizon Activation Mapping (HAM), a visual interpretability technique inspired by grad-CAM that uses gradient norm averages to study the horizon's subseries where grad-CAM studies attention maps over image data. We introduce causal and anti-causal modes to calculate gradient update norm averages across subseries at every timestep and lines of proportionality signifying uniform distributions of the norm averages. Optimization landscape studies with respect to changes in batch sizes, early stopping, train-val-test splits, architectural choices, univariate forecasting and dropouts are studied with respect to performances and subseries in HAM. Interestingly, batch size based differences in activities seem to indicate potential for existence of an exponential approximation across them per epoch relative to each other. Multivariate forecasting models including MLP-based CycleNet, N-Linear, N-HITS, self attention-based FEDformer, Pyraformer, SSM-based SpaceTime and diffusion-based Multi-Resolution DDPM over different horizon sizes trained over the ETTm2 dataset are used for HAM plots in this study. NHITS' neural approximation theorem and SpaceTime's exponential autoregressive activities have been attributed to trends in HAM plots over their training, validation and test sets. In general, HAM can be used for granular model selection, validation set choices and comparisons across different neural network model families.

</details>


### [437] [Bandit Algorithms for Deep Brain Stimulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12699)
*Arkaprava Gupta,Nicholas Carter,William Zellers,Prateek Ganguli,Benedikt Dietrich,Vibhor Krishna,Parasara Sridhar Duggirala,Samarjit Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于时间和阈值触发的剪枝多臂老虎机（T3P MAB）算法，用于自适应脑深部刺激（DBS），无需离线训练，在计算资源受限的微控制器上可在两分钟内收敛，有效抑制病理性β波段活动并降低刺激功耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统固定参数DBS无法适应动态变化的神经动力学，且能耗高、易产生副作用；现有强化学习方法依赖深度神经网络，需要离线训练且计算成本过高，不适合植入式硬件。

Method: 提出T3P MAB算法，联合调谐刺激频率和幅度，避免离线训练，具有可解释性以支持临床医生调整；基于基底节-丘脑计算模型进行验证，并在多种微控制器上实现并测量能耗。

Result: T3P比竞争MAB方法收敛更快，在抑制β波段活动和降低刺激功率方面优于深度强化学习基线；在两分钟内收敛，适合资源受限的植入式系统。

Conclusion: 轻量级基于老虎机的控制方法是实现个性化、节能DBS的实用路径。

Abstract: Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) is an effective treatment for Parkinson's disease, but conventional fixed-parameter stimulation can reduce battery life and cause side effects while failing to adapt to changing neural dynamics. Recent reinforcement learning approaches improve adaptability, yet most rely on deep neural networks that require offline training and are computationally too expensive for implantable hardware. This paper presents a resource-conscious adaptive DBS framework based on a Time- and Threshold-Triggered Pruned Multi-Armed Bandit (T3P MAB) algorithm. The proposed method jointly tunes stimulation frequency and amplitude, avoids prior training, and remains transparent enough to support clinician-guided adjustment. Using a computational basal ganglia-thalamic model, we show that T3P converges faster than competing MAB methods and outperforms deep-RL baselines in suppressing pathological beta-band activity while reducing stimulation power. We implemented it on different microcontrollers and report detailed energy measurements, showing convergence in under two minutes and suitability for resource-constrained implantable systems. These results support lightweight bandit-based control as a practical path toward personalized, energy-efficient DBS.

</details>


### [438] [Mechanism Shift During Post-training from Autoregressive to Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14758)
*Injin Kong,Hyoungjoon Lee,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对自回归模型进行扩散后训练并非表面上的生成方式改变，而是内部计算机制的深度重组：在局部因果任务上保留原有回路，在全局任务上遗弃继承路径并将计算前移至浅层；语义上从尖锐局部专门化转向分布式整合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究后训练扩散模型是否真正获得了新的计算机制，还是仅仅以非自回归形式重新表达了自回归计算。

Method: 对自回归模型及其从相同骨干网络后训练得到的掩码扩散模型进行对比电路分析，从结构和语义两个维度揭示计算重组的模式。

Result: 结构上，重组具有任务依赖性：局部因果任务保留自回归回路，全局任务则放弃继承路径并将计算前移至浅层。语义上，重组具有一致性：从尖锐的局部专门化转变为分布式整合。

Conclusion: 扩散后训练并非表面上的生成过程改变，而是内部计算的深度重组，其重组深度取决于任务类型。

Abstract: Post-training pretrained autoregressive models (ARMs) into masked diffusion models (MDMs) has emerged as a cost-effective way to overcome the limitations of sequential generation. Yet it remains unclear whether post-trained MDMs acquire genuinely new computational mechanisms or merely re-express autoregressive computation in a non-autoregressive form. Through a comparative circuit analysis of ARMs and their MDM counterparts post-trained from the same backbones, we uncover two complementary axes of reorganization. Structurally, the shift is task-dependent: MDMs preserve autoregressive circuitry on locally causal tasks but abandon inherited pathways and front-load computation into early layers on global tasks. Semantically, the shift is consistent across regimes: sharp, localized specialization in ARMs gives way to distributed integration in MDMs. Together, these findings show that diffusion post-training is not a surface-level change in the generation procedure but a reorganization of internal computation whose depth depends on the task.

</details>


### [439] [Adaptive Exponential Integration for Stable Gaussian Mixture Black-Box Variational Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14855)
*Baojun Che,Yifan Chen,Daniel Zhengyu Huang,Xinying Mao,Weijie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合仿射不变预条件、指数积分器和自适应时间步长的黑箱变分推断框架，用于高斯混合族，在保证稳定性的同时实现高效优化，并在高斯后验下证明了指数收敛性和几乎必然收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准数值优化方法在使用高斯混合族进行黑箱变分推断时，常面临不稳定和低效问题，亟需一种既稳定又高效的优化框架。

Method: 该框架包含三个核心组件：(1)基于自然梯度公式的仿射不变预条件，(2)无条件保持协方差矩阵正定性的指数积分器，(3)自适应时间步长机制以兼顾稳定性和不同优化阶段（预热与收敛）的需求。

Result: 在噪声-free设定下证明了高斯后验的指数收敛性，在蒙特卡洛估计下证明了几乎必然收敛性；在多模态分布、Neal多尺度漏斗及基于PDE的Darcy流贝叶斯反问题的数值实验中验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 所提方法与流形优化和镜像下降有自然联系，自适应时间步长被严格证明为必要，整体框架实现了稳定高效的BBVI优化。

Abstract: Black-box variational inference (BBVI) with Gaussian mixture families offers a flexible approach for approximating complex posterior distributions without requiring gradients of the target density. However, standard numerical optimization methods often suffer from instability and inefficiency. We develop a stable and efficient framework that combines three key components: (1) affine-invariant preconditioning via natural gradient formulations, (2) an exponential integrator that unconditionally preserves the positive definiteness of covariance matrices, and (3) adaptive time stepping to ensure stability and to accommodate distinct warm-up and convergence phases. The proposed approach has natural connections to manifold optimization and mirror descent. For Gaussian posteriors, we prove exponential convergence in the noise-free setting and almost-sure convergence under Monte Carlo estimation, rigorously justifying the necessity of adaptive time stepping. Numerical experiments on multimodal distributions, Neal's multiscale funnel, and a PDE-based Bayesian inverse problem for Darcy flow demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [440] [Riemannian AmbientFlow: Towards Simultaneous Manifold Learning and Generative Modeling from Corrupted Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18728)
*Willem Diepeveen,Oscar Leong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Riemannian AmbientFlow框架，能够从带噪声或线性退化的观测数据中同时学习概率生成模型和底层非线性数据流形，并提供了理论保证和实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多科学和成像应用中，清洁样本不可用，只能观测到噪声或线性退化的测量数据，且需要提取数据中潜在的流形几何结构以进行下游分析。

Method: 基于AmbientFlow的变分推断框架，引入由归一化流诱导的数据驱动黎曼几何，通过拉回度量（pullback metrics）和黎曼自编码器提取流形结构，并结合几何正则化与测量条件。

Result: 理论保证：在适当的几何正则化和测量条件下，学习到的模型能以可控误差恢复底层数据分布，并获得光滑的bi-Lipschitz流形参数化；该光滑解码器可作为逆问题的生成先验，具有恢复保证。实验在低维合成流形和MNIST上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: Riemannian AmbientFlow能够从退化观测中同时学习生成模型和数据流形，兼具理论保障与实证效果，为逆问题提供有原则的生成先验。

Abstract: Modern generative modeling methods have demonstrated strong performance in learning complex data distributions from clean samples. In many scientific and imaging applications, however, clean samples are unavailable, and only noisy or linearly corrupted measurements can be observed. Moreover, latent structures, such as manifold geometries, present in the data are important to extract for further downstream scientific analysis. In this work, we introduce Riemannian AmbientFlow, a framework for simultaneously learning a probabilistic generative model and the underlying, nonlinear data manifold directly from corrupted observations. Building on the variational inference framework of AmbientFlow, our approach incorporates data-driven Riemannian geometry induced by normalizing flows, enabling the extraction of manifold structure through pullback metrics and Riemannian Autoencoders. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that, under appropriate geometric regularization and measurement conditions, the learned model recovers the underlying data distribution up to a controllable error and yields a smooth, bi-Lipschitz manifold parametrization. We further show that the resulting smooth decoder can serve as a principled generative prior for inverse problems with recovery guarantees. We empirically validate our approach on low-dimensional synthetic manifolds and on MNIST.

</details>


### [441] [HE-SNR: Uncovering Latent Logic via Entropy for Guiding Mid-Training on SWE-bench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.20255)
*Yueyang Wang,Jiawei Fu,Baolong Bi,Xili Wang,Xiaoqing Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对SWE-bench基准下大语言模型在软件工程任务中缺乏有效中间训练指导指标的问题，提出了基于熵压缩假设的新指标HE-SNR，并通过严格的数据过滤策略进行验证，实验覆盖高达560B参数的模型和32K/128K上下文窗口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指标如困惑度(PPL)受"长上下文税"影响，与下游SWE性能相关性弱，缺乏能够有效指导中间训练的指标来优化大语言模型在复杂软件工程领域的潜能。

Method: 提出熵压缩假设，将智能重新定义为将不确定性结构化为低阶熵压缩状态（"合理犹豫"）的能力；基于细粒度熵分析，提出新指标HE-SNR（高熵信噪比），并引入严格的数据过滤策略。

Result: 在高达560B参数的模型上，跨越32K/128K不同上下文窗口进行验证，证明了HE-SNR指标的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作为优化大语言模型在复杂工程领域的潜在能力提供了理论基础和实践工具，弥补了中间训练阶段缺乏有效指标的空白。

Abstract: SWE-bench has emerged as the premier benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models on complex software engineering tasks. While these capabilities are fundamentally acquired during the mid-training phase and subsequently elicited during Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), there remains a critical deficit in metrics capable of guiding mid-training effectively. Standard metrics such as Perplexity (PPL) are compromised by the "Long-Context Tax" and exhibit weak correlation with downstream SWE performance. In this paper, we bridge this gap by first introducing a rigorous data filtering strategy. Crucially, we propose the Entropy Compression Hypothesis, redefining intelligence not by scalar Top-1 compression, but by the capacity to structure uncertainty into Entropy-Compressed States of low orders ("reasonable hesitation"). Grounded in this fine-grained entropy analysis, we formulate a novel metric, HE-SNR (High-Entropy Signal-to-Noise Ratio). We validate our approach on models with up to 560B parameters across different context windows (32K/128K). This work provides both the theoretical foundation and practical tools for optimizing the latent potential of LLMs in complex engineering domains.

</details>


### [442] [Representation Unlearning: Forgetting through Information Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21564)
*Antonio Almudévar,Alfonso Ortega*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出表示遗忘（Representation Unlearning）框架，通过在模型表示空间而非参数空间进行遗忘操作，利用信息瓶颈原理最大化保留数据的信息量并抑制遗忘数据的信息，在多个基准上优于传统参数级方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法通常修改模型参数，存在不稳定、计算成本高且受限于局部近似的问题，需要更高效可靠的遗忘方案以满足隐私法规和鲁棒性需求。

Method: 在模型的表示空间学习一个变换，施加信息瓶颈：最大化与保留数据的互信息，同时抑制与遗忘数据的互信息；推导变分代理使目标可解，并设计两种实例化方案（同时有保留/遗忘数据、仅零样本遗忘数据）。

Result: 在多个基准实验上，表示遗忘方法在遗忘可靠性、效用保持和计算效率方面均优于基于参数修改的基线方法。

Conclusion: 表示遗忘是一种更稳定、高效且可靠的遗忘范式，通过操作表示空间而非参数空间，有效解决了现有方法的局限性。

Abstract: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of specific training data from a model, a need driven by privacy regulations and robustness concerns. Existing approaches typically modify model parameters, but such updates can be unstable, computationally costly, and limited by local approximations. We introduce Representation Unlearning, a framework that performs unlearning directly in the model's representation space. Instead of modifying model parameters, we learn a transformation over representations that imposes an information bottleneck: maximizing mutual information with retained data while suppressing information about data to be forgotten. We derive variational surrogates that make this objective tractable and show how they can be instantiated in two practical regimes: when both retain and forget data are available, and in a zero-shot setting where only forget data can be accessed. Experiments across several benchmarks demonstrate that Representation Unlearning achieves more reliable forgetting, better utility retention, and greater computational efficiency than parameter-centric baselines.

</details>


### [443] [Bridging Functional and Representational Similarity via Usable Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21568)
*Antonio Almudévar,Alfonso Ortega*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一框架，通过“可用信息”视角量化表示之间的相似性，建立了功能相似性与条件互信息的形式化联系，揭示了拼接方法的固有不对称性，发现重建度量和CKA/RSA等工具在特定约束下可作为可用信息的估计量，并证明了表示相似性是功能相似性的充分非必要条件，通过任务粒度层次统一了这些概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前表示相似性度量方法众多（如CKA、RSA、拼接等），但缺乏统一的理论框架来理解它们之间的关系和局限性。作者旨在通过可用信息这一核心概念，建立不同相似性度量之间的形式化联系。

Method: 通过信息论视角，将拼接性能与条件互信息建立形式化联系；分析拼接的非对称性并提出双向分析必要性；证明重建度量和CKA/RSA等工具在特定约束下是可用信息的估计量；提出任务粒度层次来统一表示相似性与功能相似性。

Result: 建立了拼接与条件互信息的形式化联系；揭示了拼接方法的固有不对称性；发现表示相似性依赖于预测族容量；证明了表示相似性是功能相似性的充分非必要条件；通过任务粒度层次统一了这些概念。

Conclusion: 表示相似性是功能相似性的极限情况（输入重建时的最大粒度），相似性度量应结合任务粒度和观测器容量进行选择，功能比较需要双向分析而非单向映射。

Abstract: We present a unified framework for quantifying the similarity between representations through the lens of \textit{usable} information, offering a rigorous theoretical and empirical synthesis across three key dimensions. First, addressing functional similarity, we establish a formal link between stitching performance and conditional mutual information. We further reveal that stitching is inherently asymmetric, demonstrating that robust functional comparison necessitates a bidirectional analysis rather than a unidirectional mapping. Second, concerning representational similarity, we find that reconstruction-based metrics and standard tools (e.g., CKA, RSA) act as estimators of usable information under specific constraints. Crucially, we show that similarity is relative to the capacity of the predictive family: representations that appear distinct to a rigid observer may be identical to a more expressive one. Third, we demonstrate that representational similarity is sufficient but not necessary for functional similarity. We unify these concepts through a task-granularity hierarchy: similarity on a complex task guarantees similarity on any coarser derivative, establishing representational similarity as the limit of maximum granularity: input reconstruction.

</details>


### [444] [Server-Proximal Aggregation for Federated Domain-Incremental Learning under Partial Participation: Task-Uniform Convergence and Backward Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22274)
*Longtao Xu,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPECIAL算法，通过在FedAvg中加入服务器端近端项（锚点）来解决联邦域增量学习（FDIL）中的后向知识迁移与收敛率问题。该方法无需记忆缓冲区、合成数据或任务特定头，在保持通信和模型大小不变的前提下，提供了BKT保障和首个部分参与FDIL的非凸收敛率O((E/NT)^(1/2))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实联邦系统面临输入分布漂移且隐私规则禁止原始数据共享，但现有FDIL方法缺乏后向知识迁移（BKT）的理论保证，以及部分参与下跨所有任务序列的收敛率分析。

Method: 提出SPECIAL算法：在标准FedAvg基础上增加服务器端近端项（锚点），每轮服务器将均匀采样的参与客户端的更新向上一轮全局模型轻量拉近，从而抑制累积漂移，无需记忆缓冲区、合成数据或任务特定头。

Result: 理论证明SPECIAL：(i) BKT界将先前任务损失的增加控制在随轮数、本地epoch和参与客户端数增加而减小的漂移项内；(ii) 首个部分参与FDIL的非凸收敛率O((E/NT)^(1/2))，与单任务FedAvg匹配，并明确分离优化方差与任务间漂移。实验验证了有效性。

Conclusion: SPECIAL通过简洁的服务器端锚点机制，在无额外存储和通信开销下，同时实现了FDIL的BKT保障与高效收敛，填补了该领域的重要理论空白。

Abstract: Real-world federated systems seldom operate on static data: input distributions drift while privacy rules forbid raw-data sharing. We study this setting as Federated Domain-Incremental Learning (FDIL), where (i) clients are heterogeneous, (ii) tasks arrive sequentially with shifting domains, yet (iii) the label space remains fixed. Two theoretical pillars remain missing for FDIL under realistic deployment: a guarantee of backward knowledge transfer (BKT) and a convergence rate that holds across the sequence of all tasks with partial participation. We introduce SPECIAL (Server-Proximal Efficient Continual Aggregation for Learning), a simple, memory-free FDIL algorithm that adds a single server-side ``anchor'' to vanilla FedAvg: in each round, the server nudges the uniformly sampled participated clients update toward the previous global model with a lightweight proximal term. This anchor curbs cumulative drift without replay buffers, synthetic data, or task-specific heads, keeping communication and model size unchanged. Our theory shows that SPECIAL (i) preserves earlier tasks: a BKT bound caps any increase in prior-task loss by a drift-controlled term that shrinks with more rounds, local epochs, and participating clients; and (ii) learns efficiently across all tasks: the first communication-efficient non-convex convergence rate for FDIL with partial participation, O((E/NT)^(1/2)), with E local epochs, T communication rounds, and N participated clients per round, matching single-task FedAvg while explicitly separating optimization variance from inter-task drift. Experimental results further demonstrate the effectiveness of SPECIAL.

</details>


### [445] [Pushing the Limits of Block Rotations in Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22347)
*Sai Sanjeet,Ian Colbert,Pablo Monteagudo-Lago,Giuseppe Franco,Yaman Umuroglu,Nicholas J. Fraser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析了分块Hadamard旋转对离群值抑制的非渐近性质，发现其效果受输入向量几何结构限制，并提出PeRQ框架——通过排列预归一化实现块间ℓ1范数均衡，在Transformer中利用置换等性价比区域将排列合并入权重，实验表明在Llama3 1B的INT4量化（块大小16）中恢复全向量旋转困惑度达90%（无排列仅46%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分块PTQ方法采用块旋转扩散离群值，但块结构对离群值抑制的影响缺乏理论理解，尤其缺乏非渐近分析。

Method: ①理论分析：证明最坏情况下后旋转离群值大小由前旋转ℓ1范数的块间分布决定；②算法设计：提出贪心质量扩散算法校准排列，均衡期望块间ℓ1范数；③工程优化：识别Transformer中置换等性价比区域，将排列合并入权重以避免推理开销。

Result: PeRQ在所有块大小上一致提升精度，Llama3 1B INT4量化（块大小16）恢复90%全向量旋转困惑度，无排列仅46%。

Conclusion: 块旋转对离群值的抑制受限于输入几何结构，通过排列预均衡块间ℓ1范数可显著提升量化效果，且不增加推理开销。

Abstract: Recent post-training quantization (PTQ) methods have adopted block rotations to diffuse outliers prior to rounding. While this reduces the overhead of online full-vector rotations, the effect of block structure on outlier suppression remains poorly understood. To fill this gap, we present the first systematic, non-asymptotic analysis of outlier suppression for block Hadamard rotations. Our analysis reveals that outlier suppression is fundamentally limited by the geometry of the input vector. In particular, in the deterministic worst case, post-rotation outliers are minimized when the pre-rotation $\ell_1$ norm mass is evenly distributed across blocks. Guided by these insights, we introduce PeRQ (Permute, Rotate, then Quantize), a PTQ framework that redistributes activation mass via permutations prior to rotation. We propose a greedy mass diffusion algorithm to calibrate permutations by equalizing the expected blockwise $\ell_1$ norms. To avoid adding inference overhead, we identify permutation-equivariant regions in transformer architectures to merge these permutations into model weights before deployment. Experiments show that PeRQ consistently improves accuracy across all block sizes, recovering up to 90% of the full-vector rotation perplexity when quantizing Llama3 1B to INT4 with block size 16, compared to 46% without permutations.

</details>


### [446] [Learn from A Rationalist: Distilling Intermediate Interpretable Rationales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22531)
*Jiayi Dai,Randy Goebel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出REKD方法，通过知识蒸馏让能力较弱的学生模型从教师模型学到的解释性特征（rationales）和预测结果中提升自身性能，从而改善基于选择-预测架构的可解释框架在弱骨干网络下的预测表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在高风险领域的广泛应用催生了对可解释性的需求。现有的理性提取（RE）框架采用选择-预测架构，但当底层神经网络能力不足时（如小型学生网络），搜索最优特征子集的计算挑战极大，导致预测性能下降。

Method: 提出REKD（Rationale Extraction with Knowledge Distillation），在标准RE优化目标之外，让学生RE模型同时从教师模型的rationales（特征选择）和最终预测结果中进行知识蒸馏学习。该方法与模型结构无关，可集成任意黑盒神经网络作为骨干模型。

Result: 在IMDB电影评论、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上，使用BERT和ViT多种变体进行实验，结果表明REKD显著提升了学生RE模型的预测性能。

Conclusion: REKD通过引入知识蒸馏对RE框架进行结构性的改进，使能力不足的学生模型能从教师模型的可解释且可验证的知识中有效学习，验证了该方法的跨模态（语言和视觉）通用性和有效性。

Abstract: Because of the pervasive use of deep neural networks (DNNs), especially in high-stakes domains, the interpretability of DNNs has received increased attention. The general idea of rationale extraction (RE) is to provide an interpretable-by-design framework for DNNs via a select-predict architecture where two neural networks learn jointly to perform feature selection and prediction, respectively. Given only the remote supervision from the final task prediction, the process of learning to select subsets of features (or rationales) requires searching in the space of all possible feature combinations, which is computationally challenging and even harder when the base neural networks are not sufficiently capable. To improve the predictive performance of RE models that are based on less capable or smaller neural networks (i.e., the students), we propose REKD (Rationale Extraction with Knowledge Distillation) where a student RE model learns from the rationales and predictions of a teacher (i.e., a rationalist) in addition to the student's own RE optimization. This structural adjustment to RE aligns well with how humans could learn effectively from interpretable and verifiable knowledge. Because of the neural-model agnostic nature of the method, any black-box neural network could be integrated as a backbone model. To demonstrate the viability of REKD, we conduct experiments with multiple variants of BERT and vision transformer (ViT) models. Our experiments across language and vision classification datasets (i.e., IMDB movie reviews, CIFAR 10 and CIFAR 100) show that REKD significantly improves the predictive performance of the student RE models.

</details>


### [447] [Unsupervised Hierarchical Skill Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23156)
*Damion Harvey,Geraud Nangue Tasse,Benjamin Rosman,Branden Ingram,Steven James*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无监督的技能分割与层次结构发现方法，利用基于语法的技术从未标记的轨迹中提取技能并构建层次结构，在Craftax和完整版Minecraft等基于像素的高维环境中验证了其有效性，并在下游强化学习任务中展现了加速和稳定学习的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的技能分割或选项学习方法大多依赖动作标签、奖励信号或人工标注，限制了方法的通用性和可扩展性。为解决这一问题，作者希望提出一种完全无监督的方法，仅从无标签轨迹中自动发现可复用的技能及其层次结构。

Method: 采用基于语法的方法对无标签轨迹进行分割，从中提取技能并诱导出层次结构。该层次结构能够同时捕获底层行为及其组合形成的高层技能。

Result: 在Craftax和完整版Minecraft等高维像素环境中，使用技能分割、技能复用和层次结构质量等指标进行评估，所提方法一致地产生了比现有基线更具结构性和语义意义的层次结构。此外，作为概念验证，这些发现的层次结构能够加速并稳定下游强化学习任务的学习过程。

Conclusion: 基于语法的无监督方法可以有效从无标签轨迹中发现结构化和语义上有意义的技能层次，并且这些自动发现的层次结构对下游强化学习任务具有正向促进作用。

Abstract: We consider the problem of unsupervised skill segmentation and hierarchical structure discovery in reinforcement learning. While recent approaches have sought to segment trajectories into reusable skills or options, most rely on action labels, rewards, or handcrafted annotations, limiting their applicability. We propose a method that segments unlabelled trajectories into skills and induces a hierarchical structure over them using a grammar-based approach. The resulting hierarchy captures both low-level behaviours and their composition into higher-level skills. We evaluate our approach in high-dimensional, pixel-based environments, including Craftax and the full, unmodified version of Minecraft. Using metrics for skill segmentation, reuse, and hierarchy quality, we find that our method consistently produces more structured and semantically meaningful hierarchies than existing baselines. Furthermore, as a proof of concept, we demonstrate that these discovered hierarchies accelerate and stabilise learning on downstream reinforcement learning tasks.

</details>


### [448] [Good SFT Optimizes for SFT, Better SFT Prepares for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01058)
*Dylan Zhang,Yufeng Xu,Haojin Wang,Qingzhi Chen,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PEAR是一种通过重要性采样重新加权SFT损失的方法，用于纠正SFT与RL阶段之间的数据分布不匹配问题，从而提升LLM后训练的整体性能，在数学推理任务上最高提升14.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前SFT-RL两阶段训练中，SFT阶段仅独立优化自身性能，未考虑后续RL阶段的分布差异，导致强SFT检查点经RL后可能不如弱SFT检查点。作者旨在解决这一分布不匹配问题。

Method: 提出PEAR算法，利用重要性采样对SFT损失进行重新加权，包含token级、block级和sequence级三种变体，在离线SFT数据上收集概率后几乎不增加额外训练开销。

Result: 在可控推理游戏和数学推理任务上的实验表明，PEAR持续优于标准SFT，在AIME2025上pass@8指标最高提升14.6%。

Conclusion: PEAR是一种有效的后训练方法，通过将下游RL纳入SFT的设计与评估，实现更全面的LLM后训练，而非将SFT孤立优化。

Abstract: Post-training of reasoning LLMs is a holistic process that typically consists of an offline SFT stage followed by an online reinforcement learning (RL) stage. However, SFT is often optimized in isolation to maximize SFT performance alone.
  We show that, after identical RL training, models initialized from stronger SFT checkpoints can significantly underperform those initialized from weaker ones. We attribute this to a mismatch typical in current SFT-RL pipelines: the distribution that generates the offline SFT data can differ substantially from the policy optimized during online RL, which learns from its own rollouts.
  We propose PEAR (Policy Evaluation-inspired Algorithm for Offline Learning Loss Re-weighting), an SFT-stage method that corrects this mismatch and better prepares the model for RL. PEAR uses importance sampling to reweight the SFT loss, with three variants operating at the token, block, and sequence levels. It can be used to augment standard SFT objectives and incurs little additional training overhead once probabilities for the offline data are collected.
  We conduct controlled experiments on verifiable reasoning games and mathematical reasoning tasks on Qwen 2.5 and 3 and DeepSeek-distilled models. PEAR consistently improves post-RL performance over canonical SFT, with pass at 8 gains up to a 14.6 percent on AIME2025. Our results suggest that PEAR is an effective step toward more holistic LLM post-training by designing and evaluating SFT with downstream RL in mind rather than in isolation.

</details>


### [449] [How Far Ahead Do LLMs Plan? Uncovering the Latent Horizon in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02103)
*Liyan Xu,Mo Yu,Fandong Meng,Jie Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过提出的Tele-Lens探测方法研究LLM在CoT推理中的潜在规划能力，发现LLM主要执行近视的增量转换而非精确的全局规划，并基于此提出利用稀疏关键位置增强CoT不确定性估计，以及实现CoT绕行的自动识别而不影响性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT推理已成为LLM多步推理的核心机制，但近期证据显示：隐藏状态在CoT完全展开前就已编码未来推理，而显式步骤对需要组合计算的任务仍至关重要。为了深入理解LLM内部状态与其外显推理轨迹之间的关系，作者研究了LLM的潜在规划能力。

Method: 提出了Tele-Lens探测方法，应用于不同任务领域的隐藏状态，通过分析LLM在推理过程中的潜在规划强度来揭示其推理特性。

Result: 实证结果表明LLM表现出近视的视野，主要进行增量转换而缺乏精确的全局规划；验证了稀疏的关键位置集合可以有效表示整个推理路径的不确定性；证明了可以在不影响性能的情况下自动识别CoT绕行。

Conclusion: LLM在CoT推理中不具备强全局规划能力，而是近视的增量推理；基于此特性可以利用稀疏关键位置进行不确定性估计，并实现CoT绕行的自动识别。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has become a central mechanism for eliciting multi-step reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet recent evidence presents a tension: hidden states appear to already encode future reasoning before CoT fully unfolds, while explicit steps still remain crucial for tasks requiring compositional computation. To deepen the understanding between LLM's internal states and its verbalized reasoning trajectories, we investigate the latent planning strength of LLMs, through our probing method, Tele-Lens, applying to hidden states across diverse task domains. Our empirical results indicate that LLMs exhibit a myopic horizon, primarily conducting incremental transitions without precise global planning. Leveraging this characteristic, we propose a hypothesis on enhancing uncertainty estimation of CoT, which we validate that a sparse set of pivot positions can effectively represent the uncertainty of the entire path. We further underscore the significance of exploiting CoT dynamics, and demonstrate that automatic recognition of CoT bypass can be achieved without performance degradation. Our code, data and models are released at https://github.com/lxucs/tele-lens.

</details>


### [450] [Achieving Linear Speedup for Composite Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03357)
*Kun Huang,Shi Pu,Karl Henrik Johansson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedNMap，一种基于法向映射的复合联邦学习方法，通过法向映射更新方案处理非光滑正则项，并结合局部修正策略缓解数据异质性。在标准假设下，该方法在非凸损失函数（无论是否满足Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件）上实现了关于客户端数量和本地更新次数的线性加速，这是首个在非凸复合联邦学习中建立线性加速的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习方法在处理复合目标（光滑损失+非光滑正则项）时缺乏线性加速保证，尤其是在非凸场景下。作者旨在设计首个实现线性加速的非凸复合联邦学习算法。

Method: FedNMap采用法向映射（normal map）更新机制处理非光滑项，并结合局部修正策略（local correction strategy）来减轻客户端数据异质性的影响。

Result: 在标准假设下（光滑局部损失、正则项弱凸性、有界随机梯度方差），FedNMap在非凸损失上实现了关于客户端数量和本地更新次数的线性加速，无论是否满足Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件。数值实验验证了理论发现。

Conclusion: FedNMap是首个在非凸复合联邦学习中建立线性加速的算法，为处理带非光滑正则项的联邦学习问题提供了理论保证和实用方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes FedNMap, a normal map-based method for composite federated learning, where the objective consists of a smooth loss and a possibly nonsmooth regularizer. FedNMap leverages a normal map-based update scheme to handle the nonsmooth term and incorporates a local correction strategy to mitigate the impact of data heterogeneity across clients. Under standard assumptions, including smooth local losses, weak convexity of the regularizer, and bounded stochastic gradient variance, FedNMap achieves linear speedup with respect to both the number of clients and the number of local updates for nonconvex losses, both with and without the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first algorithm establishing linear speedup for nonconvex composite federated learning. Numerical experiments corroborate our theoretical findings and demonstrate the linear speedup of FedNMap.

</details>


### [451] [Optimization and Generation in Aerodynamics Inverse Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03582)
*Huaguan Chen,Ning Lin,Luxi Chen,Jiacheng Cen,Rui Zhang,Wenbing Huang,Chongxuan Li,Hao Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种概率框架，将视觉特征保持与空气动力学优化统一为目标函数，通过重加权学习到的视觉设计分布来实现既降阻又保形的外观优化与生成。实验表明，该方法在车辆和飞行器上分别实现了5.8%和28.8%的阻力/升阻比改善，同时保持视觉一致性，并通过风洞实验验证了结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CFD优化精度高但速度慢，现有学习方法主要关注性能而忽视视觉特征的保持，缺乏一个能将优化、生成与视觉一致性统一起来的目标。

Method: 将视觉保持与气动改进形式化为一个概率目标：学习一个与参考形状或视图一致的视觉设计分布，然后用空气动力学代价对其进行重加权。优化阶段从初始几何出发迭代至低成本高概率的设计；生成阶段从同一视图引导采样低成本的3D候选。

Result: 视觉保持优化使车辆阻力降低5.8%，飞行器升阻比目标改进28.8%；视图引导生成使车辆阻力降低3.0%，飞行器升阻比目标改进68.6%，且均保持视觉一致性。3D打印风洞实验提供了独立验证。

Conclusion: 该工作为视觉特征保持的空气动力学优化与早期3D设计探索提供了概率基础与实用路径。

Abstract: Aerodynamic inverse design can improve vehicle and aircraft efficiency, but practical design rarely seeks performance alone: vehicle refinement must reduce drag while preserving visual features linked to design language, brand recognition and user perception. Traditional CFD-driven optimization is accurate but slow for broad exploration, and current learning-based methods are still largely performance-driven and lack a coherent target linking optimization, generation and visual consistency. Here we formulate visual preservation and aerodynamic improvement as one probability target. Designs consistent with a reference shape or view define a learned visual design distribution, which is reweighted by aerodynamic cost. Optimization then refines an initial geometry toward a low-cost, high-probability design, whereas guided generation samples lower-cost 3D candidates from the same input view. OpenFOAM evaluation shows that visual-feature-preserving optimization reduces vehicle drag by 5.8\% relative to the initial vehicle and reduces the best valid aircraft drag-to-lift objective by 28.8\% relative to the initial aircraft while preserving input visual features. For view-based generation, guidance reduces vehicle drag by 3.0\% and the aircraft drag-to-lift objective by 68.6\% relative to direct generation from the same view, while maintaining visual consistency. Wind-tunnel tests with 3D-printed vehicle prototypes provide an independent wake-level check, and controlled analyses explain the distributional mechanisms behind these results. This work provides a probabilistic foundation and practical route for visual-feature-preserving aerodynamic refinement and early-stage 3D design exploration.

</details>


### [452] [Selecting Hyperparameters for Tree-Boosting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05786)
*Floris Jan Koster,Fabio Sigrist*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了多种树提升超参数优化方法（随机网格搜索、TPE、GP-BO、Hyperband、SMAC和确定性全网格搜索）在59个回归和分类数据集上的表现，发现SMAC方法明显优于其他方法。同时揭示了超参数调优需要超过100次试验、默认参数导致模型不准确、所有超参数均显著影响精度、以及回归任务中早停法优于将迭代次数纳入搜索空间等关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树提升方法的超参数对其样本外精度至关重要，但目前缺乏对不同超参数优化方法的系统比较研究，因此需要全面评估各种超参数优化策略的有效性。

Method: 在59个回归和分类数据集上，实证比较了随机网格搜索、TPE、GP-BO、Hyperband、SMAC和确定性全网格搜索六种超参数优化方法在树提升模型中的表现。

Result: SMAC方法在所有被考虑的方法中表现最优；需要超过100次试验才能实现准确调优；使用默认超参数会导致模型精度严重下降；所有超参数均对树提升精度有实质性影响；在回归任务中，使用早停法选择迭代次数比将其纳入搜索空间更准确。

Conclusion: SMAC是树提升超参数优化的首选方法，同时研究结果强调了充分调优（而非使用默认值）的重要性，并指出了早停法在回归任务中的优势。

Abstract: Tree-boosting is a widely used machine learning technique for tabular data. However, its out-of-sample accuracy is critically dependent on multiple hyperparameters. In this article, we empirically compare several popular methods for hyperparameter optimization for tree-boosting including random grid search, the tree-structured Parzen estimator (TPE), Gaussian-process-based Bayesian optimization (GP-BO), Hyperband, the sequential model-based algorithm configuration (SMAC) method, and deterministic full grid search using $59$ regression and classification data sets. We find that the SMAC method clearly outperforms all the other considered methods. We further observe that (i) a relatively large number of trials larger than $100$ is required for accurate tuning, (ii) using default values for hyperparameters yields very inaccurate models, (iii) all considered hyperparameters can have a material effect on the accuracy of tree-boosting, i.e., there is no small set of hyperparameters that is more important than others, and (iv) choosing the number of boosting iterations using early stopping yields more accurate results compared to including it in the search space for regression tasks.

</details>


### [453] [Discrete diffusion samplers and bridges: Off-policy algorithms and applications in latent spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05961)
*Arran Carter,Sanghyeok Choi,Kirill Tamogashev,Víctor Elvira,Esmeralda S. Whitammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离散空间中的扩散采样器，引入离策略训练技术、提出离散域的数据-能量薛定谔桥训练方法，并将其应用于图像生成模型的离散潜空间中的无数据后验采样，显著提升了离散采样器的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散扩散采样器未能充分利用连续空间中常用的离策略训练思想，且缺乏从任意两个分布之间桥接的能力，限制了其应用范围。

Method: (1) 将离策略训练技术引入离散扩散采样器； (2) 提出数据-能量薛定谔桥训练方法，将离散扩散采样器推广至任意两个分布之间的桥接任务； (3) 将所提方法应用于图像生成模型离散潜空间中的无数据后验采样。

Result: 离策略训练技术在已有和新提出的合成基准上均提升了离散采样器的性能；离散域的数据-能量薛定谔桥训练首次实现了离散空间中的分布桥接；所提方法成功应用于无数据后验采样任务。

Conclusion: 通过引入离策略训练和薛定谔桥推广，离散扩散采样器的性能得到显著提升，并拓展了在离散潜空间后验采样等实际任务中的应用潜力。

Abstract: Sampling from a distribution $p(x) \propto e^{-\mathcal{E}(x)}$ known up to a normalising constant is an important and challenging problem in statistics. Recent years have seen the rise of a new family of amortised sampling algorithms, commonly referred to as diffusion samplers, that enable fast and efficient sampling from an unnormalised density. Such algorithms have been widely studied for continuous-space sampling tasks; however, their application to problems in discrete space remains largely unexplored. Although some progress has been made in this area, discrete diffusion samplers do not take full advantage of ideas commonly used for continuous-space sampling. In this paper, we propose to bridge this gap by introducing off-policy training techniques for discrete diffusion samplers. We show that these techniques improve the performance of discrete samplers on both established and new synthetic benchmarks. Next, we generalise discrete diffusion samplers to the task of bridging between two arbitrary distributions, introducing data-to-energy Schrödinger bridge training for the discrete domain for the first time. Lastly, we showcase the application of the proposed diffusion samplers to data-free posterior sampling in the discrete latent spaces of image generative models.

</details>


### [454] [Rare Event Analysis of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06791)
*Jake McAllister Dorman,Edward Gillman,Dominic C. Rose,Jamie F. Mair,Juan P. Garrahan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个端到端框架，用于系统分析大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理过程中出现的罕见事件（rare events），涵盖了理论、高效生成策略、概率估计和误差分析，并展示了具体实例及扩展应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在部署时，由于使用规模巨大，开发阶段完全未被观察到的事件（即罕见事件）很可能在部署中变得显著，但这些事件本质上难以被观测到。现有方法缺乏系统性的分析框架，因此需要一种端到端的方法来识别、估计和分析这些罕见事件。

Method: 本文提出了一个端到端框架，包含四个核心组件：(1) 理论基础，(2) 高效生成策略（用于采样罕见事件），(3) 概率估计（对罕见事件的发生概率进行量化），(4) 误差分析（评估估计的可靠性）。

Result: 通过具体实例展示了该框架的有效性，并指出该框架可扩展至其他模型和上下文，验证了其通用性。

Conclusion: 该框架为系统性分析LLM中的罕见事件提供了完整的理论-实践路径，且概念和技术具有广泛的通用性，可应用于其他模型和场景。

Abstract: Being probabilistic models, during inference large language models (LLMs) display rare events: behaviour that is far from typical but highly significant. By definition all rare events are hard to see, but the enormous scale of LLM usage means that events completely unobserved during development are likely to become prominent in deployment. Here we present an end-to-end framework for the systematic analysis of rare events in LLMs. We provide a practical implementation spanning theory, efficient generation strategies, probability estimation and error analysis, which we illustrate with concrete examples. We outline extensions and applications to other models and contexts, highlighting the generality of the concepts and techniques presented here.

</details>


### [455] [Gradient Preconditioning for Efficient and Reliable Reward-Guided Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08646)
*Jisung Hwang,Minhyuk Sung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种梯度预处理方法，通过将奖励梯度投影到精心设计的白高斯噪声可行集上，使得单步生成模型在奖励引导生成时既高效又可靠，在FLUX上仅用30%的时间达到相当的Aesthetic Score。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时噪声优化虽能提升奖励引导生成效果，但容易导致奖励黑客行为（降低生成质量）且速度太慢，实际应用中不可用。

Method: 通过将奖励梯度投影到一个紧凑的谱集（具有分块范数约束的白高斯噪声可行集）上进行预处理，该投影为闭式解，复杂度为O(N log N)，与FFT相同。

Result: 在FLUX上使用四种奖励模型进行实验，该方法达到与最先进的基于正则化的方法相当的Aesthetic Score，但仅需其30%的墙钟时间。

Conclusion: 该梯度预处理方法能有效防止奖励黑客行为，同时大幅提升奖励引导生成的速度和效果。

Abstract: We propose a gradient preconditioning method that makes reward-guided generation with one-step generative models both efficient and reliable. Test-time noise optimization can unlock substantially better reward-guided generations from pretrained generative models, but it is prone to reward hacking that degrades quality and is often too slow for practical use. We precondition reward gradients by projecting them onto a carefully designed white Gaussian noise feasible set, a compact spectral set with blockwise norm constraints that tightly captures the statistics and spatial uncorrelatedness of white Gaussian noise. This preconditioning reshapes each gradient update into a noise-aligned direction, driving faster and more effective reward ascent while preventing reward hacking. The projection is closed-form and matches the $O(N \log N)$ complexity of FFT, adding negligible overhead in practice. In experiments on FLUX with four reward models, our approach reaches a comparable Aesthetic Score using only 30% of the wall-clock time required by the state-of-the-art regularization-based method.

</details>


### [456] [Computationally Efficient Replicable Learning of Parities and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09499)
*Moshe Noivirt,Jessica Sorrell,Eliad Tsfadia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了可复制PAC学习与差分隐私、统计查询模型之间的计算关系，提出了首个在任意分布上高效可复制学习的奇偶性算法，证明可复制学习在计算上严格强于SQ学习、接近差分隐私，并基于RP≠NP假设证明了可复制性转化为纯差分隐私需要样本复杂度的严格损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究可复制PAC学习与其他稳定性概念（差分隐私、统计查询模型）之间的计算关系，特别是可复制学习在计算能力上究竟更接近SQ学习还是差分隐私学习。此前已知统计上可复制学习与差分隐私等价且强于SQ学习，但计算上所有高效可复制学习算法局限于SQ可学习任务或受限分布。

Method: 提出了一个高效且可复制的新算法：给定一组向量，输出覆盖其中大部分向量的线性子空间。利用该算法构建了首个在任意分布上高效可复制的奇偶性（parities）实可学习算法。

Result: 1) 首次证明高效可复制学习在一般分布上严格扩展了SQ学习，能力更接近差分隐私学习；2) 假设RP≠NP，证明了将可复制性转化为纯差分隐私需要样本复杂度的严格损失。

Conclusion: 可复制学习在计算上强于SQ学习，且尽管存在可复制性与隐私之间的计算分离，但其计算能力与差分隐私学习更为接近。

Abstract: We study the computational relationship between replicability (Impagliazzo et al. [STOC `22], Ghazi et al. [NeurIPS `21]) and other stability notions. Specifically, we focus on replicable PAC learning and its connections to differential privacy (Dwork et al. [TCC 2006]) and to the statistical query (SQ) model (Kearns [JACM `98]). Statistically, it was known that differentially private learning and replicable learning are equivalent and strictly more powerful than SQ-learning. Yet, computationally, all previously known efficient (i.e., polynomial-time) replicable learning algorithms were confined to SQ-learnable tasks or restricted distributions, in contrast to differentially private learning.
  Our main contribution is the first computationally efficient replicable algorithm for realizable learning of parities over arbitrary distributions, a task that is known to be hard in the SQ-model, but possible under differential privacy. This result provides the first evidence that efficient replicable learning over general distributions strictly extends efficient SQ-learning, and is closer in power to efficient differentially private learning, despite computational separations between replicability and privacy. Additionally, we leverage our parity learner to prove that, assuming $RP \neq NP$, converting replicability to pure differential privacy requires a strict loss in sample complexity. Our main building block is a new, efficient, and replicable algorithm that, given a set of vectors, outputs a subspace of their linear span that covers most of them.

</details>


### [457] [Prioritize the Process, Not Just the Outcome: Rewarding Latent Thought Trajectories Improves Reasoning in Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10520)
*Jonathan Williams,Esin Tureci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RLTT框架，通过向Looped Language Model的完整潜推理轨迹分配奖励（而非仅最终潜状态），解决了标准强化学习方法（如GRPO）在循环语言模型中的信用分配不匹配问题。实验表明，在1.4B和2.6B参数规模下，RLTT在数学推理基准上相比GRPO分别提升+5.8%和+10.9%，且能迁移至非数学推理任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的强化学习目标（如GRPO）仅对最终潜状态分配奖励，与LoopLM内部多步潜推理的计算过程存在根本性不匹配，导致强化学习无法进一步提升LoopLM的推理能力。

Method: 提出RLTT（Reward Latent Thought Trajectories）框架，将奖励沿完整的潜推理轨迹进行密集的轨迹级信用分配，无需外部验证器，可直接替代GRPO且额外开销可忽略。

Result: 在Ouro-1.4B-Thinking和2.6B-Thinking模型上，RLTT相比GRPO在MATH-500、AIME24/26、BeyondAIME等数学推理基准上平均准确率分别提升+5.8%（1.4B）和+10.9%（2.6B），且能有效迁移至非数学推理基准。

Conclusion: 轨迹级信用分配对LoopLM的强化学习有效，RLTT框架在保持低开销的同时显著优于仅依赖最终状态奖励的标准方法。

Abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform multi-step latent reasoning prior to token generation and outperform conventional LLMs on reasoning benchmarks at smaller parameter budgets. However, attempts to further improve LoopLM reasoning with reinforcement learning have failed - standard objectives such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only assign credit to the final latent state, creating a fundamental mismatch with the model's internal computation. To resolve this, we introduce RLTT (Reward Latent Thought Trajectories), a reinforcement learning framework which distributes reward across the full latent reasoning trajectory. RLTT provides dense, trajectory-level credit assignment without relying on external verifiers and can directly replace GRPO with negligible overhead. Across extensive experiments with Ouro-1.4B/2.6B-Thinking under identical training and inference conditions, RLTT yields statistically significant improvements over GRPO on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, improving mean accuracy over MATH-500, AIME24/26, and BeyondAIME by +5.8% on the 1.4B scale, and +10.9% on the 2.6B scale. Despite being trained exclusively on mathematics, RLTT also transfers effectively to non-mathematical reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of trajectory-level credit assignment for reinforcement learning in LoopLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/jonwill8/RLTT.git.

</details>


### [458] [Coarse-Grained Boltzmann Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10637)
*Weilong Chen,Bojun Zhao,Jan Eckwert,Julija Zavadlav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出粗粒化玻尔兹曼生成器（CG-BGs），将基于流的生成模型与重要性采样结合到粗粒化坐标空间，通过学习平均力势（PMF）实现重加权，在极大降低计算成本的同时保持统计正确性，为大型分子系统的平衡采样提供了实用方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 玻尔兹曼生成器（BGs）虽能通过精确似然生成模型结合重要性采样从玻尔兹曼分布中采样，但实际扩展性有限；而粗粒化代理虽能降低有效维度以建模更大系统，却缺乏保证渐近正确统计量的重加权过程。本文旨在融合两者优势，解决大规模分子系统平衡采样的可扩展性问题。

Method: CG-BGs框架在粗粒化坐标空间中使用基于流的生成模型生成样本，并通过学习得到的平均力势（PMF）进行重要性采样重加权。PMF通过增强采样力匹配（enhanced sampling force matching）从快速收敛的轨迹中学习获得。

Result: 实验表明，CG-BGs能够在高度降维的表示中捕捉溶剂介导的相互作用，同时相比原子级BGs大幅降低计算成本，为更大分子系统的平衡采样提供了实用路径。

Conclusion: CG-BGs成功将粗粒化建模与生成式重要性采样相结合，在保持渐近正确统计量的前提下显著提升计算效率，是平衡采样领域向更大分子系统扩展的有效方法。

Abstract: Sampling equilibrium molecular configurations from the Boltzmann distribution is a longstanding challenge. Boltzmann Generators (BGs) address this by combining exact-likelihood generative models with importance sampling, but practical scalability is limited. Meanwhile, coarse-grained surrogates enable the modeling of larger systems by reducing effective dimensionality, yet often lack a reweighting procedure required to ensure asymptotically correct statistics. In this work, we propose Coarse-Grained Boltzmann Generators (CG-BGs), a framework for reduced-order generative modeling with importance sampling in coarse-grained coordinate space. CG-BGs generate samples using a flow-based model and reweight them using a learned potential of mean force (PMF). We show that the PMF can be learned from rapidly converged trajectories via enhanced sampling force matching. Experiments demonstrate that CG-BGs capture solvent-mediated interactions in highly reduced representations while substantially reducing computational cost relative to atomistic BGs, providing a practical route toward equilibrium sampling of larger molecular systems.

</details>


### [459] [Collaborative Threshold Watermarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10765)
*Tameem Bakr,Anish Ambreth,Nils Lukas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出(t,K)-门限水印方法，通过秘密共享水印密钥，实现联邦学习中大规模客户端协作嵌入水印，仅需t个客户端即可验证，抗合谋且鲁棒性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中多个客户端共同训练模型，现有水印方法难以兼顾大规模客户端场景——要么随K增长水印稀释，要么单个客户端可独立验证并可能移除水印。

Method: 采用秘密共享技术将水印密钥τ分割，使得至少t个客户端协作才能重构密钥并验证模型；验证过程不暴露τ明文。在白盒设置下进行实例化，在图像分类（IID和非IID分区）和语言模型微调任务上评估。

Result: 在K=128规模下仍保持可检测性，精度损失极小；在包括使用20%训练数据进行自适应微调等攻击下，检测z值仍≥4，超过检测阈值。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种面向联邦学习的(t,K)-门限水印协议，能够在大规模客户端场景下实现可验证的模型溯源，同时防止少于t个客户端的合谋攻击，并在多种任务和攻击下保持检测鲁棒性。

Abstract: In federated learning (FL), $K$ clients jointly train a model without sharing raw data. Because each participant invests data and compute, clients need mechanisms to later prove the provenance of a jointly trained model. Model watermarking embeds a hidden signal in the weights, but naive approaches either do not scale with many clients as per-client watermarks dilute as $K$ grows, or give any individual client the ability to verify and potentially remove the watermark. We introduce $(t,K)$-threshold watermarking: clients collaboratively embed a shared watermark during training, while only coalitions of at least $t$ clients can reconstruct the watermark key and verify a suspect model. We secret-share the watermark key $τ$ so that coalitions of fewer than $t$ clients cannot reconstruct it, and verification can be performed without revealing $τ$ in the clear. We instantiate our protocol in the white-box setting and evaluate it on image classification tasks on both IID and non-IID partitions, as well as language models fine-tuning setting. Our watermark remains detectable at scale ($K=128$) with minimal accuracy loss and stays above the detection threshold ($z\ge 4$) under attacks including adaptive fine-tuning using up to 20% of the training data. Code is available at https://github.com/tameemalaa/collaborative-threshold-watermark.

</details>


### [460] [Size Transferability of Graph Transformers with Convolutional Positional Encodings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15239)
*Javier Porras-Valenzuela,Zhiyang Wang,Xiaotao Shang,Yusu Wang,Alejandro Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了图Transformer（GT）的流形极限模型，建立了带GNN位置编码的GT与流形神经网络（MNN）之间的理论联系，证明了GT能从GNN位置编码继承可迁移性保证，即在小图上训练的GT能在温和假设下泛化到大图，并通过实验验证了GT的可扩展行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer在多个领域取得了显著成功，推动了图Transformer作为基于注意力机制的图结构数据架构的发展。然而，GT中一个关键设计是使用基于GNN的位置编码来融入结构信息，但其理论基础和可迁移性尚不明确，因此需要从理论上理解GT的行为并保证其从小图到大图的泛化能力。

Method: 从流形极限模型的角度研究图序列上的GT，建立带GNN位置编码的GT与流形神经网络（MNN）之间的理论联系，并利用GNN在流形收敛下的可迁移性结果，证明GT从位置编码继承可迁移性保证。

Result: 证明了在温和假设下，在小图上训练的GT可以泛化到大图；在标准图基准上的实验表明GT表现出与GNN相当的可扩展行为；在地形最短路径距离估计的真实场景中验证了可迁移GT的效率。

Conclusion: 该工作为理解图Transformer提供了新的理论视角，并为在大规模场景下高效训练GT提出了实用方向。

Abstract: Transformers have achieved remarkable success across domains, motivating the rise of Graph Transformers (GTs) as attention-based architectures for graph-structured data. A key design choice in GTs is the use of Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based positional encodings to incorporate structural information. In this work, we study GTs through the lens of manifold limit models for graph sequences and establish a theoretical connection between GTs with GNN positional encodings and Manifold Neural Networks (MNNs). Building on transferability results for GNNs under manifold convergence, we show that GTs inherit transferability guarantees from their positional encodings. In particular, GTs trained on small graphs provably generalize to larger graphs under mild assumptions. We complement our theory with extensive experiments on standard graph benchmarks, demonstrating that GTs exhibit scalable behavior on par with GNNs. To further show the efficiency in a real-world scenario, we implement GTs for shortest path distance estimation over terrains to better illustrate the efficiency of the transferable GTs. Our results provide new insights into the understanding of GTs and suggest practical directions for efficient training of GTs in large-scale settings.

</details>


### [461] [GICDM: Mitigating Hubness for Reliable Distance-Based Generative Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16449)
*Nicolas Salvy,Hugues Talbot,Bertrand Thirion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现生成模型评估中常用的高维嵌入空间存在枢纽性现象（hubness），扭曲了近邻关系和距离度量。基于经典的ICDM方法，提出生成式ICDM（GICDM），通过修正真实和生成数据的邻域估计，并引入多尺度扩展，有效解决了枢纽性导致的评估失败，恢复了可靠的度量行为，提升了与人工评估的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型评估依赖高维嵌入空间计算样本间距离，但这些空间存在枢纽性现象（hubness），导致近邻关系扭曲、基于距离的度量有偏，现有评估方法不可靠。

Method: 基于经典迭代上下文相似性度量（ICDM），提出生成式ICDM（GICDM）以修正真实数据和生成数据的邻域估计，并引入多尺度扩展改善经验表现。

Result: 在合成和真实基准上的大量实验表明，GICDM解决了枢纽性导致的评估失败，恢复了可靠的度量行为，并提高了与人工评估的一致性。

Conclusion: 高维嵌入空间中的枢纽性现象会显著偏置生成模型的评估结果，而GICDM通过修正邻域估计有效缓解了该问题，使自动评估更贴近人类判断。

Abstract: Generative model evaluation commonly relies on high-dimensional embedding spaces to compute distances between samples. We show that dataset representations in these spaces are affected by the hubness phenomenon, which distorts nearest-neighbor relationships and biases distance-based metrics. Building on the classical Iterative Contextual Dissimilarity Measure (ICDM), we introduce Generative ICDM (GICDM), a method to correct neighborhood estimation for both real and generated data. We introduce a multi-scale extension to improve empirical behavior. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real benchmarks demonstrate that GICDM resolves hubness-induced failures, restores reliable metric behavior, and improves alignment with human assessment.

</details>


### [462] [RAT+: Train Dense, Infer Sparse -- Recurrence Augmented Attention for Dilated Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18196)
*Xiuying Wei,Caglar Gulcehre*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAT+提出了一种密集预训练架构，通过全序列循环和主动循环学习增强注意力，使得单个模型在推理时可灵活切换为不同膨胀率（D）的稀疏注意力模式，无需为每种配置重新训练。在1.5B参数、100B tokens训练下，D=16时接近密集精度，D=64时仅下降2-3个点；扩展到2.6B和7.6B参数时，64倍注意力FLOPs和KV缓存缩减仅带来约1个点的精度损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化膨胀注意力在推理时能通过膨胀因子D降低FLOPs和KV缓存大小，但传统方法需要对每种配置单独训练，无法灵活复用预训练模型。作者希望设计一种架构，既能享受稠密预训练的好处，又能在推理时灵活切换不同稀疏模式，避免为每种场景重新训练。

Method: 在注意力层中引入全序列递归（full-sequence recurrence）和主动递归学习（active recurrence learning），构建RAT+架构。模型先进行标准稠密预训练，推理时通过短期的1B token分辨率适应（resolution adaptation），即可切换为任意膨胀率（D）的膨胀注意力（可选局部窗口）或混合层/头组合，无需重新训练稀疏模型。

Result: 1.5B参数、100B tokens训练下，D=16时精度接近密集模型，D=64时在常识推理和LongBench任务上下降约2-3个点。扩展到2.6B和7.6B参数时，64倍注意力FLOPs和KV缓存缩减下，平均精度损失仅为1个点左右。

Conclusion: RAT+通过引入递归机制实现了稠密预训练模型在推理时灵活切换稀疏注意力模式的能力，显著降低了不同推理场景下的计算和存储开销，且在大规模参数下性能损失更小，为高效推理提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Structured dilated attention has an appealing inference-time efficiency knob: it reduces the FLOPs of attention and the KV cache size by a factor of the dilation size D, while preserving long-range connectivity. While prior work studies it by training each configuration from scratch, directly sparsifying a pretrained attention model into a dilated pattern leads to severe accuracy degradation, preventing flexible reuse across inference scenarios. We introduce RAT+, a dense-pretraining architecture that augments attention with full-sequence recurrence and active recurrence learning. A single RAT+ model is pretrained densely once and can then be flexibly switched at inference time to dilated attention (optionally with local windows) or hybrid layer/head compositions, requiring only a short 1B-token resolution adaptation rather than retraining separate sparse models. At 1.5B parameters trained on 100B tokens, RAT+ closely matches dense accuracy at D = 16, and drops by about 2-3 points at D = 64 on commonsense reasoning and LongBench tasks. We further scale to 2.6B and 7.6B parameters and observe even more promising performance (e.g., a 1-point average accuracy loss with a 64x reduction in attention FLOPs and KV cache size). Code is available at https://github.com/wimh966/rat-plus.

</details>


### [463] [Is Your Diffusion Sampler Actually Correct? A Sampler-Centric Evaluation of Discrete Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19619)
*Luhan Tang,Longxuan Yu,Shaorong Zhang,Greg Ver Steeg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的评估问题，提出了一种基于采样器的oracle框架，将去噪器近似误差与采样器引起的误差分离。研究发现，即使在oracle去噪器下，少步离散扩散采样器也无法实现分布正确性，且NLL、GenPPL、MAUVE等指标的改善并不代表采样正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散扩散语言模型的评估指标混淆了去噪器近似误差与采样动力学引起的采样误差，而自回归模型不存在此问题。需要一种能隔离采样器误差的评估框架。

Method: 提出了一种以采样器为中心的oracle框架，用精确的隐马尔可夫模型后验（来自真实马尔可夫链）替代学习得到的去噪器，从而在受控环境中隔离采样器引起的误差。

Result: 少步离散扩散采样器即使在oracle去噪器下也无法实现分布正确性，存在转移级别的不匹配，只有步数接近序列长度时该不匹配才会消失。NLL、GenPPL、MAUVE等指标的改善并不保证采样正确。

Conclusion: 现有评估指标无法可靠反映离散扩散采样器的分布正确性，需要开发更严谨的评估方法。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) provide a fast and flexible alternative to autoregressive models (ARMs) via iterative denoising with parallel updates. However, their evaluation is challenging: existing metrics conflate denoiser approximation error with sampler-induced error from the sampling dynamics, a problem that does not arise for ARMs whose autoregressive sampling exactly reflects the learned probability model. We introduce a sampler-centric oracle framework that replaces learned denoisers with an exact Hidden Markov Model posterior derived from a ground-truth Markov chain, isolating sampler-induced error in a controlled setting. We show that few-step discrete diffusion samplers are not distributionally correct even under an oracle denoiser, with transition-level mismatch that vanishes only as the number of steps approaches the sequence length. Moreover, improvements in negative log-likelihood (NLL), generative perplexity (GenPPL), or MAUVE do not imply correct sampling. Code is available at https://luhantang.github.io/dllm_sampler

</details>


### [464] [Routing by Reaching: Composition of Pre-trained GFlowNets for Multi-Objective Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21565)
*Seokwon Yoon,Youngbin Choi,Seunghyuk Cho,Seungbeom Lee,MoonJeong Park,Dongwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种在推理时组合预训练GFlowNets的框架，无需重新训练即可适应多目标奖励组合，支持线性和非线性标量化，理论上保证线性情形精确恢复目标分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GFlowNets多目标扩展需要为每种目标组合进行联合训练，目标集变化时需从头训练，缺乏灵活性和可组合性。

Method: 在推理阶段组合预训练的GFlowNets，通过理论分析证明线性标量化下精确恢复目标分布，非线性算子下通过畸变因子量化近似质量。

Result: 在合成2D网格和真实分子生成任务上达到与基线方法相当的性能。

Conclusion: 所提框架实现了无需微调或重训练的多目标适应，具有灵活性和理论保证，适用于科学发现等需要探索多样候选解的场景。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn to sample diverse candidates in proportion to a reward function, making them well-suited for scientific discovery, where exploring multiple promising solutions is crucial. Further extending GFlowNets to multi-objective settings has attracted growing interest as real-world applications often involve multiple, conflicting objectives. However, existing approaches require joint training for each combination of objectives, meaning that any change in the objective set necessitates retraining from scratch. We propose a framework that composes pre-trained GFlowNets at inference time, enabling rapid adaptation without fine-tuning or retraining.
