Importantly, our framework is flexible, capable of handling diverse reward combinations ranging from linear scalarization to complex nonlinear operators, which are often handled separately in previous literature. We prove that our method exactly recovers the target distribution for linear scalarization, and quantify the approximation quality for nonlinear operators through a distortion factor. Experiments on a synthetic 2D grid and real-world molecule generation tasks demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to baselines.

</details>


### [465] [Improving Full Waveform Inversion in Large Model Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00377)
*Yinan Feng,Peng Jin,Yuzhe Guo,Yinpeng Chen,Youzuo Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文表明，通过在模型容量、数据多样性和训练策略三个维度上进行协调缩放，完全在简单合成数据上训练的十亿参数模型能够显著泛化到复杂、未见过的地质结构，在OpenFWI和六个挑战性地球物理基准上实现SOTA性能，SSIM从0.5844提升至0.7669，大幅缩小了数据驱动全波形反演的泛化差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的数据驱动全波形反演方法通常使用小模型，受限于可用数据集的体积、地质多样性和空间范围有限，导致严重的过拟合问题。尽管在合成数据集上表现良好，但这些方法无法泛化到更真实的地质结构。本文旨在解决数据驱动FWI的泛化差距问题。

Method: 提出了一个三轴协调缩放的工作方案：模型容量缩放（使用十亿参数模型）、数据多样性缩放、训练策略缩放。模型完全在模拟的简单合成数据上训练。

Result: 在OpenFWI上达到SOTA性能，在六个挑战性地球物理基准（Marmousi、2D SEG/EAGE Salt and Overthrust、2004 BP、Sigsbee、SEAM Phase I）上，SSIM从0.5844提升至0.7669，能够推断训练集中不存在的复杂结构。

Conclusion: 通过适当的缩放策略，在简单合成数据上训练的大模型能够实现对更复杂和真实地质结构的实质性泛化，显著缩小了数据驱动FWI的泛化差距。

Abstract: Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) is a highly nonlinear and ill-posed problem that aims to recover subsurface velocity maps from surface-recorded seismic waveforms data. Existing data-driven FWI typically uses small models, as available datasets have limited volume, geological diversity, and spatial extent, leading to substantial concerns about overfitting. Although they perform well on synthetic datasets, current methods fail to generalize to more realistic geological structures. In this work, we show that a model trained entirely on simulated and relatively simple data can generalize remarkably well to challenging and unseen geological benchmarks. We provide a working recipe that tames a billion-parameter model for FWI through coordinated scaling across three axes: model capacity, data diversity, and training strategy. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on OpenFWI and significantly narrows the generalization gap in data-driven FWI. Across six challenging geophysical benchmarks, including Marmousi, 2D SEG/EAGE Salt and Overthrust, 2004 BP, Sigsbee, and SEAM Phase I, it infers complex structures absent from the training set and delivers significant performance improvements (SSIM from 0.5844 to 0.7669). Overall, our results demonstrate that with an appropriate scaling strategy, large models trained on simple synthetic data can achieve substantial generalization to more complex and realistic geological structures.

</details>


### [466] [Rooted Absorbed Prefix Trajectory Balance with Submodular Replay for GFlowNet Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00454)
*Xi Wang,Wenbo Lu,Shengjie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RapTB（根吸收前缀轨迹平衡）目标函数和SubM（子模重放刷新）策略，解决GFlowNet微调LLM时的模式坍缩问题，包括前缀坍缩和长度偏差，在分子生成任务中提升了优化性能和多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GFlowNet在微调大语言模型以逼近奖励比例后验时容易发生模式坍缩（前缀坍缩和长度偏差），现有方法对早期前缀的信用分配弱，且重放存在偏差导致训练流分布偏移。

Method: (1) RapTB：根吸收前缀轨迹平衡目标，在根节点锚定子轨迹监督，通过吸收后缀回放将终端奖励传播到中间前缀，提供密集的前缀级学习信号。(2) SubM：子模重放刷新策略，兼顾高奖励与多样性以缓解重放引起的分布偏移。

Result: 在基于SMILES字符串的LLM分子生成任务中，RapTB结合SubM在优化性能和分子多样性上持续提升，同时保持高有效性。

Conclusion: 提出的RapTB和SubM有效缓解了GFlowNet微调LLM时的模式坍缩问题，为前缀级信用分配和重放分布偏移提供了解决方案。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) enable fine-tuning large language models to approximate reward-proportional posteriors, but they remain prone to mode collapse, manifesting as prefix collapse and length bias. We attribute this to two factors: (i) weak credit assignment to early prefixes, and (ii) biased replay that induces a shifted, non-representative training flow distribution. We propose Rooted absorbed prefix Trajectory Balance RapTB, an objective that anchors subtrajectory supervision at the root and propagates terminal rewards to intermediate prefixes via absorbed suffix-based backups, providing dense prefix-level learning signals. To mitigate replay-induced distribution shift, we further introduce SubM, a submodular replay refresh strategy that promotes both high reward and diversity. Empirically, on tasks such as molecule generation with LLM using SMILES strings, RapTB combined with SubM consistently improves optimization performance and molecular diversity while preserving high validity.

</details>


### [467] [Relational In-Context Learning via Synthetic Pre-training with Structural Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03805)
*Yanbo Wang,Jiaxuan You,Chuan Shi,Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RDB-PFN，首个完全基于合成数据训练的关系数据库基础模型。通过关系先验生成器生成多样化的合成关系数据库，在200万+任务上预训练，使模型能够通过上下文学习适应新数据库。在19个真实关系预测任务上超越现有表格基础模型，且架构轻量、推理快速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系数据库是现代商业的支柱，但缺乏像文本或视觉领域那样的基础模型。主要障碍是高质量关系数据库数量稀缺、结构异构且多为私有，难以进行互联网规模预训练。

Method: 受Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs)启发（使用SCMs生成合成数据实现单表推理），设计关系先验生成器(Relational Prior Generator)从头创建无限多样化的关系数据库流。在超过200万合成单表和关系任务上预训练，使模型通过真正的上下文学习适应新数据库。

Result: 在19个真实世界关系预测任务上，RDB-PFN在少样本设定下表现优异，超越在相同DFS线性化输入上评估的最先进表格基础模型，同时使用轻量级架构并实现快速推理。

Conclusion: RDB-PFN通过纯合成数据训练有效解决了关系数据库领域的数据稀缺问题，证明了基于合成数据训练关系基础模型的可行性，为关系数据库基础模型研究开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Relational Databases (RDBs) are the backbone of modern business, yet they lack foundation models comparable to those in text or vision. A key obstacle is that high-quality RDBs are private, scarce, and structurally heterogeneous, making internet-scale pre-training infeasible. To overcome this data scarcity, we introduce RDB-PFN, the first relational foundation model trained purely via synthetic data. Inspired by Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs), where synthetic data generated from Structural Causal Models (SCMs) enables reasoning on single tables, we design a Relational Prior Generator to create an infinite stream of diverse RDBs from scratch. Pre-training on over 2 million synthetic single-table and relational tasks, RDB-PFN learns to adapt to any new database instantly via genuine in-context learning. Experiments show that RDB-PFN achieves strong few-shot performance on 19 real-world relational prediction tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art tabular foundation models evaluated on the same DFS-linearized inputs, while using a lightweight architecture and fast inference. The code is available at https://github.com/MuLabPKU/RDBPFN.

</details>


### [468] [Non-Euclidean Gradient Descent Operates at the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05002)
*Rustem Islamov,Michael Crawshaw,Jeremy Cohen,Robert Gower*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过方向光滑性视角将边缘稳定性（EoS）现象推广到非欧几里得范数，定义了广义锐度，并证明非欧几里得梯度下降法同样表现出渐进尖锐化和阈值振荡，为多种优化方法提供了几何感知的谱诊断工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EoS现象在深度学习中广泛存在，但其理论基础仍不完善，尤其是缺乏对非欧几里得范数下梯度方法的推广研究。

Method: 利用方向光滑性框架，将EoS解释推广到任意范数下，定义广义锐度。将普通GD和预条件GD作为特例，并扩展到ℓ∞-下降、Block CD、Spectral GD及其归一化版本。

Result: 实验表明，非欧几里得GD的广义锐度同样表现出渐进尖锐化和在阈值2/η附近振荡的现象。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种几何感知的谱诊断工具，适用于广泛非欧几里得梯度方法，为理解EoS提供了更统一的理论视角。

Abstract: The Edge of Stability (EoS) is a phenomenon where the sharpness (largest eigenvalue) of the Hessian approaches and then hovers near the stability threshold $2/η$ during gradient descent (GD) with step size $η$. Despite (apparently) violating classical smoothness assumptions, EoS has been widely observed in deep learning, but its theoretical foundations remain incomplete. We provide an interpretation of EoS through the lens of Directional Smoothness [Mishkin et al., 2024]. This interpretation naturally extends to non-Euclidean norms, which we use to define generalized sharpness under an arbitrary norm. Our generalized sharpness measure includes previously studied vanilla GD and preconditioned GD as special cases, as well as methods for which EoS has not been studied, such as $\ell_{\infty}$-descent, Block CD, Spectral GD, and their normalized versions. Through experiments on neural networks, we show that non-Euclidean GD with our generalized sharpness also exhibits progressive sharpening followed by oscillations around or above the threshold $2/η$. Practically, our framework provides a geometry-aware spectral diagnostic that can be applied across a broad class of non-Euclidean gradient methods.

</details>


### [469] [Sparse Scheduled Diffusion Guidance for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07860)
*Abduragim Shtanchaev,Albina Ilina,Yazid Janati,Arip Asadulaev,Martin Takac,Eric Moulines*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Spin提出了一种无需从纯噪声开始的后验采样方法，通过在中间时间步采样后验时间边缘分布作为热启动，并仅在调度的时间步施加轻量级像素空间校正，从而在不通过去噪器反向传播的情况下实现数据一致性，在FFHQ和ImageNet上达到竞争性重建质量，运行速度提升2倍（像素空间模型）至50倍（潜在扩散模型）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的扩散模型用于贝叶斯逆问题时，全轨迹的密集数据一致性引导计算成本高，且需要从纯噪声开始采样；现有方法虽避免了向量-雅可比积，但仍依赖全轨迹引导或昂贵的内循环求解。

Method: Spin方法首先在中间时间步t_*采样后验时间边缘分布作为热启动，然后执行引导反向扩散过程；在引导阶段，仅在调度的时间步（去噪器仍能消除伪影的步骤）施加轻量级像素空间校正，无需通过去噪器或解码器反向传播。

Result: 在FFHQ和ImageNet上的线性和非线性逆问题中，Spin以显著更优的运行时-内存配置达到竞争性重建质量：像素空间模型加速2倍，潜在扩散模型加速高达50倍，内存成本更低。

Conclusion: 通过将先验细化与数据一致性解耦（先验提供去噪，轻量级像素空间优化执行测量约束），Spin有效降低了后验采样的计算开销，实现了高效高质量的逆问题求解。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models are effective priors for Bayesian inverse problems, but posterior sampling with these priors is often costly because data-consistency guidance is applied throughout the full reverse trajectory. Existing methods have shown that vector-Jacobian products through the denoiser can sometimes be avoided, yet they typically still rely on dense guidance through the full trajectory or expensive inner solves. We introduce Sparse Scheduled Diffusion Guidance for Inverse Problems (Spin), a solver that avoids starting posterior sampling from pure noise. Spin first samples from a posterior time-marginal at an intermediate timestep $t_*$, and then uses that state as a warm start for a guided reverse diffusion process. At guidance time, instead of enforcing the measurement constraint at every denoising step, Spin applies lightweight corrections only at scheduled timesteps where the denoiser can still clean up artifacts. The resulting procedure decouples prior refinement from data consistency: the prior supplies denoising, while lightweight pixel-space optimization enforces the measurement constraint without backpropagation through the denoiser or decoder. Across linear and nonlinear inverse problems on FFHQ and ImageNet, Spin achieves competitive reconstruction quality with a substantially better runtime--memory profile, running 2x faster on pixel-space models and up to 50x faster on latent diffusion models, with lower memory costs.

</details>


### [470] [Jailbreak Scaling Laws for Large Language Models: Polynomial-Exponential Crossover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11331)
*Indranil Halder,Annesya Banerjee,Cengiz Pehlevan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现对抗性提示注入攻击可使大语言模型的安全攻击成功率从多项式增长转变为指数增长（随推理样本数增加），并通过自旋玻璃理论模型揭示了这一现象背后的统计机制，在3B-70B参数规模的多个模型上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释对抗性攻击成功率随推理样本数量增加而呈现不同缩放规律（多项式vs指数增长）的统计与物理机制。

Method: 提出一个自旋玻璃系统模型，在复制对称破缺（replica-symmetry-breaking）机制下运行，生成服从吉布斯测度，低能团簇被标记为不安全。短注入提示对应弱磁场（幂律缩放），长注入提示对应强磁场（指数缩放）。

Result: 短注入提示下攻击成功率随样本数呈幂律增长，长注入提示下呈指数增长；在3B-70B参数的LLM上，多种攻击方法（GCG、AutoDAN）和基准（AdvBench、HarmBench）上均观察到一致趋势。

Conclusion: 对抗性提示注入攻击的缩放规律可由自旋玻璃理论统一解释，注入长度决定磁场强度从而改变增长形态，为理解LLM安全漏洞的统计本质提供了理论框架。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks can reliably steer safety-aligned large language models toward unsafe behavior. Empirically, we find that adversarial prompt-injection attacks can amplify attack success rate from the slow polynomial growth observed without injection to exponential growth with the number of inference-time samples. We first identify a minimal statistical mechanism for these two regimes by giving a small set of assumptions on the distribution of safe generation across contexts under which both scaling laws follow. To explain this phenomenon further, we propose a theoretical generative model of proxy language in terms of a spin-glass system operating in a replica-symmetry-breaking regime, where generations are drawn from the associated Gibbs measure and a subset of low-energy, size-biased clusters is designated unsafe. We analytically show how this model naturally realizes the minimal assumptions. Short injected prompts correspond to a weak magnetic field aligned towards unsafe cluster centers and yield a power-law scaling of attack success rate with the number of inference-time samples, while long injected prompts, i.e., strong magnetic field, yield exponential scaling. We observe qualitatively consistent behavior across a broad range of large language models, spanning parameter scales from 3B to 70B. In particular, the main trends remain stable across multiple attack methods, such as GCG and AutoDAN, as well as across benchmark datasets such as AdvBench and HarmBench.

</details>


### [471] [Enhancing LLM Training via Spectral Clipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14315)
*Xiaowen Jiang,Andrei Semenov,Sebastian U. Stich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SPECTRA框架，通过对更新进行谱裁剪（后裁剪）和对梯度进行谱裁剪（前裁剪），在LLM训练中统一提升AdamW等多种优化器的验证损失，达到SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自适应优化器（如AdamW）未考虑权重和梯度的谱结构，导致LLM训练中出现两个问题：更新谱范数过大破坏稳定性与泛化；随机梯度噪声存在稀疏谱尖峰。现有方法缺乏通用框架同时处理这两个问题。

Method: 提出SPECTRA框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 后谱裁剪(post-spectral clipping)——对优化器更新施加谱范数约束；(2) 前谱裁剪(pre-spectral clipping)——抑制梯度中的稀疏谱尖峰噪声。证明后裁剪是带谱范数约束和权重正则化的Composite Frank-Wolfe方法。采用Newton-Schulz迭代实现高效软谱裁剪，避免昂贵的SVD分解。

Result: 在LLM预训练实验中，SPECTRA统一提升了AdamW、Signum、Mars、AdEMAMix等多种优化器的验证损失，最优变体达到SOTA。训练出的模型权重范数更小，验证了谱裁剪与正则化之间的联系。

Conclusion: SPECTRA是一个通用且高效的谱感知优化框架，通过谱裁剪同时解决更新稳定性与梯度噪声问题，可广泛适用于各类优化器并提升LLM训练效果。

Abstract: While spectral-based optimizers like Muon operate directly on the spectrum of updates, standard adaptive methods such as AdamW do not account for the spectral structure of weights and gradients, leaving them vulnerable to two empirical issues in large language model (LLM) training: (i) the optimizer updates can have large spectral norms, potentially destabilizing training and degrading generalization; (ii) stochastic gradient noise can exhibit sparse spectral spikes, with a few dominant singular values much larger than the rest. We propose SPECTRA, a general framework addressing these by (i) post-spectral clipping of updates to enforce spectral-norm constraints (ii) optional pre-spectral clipping of gradients to suppress spectral noise spikes. We prove that post-clipping constitutes a Composite Frank-Wolfe method with spectral-norm constraints and weight regularization. We further analyze how pre-clipping mitigates sparse spectral spikes. We propose efficient soft spectral clipping via Newton-Schulz iterations, avoiding expensive SVD. Experiments on LLM pretraining show SPECTRA uniformly improves validation loss for various optimizers, including AdamW, Signum, Mars, and AdEMAMix, with the best-performing variants achieving state-of-the-art results. Models trained with SPECTRA exhibit smaller weight norms, confirming the link between spectral clipping and regularization.

</details>


### [472] [Maximizing Mutual Information Between Prompt and Response Improves LLM Performance With No Additional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19294)
*Hyunji Nam,Haoran Li,Natasha Jaques*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出互信息偏好优化（MIPO），一种通过对比数据增强构建偏好对的方法，利用正确提示与随机无关提示分别生成正负响应，通过直接偏好优化学习以最大化提示与响应间的点互信息。在1-7B参数量的Llama和Qwen模型上，MIPO在个性化任务上提升3-51%，在数学和多项选择等可验证领域也能获得1-20%的提升，无需额外数据或外部监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型后训练高度依赖人工标注或外部验证器，已有数据已被充分利用而新数据获取成本高昂，且真正的智能远超可验证任务范畴，因此需要一种减少对外部信号依赖、适用于可验证与非可验证领域的自我改进框架。

Method: 提出MIPO方法：通过对比数据增强构建偏好对——正响应基于正确提示生成，负响应基于随机无关提示生成；然后使用直接偏好优化从该配对数据中学习，从而在基座LLM下最大化提示与响应间的点互信息。

Result: 在1-7B参数的Llama和Qwen指令模型上，MIPO在个性化任务上相比提示基线获得3-16%的提升（Qwen2.5-1B-Instruct达到51%）；在数学和多项选择问答等可验证领域，无需额外数据或外部监督也能获得1-20%的提升。

Conclusion: MIPO提供了一种利用对比数据对衍生的内在信号进行自我改进的有效方向，既适用于非可验证的个性化任务，也可推广到可验证领域，减少对外部监督的依赖。

Abstract: While post-training has successfully improved large language models (LLMs) across a variety of domains, these gains heavily rely on human-labeled data or external verifiers. Existing data has already been exploited, and new data is expensive to collect. Moreover, true intelligence goes far beyond verifiable tasks. Therefore, we need self-improvement frameworks that are less dependent on external signals and more broadly applicable to both verifiable and non-verifiable domains. We propose **Mutual Information Preference Optimization (MIPO)**, a contrastive data augmentation method that constructs preference pairs by generating a positive response conditioning on the correct prompt, and a negative response by conditioning on a random, unrelated prompt. We show that using Direct Preference Optimization to learn from this paired data maximizes pointwise mutual information *under the base LLM* between prompts and model responses. Experiments with with 1-7B parameter Llama and Qwen instruct models show that MIPO achieves 3-16% gains (and 51% increase for Qwen2.5-1B-Instruct) on personalization compared to prompting baselines. Surprisingly, MIPO can also be useful in verifiable domains, such as math and multiple-choice question answering, yielding 1-20% gains *without any additional data or external supervision*. These results suggest a promising direction for self-improvement using intrinsic signals derived from contrastive data pairs.

</details>


### [473] [Path-Space Mirror Descent for On-Policy Reinforcement Learning under the Generalized Schrödinger Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21621)
*Yuehu Gong,Zeyuan Wang,Yulin Chen,Shutong Ding,Qingyuan Zhou,Yanwei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对生成式策略（扩散/流模型）与基于似然的on-policy近端更新不匹配的问题，提出GSB-MDPO，将on-policy生成式策略优化形式化为广义薛定谔桥问题，利用路径空间KL作为镜像下降策略优化中的近端项来上界终端动作KL，在14个连续控制任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典on-policy算法（如PPO）使用简单高斯策略，表达能力有限；而扩散/流模型生成式策略表达力强但终端动作密度通常不可解，难以与基于似然的on-policy近端更新匹配。

Method: 将on-policy生成式策略优化形式化为Generalized Schrödinger Bridge问题，通过路径测度更新结合镜像下降策略优化（MDPO），利用GSB路径空间KL作为近端项来上界终端动作KL，避免显式计算终端动作似然。

Result: 在14个连续控制任务（Playground和Gym-MuJoCo）上验证了GSB-MDPO的经验有效性。

Conclusion: 路径空间正则化可以作为多步生成式策略的原则性近端更新方法。

Abstract: Classical on-policy algorithms such as PPO and mirror descent policy optimization provide stable proximal policy updates through tractable action likelihoods, but are typically instantiated with simple Gaussian policies whose expressiveness can be limited in complex continuous-control tasks. Generative policies based on diffusion and flow models provide more expressive action distributions, but they naturally define distributions over multi-step denoising paths whose terminal action density is often intractable, creating a mismatch with likelihood-based on-policy proximal updates. To address this mismatch, we introduce \textbf{GSB-MDPO} (\emph{Generalized Schrödinger Bridge Mirror Descent Policy Optimization}), which formulates on-policy generative policy optimization as a Generalized Schrödinger Bridge problem over state-conditioned generation paths and instantiates the resulting path-measure update through mirror descent policy optimization. The key insight is that the GSB path-space KL plays the role of the proximal term in MDPO while upper-bounding the terminal action KL, enabling direct control of the executed action distribution without explicit terminal action likelihood evaluation. Experiments on 14 continuous-control tasks across Playground and Gym-MuJoCo demonstrate the empirical effectiveness of GSB-MDPO and support path-space regularization as a principled proximal update for multi-step generative policies.

</details>


### [474] [Learning Safely Without Knowing the World:COMPASS-Hedge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22348)
*Ting Hu,Luanda Cai,Emmanouil-Vasileios Vlatakis-Gkaragkounis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出COMPASS-Hedge算法，首次在全信息在线学习中同时实现对抗环境下的极小极大最优遗憾、随机环境下的实例最优差距依赖遗憾，以及相对于固定基准策略的$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1)$遗憾，无需任何环境先验知识或问题参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线学习算法面临一个三元困境：需要在对抗性设置、随机性设置和固定比较器安全性三者之间权衡遗憾保证。现有方法通常只能擅长其中一到两个场景，无法在不牺牲最优速率或需要问题参数先验的情况下统一三者。

Method: 提出COMPASS-Hedge算法，核心创新包括：自适应伪遗憾缩放（adaptive pseudo-regret scaling）、基于阶段的攻击策略（phase-based aggression）以及比较器感知的混合策略（comparator-aware mixing strategy）。算法无参数，无需了解环境性质或随机次优性差距的大小。

Result: 在全信息在线学习设置中，首次同时实现了三个世界的最优保证：对抗环境下的极小极大最优遗憾、随机环境下的实例最优差距依赖遗憾，以及相对于基准策略的$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1)$安全遗憾。

Conclusion: 基准安全性不必以牺牲最坏情况鲁棒性或随机效率为代价，实现了"三世界最优"（best-of-three-world）的统一框架。

Abstract: Online learning algorithms often face a fundamental trilemma: balancing regret guarantees between adversarial and stochastic settings and providing baseline safety against a fixed comparator. While existing methods excel in one or two of these regimes, they typically fail to unify all three without sacrificing optimal rates or requiring oracle access to problem-dependent parameters. In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing COMPASS-Hedge. To the best of our knowledge, our algorithm is the first full-information anytime method to simultaneously achieve, up to logarithmic factors: i) minimax-optimal regret in adversarial environments; ii) instance-optimal, gap-dependent regret in stochastic environments; and iii) $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1)$ regret relative to a designated baseline policy. Crucially, COMPASS-Hedge is parameter-free and requires no prior knowledge of the environment's nature or the magnitude of the stochastic suboptimality gaps. Our approach hinges on a novel integration of adaptive pseudo-regret scaling and phase-based aggression, coupled with a comparator-aware mixing strategy. To the best of our knowledge, this provides the first "best-of-three-world" guarantee in the full-information setting, establishing that baseline safety does not have to come at the cost of worst-case robustness or stochastic efficiency.

</details>


### [475] [Graph Memory Transformer (GMT)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23862)
*Nicola Zanarini,Niccolò Ferrari,Evelina Lamma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出图记忆Transformer（GMT），用显式学习记忆图替代解码器-only Transformer中的前馈网络子层，通过质心路由、有向转移矩阵和门控位移读出实现图介导记忆导航，在82.2M参数下取得与更大密集基线可比较的零样本性能，并提供了可直接检查的结构可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索是否可以将解码器-only Transformer中的前馈网络（FFN）子层替换为显式学习的记忆图，同时保留自回归架构，以提升模型的结构可解释性。

Method: 提出GMT，保持因果自注意力不变，将每个token的FFN变换替换为记忆单元，包含：可学习质心库、有向转移矩阵、引力源路由、token条件目标选择和门控位移读出。记忆单元返回从估计源记忆状态到目标记忆状态的位移，而非检索值。

Result: GMT v7（82.2M参数）在验证损失（3.5995 vs 3.2903）和困惑度（36.58 vs 26.85）上落后于更大密集基线（103.0M参数），但零样本基准测试表现接近。

Conclusion: 用图介导记忆导航替代密集的token内变换是可行的，并提供了可直接检查的结构可解释性，但大规模扩展、优化内核和更广泛评估留待后续工作。

Abstract: We investigate whether the Feed-Forward Network (FFN) sublayer in a decoder-only transformer can be replaced by an explicit learned memory graph while preserving the surrounding autoregressive architecture. The proposed Graph Memory Transformer (GMT) keeps causal self-attention intact, but replaces the usual per-token FFN transformation with a memory cell that routes token representations over a learned bank of centroids connected by a learned directed transition matrix. In the base GMT v7 instantiation studied here, each of 16 transformer blocks contains 128 centroids, a 128 * 128 edge matrix, gravitational source routing, token-conditioned target selection, and a gated displacement readout. The cell therefore returns movement from an estimated source memory state toward a target memory state, rather than a retrieved value. The resulting model is a fully decoder-only language model with 82.2M trainable parameters and no dense FFN sublayers, compared with a 103.0M-parameter dense GPT-style baseline used in the evaluation. The base v7 model trains stably and exposes centroid usage, transition structure, and source-to-target movement as directly inspectable quantities of the forward computation. It remains behind the larger dense baseline in validation loss and perplexity (3.5995/36.58 vs. 3.2903/26.85), while showing close zero-shot benchmark behavior under the evaluated setting. These results are not intended as a state-of-the-art claim; they support the viability and structural interpretability of replacing dense within-token transformation with graph-mediated memory navigation. Broader scaling, optimized kernels, and more extensive benchmark evaluation are left for subsequent work.

</details>


### [476] [Negative Ontology of True Target for Machine Learning: Towards Evaluation and Learning under Democratic Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24824)
*Yongquan Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从哲学角度探讨了机器学习中“真实目标（TT）”存在性假设的转变，提出基于“TT不存在”这一否定本体论假设的“民主监督”范式，并构建了多不准确真实目标（MIATTs）框架（EL-MIATTs），用于机器学习的评估与学习，最后在教育与职业发展领域展示了应用潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流机器学习范式隐含地假设真实目标（TT）客观存在，本文质疑这一本体论假设，旨在通过重新审视TT的存在性来为机器学习预测建模提供新的视角和洞见。

Method: 采用否定本体论立场（认为TT在客观世界中不存在），提出民主监督概念；进而提出多不准确真实目标（MIATTs）作为实例级实现；基于MIATTs推导逻辑驱动的生成与评估原则、逻辑评估公式以及“不可定义真实目标学习”方法，最终构建EL-MIATTs框架。

Result: 提出了EL-MIATTs框架，包含MIATTs的生成与评估原则、逻辑评估公式和不可定义真实目标学习方法；并通过真实应用案例展示了该框架在支持个体教育与职业发展方面的潜力。

Conclusion: 本文通过否定真实目标客观存在的本体论假设，提出了民主监督及MIATTs框架，为机器学习评估与学习提供了新的范式，并证明其在教育及职业发展领域具有实际价值。

Abstract: This article philosophically examines how shifts in assumptions regarding the existence and non-existence of the true target (TT) give rise to new perspectives and insights for machine learning (ML)-based predictive modeling and, correspondingly, proposes a knowledge system for evaluation and learning under Democratic Supervision. By systematically analysing the existence assumption of the TT in current mainstream ML paradigms, we explicitly adopt a negative ontology perspective, positing that the TT does not objectively exist in the real world, and, grounded in this non-existence assumption, define Democratic Supervision for ML. We further present Multiple Inaccurate True Targets (MIATTs) as an instance-level realization of Democratic Supervision. Building upon MIATTs, we derive principles, for the logic-driven generation and assessment of MIATTs, a logical assessment formulation for evaluation with MIATTs, and undefinable true target learning for learning with MIATTs. Based on these components, we establish the evaluation and learning with MIATTs (EL-MIATTs) framework for ML-based predictive modelling. A real-world application demonstrates the potential of the proposed EL-MIATTs framework in supporting education and professional development for individuals, aligning with prior discussions of Democratic Supervision in the fields of education and professional development.

</details>


### [477] [Advancing multi-site emission control: A physics-informed transfer learning framework with mixture of experts for carbon-pollutant synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26571)
*Yuxuan Ying,Hanqing Yang,Kaige Wang,Yu Hu,Zhiming Zheng,Yunliang Jiang,Xiaoqing Lin,Xiaodong Li,Jun Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出碳-污染物混合专家模型（CPMoE），通过结合物理守恒定律、运行工况异质性和碳-污染物耦合关系，在13个垃圾焚烧发电厂间实现可迁移的多污染物协同预测，迁移后R²保持在0.61-0.84，并能在数字孪生中实现3.6-6.3%的风险指数降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市固废焚烧（MSWI）虽能实现垃圾能源化，但会排放二氧化碳、一氧化碳及多种受管制的空气污染物。不同焚烧设施间因物理约束和工况结构差异，传统数据驱动模型难以跨厂泛化。现有研究多聚焦单厂优化，缺乏适用于异质化网络的可迁移决策支持方法。

Method: 1) 构建碳-污染物混合专家模型（CPMoE），将过程观测路由到工况特定的专家网络，并施加基于守恒定律的正则化约束；2) 结合物理信息迁移学习，将参考模型适配到新设施；3) 将迁移后的模型嵌入离线数字孪生系统，基于历史运行记录筛选候选操作调整方案。

Result: 在13个源厂上，CPMoE对6种主要污染物和系统级风险指数的预测R²分别为0.668-0.904和0.666-0.970；迁移至12个目标厂后，对应R²仍保持在0.661-0.842和0.610-0.841。专家利用模式显示适应过程是结构化工况重加权而非从头学习。数字孪生仿真中，风险指数持续降低3.6-6.3%，94-100%的样本实现污染物协同削减。

Conclusion: 该研究证明，通过将物理守恒约束和工况异质性纳入模型设计，能够在异质化垃圾焚烧网络中获得可迁移的碳-污染物协同控制能力，为跨设施的系统级决策支持提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) converts urban waste to energy but simultaneously emits carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide and multiple regulated air pollutants whose formation is tightly coupled within a single combustion system. Controlling these emissions across a network of diverse facilities poses a fundamentally different challenge from optimising a single plant: data-driven models trained at one site capture local statistical patterns that rarely survive transfer to another, because they lack the physical constraints and regime-level structure needed to generalise. Here we show that shared emission-control relationships can be identified across heterogeneous MSWI plants when physical conservation laws, operating-regime heterogeneity and carbon-pollutant coupling are treated jointly. We develop a carbon-pollutant mixture-of-experts (CPMoE) model that routes process observations through regime-specific expert networks under conservation-based regularisation, and combine it with physics-informed transfer learning to adapt a reference model to new facilities. Across 13 plants, CPMoE predicts six major pollutants and a composite system-level risk index with source-domain R2 of 0.668-0.904 and 0.666-0.970, respectively; after transfer to 12 target plants these values remain 0.661-0.842 and 0.610-0.841. Expert-utilisation patterns show that adaptation proceeds through structured regime re-weighting rather than re-learning from scratch. Embedding the transferred model in an offline digital twin and screening candidate operating adjustments against historical process records yields consistent risk-index reductions of 3.6-6.3% with simultaneous pollutant co-reductions in 94-100% of evaluated samples. These findings suggest a practical route toward transferable, system-level decision support for carbon-pollutant co-control in heterogeneous waste-to-energy networks.

</details>


### [478] [CompleteRXN: Toward Completing Open Chemical Reaction Databases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00222)
*Gabriel Vogel,Minouk Noordsij,Evgeny Pidko,Jana M. Weber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CompleteRXN——一个大规模监督式反应补全基准，用于在真实缺失数据条件下补全化学反应。构建了对齐的不完整与原子平衡反应数据集，并评估了包括约束解码反应平衡器（CRB）在内的多种基线模型。CRB在随机划分上达到99.20%的等价准确率，在极端分布外划分上达91.12%，但在未 curated 的完整USPTO数据上性能大幅下降，揭示了基准性能与实际鲁棒性之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有化学反应数据集（如USPTO）严重不完整，常缺失副产物、共反应物和化学计量系数，限制了其在下游任务中的适用性和可靠性。因此需要构建一个能模拟真实缺失数据条件下的反应补全基准。

Method: 通过将USPTO记录与经过人工整理的机理反应进行对齐，构建了对齐的不完整与原子平衡反应数据集。提出了一种带约束解码的编码器-解码器反应补全模型（CRB），并与另一种算法方法SynRBL进行了比较。

Result: CRB在随机划分上达到99.20%的等价准确率，在极端分布外划分上达到91.12%。SynRBL能生成平衡且化学合理的补全结果，但准确率较低。所有方法的性能随不完整性增加而下降，且在未 curated 的完整USPTO数据上性能大幅下降。

Conclusion: CompleteRXN基准能有效评估反应补全方法，但当前方法在现实场景中的鲁棒性仍有显著不足，基准性能与实际应用之间存在明显差距，需要未来进一步研究。

Abstract: Chemical reaction datasets such as USPTO suffer from substantial incompleteness, frequently missing byproducts, co-reactants, and stoichiometric coefficients. This limits their applicability and reliability in downstream applications. Here, we introduce CompleteRXN, a large-scale supervised benchmark for reaction completion under realistic missing-data conditions. We construct a dataset of aligned incomplete and atom-balanced reactions by mapping USPTO records to curated mechanistic reactions. We evaluate representative baselines, including a novel encoder-decoder reaction completion model with constrained decoding, the Constrained Reaction Balancer (CRB), and a recent algorithmic method, SynRBL. On our CompleteRXN benchmark, the CRB achieves high performance across splits of increasing difficulty, reaching 99.20% equivalence accuracy on the random split and 91.12% on the extreme out-of-distribution split. SynRBL produces many balanced and chemically plausible completions, but with lower accuracy on the benchmark test splits. Across all methods, performance degrades with increasing incompleteness. We observe a substantial drop when evaluating on reactions outside the benchmark (full uncurated USPTO), highlighting the gap between benchmark performance and practical robustness and motivating future work.

</details>


### [479] [Stable-GFlowNet: Toward Diverse and Robust LLM Red-Teaming via Contrastive Trajectory Balance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00553)
*Minchan Kwon,Sunghyun Baek,Minseo Kim,Jaemyung Yu,Dongyoon Han,Junmo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Stable-GFN (S-GFN)，通过消除配分函数Z估计和引入鲁棒掩码机制与流畅性稳定器，解决了生成流网络在红队测试中的训练不稳定和模式坍塌问题，在保证攻击多样性的同时实现了更优的攻击性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型红队测试中，现有方法难以同时实现有效且多样的攻击；生成流网络虽能进行分布匹配，但存在训练不稳定和模式坍塌问题，尤其是不稳定的奖励信号会加速模式坍塌。

Method: 1) 通过成对比较避免配分函数Z的估计；2) 采用鲁棒掩码机制应对噪声奖励；3) 提出流畅性稳定器防止模型陷入产生无意义文本的局部最优解。

Result: 在各种设置下，S-GFN展现出压倒性的攻击性能和多样性优势。

Conclusion: S-GFN在保持GFN最优策略的同时实现了更稳定的训练，为LLM红队测试提供了有效且多样的攻击方法。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) Red-Teaming, which proactively identifies vulnerabilities of LLMs, is an essential process for ensuring safety. Finding effective and diverse attacks in red-teaming is important, but achieving both is challenging. Generative Flow Networks (GFNs) that perform distribution matching are a promising methods, but they are notorious for training instability and mode collapse. In particular, unstable rewards in red-teaming accelerate mode collapse. We propose Stable-GFN (S-GFN), which eliminates partition function $Z$ estimation in GFN and reduces training instability. S-GFN avoids Z-estimation through pairwise comparisons and employs a robust masking methodology against noisy rewards. Additionally, we propose a fluency stabilizer to prevent the model from getting stuck in local optima that produce gibberish. S-GFN provides more stable training while maintaining the optimal policy of GFN. We demonstrate the overwhelming attack performance and diversity of S-GFN across various settings.

</details>


### [480] [Aitchison Embeddings for Learning Compositional Graph Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00716)
*Nikolaos Nakis,Chrysoula Kosma,Panagiotis Promponas,Michail Chatzianastasis,Giannis Nikolentzos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Aitchison几何的组合图嵌入框架，将节点表示为单纯形值组合，通过等距对数比（ILR）坐标嵌入，实现内禀可解释的图表示学习，在节点分类和链接预测任务上达到 competitive 性能，并支持子成分一致性下的原则性成分约简。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图嵌入方法大多数难以解释，无法揭示学习到的特征与图结构之间的关系。然而许多网络天然具有角色混合视图，节点可被描述为潜在原型因子的混合。现有方法缺乏对这种组合结构的几何保真建模，且解释性通常依赖事后分析而非内建。

Method: 提出一个组合图嵌入框架：节点表示为单纯形值组合（simplex-valued compositions），采用等距对数比（ILR）坐标进行嵌入，在保留Aitchison距离的同时允许在欧氏空间中进行无约束优化。框架支持固定和可学习的ILR基，并通过子成分一致性实现原则性的成分约简（子成分维度移除）。

Result: 在节点分类和链接预测任务上，该方法在保持与强基线方法竞争性性能的同时，提供了内建的可解释性（而非事后解释）。子成分一致性使得可以移除并重新归一化子集，从而探测原型组如何影响表示和预测。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了在Aitchison几何下建模节点组合表示的有效性，实现了可解释性与性能的平衡，并为图表示学习提供了新的几何视角。子成分一致性特性为理解不同原型组对预测的贡献提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Representation learning is central to graph machine learning, powering tasks such as link prediction and node classification. However, most graph embeddings are hard to interpret, offering limited insight into how learned features relate to graph structure. Many networks naturally admit a role-mixture view, where nodes are best described as mixtures over latent archetypal factors. Motivated by this structure, we propose a compositional graph embedding framework grounded in Aitchison geometry, the canonical geometry for comparing mixtures. Nodes are represented as simplex-valued compositions and embedded via isometric log-ratio (ILR) coordinates, which preserve Aitchison distances while enabling unconstrained optimization in Euclidean space. This yields intrinsically interpretable embeddings whose geometry reflects relative trade-offs among archetypes and supports coherent behavior under component restriction; we consider both fixed and learnable ILR bases. Across node classification and link prediction, our method achieves competitive performance with strong baselines while providing explainability by construction rather than post-hoc. Finally, subcompositional coherence enables principled component restriction: removing and renormalizing subsets preserves a well-defined geometry, which we exploit via subcompositional dimensionality removal to probe how archetype groups influence representations and predictions.

</details>


### [481] [Statistical Consistency and Generalization of Contrastive Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02116)
*Yuanfan Li,Xiyuan Wei,Tianbao Yang,Yiming Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了对比表示学习(CRL)的统一统计学习理论，证明了对比损失与最优排序统计一致，推导了随负样本数m和锚点数n衰减的泛化界（监督：O(1/m+1/√n)，自监督：O(1/√m+1/√n)），解释了大规模负样本的实证优势，并通过大规模视觉-语言模型实验验证了理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CRL理论存在三大关键缺陷：(i)统计一致性尚未明确；(ii)泛化界随负样本增加而恶化，与实证结果矛盾；(iii)检索性能缺乏理论分析。本文旨在填补这些空白。

Method: 采用AUC型群体准则评估下游检索质量，证明对比损失与最优排序统计一致并建立校准型不等式；分别在监督和自监督设置下推导泛化界，揭示负样本数m与锚点数n间的显式权衡。

Result: 对比损失对最优排序具有统计一致性；监督学习泛化界O(1/m+1/√n)，自监督学习泛化界O(1/√m+1/√n)，解释了大规模负样本的优势；大规模视觉-语言模型实验验证了理论预测。

Conclusion: 本文为CRL提供了统一的统计学习理论基础，解决了现有理论的矛盾，为理解对比学习的实际成功提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Contrastive representation learning (CRL) underpins many modern foundation models. Despite recent theoretical progress, existing analyses suffer from several key limitations: (i) the statistical consistency of CRL remains poorly understood; (ii) available generalization bounds deteriorate as the number of negative samples increases, contradicting the empirical benefits of large negative sets; and (iii) the retrieval performance of CRL has received limited theoretical attention. In this paper, we develop a unified statistical learning theory for CRL. For downstream tasks, we evaluate retrieval quality using an AUC-type population criterion and show that the contrastive loss is \emph{statistically consistent} with optimal ranking. We further establish a \emph{calibration-style inequality} that quantitatively relates excess contrastive risk to excess retrieval suboptimality. For upstream training, we study both supervised and self-supervised contrastive objectives and derive generalization bounds of order $O(1/m + 1/\sqrt{n})$ and $O(1/\sqrt{m} + 1/\sqrt{n})$, respectively, where $m$ denotes the number of negative samples and $n$ the number of anchor points. These bounds not only explain the empirical advantages of large negative sets but also reveal an explicit trade-off between $m$ and $n$. Extensive experiments on large-scale vision--language models corroborate our theoretical predictions.

</details>


### [482] [Transformed Latent Variable Multi-Output Gaussian Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05133)
*Xiaoyu Jiang,Xinxing Shi,Sokratia Georgaka,Magnus Rattray,Mauricio A Álvarez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出T-LVMOGP框架，通过将输入和输出潜变量映射到嵌入空间（使用Lipschitz正则化神经网络）构建灵活的多输出深度核，结合随机变分推理，将多输出高斯过程扩展到高维输出空间（如超过10,000个输出），在气候建模和空间转录组学数据上优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多输出高斯过程（MOGP）方法在处理高维输出空间时面临可扩展性瓶颈，通常采用低秩或可分离核等限制性假设，牺牲了表达能力。

Method: 提出变换潜变量MOGP（T-LVMOGP），利用Lipschitz正则化神经网络将输入和输出特定潜变量映射到嵌入空间，构建灵活的多输出深度核，并结合随机变分推理实现高效扩展。

Result: 在超过10,000个输出的气候建模和零膨胀空间转录组学数据上，T-LVMOGP在预测精度和计算效率方面均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: T-LVMOGP成功将MOGP扩展到大规模输出场景，在保持捕获有意义的输出间依赖关系能力的同时，实现了高维输出设置下的高效计算。

Abstract: Multi-Output Gaussian Processes (MOGPs) provide a principled probabilistic framework for modelling correlated outputs but face scalability bottlenecks when applied to datasets with high-dimensional output spaces. To maintain tractability, existing methods typically resort to restrictive assumptions, such as employing low-rank or sum-of-separable kernels, which can limit expressiveness. We propose the Transformed Latent Variable MOGP (T-LVMOGP), a novel framework that scales MOGPs to a massive number of outputs while preserving the capacity to capture meaningful inter-output dependencies. T-LVMOGP constructs a flexible multi-output deep kernel by mapping inputs and output-specific latent variables into an embedding space using a Lipschitz-regularised neural network. Combined with stochastic variational inference, our model effectively scales to high-dimensional output settings. Across diverse benchmarks, including climate modelling with over 10,000 outputs and zero-inflated spatial transcriptomics data, T-LVMOGP outperforms baselines in both predictive accuracy and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [483] [Uncertainty Estimation via Hyperspherical Confidence Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05964)
*Eunseo Choi,Ho-Yeon Kim,Jaewon Lee,Taeyong jo,Myungjun lee,Heejin Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出超球面置信映射(HCM)，通过将输出分解为幅度和单位方向向量，利用几何约束违反程度实现无需采样和分布假设的确定性不确定性估计，在多个基准和工业任务中达到与集成方法相当的性能且推理成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不确定性估计方法依赖于昂贵的采样或严格的分布假设，亟需一种高效且无需分布假设的方法来满足自动驾驶、医疗等高风险领域的需求。

Method: 将网络输出分解为幅度和约束在单位超球面上的归一化方向向量，将对几何约束的违反程度解释为不确定性度量，实现确定性的不确定性估计。

Result: 在多个基准和真实工业任务中，HCM达到或超越了集成方法和证据方法的性能，推理成本显著更低，置信度-误差对齐更优。

Conclusion: 几何结构在不估计中具有强大潜力，HCM可作为传统不确定性估计方法的多功能替代方案。

Abstract: Quantifying uncertainty in neural network predictions is essential for high-stakes domains such as autonomous driving, healthcare, and manufacturing. While existing approaches often depend on costly sampling or restrictive distributional assumptions, we propose Hyperspherical Confidence Mapping (HCM), a simple yet principled framework for sampling-free and distribution-free uncertainty estimation. HCM decomposes outputs into a magnitude and a normalized direction vector constrained to lie on the unit hypersphere, enabling a novel interpretation of uncertainty as the degree of violation of this geometric constraint. This yields deterministic and interpretable estimates applicable to both regression and classification. Experiments across diverse benchmarks and real-world industrial tasks demonstrate that HCM matches or surpasses ensemble and evidential approaches, with far lower inference cost and stronger confidence-error alignment. Our results highlight the power of geometric structure in uncertainty estimation and position HCM as a versatile alternative to conventional techniques.

</details>


### [484] [SMolLM: Small Language Models Learn Small Molecular Grammar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06322)
*Akhil Jindal,Harang Ju*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SMolLM是一个仅53K参数的权重共享Transformer，在ZINC-250K基准上生成新颖SMILES达到95%有效性，性能超越参数多10倍的标准GPT。机制上，同一模块按固定层次（括号→环→化合价）逐步解决SMILES约束，通过误差分类和线性探针揭示，消融实验隔离出括号匹配头部。实现了紧凑可解释的分子生成器，为形式语言领域的迭代计算研究提供测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解大规模语言模型如何学习化学语法（分子SMILES表示）的内部机制，探索小型可解释模型是否能在分子生成任务上媲美大模型。

Method: 提出SMolLM，一种53K参数的权重共享Transformer架构。通过误差分类、线性探针和消融实验分析模型内部处理SMILES约束的机制。

Result: SMolLM在ZINC-250K基准上以95%的有效性生成新颖SMILES，超越参数多10倍的标准GPT。模型同一模块按固定层次（括号→环→化合价）逐步解决SMILES约束。

Conclusion: 证明了紧凑、机制可解释的分子生成器的可行性，并为形式语言领域中的迭代计算研究提供了实验平台。

Abstract: Language models for molecular design have scaled to hundreds of millions of parameters, yet how they learn chemical grammar is poorly understood. We train SMolLM, a 53K-parameter weight-shared transformer, to generate novel SMILES with 95% validity on the ZINC-250K drug-like-molecule benchmark, outperforming a standard GPT with 10 times more parameters. Mechanistically, the same block resolves SMILES constraints across passes in a fixed hierarchy: brackets first, rings second, and valence last, as shown by error classification and linear probing, with ablation isolating the bracket-matching head. Together, these results yield a compact, mechanistically interpretable molecular generator and a testbed for studying iterative computation in formal-language domains.

</details>


### [485] [Order-Agnostic Autoregressive Modelling with Missing Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06355)
*Ignacio Peis,Pablo M. Olmos,Jes Frellsen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了顺序无关自回归模型（Order-Agnostic AR Models）在缺失数据场景下的应用，提出了缺失感知的顺序无关自回归模型（MO-ARM），在完全观测数据上隐式执行随机缺失插补，在不完全数据上提出了首个原则性训练框架，并利用其条件密度估计进行主动信息获取，在多个真实基准上优于现有插补基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 顺序无关自回归模型在深度生成建模中表现优异，但它们在缺失数据场景下的应用尚未被充分探索。现有工作缺乏将这类模型系统应用于不完整数据的理论与方法。

Method: 1) 理论分析表明标准训练在完全随机缺失机制下隐式执行插补；2) 提出首个针对一般缺失机制下不完全数据训练的原则性框架；3) 利用摊销条件密度估计进行主动信息获取，顺序选择最具信息量的缺失变量。

Result: 在多个真实世界基准数据集上，MO-ARM一致性地优于已有的插补基线方法。

Conclusion: 顺序无关自回归模型可以有效应用于缺失数据场景，MO-ARM为缺失数据下的生成建模和主动信息获取提供了统一且有效的框架。

Abstract: Order-Agnostic autoregressive models have demonstrated strong performance in deep generative modeling, yet their use in settings with incomplete data remains largely unexplored. In this work, we reinterpret them through the lens of missing data. First, we show that their standard training procedure on fully observed data implicitly performs imputation under a missing completely at random mechanism, resulting in robust out-of-sample imputation performance in settings with high missingness. Second, we introduce the first principled framework for training them directly on incomplete datasets under general missingness mechanisms. Third, we leverage their amortized conditional density estimation to perform active information acquisition, i.e., sequentially selecting the most informative missing variables for downstream prediction or inference. Across a suite of real-world benchmarks, our Missingness-Aware Order-Agnostic Autoregressive Model (MO-ARM) consistently outperforms established imputation baselines.

</details>


### [486] [Prune-OPD: Efficient and Reliable On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07804)
*Zhicheng Yang,Zhijiang Guo,Yifan Song,Minrui Xu,Yongxin Wang,Yiwei Wang,Xiaodan Liang,Jing Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prune-OPD通过动态检测学生与教师之间的前缀漂移，实时截断无效推理轨迹并重分配计算资源，在保持或提升推理性能的同时减少37.6%-68.0%的训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统同策蒸馏（OPD）在长程推理任务中面临关键缺陷：学生生成前缀不可避免偏离教师思维过程，导致教师稠密奖励失去局部可利用性，继续在漂移轨迹上生成和评估token不仅降低奖励质量还造成巨大计算浪费。

Method: 提出Prune-OPD框架，通过持续监控学生与教师预测的局部兼容性（如top-k重叠），实时检测前缀漂移事件。检测到严重漂移后，单调降低后续不可靠奖励权重并触发动态rollout截断，将计算重分配至可靠的教师监督区域。

Result: 在多种教师-学生组合下，Prune-OPD在AMC、AIME、HMMT等挑战性基准上保持甚至提升性能，同时减少37.6%-68.0%训练时间。当师生兼容性高时，自动保留长上下文监督并扩展训练窗口。

Conclusion: Prune-OPD提升OPD的关键不在于盲目缩短rollout，而是将计算重分配至局部可用的教师奖励上，实现训练预算与监督质量的自适应对齐。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) leverages dense teacher rewards to enhance reasoning models. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon tasks exposes a critical flaw: as the student's generated prefix inevitably diverges from the teacher's thought process, the teacher's dense reward loses local exploitability. Continuing to generate and evaluate tokens on these ``drifted'' trajectories not only degrades reward quality but also incurs massive computational waste. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Prune-OPD}, a framework that dynamically aligns training budgets with supervision quality. By continuously monitoring the local compatibility between student and teacher predictions (e.g., via top-$k$ overlap), Prune-OPD detects prefix-drift events in real time. Upon detecting severe drift, it monotonically down-weights subsequent unreliable rewards and triggers dynamic rollout truncation. This allows the training process to halt futile generation and reallocate compute strictly to reliable teacher supervision. Across diverse teacher-student combinations, Prune-OPD consistently aligns computation with supervision reliability. When prefix drift makes dense teacher rewards unreliable, it reduces training time by 37.6\%--68.0\% while preserving, and often improving, performance on challenging benchmarks (AMC, AIME, HMMT). When student-teacher compatibility remains high, it automatically preserves long-context supervision by expanding the training window. These results suggest that Prune-OPD improves OPD not by blindly shortening rollouts, but by reallocating computation toward locally exploitable teacher rewards.

</details>


### [487] [PRIM: Meta-Learned Bayesian Root Cause Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08786)
*Christopher Lohse,Anish Dhir,Amadou Ba,Bradley Eck,Marco Ruffini,Jonas Wahl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRIM是一种因果元学习方法，通过仿真-贝叶斯推理框架将根因分析转化为分布差异推断任务，利用MACE Transformer神经过程在17毫秒内实现零样本推理，在合成与真实数据集上达到与已知因果结构方法竞争的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决复杂系统根因分析中误差传播、因果结构知识需求和测试时推理计算成本高等挑战，提出无需显式统计检验和结构学习的端到端方法。

Method: 采用基于先验拟合网络的仿真元学习范式，通过MACE（模型平均因果估计）Transformer神经过程联合关注观测样本、异常样本和节点因果结构，在合成因果先验上进行贝叶斯边际化，隐式推断基线期与异常期数据生成机制间的分布差异。

Result: 在合成基准和PetShop、CausRCA两个真实基准数据集上，PRIM与已知因果图的方法性能相当，在多项任务上优于不依赖因果图的方法，且轻量微调可进一步提升性能。对于100变量系统，零样本推理仅需17毫秒。

Conclusion: PRIM通过元学习实现了高效、零样本的根因分析，无需测试时拟合因果结构，兼顾了计算效率和性能竞争力。

Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) in complex systems is challenging due to error propagation across multiple variables, the need for structural causal knowledge, and the computational cost of inference at test time. We introduce PRIM (Prior-fitted Root cause Identification with Meta-learning), a causal meta-learning approach that frames RCA as a Bayesian inference task over a synthetic prior of causal models. By marginalising out structural uncertainty, PRIM implicitly identifies changes in the data-generating mechanism between baseline and anomalous periods. In doing so, PRIM infers distributional differences without explicit statistical testing, and implicitly learns causal structure without model fitting at test time. Following the simulation-based meta-learning paradigm of prior-fitted networks, PRIM uses a Model-Averaged Causal Estimation (MACE) transformer neural process that jointly attends over observational and anomalous samples and the causal structure of nodes, enabling zero-shot inference in 17,ms for systems with up to 100 variables. Across synthetic benchmarks and two realistic benchmark datasets, PetShop and CausRCA, PRIM is competitive with methods that are aware of the system's causal graphical structure a priori while outperforming graph-unaware methods on several tasks. Lightweight fine-tuning to specific domains and data dynamics improves performance further.

</details>


### [488] [Inpainting physics: self-supervised learning for context-driven fluid simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08832)
*Jonas Weidner,Yeray Martin-Ruisanchez,Daniel Rueckert,Benedikt Wiestler,Julian Suk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将稳态CFD推理重新定义为修复问题，通过自监督先验和局部邻域分词器，在神经代理模型中实现可重用的流场先验，在颅内动脉瘤血流动力学任务中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经代理模型作为前向算子训练，受限于训练时的边界条件和几何条件，难以应对边界条件偏移或局部几何变化，缺乏可重用性。

Method: 将稳态CFD推理重新定义为修复问题；学习速度场的自监督先验，推理时仅通过固定已知区域（入口、出口、未变化区域）施加边界约束；引入局部邻域分词器将高分辨率速度场压缩为紧凑空间潜在token；在潜在token上训练流匹配和掩码自编码器模型。

Result: 在颅内动脉瘤血流动力学任务中，该方法能从稀疏边界上下文重建完整速度场；在边界条件偏移和数据集偏移下均优于有监督神经代理模型；支持局部几何编辑，复用未变化的模拟上下文。

Conclusion: 将CFD推理视为上下文条件化的修复问题，能够将神经代理模型从任务特定的预测器转变为可重用的流场先验。

Abstract: Neural surrogate models for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are typically trained as forward operators that map explicit problem specifications, such as geometry and boundary conditions, to solution fields. This ties the model to the conditioning variables seen during training and limits reuse under boundary-condition shifts or local geometry changes. We propose to reformulate steady CFD inference as an inpainting problem: instead of training on explicit boundary conditions, we learn a self-supervised prior over velocity fields and impose boundary constraints only during inference by fixing known regions such as inlet, outlet or unchanged regions from previous simulations. To scale this idea to large 3D meshes, we introduce a local neighbourhood tokeniser that represents high-resolution velocity fields as compact spatial latent tokens and train latent flow-matching and masked-autoencoder models on these tokens. On intracranial aneurysm hemodynamics, our method reconstructs full velocity fields from sparse boundary context, outperforms supervised neural surrogates under boundary-condition and dataset shift and enables local geometry editing by reusing unchanged simulation context. These results suggest that viewing CFD inference as context-conditioned inpainting can turn neural surrogates from task-specific predictors into reusable flow priors.

</details>


### [489] [TopoGeoScore: A Self-Supervised Source-Only Geometric Framework for OOD Checkpoint Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08870)
*Farid Hazratian,Ali Zia,Hien Duy Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TopoGeoScore，一种仅利用源域表示（无目标域样本或标签）的无监督鲁棒性评分方法，通过提取类流形的几何与拓扑特征（Laplacian行列式、Ollivier-Ricci曲率、高阶拓扑摘要）并自监督学习权重，实现分布外场景下的鲁棒检查点选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在目标域标签不可用且甚至无法获取目标域样本的极受限场景下，如何仅凭源域表示评估模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性并选择最佳检查点，是一个尚未解决的难题。

Method: 对每个检查点，从源域嵌入构建类条件互k近邻图，提取三种可解释信号：基于扭转思想的简化Laplacian对数行列式（全局流形复杂度）、Ollivier-Ricci曲率（局部邻域规则性）、高阶拓扑摘要（碎片连通性、环路、全局-局部不一致性）；通过自监督目标学习非负线性权重，保持几何保持视图下的不变性并与结构破坏视图分离。

Result: 在CIFAR系列腐蚀/分布偏移基准、ImageNet-C、MNLI→HANS迁移、OGBN-Arxiv等任务上验证有效，表明源域表示中确实蕴含可测量的全局-局部-拓扑鲁棒性证据。

Conclusion: TopoGeoScore能够在无需任何目标域信息的情况下，基于源域表示的几何与拓扑结构实现有效的鲁棒检查点选择，为实际部署前的模型筛选提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness is difficult to diagnose when target-domain labels are unavailable. We consider a more restrictive source-only variant of unsupervised accuracy estimation: selecting robust checkpoints using only source-domain representations, with no target samples or target labels. We propose \textbf{TopoGeoScore}, a source-only geometric scorer for label-free OOD checkpoint selection. Given a trained checkpoint, we construct class-conditional mutual $k$-nearest-neighbour graphs from source embeddings and extract three interpretable signals: a torsion-inspired reduced Laplacian log-determinant for global class-manifold complexity, Ollivier--Ricci curvature for local neighbourhood regularity, and higher-order topological summaries for fragmented connectivity, loops, and global--local inconsistency. Instead of fixing their weights by hand, TopoGeoScore learns a non-negative linear score through a self-supervised objective that enforces invariance under approximately geometry-preserving embedding views and separation from structure-breaking views. The score remains interpretable and uses no target-domain samples or labels. Results across CIFAR-based corruption and distribution-shift benchmarks, ImageNet-C, MNLI$\to$HANS transfer, and OGBN-Arxiv suggest that source representations contain measurable global--local--topological evidence of robustness, supporting practical checkpoint selection before deployment under distribution shift.

</details>


### [490] [Nearly-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Kernelized Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10299)
*Shogo Iwazaki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究对抗性环境下的核化赌博机（高斯过程赌博机），证明指数权重算法可达到$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T γ_T})$的对抗性遗憾，对SE和Matérn核给出了与算法无关的下界以证明最优性，并提出了基于Nyström近似的计算高效变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有核化赌博机研究主要假设奖励函数由随机过程生成，而现实场景中奖励可能由对手恶意选择，因此需要研究对抗性环境下的核化赌博机算法及其理论保证。

Method: 采用指数权重（Exponential-weight）算法处理对抗性奖励；利用Nyström近似降低计算复杂度，同时保持近最优的遗憾界。

Result: 证明指数权重算法实现$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T γ_T})$的对抗性遗憾；对SE和Matérn核给出算法无关下界，证明最优性（至多对数因子）；Nyström近似变体保持近最优遗憾。

Conclusion: 指数权重算法在对抗性核化赌博机中是最优的（至多对数因子），且可通过Nyström近似实现计算高效性。

Abstract: This paper studies kernelized bandits (also known as Gaussian process bandits) in an adversarial environment, where the reward functions in a known reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) may be adversarially chosen at each round. We show that the exponential-weight algorithm achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T γ_T})$ adversarial regret, where $T$ and $γ_T$ denote the number of total rounds and the maximum information gain, respectively. For squared exponential (SE) and $ν$-Matérn kernels, we also show algorithm-independent lower bounds that guarantee the optimality of our algorithm up to polylogarithmic factors. Furthermore, we present a computationally efficient variant of our algorithm using Nyström approximation while maintaining nearly optimal regret guarantees.

</details>


### [491] [Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization for On-Policy Reasoning Distillation under Large Policy Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13230)
*Xinyu Liu,Kechen Jiao,Chunyang Xiao,Runsong Zhao,Junhao Ruan,Bei Li,Jiahao Liu,Qifan Wang,Xin Chen,Jingang Wang,Chenglong Wang,Tong Xiao,JingBo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有基于策略的知识蒸馏(OPD)方法在师生策略差异较大时效果不佳，为此提出TGPO方法，通过教师直接指导token级生成并结合RLVR奖励，在推理基准上持续优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于逆KL(RKL)的在线策略蒸馏方法在师生策略差异较大时，RL驱动的探索会产生教师分布之外的轨迹，导致无效负面反馈，限制了蒸馏效果。

Method: TGPO提出教师直接指导token级别的生成（基于学生生成的上下文），并结合RLVR风格的轨迹级奖励，协同引导探索朝向更优的延续方向。

Result: 在推理基准上，TGPO持续优于现有RKL-based OPD方法，且在不同教师模型下保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: TGPO通过教师直接参与token级生成指导，有效解决了大策略差异下的蒸馏失效问题，为推理导向的后训练提供了更鲁棒的方案。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a promising paradigm for reasoning-oriented post-training of large language models (LLMs), especially when combined with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing OPD methods rely on reverse KL (RKL)-based teacher supervision over trajectories sampled from the student policy. However, we identify a critical limitation: under large teacher--student policy divergence, RL-driven exploration often produces trajectories outside the teacher distribution, resulting in uninformative negative feedback. To address this, we propose Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization (TGPO), an on-policy reasoning distillation method that remains effective under large policy divergence settings. Rather than relying solely on evaluative supervision, TGPO uses teacher to directly guide token level generation conditioning on student-generated contexts; together with RLVR-style trajectory level rewards, TGPO steers exploration toward improved continuations. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks show that TGPO consistently outperforms existing RKL-based OPD methods and remains robust across different teacher models.

</details>


### [492] [TabPFN-3: Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13986)
*Léo Grinsztajn,Klemens Flöge,Oscar Key,Felix Birkel,Philipp Jund,Brendan Roof,Mihir Manium,Shi Bin Hoo,Magnus Bühler,Anurag Garg,Dominik Safaric,Jake Robertson,Benjamin Jäger,Simone Alessi,Adrian Hayler,Vladyslav Moroshan,Lennart Purucker,Philipp Singer,Alan Arazi,Julien Siems,Jan Hendrik Metzen,Georg Grab,Nick Erickson,Siyuan Guo,Eliott Kalfon,Simon Bing,David Salinas,Clara Cornu,Lilly Charlotte Wehrhahn,Diana Kriuchkova,Kursat Kaya,Lydia Sidhoum,Marie Salmon,Jerry Chen,Madelon Hulsebos,Yann LeCun,Samuel Müller,Bernhard Schölkopf,Sauraj Gambhir,Noah Hollmann,Frank Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TabPFN-3是新一代表格数据基础模型，支持百万级训练样本，在标准基准上显著超越所有基线模型，同时推理速度提升20倍，并引入测试时计算扩展、支持关系数据、时间序列和表格文本数据等新能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据驱动科学与工业中的大多数高价值预测问题，现有TabPFN虽推动了基础模型革命，但在数据规模、推理效率和模态覆盖上仍有不足，用户反馈也指向这些痛点。

Method: 基于用户反馈，模型扩展到支持100万训练行，仅使用合成数据预训练，引入测试时计算扩展机制，采用缩减的KV缓存和行分块策略实现单卡H100上百万行快速推理，并针对时间序列、关系数据和表格文本数据开发专用检查点。

Result: 在TabArena上前向传播显著超越所有调优和集成基线，Pareto主导速度/性能前沿；在百万行/200特征数据集上击败8小时调优的梯度提升树基线；TabPFN-3-Plus在TabArena上超越所有非TabPFN模型200+ Elo（大数据子集达420 Elo），比AutoGluon 1.5 extreme快10倍；时间序列基准fev-bench排名第二；SHAP计算加速120倍；整体比TabPFN-2.5快20倍。

Conclusion: TabPFN-3大幅推进了表格预测的前沿，通过规模扩展和速度优化实现了更强的性能与效率，并拓展到更多数据模态，为表格基础模型设立了新标杆。

Abstract: Tabular data underpins most high-value prediction problems in science and industry, and TabPFN has driven the foundation model revolution for this modality. Designed with feedback from our users, TabPFN-3 builds on this foundation to scale state-of-the-art performance to datasets with 1M training rows and substantially reduce training and inference time. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data from our prior, TabPFN-3 dramatically pushes the frontier of tabular prediction and brings substantial gains on time series, relational, and tabular-text data. On the standard tabular benchmark TabArena, a forward pass of TabPFN-3 outperforms all other models, including tuned and ensembled baselines, by a significant margin, and pareto-dominates the speed/performance frontier. On more diverse datasets, TabPFN-3 ranks first on datasets with many classes, and beats 8-hour-tuned gradient-boosted-tree baselines on datasets up to 1M training rows and 200 features. TabPFN-3 introduces test-time compute scaling to tabular foundation models. Our API offering TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) exploits this to beat all non-TabPFN models by over 200 Elo on TabArena, rising to 420 Elo on the largest data subset, and outperforms AutoGluon 1.5 extreme while being 10x faster, without using LLMs, real data, internet search or any other model besides TabPFN. TabPFN-3 extends the capabilities of our models, enabling SOTA prediction on relational data (new SOTA foundation model on RelBenchV1) and tabular-text data (SOTA on TabSTAR via TabPFN-3-Plus); and improves existing integrations: a specialized checkpoint, TabPFN-TS-3, ranks 2nd on the time-series benchmark fev-bench, and SHAP-value computation is up to 120x faster. TabPFN-3 achieves this performance while being up to 20x faster than TabPFN-2.5. In addition, a reduced KV cache and row-chunking scale to 1M rows on one H100 with fast inference speed.

</details>


### [493] [Latency-Quality Routing for Functionally Equivalent Tools in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14241)
*Kexin Chu,Dawei Xiang,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 LQM-ContextRoute，一个面向同功能工具提供商的上下文赌博机路由器，通过延迟-质量匹配机制在运行时负载下优化路由决策，在多个基准上超越 SW-UCB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当多个功能等价但延迟、可靠性和回答质量各异的工具提供商共存时，现有方法将延迟与质量在加性奖励中混合，导致低延迟掩盖低质量，无法适应运行时负载变化。

Method: 提出延迟-质量匹配（Latency-Quality Matching）机制：按每个服务周期内的预期回答质量对提供商排序，结合查询特定的质量估计和 LLM-as-judge 反馈，实现在线自适应路由。

Result: 在 Web 搜索负载基准上 F1 提升 +2.18 pp；在 StrategyQA 高异质性设置下准确率提升最高 +18 pp；在异构检索器池上 NDCG 提升 +2.91~+3.22 pp。

Conclusion: 同功能工具路由应将领延迟视为服务容量而非奖励中的补偿项，尤其在运行时压力与提供商质量异质性并存时效果显著。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents increasingly access the same tool type through multiple functionally equivalent providers, such as web-search APIs, retrievers, or LLM backends exposed behind a shared interface. This creates a provider-routing problem under runtime load: the router must choose among providers that differ in latency, reliability, and answer quality, often without gold labels at deployment time. We introduce LQM-ContextRoute, a contextual bandit router for same-function tool providers. Its key design is latency-quality matching: instead of letting low latency offset poor answers in an additive reward, the router ranks providers by expected answer quality per service cycle. It combines this capacity-aware score with query-specific quality estimation and LLM-as-judge feedback, allowing it to adapt online to both load changes and provider-quality differences. On the main web-search load benchmark, LQM-ContextRoute improves F1 by +2.18 pp over SW-UCB while staying on the latency-quality frontier. In a high-heterogeneity StrategyQA setting, LQM-ContextRoute avoids additive-reward collapse and improves accuracy by up to +18 pp over SW-UCB; on heterogeneous retriever pools, it improves NDCG by +2.91--+3.22 pp over SW-UCB. These results show that same-function tool routing benefits from treating latency as service capacity, especially when runtime pressure and provider-quality heterogeneity coexist.

</details>


### [494] [Turning Stale Gradients into Stable Gradients: Coherent Coordinate Descent with Implicit Landscape Smoothing for Lightweight Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14373)
*Chen Liang,Xiatao Sun,Qian Wang,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种确定性、样本高效且预算感知的零阶优化器 Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD)，通过利用梯度相干性将历史梯度转化为计算资产，实现了 $O(1)$ 查询复杂度，并在 MLP、CNN、ResNet 等架构上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零阶优化方法面临样本低效（如标准有限差分）或高方差（如随机子空间方法）之间的权衡，亟需一种既高效又稳定的方法。

Method: 提出 CoCD，基于梯度相干性概念，等价于带"热启动"的块循环坐标下降（BCCD），将历史梯度从负担转化为计算资产，实现每步 $O(1)$ 查询复杂度；同时利用大步长有限差分的隐式平滑效应提升收敛稳定性。

Result: 在 MLP、CNN 和 ResNet（多达 27 万参数）上，CoCD 在样本效率和收敛损失/准确率上显著优于 BCCD，且相比随机化 ZO 方法具有更好的稳定性。

Conclusion: 确定性的、结构感知的更新方式为轻量级零阶优化提供了优于随机化方法的替代方案。

Abstract: Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization is pivotal for scenarios where backpropagation is unavailable, such as memory-constrained on-device learning and black-box optimization. However, existing methods face a stark trade-off: they are either sample-inefficient (e.g., standard finite differences) or suffer from high variance due to randomized estimation (e.g., random subspace methods). In this work, we propose Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD), a deterministic, sample-efficient, and budget-aware ZO optimizer. Theoretically, we formalize the notion of gradient coherence and demonstrate that CoCD is equivalent to Block Cyclic Coordinate Descent (BCCD) with ``warm starts,'' effectively converting historical (stale) gradients from a liability into a computational asset. This mechanism enables $O(1)$ query complexity per step while maintaining global descent directions. Furthermore, we derive error bounds revealing a counter-intuitive insight: larger finite-difference step sizes can induce an implicit smoothing effect on the optimization landscape by reducing the effective smoothness constant, thereby improving convergence stability. Experiments on MLP, CNN, and ResNet architectures (up to 270k parameters) demonstrate that CoCD significantly outperforms BCCD in terms of sample efficiency and convergence loss/accuracy, and exhibits superior stability over randomized ZO methods. Our results suggest that deterministic, structure-aware updates offer a superior alternative to randomization for lightweight ZO optimization.

</details>


### [495] [DualKV: Shared-Prompt Flash Attention for Efficient RL Training with Large Rollouts and Long Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15422)
*Jiading Gai,Shuai Zhang,Xiang Song,Bernie Wang,George Karypis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DualKV 是一种消除 RL 后训练中共享提示词复制的 FlashAttention 核变体，通过融合前向/反向核与数据流水线重设计，在 GRPO/DAPO 训练中实现 1.63–3.82× 策略更新加速，并将 MFU 从 36% 提升至 76%+。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 GRPO、DAPO 等 RL 后训练方法中，对 N 条响应序列使用标准 FlashAttention 会导致共享提示词的 P 个 token 被复制 N 次，在长上下文、大 rollout 场景下造成大量计算和内存冗余。尽管因果掩码使提示词表示在不同序列间不变，但现有核尚未利用此特性来消除冗余。

Method: (1) 融合 CUDA 前向和反向核：在单次核启动中遍历两个不相交的 KV 区域——共享上下文（提示词）和每条序列的响应部分；(2) 在 veRL 框架中重新设计数据流水线，将 N(P+R) 个 token 重打包为 P+NR 个 token 每微批，将 token 减少从注意力层扩展到整个模型，缩减因子 ρ = N(P+R)/(P+NR)。该方法在数学上等价于标准注意力，无近似。

Result: 在 Qwen3-8B GRPO 训练（8×H100, N=32, 8K 上下文）上实现 1.63–2.09× 策略更新加速、2× 更大微批次、MFU 从 36% 提升至 76%；DAPO 上获得 2.47× 加速、77% MFU；在 30B MoE 规模（16×H100）上相比 FlashAttention（需 4 路 Ulysses 序列并行避免 OOM）实现 3.82× 策略更新加速和 3.38× 端到端步加速。

Conclusion: DualKV 通过核级优化消除 RL 训练中共享提示词的计算和内存冗余，显著提升吞吐和内存效率，且无需近似，在大规模 RL 后训练中具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: Modern RL post-training methods such as GRPO and DAPO train on $N$ response sequences of $R$ tokens sampled from a shared prompt of $P$ tokens, but standard FlashAttention replicates all $P$ prompt tokens $N$ times across both forward and backward passes -- duplicating compute and memory on identical hidden states. In large-rollout, long-context RL training ($N{\geq}16$, $P{\geq}8\text{K}$), this redundancy dominates the policy update cost. We observe that in decoder-only models, causal masking makes prompt representations invariant across sequences at every layer, so all per-token operations (norms, projections, MLP) and attention can process the prompt once -- a property not yet exploited at the kernel level for training. We propose \textbf{DualKV}, the first FlashAttention kernel variant that eliminates shared-prompt replication during RL training, via (1)~fused CUDA forward and backward kernels that iterate over two disjoint KV regions -- shared context and per-sequence response -- in a single kernel launch, and (2)~a data-pipeline redesign in veRL that repacks $N(P{+}R)$ tokens into $P{+}NR$ tokens per micro-batch, extending the token reduction from attention to the entire model by a factor $ρ= N(P{+}R)/(P{+}NR)$. DualKV is mathematically equivalent to standard attention and introduces no approximation. On Qwen3-8B GRPO training with 8$\times$H100 GPUs ($N{=}32$, 8K-context), DualKV achieves $1.63$--$2.09\times$ policy-update speedup, enables $2\times$ larger micro-batches, and raises MFU from $36\%$ to $76\%$. Similar gains hold for DAPO ($2.47\times$ speedup, $77\%$ MFU). At 30B MoE scale on 16$\times$H100, DualKV achieves $3.82\times$ policy-update and $3.38\times$ end-to-end step speedup over FlashAttention (which requires 4-way Ulysses sequence parallelism to avoid OOM).

</details>


### [496] [To MRL or not to MRL: Text Embeddings are Robust to Truncation Without Matryoshka Learning, Except In Heavy Truncation Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16608)
*Sotaro Takeshita,Yurina Takeshita,Simone Paolo Ponzetto,Daniel Ruffinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究MRL（Matryoshka Representation Learning）与随机截断（Random Truncation）作为文本嵌入压缩方法的对比，发现除非进行重度截断（减少80%以上维度），未使用MRL训练的模型通过简单截断也能取得与MRL模型相当甚至更优的下游性能，表明截断鲁棒性可能并非MRL特有。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明随机截断文本嵌入对下游性能影响甚微，但尚无工作系统比较MRL与随机截断的有效性，因此本文旨在厘清两者作为嵌入压缩方法的优劣。

Method: 对使用MRL和未使用MRL训练的多种文本编码器应用相同的截断操作，并在多个下游任务上对比其性能表现。

Result: 除非嵌入维度减少80%以上，非MRL模型的截断嵌入性能与MRL模型相当甚至更优；仅在重度截断场景下MRL体现出优势。

Conclusion: 截断鲁棒性并非MRL所独有，是否采用MRL取决于是否需要支持重度截断（如减少80%以上维度）的场景。

Abstract: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is a widely adopted approach for training text encoders so they provide useful text representations at various sizes, available by simply truncating the resulting vectors at sizes pre-determined at training time. Recent works have shown that randomly truncating text embeddings has minimal impact in downstream performance unless vectors are reduced in size by at least 70%, suggesting that embeddings are already robust to truncation without the use of MRL. However, no prior work has compared random truncation to MRL, so it is unclear how the two methods compare as effective embedding reduction methods. In this paper, we study this by applying the same truncation used by MRL to models trained with and without MRL. Our results across several models and downstream tasks show that, unless heavily truncating embeddings (i.e. reducing their size by at least 80%), truncated embeddings of non-MRL models are competitive with, and often outperform models trained with MRL. This suggests that truncation robustness may not necessarily come from MRL, and that the choice of spending the additional training cost of MRL depends on whether heavy truncation is desired. We make our code available for reproduction.

</details>


### [497] [Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20612)
*Ziye Chen,Hongbin Lin,Jie Li,Lijie Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Matryoshka概念瓶颈模型（MCBM），通过嵌套层次化概念结构实现自适应概念利用，将期望干预成本从线性降至对数级别O(log K)，并在单个模型内支持多粒度推理而无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）在测试时干预成本高昂，要么使用单一静态概念集导致专家需穷举标注，要么训练多个针对不同概念预算的模型造成巨大计算和维护开销。

Method: 受Matryoshka表示学习启发，基于最大相关性和最小冗余原则将概念组织成嵌套层次结构，使单个模型能在无需重训练的情况下支持多粒度概念推理。

Result: 理论上将期望干预成本从线性降至对数阶O(log K)并保证单调性能提升；实验上与独立训练模型性能相当，同时实现动态高效的专家交互。

Conclusion: MCBM通过统一架构有效解决了CBM部署中干预成本高的问题，实现了自适应概念利用与高效专家交互的平衡。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) have emerged as a prominent paradigm for interpretable deep learning, learning by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, their practical deployment is hindered by the high cost of test-time intervention, as correcting model errors typically requires human experts to manually inspect and verify a large set of predicted concepts. Existing approaches suffer from a fundamental structural limitation: they either adopt a single static concept set, forcing experts to exhaustively annotate concepts and incurring prohibitive intervention costs, or train multiple models tailored to different concept budgets, resulting in substantial computational and maintenance overhead. To address this challenge, we propose the Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Model (MCBM), a unified architecture that enables adaptive concept utilization within a single model. Inspired by Matryoshka Representation Learning, MCBM organizes concepts into a nested hierarchy based on maximum relevance and minimum redundancy, allowing inference at multiple levels of conceptual granularity without retraining. Theoretically, we show that MCBM reduces the expected intervention costs from linear to logarithmic order, $O(\log K)$, while guaranteeing monotonic performance improvement. Empirically, extensive experiments demonstrate that MCBM matches the performance of independently trained models while enabling dynamic and efficient expert interaction.

</details>


### [498] [A Tutorial on Diffusion Theory: From Differential Equations to Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22586)
*Jiayi Fu,Yuxia Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本教程从微分方程视角统一阐述了扩散模型的理论基础，包括条件高斯加噪过程、ODE/SDE表示、逆向时间SDE和概率流ODE、分数匹配与去噪目标、以及DDPM、DDIM、流匹配和基于分数的SDE等方法的统一框架，并延伸到连续嵌入空间中的扩散语言模型和离散掩码令牌扩散。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型的数学基础（扩散概率模型、基于分数的建模、随机微分方程、数值采样方法）通常被分开阐述，缺乏统一的视角。本文旨在提供一个自洽的、基于微分方程的统一教程，弥合扩散过程的分析基础与现代生成算法之间的鸿沟。

Method: 从条件高斯加噪过程出发，推导出常微分方程（ODE）和随机微分方程（SDE）表示；进而得到边缘前向动力学、逆向时间SDE和概率流ODE；通过分数匹配导出去噪目标函数（噪声预测参数化）；在统一框架下涵盖DDPM、DDIM、流匹配和基于分数的SDE，并扩展到连续嵌入空间的扩散语言模型和离散掩码令牌扩散。

Result: 建立了扩散模型各主流方法（DDPM、DDIM、流匹配、基于分数的SDE）在微分方程视角下的统一理论框架，阐明了逆向采样中边际分数是核心未知量、分数匹配等价于标准去噪目标等关键结论，并将框架延伸至语言模型领域。

Conclusion: 该教程为扩散模型的数学基础与现代生成算法之间搭建了桥梁，提供了一个自洽、统一的微分方程视角，有助于研究者深入理解扩散模型的理论本质并指导算法设计。

Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as a dominant framework for generative modeling, but their mathematical foundations are often presented separately through diffusion probabilistic models, score-based modeling, stochastic differential equations, and numerical sampling methods. We write this tutorial to provide a unified and self-contained account of these viewpoints from the perspective of differential equations. Starting from a conditional Gaussian noising process, we derive ordinary differential equation (ODE) and stochastic differential equation (SDE) representations, pass to the corresponding marginal forward dynamics, and then obtain the reverse-time SDE and probability-flow ODE that make generation possible. We show that the central unknown quantity in reverse sampling is the marginal score, explain how score matching becomes the standard denoising objective under a noise-prediction parameterization, and discuss practical reverse-time sampling and guidance. We further place DDPM, DDIM, flow matching, and score-based SDEs in a common framework, and conclude with diffusion language models in continuous embedding space together with a brief discussion of discrete masked-token diffusion. The tutorial is intended as a bridge between the analytical foundations of diffusion processes and the modern generative algorithms built upon them.

</details>


### [499] [The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22737)
*Youssef Allouah,Mahdi Haghifam,Sanmi Koyejo,Reza Shokri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过一个效用约束的教师与自适应学生之间的极小极大博弈，研究模型蒸馏攻击中的部署权衡。提出了自适应的评估规则（学生重加权高价值样本）和教师端防御模板（抑制最有蒸馏价值的输出）。基于样本价值的廉价代理，提出了Product-of-Experts (PoE)防御方法——一种仅需前向传播、结合教师与代理学生进行生成的简单方案。实验表明，自适应评估揭示了巨大的被动-自适应差距：对于最先进的防御方法，自适应学生在GSM8K和MATH上恢复的能力远超被动评估所显示的。在这种更强的评估下，昂贵防御与PoE之间的鲁棒性差距显著缩小，而PoE仍保持更低的成本和更高质量的推理痕迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏攻击为模型提供者制造了一个部署权衡：使模型更有用的输出同时也使其更易被模仿。现有防御评估多采用被动学生（简单蒸馏），未能充分反映自适应攻击者的威胁，需要更真实的评估框架和更高效的防御方法。

Method: 1) 建立效用约束教师与自适应学生间的极小极大博弈框架；2) 提出自适应评估规则（学生侧重加权高价值样本）和教师侧防御模板（抑制高蒸馏价值输出）；3) 基于样本价值的廉价代理，提出Product-of-Experts (PoE)防御——将教师与代理学生结合生成。

Result: 1) 自适应评估揭示了巨大的被动-自适应差距：最先进防御下自适应学生恢复能力远超被动评估；2) 在更强评估下，昂贵防御与PoE的鲁棒性差距显著缩小；3) PoE保持更低成本和更高质量的推理痕迹。

Conclusion: 强蒸馏攻击仍然难以阻止，抗蒸馏进展应针对自适应学生而非被动学生进行评判。代码已开源。

Abstract: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a cheap proxy for example value, we derive Product-of-Experts (PoE), a simple forward-pass-only defense that combines the teacher with a proxy student during generation. Empirically, adaptive evaluation reveals a large passive--adaptive gap: on state-of-the-art defenses, adaptive students recover substantially more capability than passive evaluation suggests on GSM8K and MATH. Under this stronger evaluation, the apparent robustness gap between expensive defenses and PoE narrows considerably, while PoE remains substantially cheaper and preserves higher-quality reasoning traces. Overall, our results suggest that strong distillation remains difficult to stop, and that progress on antidistillation should be judged against adaptive students rather than passive ones. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ysfalh/distillation-game.

</details>


### [500] [Building a privacy-preserving Federated Recommender system for mobile devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22924)
*Aasheesh Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种两阶段联邦推荐系统流水线，将非敏感偏好数据与敏感移动上下文数据分离，第一阶段在云端用协同过滤生成候选列表，第二阶段在设备端用敏感信号重排序，仅模型梯度离开设备，并在多个数据集上验证，提供了Kotlin跨平台生产级实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统移动端个性化推荐需要将敏感用户数据集中到服务器，这与日益增长的隐私期望和地区法规相冲突，亟需一种既能保护隐私又不牺牲推荐质量的方法。

Method: 两阶段联邦推荐流水线：(1) 云端阶段：基于非敏感应用上下文数据运行协同过滤模型，生成候选项目短列表；(2) 设备端阶段：利用敏感的移动信号（从未离开设备）对候选进行重排序，仅模型更新/梯度离开设备。

Result: 在MovieLens、UCI Human Activity Recognition及专有数据集上验证了方法有效性，并交付了可在Android和iOS上部署的Kotlin Multiplatform生产级库。

Conclusion: 该方法实现了非敏感与敏感数据的严格分离，在保护移动端敏感上下文数据的同时仍能提供个性化推荐，并具备跨平台生产部署能力。

Abstract: Serving personalized content on mobile devices has traditionally required pooling sensitive user data on centralized servers, a practice increasingly at odds with modern privacy expectations and geographical regulations. We present a two-stage federated recommendation system pipeline for mobile devices, built around a principled separation between non-sensitive user preference data and sensitive mobile context data that never leaves the device. The first stage runs a collaborative filtering model on non-sensitive app-context data in the cloud to generate a shortlist of relevant items. The second stage re-ranks these candidates on-device using sensitive mobile signals, with only model updates/gradients ever leaving the device. We validate the approach on MovieLens, UCI Human Activity Recognition, and a proprietary pilot dataset, and deliver a production-ready implementation as a Kotlin Multiplatform library deployable on Android and iOS.

</details>


### [501] [Self-supervised Adversarial Purification for Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23239)
*Woohyun Lee,Hogun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GPR-GAE框架，通过自监督图自编码器作为独立净化器，在分类前净化对抗扰动，实现防御鲁棒性与分类准确性的解耦，达到SOTA鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对抗训练方法将鲁棒性与准确性纠缠在单一分类器中，难以平衡二者间的trade-off；现有对抗净化方法缺乏对多样化图结构的自适应能力。

Method: 设计GPR-GAE作为专用净化器，采用自监督训练策略；利用多个广义PageRank（GPR）滤波器捕获多样化结构表示；通过多步净化过程实现精确图恢复。

Result: 在多种数据集和攻击场景下，GPR-GAE达到SOTA鲁棒性，可作为即插即用的独立净化器集成到GNN分类器中。

Conclusion: 将鲁棒性与分类器分离的净化范式有效解决了准确性与鲁棒性的冲突，GPR-GAE的结构自适应能力使其在实际防御场景中具有优越性。

Abstract: Defending Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) against adversarial attacks requires balancing accuracy and robustness, a trade-off often mishandled by traditional methods like adversarial training that intertwine these conflicting objectives within a single classifier. To overcome this limitation, we propose a self-supervised adversarial purification framework. We separate robustness from the classifier by introducing a dedicated purifier, which cleanses the input data before classification. In contrast to prior adversarial purification methods, we propose GPR-GAE, a novel graph auto-encoder (GAE), as a specialized purifier trained with a self-supervised strategy, adapting to diverse graph structures in a data-driven manner. Utilizing multiple Generalized PageRank (GPR) filters, GPR-GAE captures diverse structural representations for robust and effective purification. Our multi-step purification process further facilitates GPR-GAE to achieve precise graph recovery and robust defense against structural perturbations. Experiments across diverse datasets and attack scenarios demonstrate the state-of-the-art robustness of GPR-GAE, showcasing it as an independent plug-and-play purifier for GNN classifiers.

</details>
