### [502] [Tiny Brains, Giant Impact: Uncovering the Keystone Neurons of LLM with Just a Few Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24846)
*Xiangtian Ji,Yuxin Chen,Zhengzhou Cai,Xiang Wang,An Zhang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现大型语言模型中存在一类"关键神经元"（keystone neurons）——跨任务高度激活的稀疏神经元子集，移除它们会导致模型行为崩溃。这些神经元在预训练阶段建立且参数高度校准，基于此提出仅更新关键神经元的微调方法，在减少参数修改量的同时达到甚至超越全参数微调的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型展现出强大的综合能力，但其内部运作机制尚未被充分理解，作者希望揭示支撑模型行为的核心神经结构。

Method: 1）通过跨任务激活强度分析，从多个能力维度的Transformer中识别出始终高度激活的稀疏神经元子集；2）通过移除实验验证这些神经元对模型行为的决定性作用；3）提出仅更新关键神经元的监督微调方法。

Result: 关键神经元是模型稳定且固有的子集，主要在预训练阶段建立，其参数值在训练过程中被精确校准；仅更新关键神经元的微调方法在任务性能上可比肩甚至超越全参数微调，同时更好地保留其他能力维度的表现。

Conclusion: 识别出关键神经元揭示了LLM内部运作的核心机制，并提供了高效微调的新范式，在减少参数更新的同时保持了模型的综合能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) display strong comprehensive abilities, yet the internal mechanisms that support these behaviors remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we show that across a wide range of open-weight Transformers, a subset of neurons remains consistently highly activated during inference across tasks of multiple capability dimensions. By probing along the cross-task activation strength, an extremely sparse subset is isolated, whose removal causes a collapse in model behavior, which we term keystone neurons. Our analysis reveals that keystone neurons are a stable and intrinsic neuron subset of the model that is largely established during pretraining. The parameters associated with these neurons are tightly calibrated during the training process, and their precise values are critical for the capabilities of the model. Building on these insights, we propose a supervised fine-tuning approach that updates only keystone neurons, achieving task gains comparable to or even better than full-parameter fine-tuning while better preserving performance in other capability dimensions, despite modifying a much smaller number of parameters.

</details>


### [503] [Theoretical Analysis of Sparse Optimization with Reparameterization, Weight Decay, and Adaptive Learning Rate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25134)
*Huangyu Xu,Jingqin Yang,Qianqian Xu,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReWA方法（基于重参数化、权重衰减和自适应学习率），用于解决稀疏优化中$\ell_p$正则化（$0<p<1$）因梯度无界导致的优化不稳定问题。该方法与$\ell_p$正则化紧密相关，但具有更稳定的优化景观。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上用ResNet的实验表明，ReWA相比$\ell_1$正则化显著提升了稀疏性，同时保持了测试准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏优化在诸多实际应用中至关重要，但$\ell_p$正则化（$0<p<1$）存在梯度无界导致的优化不稳定性问题，亟需一种既保持稀疏性又具有稳定优化特性的方法。

Method: 提出ReWA方法，结合重参数化（Reparameterization）、权重衰减（Weight decay）和自适应学习率（Adaptive learning rate），构建与$\ell_p$正则化相关但优化景观更稳定的新目标。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet数据集上使用ResNet架构，ReWA相比$\ell_1$正则化显著提升了模型稀疏性，同时测试准确率保持不变。

Conclusion: ReWA是一种有效且稳定的稀疏优化方法，克服了$\ell_p$正则化的不稳定缺陷，在稀疏性和精度之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Sparse optimization is a fundamental challenge in various practical applications. A popular approach to sparse optimization is $\ell_p$ regularization. However, it may encounter optimization instability due to the unbounded gradients when $0<p<1$. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to sparse optimization termed ReWA, based on Reparameterization, Weight decay, and Adaptive learning rate. ReWA is closely connected to $\ell_p$-regularization, yet it unveils a distinct optimization landscape that helps mitigate instability issues. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with ResNets demonstrate that ReWA leads to significant sparsity improvements over the $\ell_1$-regularization approach while preserving test accuracy.

</details>


### [504] [Autoregression-Free Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25413)
*Jiaquan Zhang,Caiyan Qin,Haoyu Bian,Libin Cai,Yi Lu,Chaoning Zhang,Wei Dong,Yuanfang Guo,Yang Yang,Hen Tao Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自回归自由神经算子(AFNO)，将PDE的时间演化映射到潜空间并用流匹配学习连续时间向量场，避免自回归 rollout，实现长期稳定预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于神经算子的时间相关PDE求解方法采用自回归 rollout 方式在物理场空间中进行预测，导致长期预测时误差逐步累积，且缺乏连续时间建模能力。

Method: 将PDE时间演化映射到潜空间，在潜空间中利用流匹配(flow matching)学习连续时间向量场，通过显式条件化物理参数捕获不同参数配置下的动力学行为。

Result: 在六个PDE上的理论和实验表明，AFNO相比基线方法显著提升了长期预测稳定性，并持续降低了 rollout 误差。

Conclusion: AFNO通过潜空间连续时间建模和流匹配，有效克服了自回归 rollout 的误差累积问题，为长期PDE求解提供了更稳定的方案。

Abstract: Neural operators learn mappings from function-dependent inputs to solutions, providing an effective framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). For time-dependent PDEs, existing methods typically perform long-horizon prediction through autoregressive rollout directly in high-dimensional physical field spaces, where each predicted state is recursively fed back as the input for the next step. Although effective for short-term prediction, this autoregressive rollout and the lack of continuous-time modeling lead to progressive error accumulation over long-horizon rollouts. In this work, we propose Autoregression-Free Neural Operators (AFNO), which map the time evolution of PDEs into a latent space and model continuous-time vector fields within it. AFNO uses flow matching to learn the latent vector field, thereby enabling continuous evolution over extended horizons, avoiding autoregressive rollout and capturing dynamics under varying parameter configurations through explicit conditioning on physical parameters. Theoretical analysis and extensive experiments on six PDEs demonstrate that AFNO improves long-horizon prediction stability and consistently reduces rollout errors compared with the baselines.

</details>


### [505] [GoQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26092)
*Maoyang Xiang,Bo Wang,Tao Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GoQuant是一种算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过几何正交残差投影量化方法，在超低位宽（<4-bit）下用移位-加法操作替代密集MAC运算，解决了对数幂次量化中的低角度分辨率问题，在LLaMA-2-7B 3-bit量化下实现6.10困惑度，并将28nm工艺下的关键路径延迟降低至0.35ns。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型和视觉Transformer在边缘设备部署受限于内存和密集MAC阵列带来的时序瓶颈；超低位宽下的对数幂次量化虽硬件高效，但存在低角度分辨率固有限制，导致高维特征流形退化。

Method: 提出GoQuant，一种基于双基几何投影的量化框架：将量化问题转化为双基几何投影，通过严格的移位-加操作自适应合成高分辨率残差格点；采用解析求解器替代计算密集的梯度优化，全模型标定时间缩短至约15分钟。

Result: 在3-bit (W3/A16)约束下，LLaMA-2-7B困惑度达6.10，优于依赖非对称缩放的MAC密集型基线AWQ；4-bit场景下保持竞争精度。28nm标准单元RTL综合显示，并行移位-加数据通路将关键路径延迟降至0.35ns。

Conclusion: GoQuant通过算法-硬件协同设计有效缓解了超低位宽下对数量化低角度分辨率问题，实现了跨模态适用性和硬件效率，为边缘部署LLM/ViT提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds. To address this geometric limitation, we propose Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, GoQuant adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, its analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately 15 minutes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate GoQuant's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, it achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that GoQuant effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees. By flattening the combinational logic depth, our parallel shift-and-add datapath reduces the critical path delay to 0.35 ns.

</details>


### [506] [Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26193)
*Qideng Tang,Dai Chaofan,Wubin Ma,Yahui Wu,Haohao Zhou,Tao Zhang,Huan Li,Dalin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoAD框架，通过统一分类范式（Outlier Exposure）和重构范式（Masked Autoencoder），利用分类模块生成概率软掩码指导重构模块，同时重构模块缓解分类模块的泛化问题，实现对细微和复杂时间序列异常的有效检测。CoAD在高质量基准数据集上显著优于现有深度学习和传统方法，且轻量高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSAD方法存在两大问题：基于Outlier Exposure（OE）的分类方法泛化能力差，基于Masked Autoencoder（MAE）的重构方法存在掩码对齐问题。此外，现有深度学习方法在检测细微和持续异常方面表现不佳。

Method: 提出CoAD框架，包含两个协同模块：1) 分类模块生成概率软掩码（而非硬掩码），并解决分类粒度不当和频域信息忽略的问题；2) 重构模块利用分类模块提供的软掩码进行重建，同时缓解分类模块的泛化问题。两个模块相互协同，发挥互补优势。

Result: 在高质量基准数据集和严格评估协议下，CoAD显著优于现有SOTA深度学习方法和传统数据挖掘方法。同时CoAD模型轻量，推理速度远快于现有方法，适用于大规模实时应用。

Conclusion: 分类与重构双范式的统一协同设计能够有效克服各自缺陷，提升对细微和复杂异常检测能力，证明了深度学习在TSAD领域的潜力。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has long been a hot research topic in data mining due to its various applications. Recent studies challenge the effectiveness of popular deep learning methods for TSAD, suggesting their failure in detecting subtle and prolonged anomalies. Outlier Exposure (OE) and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) emerge as two promising paradigms (classification and reconstruction) for solving the above problems. However, OE-based methods are constrained by poor generalization, while MAE-based methods are limited by masking misalignment issues. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel framework, CoAD, which unifies the two paradigms to leverage their complementary strengths while mitigating their respective weaknesses. In this framework, the classification module generates probability-informed soft masks for the reconstruction module, which in turn alleviates the generalization problem of the classification module. This cooperative design enables CoAD to effectively detect subtle and complex anomalies that are often overlooked by existing methods. Additionally, the classification module is carefully designed to resolve issues related to improper classification granularity and the neglect of frequency information. Extensive experiments on high-quality benchmark datasets, conducted under rigorous evaluation protocols, demonstrate that CoAD significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art deep learning and traditional data mining methods, highlighting the potential of deep learning in TSAD. Moreover, CoAD is lightweight and substantially faster than existing SOTA methods, demonstrating its practical value for large-scale, real-time applications.

</details>


### [507] [On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26194)
*Sharmita Dey,Diego Paez-Granados*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PathoFM是一个面向脊髓损伤病理步态分析的时间序列基础模型，通过结合局部补全、时间连续性和无监督上下文动态三种互补预训练目标，实现了跨任务类型（分类与回归）和跨受试者的稳健表征迁移。实验表明，动态导向的目标组合比纯分组/对比或纯重建目标产生更平衡的迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床时间序列学习受限于小规模异构队列和协议漂移，而下游任务同时涵盖分类（病理诊断）和回归（时序预测），亟需探究何种归纳偏好的预训练目标能使表征跨任务类型和跨受试者迁移。

Method: 提出PathoFM，一个以编码器为中心的Transformer，在多元步态窗口上训练三种互补目标：(1)局部补全——重建连续掩码跨度以强化局部结构；(2)时间连续性——从观测前缀预测掩码中期延续以保证平滑性和因果一致性；(3)无监督上下文动态——通过注意力机制基于受试者样本窗口进行支持-查询重建。

Result: 对比目标族（分组/对比、动态导向、生成式重建）发现，动态导向的混合目标产生最平衡的迁移效果。分组目标有利于判别边界但损害连续目标所需的幅度保真度；纯重建目标保留波形结构但分类性能不足。结合局部重建与时间连续性，并在可获得样本时添加上下文条件，可生成鲁棒的跨受试者泛化表征。

Conclusion: 在脊髓损伤病理步态分析中，动态导向的预训练目标组合（局部重建+时间连续性+上下文条件）是实现分类与回归任务平衡迁移的最佳策略。

Abstract: Clinical time-series learning is routinely constrained by small, heterogeneous cohorts and protocol drift, while its downstream use spans both classification (e.g., pathology diagnosis) and regression (e.g., temporal forecasting). These constraints make foundation-model pretraining appealing, but raises an important question of which inductive biases should the pretraining objective impose so that representations transfer across task types and subjects. We study this question in pathological gait analysis for spinal cord injury (SCI) via PathoFM, an encoder-centric transformer pretrained on multivariate gait windows with three complementary objectives: Local Completion (reconstruct contiguous masked spans to enforce local structure), Temporal Continuity (predict a masked mid-horizon continuation from an observed prefix to enforce smoothness and causal consistency), and Unsupervised In-Context Dynamics (support-query reconstruction conditioned on subject exemplar windows via attention). Empirically comparing objective families (grouping/contrastive, dynamics-based, and generative reconstruction), we find that dynamics-centric mixtures produce the most balanced transfer: grouping objectives favor discriminative margins but can degrade magnitude fidelity needed for continuous targets, whereas reconstruction-only objectives preserve waveform structure but may underperform on classification. Overall, combining local reconstruction with temporal continuity, and adding in-context conditioning when exemplar access is realistic, yields robust subject-generalizing representations.

</details>


### [508] [Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26408)
*Valentina V. Kuskova,Dmitry Zaytsev,Michael Coppedge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文批评了当前时间序列因果发现中普遍使用标量边分数来总结非线性模型学习到的因果关系的做法，指出这掩盖了状态依赖的函数型因果影响。作者使用神经加性向量自回归模型，提出了基于个体条件期望的函数型因果响应函数估计框架，实验证明标量分数无法区分多样的非线性因果行为，而函数型分析能发现被忽视的体制特定和不对称因果结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前时间序列因果发现中，非线性机器学习模型学到的因果关系几乎总是被简化为标量边分数，作者认为这种做法掩盖了非线性自回归模型真正学到的对象——一个随状态、幅度和情境变化的状态依赖函数，标量因果分数构成了严重的信息瓶颈，混淆了状态间变异与状态内残差噪声。

Method: 针对可加性、贡献可分解架构形式化了函数型因果影响的概念；以神经加性向量自回归为代表架构，提出了基于个体条件期望的实用框架，直接从训练好的模型估计因果响应函数；通过受控合成实验和有代表性的案例研究（民主发展）进行验证。

Result: 在合成实验中，标量分数无法区分的边可以展现出性质不同的函数行为，包括单调、阈值、饱和和符号翻转效应；在民主发展的案例分析中，函数型分析揭示了被分数中心方法系统性遗漏的体制特定和非对称因果结构。

Conclusion: 标量因果分数构成信息瓶颈，不足以刻画非线性时间序列因果发现中学到的丰富因果结构；函数型因果分析能够揭示被传统标量方法忽视的重要因果模式，应成为非线性因果推断的标准实践。

Abstract: Causal discovery in time series is increasingly performed using nonlinear machine-learning models, yet the resulting causal relationships are almost always summarized by scalar edge scores. We argue that this practice obscures the true object learned by nonlinear autoregressive models: a state-dependent function whose effect varies across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. We formalize function-valued causal influence for additive, contribution-decomposable architectures and show that scalar causal scores constitute a severe information bottleneck, conflating between-state variation with within-state residual noise. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a representative architecture, we introduce a practical framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation for estimating causal response functions directly from trained models. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors, including monotonic, thresholded, saturating, and sign-changing effects. An applied case study on democratic development further shows that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.

</details>


### [509] [Localizing Memorized Regions in Diffusion Models via Coordinate-Wise Curvature Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26756)
*Gwangho Kim,Sungyoon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于几何特征（坐标方差坍塌）的扩散模型局部记忆检测方法，通过曲率差分（减去欠拟合基线模型的曲率）来区分过拟合驱动的记忆与数据固有约束，并推导了分数差分代理指标。在Stable Diffusion上的实验表明，该方法在记忆定位（生成图像的局部区域）上优于基于注意力的现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆检测方法多依赖全局或模型级信号，难以定位记忆在生成图像中的具体出现位置；同时需要区分过拟合驱动的记忆与数据固有约束导致的相似现象。

Method: 1) 将局部记忆表征为坐标方差的几何坍塌；2) 提出曲率差分方法，通过减去无条件模型或欠拟合版本的曲率来隔离过拟合记忆；3) 推导分数差分代理指标，为现有的分数差检测指标提供几何解释。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion上的实验表明，所提方法在记忆定位（以真实记忆掩码为基准）上优于先前的注意力定位方法。

Conclusion: 曲率差分能有效区分过拟合记忆与数据固有约束，分数差分代理指标为记忆检测提供了几何理论支撑。

Abstract: Diffusion models can unintentionally memorize training samples, raising concerns about privacy and copyright. While recent methods can detect memorization, they often rely on global or model-specific signals and provide limited insight into where memorization appears within a generated image. We provide a geometric characterization of local memorization as a coordinate-wise variance collapse. However, such collapse can also arise from intrinsic data constraints rather than overfitting. To isolate overfitting-driven memorization, we propose curvature-difference methods that subtract the curvature of an underfitted baseline, either the unconditional model or a less-trained version of itself. We further derive a score-difference proxy that provides a geometric explanation for the widely used score-difference-based detection metric. Experiments on Stable Diffusion, evaluated against ground-truth memorization masks, show that our method outperforms the prior attention-based localization method. Code is available at https://github.com/Gwangho99/mem-curv-diff.

</details>


### [510] [Two Speeds of Learning: A Representation-Readout Decomposition of Grokking and Double Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27078)
*Chi-Ning Chou,Oscar Uzdelewicz,Neng-Chun Chiu,Yao-Yuan Yang,SueYeon Chung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了表征-读出分解框架，通过分析编码器表征学习和最终分类器读出校准两个竞争过程的相对速度，统一解释了神经网络的怪诞泛化（grokking）和逐轮双下降现象，并在多种任务和架构上验证了该框架的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的训练损失和准确率信号难以解释grokking（训练损失快速下降但测试性能延迟提升）和逐轮双下降（测试损失先升后降）等异常泛化现象，且缺乏跨任务和架构的通用分析框架。

Method: 提出表征-读出分解框架，利用表征几何、神经正切核和线性探针等工具，将学习动态分解为编码器表征学习和分类器读出校准两个过程，分析两者的相对速度波动如何导致异常泛化现象。

Result: 在多种任务和架构上验证了框架的普适性：发现grokking前读出偏向训练集，表征学习虽缓慢但并非不存在（反驳了lazy-to-rich假说）；揭示了MNIST grokking和逐轮双下降中，非标准训练引起的表征退化和读出失调是异常泛化的真正原因。

Conclusion: 表征-读出分解为理解学习动态提供了自顶向下的分析框架，可用于诊断泛化行为并揭示底层算法，对可解释性研究有重要价值。

Abstract: Training loss and accuracy are the standard signals used to monitor generalization during deep neural network training. Two well-documented phenomena complicate this picture: in grokking, train loss falls rapidly while test performance improves abruptly only after a long delay; in epoch-wise double descent, train loss decreases monotonically while test loss or error rises and falls. Existing accounts are often task-specific, and a task-agnostic analysis framework for diagnosing and explaining these phenomena across realistic tasks and architectures is missing. We address this challenge by analyzing two competing processes that underlie learning dynamics: representation learning in the encoder and readout calibration in the final classifier. Using tools from representational geometry, neural tangent kernels, and linear probing, we show that both processes are active throughout training, with the fluctuations of their relative speed giving rise to seemingly anomalous generalization dynamics. Applying the representation-readout decomposition to grokking across a wide range of tasks and architectures, we find that the readout is train-biased before grokking onset, and representation learning is gradual but not absent, contrary to the lazy-to-rich account. The framework further provides diagnostic signatures distinguishing spurious from genuine generalization: in a previously reported MNIST grokking example and an epoch-wise double descent example, apparent delayed or non-monotone generalization is shown to arise from representation degradation and readout misalignment induced by non-standard training recipes. Together, these results establish the representation-readout decomposition as a top-down framework for understanding learning dynamics and revealing underlying algorithms for interpretability research.

</details>


### [511] [Density-aware Sample-specific Attack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27809)
*Qiyuan Wang,Yao Li,Raymond K. W. Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于密度比估计的双层优化后门攻击方法，通过将触发样本引导至干净数据分布的低密度区域，实现了对微调和神经元剪枝等后训练防御的完全免疫，攻击成功率保持在99%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门攻击方法容易受到微调或剪枝等后训练防御的影响，需要设计一种能够抵御这些防御的鲁棒后门攻击方法。

Method: 通过贝叶斯最优受害者训练模型推导出最优样本特定触发构建的准则，利用条件时间分数匹配估计密度比，并优化混合模型目标将触发样本置于低密度区域。

Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、GTSRB和TinyImageNet上，攻击成功率超过99%；微调防御下后防御ASR比最强基线高50-85个百分点；对神经元剪枝防御完全免疫。

Conclusion: 当前防御范式存在根本性缺陷，需要开发在干净分布支撑集之外运作的防御方法。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in backdoor attacks, existing methods remain susceptible to post-training defenses that erase the backdoor through fine-tuning or pruning. We revisit the core objectives of backdoor attacks and derive principled criteria characterizing optimal sample-specific trigger construction under a Bayes-optimal model of the victim's training. Our analysis reveals that both attack success and clean-accuracy preservation are simultaneously optimized when triggered samples are steered into low-density regions of the clean data distribution, a distributional condition that controls all moments of the poisoned distribution at once rather than a handful of input-space summary statistics. We introduce a bilevel optimization framework that estimates density ratios via conditional time-score matching and optimizes a mixture-model objective to place triggered samples in these sparse regions. Extensive evaluations on MNIST, CIFAR-10, GTSRB, and TinyImageNet demonstrate that our method achieves above 99\% attack success rate before defense and retains 50--85 percentage points higher post-defense ASR than the strongest baselines under fine-tuning defenses. Against neuron-pruning defenses, the method exhibits complete immunity, with zero neurons identified for removal across all pruning thresholds. These results expose a fundamental gap in current defense paradigms and underscore the need for defenses that operate beyond the support of the clean distribution.

</details>


### [512] [Continual Learning in Modern Hopfield Networks with an Application to Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27975)
*Ken Takeda,Masafumi Oizumi,Ryo Karakida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过现代Hopfield能量分析了扩散模型在持续学习中的遗忘机制，证明高能量、离群样本更容易被遗忘，而基于能量选择的重放样本能有效缓解遗忘，并在Stable Diffusion和DDPM上验证了理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型等生成模型越来越多地作为基础模型并通过顺序微调进行适配，但持续学习在这类生成模型中尚未被充分理解：任务变化后，学习分布的哪些方面最易丢失？应优先选择哪些重放样本？

Method: 利用现代Hopfield网络(MHN)与扩散模型之间的联系，将MHN中的分析迁移到扩散模型。引入"内在遗忘"作为任务变化后Hopfield能量的增加。在MHN中证明高能量、离群样本比聚类样本经历更大的能量增长，并分析记忆重放的有效性。在MHN和两种扩散模型(Stable Diffusion和像素空间DDPM)上验证预测。

Result: 证明了高能量、离群样本在任务变化后遗忘更严重；基于能量的重放样本选择对高能量样本尤为有效；在扩散模型中，Hopfield能量能够追踪基于重建的遗忘，且重放实验表明遗忘缓解与能量相关，与MHN分析一致。

Conclusion: 现代Hopfield能量为理解和缓解生成模型持续学习中的遗忘提供了有效的理论框架和分析工具，基于能量的重放策略具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Generative models, including diffusion models, are increasingly used as foundation models and adapted through sequential fine-tuning, making continual learning an essential problem setting. However, continual learning in such generative models remains poorly understood: after a task change, what aspects of the learned distribution are most easily lost, and what replay samples should be prioritized? We address these questions through the modern Hopfield energy. Recent links between modern Hopfield networks (MHNs) and diffusion models allow analyses in MHNs to be transferred to diffusion models. We introduce intrinsic forgetting as an increase in Hopfield energy after the task change. In tractable settings in an MHN, we prove that high-energy, outlier-like samples undergo a larger energy increase than cluster-like samples, implying that samples located in sharp, isolated basins are more forgettable. We further analyze memory replay and show that replay is particularly effective for high-energy samples, enabling an energy-based selection of replay samples. We validate these predictions in experiments on MHNs and two diffusion models under continual-learning settings: Stable Diffusion and a pixel-space DDPM. In these diffusion models, Hopfield energy tracks reconstruction-based forgetting, and replay experiments reveal energy-dependent mitigation of forgetting that is consistent with the MHN analysis.

</details>


### [513] [QuITE: Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28166)
*JungHoon Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QuITE，一种即插即用的嵌入模块，通过可学习查询令牌和单层自注意力机制将不规则多元时间序列转换为规则表示，无需修改骨干网络架构或引入人工插值，在预测和分类任务上分别取得最高54.7%和15.8%的平均相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有处理不规则多元时间序列的方法要么设计专用架构限制模型复用，要么通过插值映射到规则网格引入人工失真，缺乏既能兼容现有模型又不引入噪声的通用方案。

Method: QuITE模块使用可学习查询令牌（query tokens）通过单层自注意力聚合不规则观测数据，直接生成与骨干网络兼容的潜在表示，无需生成人工值或修改架构。

Result: 在多个真实基准数据集上，QuITE一致提升现有MTS模型性能，预测任务平均相对提升最高54.7%，分类任务最高15.8%。

Conclusion: 不规则采样的关键瓶颈在于传统嵌入层假设均匀采样，而非骨干架构本身；QuITE作为即插即用模块可有效解决该问题。

Abstract: Irregular Multivariate Time Series (IMTS) are common in practice, yet their irregular sampling complicates effective modeling. Existing approaches typically either (i) design specialized architectures that limit the reuse of proven Multivariate Time Series (MTS) models, or (ii) map IMTS onto regular temporal grids through interpolation, which may distort temporal dynamics by introducing artificial values. To address these limitations, we propose a new input-embedding-based approach. We identify that the key bottleneck lies not in the backbone architecture, but in conventional embedding layers that assume uniform sampling. In this work, we introduce QuITE (Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding), a simple yet effective plug-and-play embedding module for IMTS. QuITE employs learnable query tokens to aggregate irregular observations through a single self-attention layer, directly producing backbone-compatible latent representations without artificial value generation or architectural modification. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks show that QuITE consistently improves MTS models, yielding average relative gains of up to $54.7\%$ in forecasting and $15.8\%$ in classification across diverse datasets and backbone architectures. Code is available at: https://github.com/Meaningfull9502/QuITE.

</details>


### [514] [ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28293)
*Hongru Hou,Tiehua Mei,Denghui Geng,Jinhui Huang,Ao Xu,Hengrui Chen,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对主动推荐系统(PRS)中强化学习策略梯度存在的路径长度依赖偏差和高梯度方差两个缺陷，提出了ProRL框架，通过Stepwise Reward Centering和Position-Specific Advantage Estimation两种机制，在三个真实世界数据集上显著超越了现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动推荐系统(PRS)旨在通过生成中间推荐路径引导用户偏好向目标物品转移，但直接应用策略梯度方法存在梯度估计缺陷：（1）路径级奖励分解为具有正均值的步级奖励，产生长度依赖偏差，使梯度偏向路径延伸而非有意义探索；（2）用整个路径奖励加权每一步忽略了分解结构，导致高梯度方差。

Method: 提出ProRL框架，包含两种创新机制：（1）Stepwise Reward Centering（步级奖励居中）——减去期望奖励以消除长度依赖偏差，确保路径延伸产生零期望梯度信号；（2）Position-Specific Advantage Estimation（位置特定优势估计）——利用奖励分解结构计算步级依赖的基线，降低梯度方差。

Result: 在三个真实数据集上的实验表明，ProRL显著优于现有的主动推荐系统方法。

Conclusion: 通过纠正策略梯度中路径长度偏差和高方差问题，ProRL框架能够更精准地优化路径质量，从而在主动推荐任务中取得更优性能。

Abstract: Proactive Recommender Systems (PRSs) aim to guide user preference shift toward target items by generating paths of intermediate recommendations. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for optimizing such sequential decision tasks, as path rewards can naturally capture both short-term acceptance and long-term guidance effectiveness. However, naively applying policy gradients to PRS results in deficient gradient estimation. We identify two deficiencies: (1) path-level rewards decompose into step-level rewards with positive mean, creating a length-dependent bias that causes gradients to favor path extension over meaningful exploration; (2) weighting each step by the entire path-level reward ignores the decomposition structure, leading to high gradient variance. To rectify these two deficiencies, we propose an effective RL framework ProRL with two novel mechanisms for proactive recommendation. First, Stepwise Reward Centering subtracts expected rewards to neutralize length-dependent bias, ensuring that path extension yields zero expected gradient signal. Second, Position-Specific Advantage Estimation leverages the reward decomposition structure to compute step-dependent baselines, reducing gradient variance. Together, these mechanisms yield policy gradients that precisely target path quality. Our experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that ProRL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art PRSs. Our code is available at https://github.com/hongruhou89/ProRL.

</details>


### [515] [LEIA: Learned Environment for Interactive Architected Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28368)
*Haiqian Yang,Yuan Cao,Markus J. Buehler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LEIA，一种面向超构材料的交互式世界模型，能够实时模拟施加边界条件后的变形与应力场，并基于MicroPlate基准测试验证其在微观结构显式建模与隐式建模两个场景下的有效性，进一步展示了其在超构材料快速代理搜索设计中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型可支持游戏环境和机器人操作中的交互式探索，但物理工程领域中的真实材料具有非线性本构关系、依赖历史的内部状态、惯性动力学以及多尺度层次结构，现有的方法难以处理这些复杂特性。

Method: 提出LEIA（Learned Environment for Interactive Architected materials），一种自回归世界模型，支持用户逐步施加边界条件，实时输出变形与应力场；能够处理大规模三维非结构化网格。同时引入MicroPlate基准，包含显式微观结构（三维超构点阵）和隐式微观结构（均质板通过内部自由度建模）两个场景。

Result: 在MicroPlate基准上，LEIA与四种基线方法对比，在两个微观结构建模场景中均表现出色。进一步实验表明，LEIA能够实现高效的候选生成与排序，支持基于代理模型的快速超构材料搜索设计，且应力准确度经有限元真实验证。

Conclusion: LEIA成功将世界模型范式拓展到超构材料力学仿真领域，实现了交互式、实时的边界条件响应预测，并为超构材料的快速设计搜索提供了高效工具。

Abstract: World models have enabled interactive exploration of game environments and robotic manipulation, but physical engineering remains beyond their reach: real materials exhibit nonlinear constitutive laws, carry history-dependent internal state, undergo inertial dynamics, and may possess hierarchical structures spanning multiple length scales. We present LEIA (Learned Environment for Interactive Architected materials), a world model that lets engineers apply boundary conditions step by step and observe the resulting deformation and stress fields in real time. LEIA handles large three-dimensional unstructured meshes and generates autoregressive responses to user-specified loading. We introduce MicroPlate, a benchmark of architected plates spanning two regimes of microstructure modeling: architected lattices that resolve microstructure explicitly through three-dimensional geometry, and a homogeneous plate where microstructural change is modeled implicitly through internal degrees of freedom. MicroPlate is used to assess LEIA alongside four baseline methods across both regimes. Finally, we demonstrate that LEIA enables efficient candidate generation and ranking for fast surrogate-guided search for de novo designs of architected materials, with stress-accurate candidate ranking validated by finite element ground truth.

</details>


### [516] [Revisiting Metafeatures to Explain Model Differences on Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28418)
*Markus Herre,Andrej Tschalzev,Sascha Marton,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于TabArena基准测试，系统分析了数据集元特征是否能解释不同模型族（神经网络vs树模型、非基础模型vs基础模型）在表格数据预测任务上的性能差异。经过严格的统计检验，发现元特征对性能差异的解释力非常有限，且元特征预测器在留一数据集预测中无法显著优于简单基线，表明表格数据集的异质性使得全局元特征方法不够鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型的兴起与传统模型仍表现良好的现状并存，使得为特定表格数据集选择合适模型成为一个难题。研究者希望探究数据集元特征是否能帮助解释不同模型族之间的性能差距，以指导模型选择。

Method: 利用TabArena基准测试结果，分析数据集层面的性能差距，并将其与模型无关的数据集描述符（元特征）进行关联分析。采用严格的统计检验（假发现率控制），并进行留一数据集预测验证。

Result: (1) 神经网络与树模型的性能差距中，无元特征通过假发现率控制；(2) 非基础模型与基础模型的差距中，有一个关联稳健但无法泛化到留一数据集预测；(3) TabICLv2与TabPFN-2.6之间，一个稳健关联能改善留出预测。整体上，元特征预测器无法显著优于简单基线。

Conclusion: 表格数据集的高度异质性使得全局元特征方法不够稳健，无法为51个TabArena数据集提供有解释力的性能差距解释。

Abstract: With the rise of tabular foundation models alongside traditional models still performing well on many tasks, choosing the right model for a tabular dataset remains difficult. We investigate whether dataset meta-features can explain performance gaps between model families on tabular prediction tasks. Using the TabArena benchmark results, we analyze dataset-level performance gaps and relate them to model-agnostic dataset descriptors. After strict statistical tests with false discovery control, we find that (1) for neural network vs. tree gaps, no meta-feature survives false discovery control, (2) for non-foundation vs. foundation model gaps, one association is robust but does not generalize when tested in leave-one-dataset-out prediction, and (3) for TabICLv2 vs. TabPFN-2.6, one robust association also improves held-out prediction. Furthermore, we conduct a leave-one-dataset-out analysis and find that meta-feature predictors fail to improve meaningfully over a simple baseline. Overall, our results show the heterogeneity of tabular datasets and that global meta-feature approaches are not robust enough to offer explanations on the 51 TabArena datasets.

</details>


### [517] [Stage-wise Distortion-Perception Traversal in Zero-shot Inverse Problems with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28711)
*Jiawei Zhang,Ziyuan Liu,Leon Yan,Zhenyu Xiao,Yuantao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MAP-RPS（及其潜空间扩展LMAP-RPS），一种基于单扩散模型的零样本逆问题求解框架，通过分阶段策略（先MAP估计逼近MMSE解以获得低失真初始化，再重噪声后验采样逐步提升感知质量）实现失真-感知（D-P）权衡的灵活遍历，理论分析与实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管扩散模型在零样本逆问题求解中取得了成功，但如何在扩散逆算法中实现高效且原则性的D-P权衡遍历仍缺乏充分研究。现有方法难以在推理时灵活调整失真与感知质量的平衡。

Method: 提出MAP-RPS两阶段框架：第一阶段执行MAP估计（近似MMSE解），提供低失真初始化；第二阶段对结果加噪后进行后验采样，逐步改善感知质量。理论分析证明了两阶段设计的有效性与合理性。进一步扩展至潜空间得到LMAP-RPS，兼容大规模预训练潜扩散模型。

Result: 大量实验表明，MAP-RPS和LMAP-RPS在多种任务上实现了更有效的D-P遍历，同时作为真实世界逆问题的高效求解器表现出强劲性能。

Conclusion: 所提分阶段框架为扩散模型在零样本逆问题中实现灵活的失真-感知权衡提供了理论严谨且实用的解决方案，潜空间扩展进一步提升了方法的通用性。

Abstract: The distortion-perception (D-P) tradeoff is a fundamental phenomenon of Bayesian inverse problems, which characterizes the inherent tension between distortion performance and perceptual quality. Enabling flexible traversal of the D-P tradeoff at inference time is crucial for practical applications. Despite the recent success of diffusion models in zero-shot inverse problem solving, efficient and principled strategies for D-P traversal in diffusion-based inverse algorithms remain inadequately characterized. In this paper, we propose a stage-wise framework for realizing D-P traversal using a single diffusion model in zero-shot inverse problems. Our proposed method, termed MAP-RPS, starts with an MAP estimation stage that approximates the MMSE solution and provides a low-distortion initialization, followed by a re-noised posterior sampling stage that progressively improves perceptual quality. We provide theoretical analyses for both stages, establishing the validity and effectiveness of the proposed design. Furthermore, we extend MAP-RPS to the latent space, yielding LMAP-RPS, which enjoys broader applicability by leveraging large-scale pre-trained latent diffusion backbones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAP-RPS and LMAP-RPS enable more effective D-P traversal on various tasks, while also exhibiting strong performance as efficient solvers for real-world inverse problems.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [518] [Human-in-the-Loop Swarms: A Bionic Swarm Approach to Real-World Soil Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29091)
*Petras Swissler,Mohammadali Rashidioun,Nicholas Sahu,Raaid Kabir,Ayodeji Aderibigbe,Oladoyin Kolawole*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"Bionic Swarm"系统，通过人类在环的方法将机器人的复杂任务抽象给人类用户，降低现场和群体机器人研究的准入门槛，并验证了Score-Biased-Search地理搜索算法在真实户外环境中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 群体和现场机器人技术由于硬件部署的高成本和高开发时间，面临现实世界验证的重大障碍，需要一种降低准入门槛的方法。

Method: 提出Bionic Swarm系统，通过智能手机Web应用接收蓝牙连接传感器的测量数据，将数据转发至中央服务器运行群体算法，再向人类用户发送行动指令，形成人类在环的抽象层。同时设计了Score-Biased-Search搜索算法，对重建地图上的每个位置分配分数，通过高预期分数区域偏置搜索模式。

Result: Score-Biased-Search算法在仿真中表现出相对于搜索代理数量的超线性地图重建能力；在Bionic Swarm平台上成功实现了真实户外环境下的算法验证。

Conclusion: 这种人类在环的方法显著降低了现场和群体机器人研究的准入门槛，为群体机器人算法的真实世界验证提供了一种低成本、高效率的替代方案。

Abstract: Swarm and field robotics face significant barriers to real-world validation due to the high cost and development time to deploy hardware. This paper introduces the ``Bionic Swarm,'' a novel system that lowers these barriers by abstracting away many of the tasks that are difficult to implement on robots but which do not contribute to the overall algorithm evaluation, giving these tasks to human users. These human users take directions from a smartphone web-app that takes measurements from Bluetooth-connected sensors and relays them to a centralized server. This server runs the swarm algorithm and directs actions to the human users. We evaluate this system through the experimental validation of a geotechnically-focused search algorithm named Score-Biased-Search, which functions by assigning a ``score'' to each location on a reconstructed map, then biases search patterns through areas of higher expected scores, and which exhibits superlinear map reconstruction relative to the number of search agents. After presenting simulation results for the algorithm, we then apply the algorithm on the Bionic Swarm platform to validate its function in a real-world, outdoor setting. This work demonstrates that this human-in-the-loop approach significantly lowers the barrier to entry for field and swarm robotics research.

</details>


### [519] [CA-AC-MPC: CUDA-Accelerated Actor-Critic Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29155)
*Antoonio Buo,Vittorio Cammarota,Michele Avagnale,Pierluigi Arpenti,Vincenzo Lippiello,Fabio Ruggiero*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种CUDA加速的AC-MPC方法，在保持控制性能的同时显著减少了训练和推理时间，并在无人机竞速任务中实现了最先进的圈速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AC-MPC的可微MPC层在前向和反向传播中需要反复求解优化问题，导致训练和推理延迟过大，限制了其实用性。

Method: 引入CUDA加速的变体，对AC-MPC中的可微MPC层进行并行化加速，减少端到端执行时间。

Result: 在无人机竞速任务中实现了最先进的圈速和接近极限的动态行为，同时训练和推理时间显著减少。

Conclusion: CUDA加速有效解决了AC-MPC的计算瓶颈，在不牺牲控制性能的前提下大幅提升了效率。

Abstract: In the literature, actor-critic model predictive control (AC-MPC) integrates MPC with reinforcement learning to enable high-performance control of complex dynamical systems. However, its differentiable MPC layer requires repeatedly solving an optimization problem in both the forward and backward passes, leading to substantial training and inference latency. This paper tackles this bottleneck introducing a CUDA-accelerated variant that significantly reduces end-to-end execution time while preserving the control performance of the baseline formulation. Simulation results on an agile drone racing task show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art lap times and near-limit dynamic behaviour with markedly reduced training and inference time.

</details>


### [520] [The Open Motion Planning Library 2.0](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29301)
*Weihang Guo,Theodoros Tyrovouzis,Emiliano Flores,Clayton W. Ramsey,Zachary K. Kingston,Ioan A. Şucan,Mark Moll,Lydia E. Kavraki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OMPL 2.0 是运动规划库的重大升级版本，通过硬件加速实现实时运动规划，并无缝集成现代AI研究工作流。该库自2008年发布以来，持续扩展了新的规划器、状态空间和问题公式化方法，已成为采样-based运动规划领域的基石。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现实时运动规划并集成现代AI研究工作流，以满足日益增长的实时性需求和AI与运动规划交叉领域的研究需求。

Method: 通过硬件加速（如GPU、FPGA等）提升计算效率，同时优化软件架构以支持与AI研究工具链的无缝集成。

Result: 发布了OMPL 2.0，实现了实时运动规划能力，并与现代AI研究工作流实现了无缝集成。

Conclusion: OMPL 2.0是运动规划库的重大演进，通过硬件加速满足了实时运动规划的需求，并与AI研究深度融合，进一步巩固了OMPL在运动规划领域的基石地位。

Abstract: The Open Motion Planning Library (OMPL), first released in 2008, has become a cornerstone of the motion planning community, providing implementations of a wide range of state-of-the-art sampling-based algorithms. Over almost two decades of continuous development, we have steadily expanded the library with new planners, state spaces, and problem formulations. These additions range from asymptotically optimal and lazy planners to constrained motion planning and planning with temporal-logic goals. Building on this foundation, we introduce OMPL 2.0, a major evolution of the library that targets real-time motion planning through hardware acceleration and integrates seamlessly with modern AI research workflows. We also reflect on how OMPL and the field of motion planning have grown together over the years, and discuss the library's broader impact on the research community.

</details>


### [521] [Decentralized LLM-Driven Coordination of Acoustic Robots for Contactless Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29378)
*Yingying Wang,Narsimlu Kemsaram,Sriram Subramanian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个去中心化框架，结合Whisper语音识别、大语言模型语义解析、JSON任务表示和分布式调度，实现了通过自然语言指挥配备超声相控阵的声学机器人进行非接触式物体操作。在TurtleBot3平台上验证了顺序、并行和同步协作三种场景，任务成功率分别为96%、86%和70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言接口可以简化非专业用户对多机器人系统的高层指令交互，而超声相控阵声学操控技术已用于医疗、实验室自动化和精密运输等非接触式应用，但将大语言模型与分布式声学移动机器人相结合的研究尚属空白。

Method: 采用去中心化框架，通过Whisper进行语音识别、LLM进行语义解析，将口语指令转化为结构化的JSON任务表示（编码机器人分配、时间依赖、空间约束和同步需求），再通过分布式调度生成可执行的多机器人任务计划，在配备超声相控阵的两台TurtleBot3机器人上实现。

Result: 顺序执行任务成功率96%、并行多机器人运输86%、同步协作操作70%。

Conclusion: 自然语言指令可成功转化为分布式机器人非接触式操作动作，展示了LLM驱动的自动化在分布式机器人系统中人机交互的潜力。

Abstract: Natural language interfaces can simplify interaction with multi-robot systems, especially when non-expert users need to issue high-level commands. Acoustic manipulation using ultrasonic phased arrays also enables contactless object handling for applications such as healthcare, laboratory automation, and precision transport. However, combining large language models (LLMs) with distributed acoustic mobile robots remains underexplored. This paper presents a decentralized framework for natural language-driven coordination of acoustic robots for contactless object manipulation. The system converts spoken instructions into executable multi-robot task plans using Whisper-based speech recognition, LLM-based semantic parsing, structured JSON task representation, and distributed scheduling. The JSON schema encodes robot assignments, temporal dependencies, spatial constraints, and synchronization requirements for sequential, parallel, and synchronized execution. The system is implemented on two TurtleBot3-based acoustic robots, each equipped with an ultrasonic phased array for contactless object transport. Experiments were conducted in three scenarios: sequential execution, parallel multi-robot transport, and synchronized cooperative manipulation. The system achieved task success rates of 96 percent for sequential tasks, 86 percent for parallel execution, and 70 percent for synchronized collaborative transport. These results show that natural language commands can be transformed into distributed robot actions for contactless manipulation, highlighting the potential of LLM-driven automation for human-robot interaction in distributed robotic systems.

</details>


### [522] [Phase-Conditioned Imitation Learning with Autonomous Failure Recovery for Robust Deformable Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29407)
*Dayuan Chen,Kai Tang,Yukuan Zhang,Kazuhiro Kosuge,Yasuhisa Hirata*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种相位条件化、力感知的框架PhASER，用于鲁棒的柔性物体操作。通过FiLM条件化的ACT编码器实现相位特定行为，结合多模态相位预测器（视觉、力、位姿）实时检测接触失败并自主触发恢复轨迹，混合阻抗控制器保证柔顺执行。在双机械臂挂、脱T恤任务中，挂载成功率从56%提升至87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准模仿学习策略（如ACT）在推理时依赖马尔可夫假设，导致视觉相似但需要矛盾动作的观测产生状态混淆，且无法自主从执行失败中恢复，鲁棒性不足。

Method: 1) FiLM条件化的ACT编码器，根据当前任务相位调制特征提取，实现相位特定行为共享动力；2) 多模态相位预测器（视觉+力+位姿）实时估计相位，检测视觉不可见的接触失败并触发恢复轨迹；3) 混合阻抗控制器用于柔顺执行；4) 触觉遥操作接口用于力感知数据采集。

Result: 消融实验表明FiLM调制显著优于无条件和token级条件基线；t-SNE分析显示FiLM产生良好分离的相位特定特征表示；在双机械臂挂T恤任务中，闭环系统将成功率从56%提升至87%。

Conclusion: 所提出的相位条件化、力感知闭环分层架构有效解决了柔性物体操作中的状态混淆和失败恢复问题，显著提升了操作鲁棒性。

Abstract: This paper presents a phase-conditioned, force-aware framework for robust deformable object manipulation. Standard imitation learning policies such as Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) rely on a Markovian assumption at inference, causing state aliasing when visually similar observations require contradictory actions and preventing autonomous recovery from execution failures. We address this with a closed-loop hierarchical architecture. A FiLM-conditioned ACT encoder modulates feature extraction based on the current task phase, enabling a single unified policy to produce phase-specific behaviors while sharing action dynamics across phases. A multi-modal phase predictor fusing visual, force, and pose feedback estimates the phase in real time, detecting contact failures that are invisible to vision alone and autonomously triggering recovery trajectories. The system is completed by a hybrid impedance controller for compliant execution and a haptic teleoperation interface for force-aware data collection. Ablation studies show that FiLM-based modulation significantly outperforms both unconditioned and token-level conditioned baselines, and t-SNE analysis confirms that FiLM induces well-separated, phase-specific feature representations. Validated on hanging and removing a T-shirt with dual arms, the closed-loop system improves the hanging success rate from 56\% to 87\% through autonomous error recovery. Code and videos: https://leledeyuan00.github.io/phaser/

</details>


### [523] [A Progress-Aware Leader-Follower Midair Docking System for Dual-Drone Aerial Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29410)
*Yifan Cai,Jan Ming Kevin Tan,Xiangqi Li,Chenzhe Jin,Narsimlu Kemsaram,Valerio Modugno*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双无人机空中对接平台，采用主从编队和被动磁锁紧机构，通过进度感知任务管理器控制四个对接阶段，并集成了完整的软硬件栈。实验在仿真和真实环境中进行了定量评估，为模块化空中协作提供了可重复的测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型无人机之间的可靠空中对接是实现模块化空中协作与操作的关键，但受到精确相对位姿控制、推力及有效载荷限制等挑战的制约。

Method: 采用双四旋翼主从编队，搭载轻量级模块化框架和被动磁锁紧机构；设计进度感知任务管理器管控四个对接阶段（接近、对齐、捕获、稳定）；集成ROS 2与Crazyflie/PX4接口的完整软硬件栈及同步日志系统。

Result: 在仿真和真实实验中，通过编队误差、基线/偏航一致性、对接成功率、对接耗时和失效模式统计等指标进行了定量评估。

Conclusion: 该平台支持对接监管与同步策略的统计性比较，为模块化空中协作和可重复的空中操作提供了实用测试平台。

Abstract: Reliable midair docking between small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is essential for modular aerial cooperation and manipulation, but it requires precise relative-pose control and repeatable platform under tight thrust and payload constraints. We present a dual-drone docking platform where two quadrotors operate in a leader-follower formation and dock using a lightweight modular frame with passive magnetic latching. A progress-aware mission supervisor manages phase transitions: approach, alignment, capture, and settle. This platform integrates a complete hardware-software stack (ROS 2 with Crazyflie/PX4 interfaces) and synchronized logging for benchmark evaluation. We evaluate the platform in simulation and real-world experiments using quantitative metrics such as formation error, baseline and yaw consistency, docking success rate, time-to-dock, and failure-mode statistics. The platform enables statistically grounded comparison of docking supervision and synchronization strategies and provides a practical testbed for modular aerial cooperation and repeatable midair aerial manipulation.

</details>


### [524] [3DVLA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Models via 3D Spatial and Instance Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29416)
*Zhongyu Xia,Yousen Tang,Bingqing Wei,Yongtao Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出3DVLA框架，通过多视角一致性约束、实例感知和遮挡处理三个模块，将3D推理注入预训练VLA模型，无需额外标注即可提升机器人操作性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏3D场景理解能力，表现为三个方面：无法提取具有多视角一致性的3D空间位置、3D实例理解不足、遮挡下推理脆弱。现有3D感知方法与VLA架构不兼容且依赖昂贵的实例级标注。

Method: 提出3DVLA框架：(1)基于空间条件几何聚合的跨模态多视角一致性3D特征编码；(2)高层级实例token的实例估计模块；(3)掩码自监督3D编码分支，保留预测器进行视觉token补全以处理遮挡。

Result: 在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上集成多种VLA基线，操作性能取得一致且显著的提升。

Conclusion: 3DVLA是即插即用的3D推理增强框架，无需额外标注即可有效提升预训练VLA的3D理解与操作能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have achieved remarkable progress in robotic manipulation, yet they suffer from a critical limitation: a lack of 3D scene understanding. This deficiency manifests as three intertwined challenges: weak extraction of 3D spatial positions without enforcing multi-view consistency, inadequate 3D instance understanding, and fragile reasoning under occlusion. Although mature 3D perception methods exist, their direct integration into VLA pipelines is hindered by architectural incompatibility and by heavy reliance on costly instance-level annotations. To address the above challenges, we propose 3DVLA, a plug-and-play framework that injects robust 3D reasoning into pretrained VLAs without requiring extra manual labels or discarding VLM priors. Specifically, 3DVLA tackles the three challenges through: (1) pervasive 3D feature encoding with explicit multi-view consistency constraints across all modalities and a Spatially-Conditioned Geometry Aggregation method, (2) an instance estimation module with high-level instance tokens for 3D instance awareness, and (3) a masked self-supervised 3D encoding branch that retains its predictor for visual token completion to handle occlusions. We integrate 3DVLA with multiple VLA baselines and evaluate on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0. Results show consistent and significant gains in manipulation performance, validating both the effectiveness and plug-and-play compatibility of our approach.

</details>


### [525] [ElegantVLA: Learning When to Think for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29438)
*Ye Li,Huanan Liu,Kangye Ji,Yuan Meng,Jiajun Fan,Yuansong Wang,Shiyu Qin,Chenglei Wu,Shu-Tao Xia,Zhi Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ElegantVLA提出了一种即插即用的相位自适应推理框架，通过动态计算调度在视觉编码器、LLM和动作头之间分配计算资源，实现VLA模型加速，在GR00T和CogACT上分别获得2.55倍和3.77倍加速，并将控制频率从13.8Hz提升至26.3Hz。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型计算成本高、控制频率低，难以满足实时机器人操作需求；已有加速方法通常优化单个组件或使用固定加速规则，忽略了序列化具身控制中不同控制步骤的非均匀推理需求。受人类运动控制启发，模型应学习何时投入完整计算、何时重用先前计算。

Method: 提出ElegantVLA，一种即插即用的相位自适应推理框架。引入轻量级调度器，通过观测时序表示相似性、机器人运动线索和回合进度，联合调度视觉编码器、LLM和动作头的计算。调度器为感知-语言推理选择五级Vision-LLM计算模式（从完全重计算到多步时序重用），为动作生成选择三级去噪模式（在稳定运动时重用中间去噪状态，在目标敏感阶段保留完整精炼）。无需修改或重新训练基础模型。

Result: 在GR00T上实现2.55倍加速，在CogACT上实现3.77倍加速；在六个真实世界GR00T任务中，计算量降低2.18倍，控制频率从13.8Hz提升至26.3Hz。

Conclusion: ElegantVLA通过内模型动态计算调度为现代VLA流水线提供了通用加速框架，在不修改或重新训练基础模型的前提下显著提升推理速度和实时控制频率，有效平衡了计算效率与控制精度。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a powerful paradigm for generalist robotic control. However, their high computational cost and limited control frequency hinder real-time robotic manipulation, especially when large vision-language backbones and iterative action heads run at every control step. Existing VLA acceleration methods often optimize individual components or rely on fixed acceleration rules, treating different control steps with largely fixed computation and overlooking the non-uniform reasoning demands of sequential embodied control. Inspired by human motor control, where cognitive and feedback resources concentrate on goal-sensitive stages, we argue that VLA models should learn when to invest full computation and when to reuse prior computation. We propose ElegantVLA, a plug-in phase-adaptive inference framework that accelerates VLA models through intra-model dynamic compute scheduling. ElegantVLA introduces a lightweight scheduler that observes temporal representation similarity, robot-motion cues, and episode progress to jointly allocate computation across the vision encoder, LLM, and action head. For perception-language reasoning, the scheduler selects a five-level Vision-LLM compute mode, from full recomputation to multi-step temporal reuse, based on visual-language representation stability. For action generation, it selects a three-level denoising mode, reusing intermediate denoising states during stable motion while preserving full refinement for goal-sensitive stages. By coordinating these decisions, ElegantVLA offers a general acceleration framework for modern VLA pipelines with explicit action-generation modules, without modifying or retraining the base model. Experiments on GR00T and CogACT achieve up to 2.55x and 3.77x speedup, and on six real-world GR00T tasks ElegantVLA cuts computation by 2.18x while raising control frequency from 13.8 Hz to 26.3 Hz.

</details>


### [526] [VLA-Pro: Cross-Task Procedural Memory Transfer for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29562)
*Shengyu Si,Yuanzhuo Lu,Ruimeng Yang,Ziyi Ye,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VLA-Pro是一种即插即用的框架，通过存储和检索任务相关的程序性记忆（LoRA适配器），显著提升了VLA模型在跨任务泛化中的表现，在仿真和真实世界任务中分别实现了最高207%的相对提升和5.8%到65.0%的成功率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在泛化到未见过的任务时表现不佳，难以跨物体、场景和动作模式迁移相关经验。

Method: 提出VLA-Pro框架：训练阶段将任务特定的LoRA适配器作为参数化程序性记忆存储；推理阶段基于当前多模态上下文检索相关记忆，并动态融合这些记忆以生成当前动作块。

Result: 在RoboTwin、RLBench和真实世界操控任务上，VLA-Pro在多个骨干网络上一致提升了跨任务泛化能力，仿真任务相对提升最高达207%，真实世界成功率从5.8%提升至65.0%。

Conclusion: 程序性记忆检索与自适应机制能够有效将操控经验迁移到新任务，同时保持模块化和执行稳定性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet they still struggle to generalize to unseen tasks that necessitate transferring relevant experience across objects, scenes, and action patterns. This paper proposes VLA-Pro, a plug-and-play framework designed to enhance cross-task generalization by storing task-relevant procedural memories at training time and transferring these memories during inference. Specifically, VLA-Pro stores task-specific LoRA adapters as parameterized procedural memories during training. At inference time, VLA-Pro retrieves relevant procedural memories based on the current multi-modal context and dynamically fuses these memories for generating the current action chunk. Experiments on RoboTwin, RLBench, and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-Pro consistently improves cross-task generalization across multiple backbones, achieving up to a 207% relative improvement in simulation and increasing real-world success rate from 5.8% to 65.0%. These results suggest that procedural memory retrieval and adaptation provide an effective mechanism for transferring manipulation experience to novel tasks while preserving modularity and execution stability.

</details>


### [527] [VE2VF: Vision-Enabled to Vision-Free Distillation via Real-world Reinforcement Learning for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29564)
*Victor Kowalski,Chengxi Li,Dongheui Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种人机协作的强化学习框架，通过教师-学生蒸馏将视觉策略的知识迁移到仅依赖力觉和位姿传感的无视觉学生策略中，在真实世界的NIST装配基准上实现95%的成功率，并泛化到8个未见任务变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉增强的强化学习策略在接触丰富的机器人操作任务中容易过拟合训练时的视觉条件，限制了鲁棒性和可迁移性。现有方法依赖域随机化或数据增强，但本工作旨在无需这些技术的情况下，在真实世界中训练出兼具快速学习和强泛化能力的策略。

Method: 采用人机协作的在线强化学习框架，训练一个基于视觉的教师策略，然后通过蒸馏将其知识迁移到一个无视觉的学生策略（仅使用位姿、扭转和力矩传感）。所有训练均在真实世界中进行，不使用域随机化或数据增强。

Result: 在真实NIST装配基准板的3个代表性任务上，经过约50分钟训练后总体成功率达95%，且能鲁棒泛化到8个未见任务变体。通过蒸馏微调在最难任务上达到完全成功。

Conclusion: 所提方法在鲁棒性和适应性上均优于基线方法，证明无视觉策略通过蒸馏可以继承视觉策略的任务知识，同时避免对视觉条件的过拟合。

Abstract: When using reinforcement learning (RL) for contact-rich robotic manipulation, vision can provide task-relevant information that accelerates learning beyond what proprioception alone can achieve. However, vision-enabled policies tend to overfit to the visual conditions seen during training, limiting their robustness and transferability. We present a human-in-the-loop RL framework that employs teacher-student distillation to achieve robust performance across multiple task variants, trained entirely in the real world without requiring domain randomization or data augmentation. A vision-enabled teacher distills its knowledge into a vision-free student that relies solely on pose, twist, and wrench sensing, combining fast training with strong task generalization. On the real-world NIST assembly benchmark board, our approach achieves 95\% overall success after approximately 50 minutes of training on 3 representative tasks, including robust generalization to 8 unseen task variants. Fine-tuning with distillation achieves full success on the most challenging task. We demonstrate that the resulting policies outperform baselines in both robustness and adaptability.

</details>


### [528] [Learning to Feel Materials from Multisensory Tactile Data via Interpretable Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29572)
*Li Zou,Yasemin Vardar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个可解释的计算框架，利用多感官触觉数据对人类材料感知和识别进行建模。该框架包含三个互连模型：模型1将手指-表面交互特征映射到心理物理感官属性，模型2基于感知表征进行材料分类，模型3直接从触觉特征分类材料。研究发现，结合按压、静态接触和滑动交互信息可提高预测精度，热感线索对感知建模和材料分类特别重要。这些发现强调了热感和顺应性线索的重要性，为设计更接近人类感知的触觉界面提供了指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类对材料的触觉感知依赖于复杂的多感官触觉线索，但低级触觉信号与感知表征之间的关系尚不清楚，这一知识空白阻碍了触觉在数字环境中的集成以及具有类人触觉感知能力的机器人开发。

Method: 提出了一个可解释的计算框架，包含三个互连模型：Model 1将手指-表面交互特征映射到心理物理感官属性；Model 2基于感知表征对材料进行分类；Model 3直接从触觉特征对材料进行分类。

Result: 结合按压、静态接触和滑动交互信息可提高预测精度；热感线索对感知建模和材料分类特别重要；热感和顺应性线索在当前的机器人手指和触觉显示中代表性不足。

Conclusion: 热感和顺应性线索对类人材料感知至关重要，将其整合到人工系统中可增强其接近人类材料感知的能力，并为设计更具感知基础的触觉界面提供指导。

Abstract: Human tactile perception of materials relies on complex multisensory touch cues, yet the relationship between low-level tactile signals and perceptual representations remains poorly understood. This knowledge gap hinders the integration of touch in digital environments and the development of robots capable of human-like tactile perception. Here, we present an interpretable computational framework for modeling human material perception and recognition using multisensory touch data. Our framework comprises three interconnected models: Model 1 maps finger-surface interaction features to psychophysical sensory attributes, Model 2 classifies materials based on these perceptual representations, and Model 3 directly classifies materials from tactile features. The results showed that combining information from pressing, static contact, and sliding interactions improves prediction accuracy, and that thermal cues are particularly informative for both perceptual modeling and material classification. These findings highlight the importance of thermal and compliance cues, which remain underrepresented in current robotic fingers and haptic displays. Incorporating such cues may enhance artificial systems' ability to approximate human material perception and guide the design of more perceptually grounded haptic interfaces.

</details>


### [529] [How to Relieve Distribution Shifts in Semantic Segmentation for Off-Road Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29599)
*Ji-Hoon Hwang,Daeyoung Kim,Hyung-Suk Yoon,Dong-Wook Kim,Seung-Woo Seo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ST-Seg提出通过风格扩展（SE）和纹理正则化（TR）增强越野环境下语义分割的分布鲁棒性，显著提升跨域和目标域偏移场景下的分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越野环境下的语义分割面临源-目标域差异和传感器损坏导致的分布偏移问题，现有方法在固定源分布内隐式泛化，难以应对实际中的分布变化，导致导航任务失败。

Method: 提出ST-Seg框架，包含风格扩展（SE）生成多样化真实风格以扩宽源域覆盖范围，以及纹理正则化（TR）通过深度纹理流形稳定受风格增强学习影响的局部纹理表征。

Result: 在多种分布偏移的目标域实验上，ST-Seg显著优于现有方法，证明了其在语义分割中的鲁棒性和实际应用价值。

Conclusion: ST-Seg通过显式扩展分布和正则化纹理，有效提升了越野环境下语义分割的泛化能力，增强了自主导航系统的实际适用性。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation is crucial for autonomous navigation in off-road environments, enabling precise classification of surroundings to identify traversable regions. However, distinctive factors inherent to off-road conditions, such as source-target domain discrepancies and sensor corruption from rough terrain, can result in distribution shifts that alter the data differently from the trained conditions. This often leads to inaccurate semantic label predictions and subsequent failures in navigation tasks. To address this, we propose ST-Seg, a novel framework that expands the source distribution through style expansion (SE) and texture regularization (TR). Unlike prior methods that implicitly apply generalization within a fixed source distribution, ST-Seg offers an intuitive approach for distribution shift. Specifically, SE broadens domain coverage by generating diverse realistic styles, augmenting the limited style information of the source domain. TR stabilizes local texture representation affected by style-augmented learning through a deep texture manifold. Experiments across various distribution-shifted target domains demonstrate the effectiveness of ST-Seg, with substantial improvements over existing methods. These results highlight the robustness of ST-Seg, enhancing the real-world applicability of semantic segmentation for off-road navigation.

</details>


### [530] [VLAConf: Calibrated Task-Success Confidence for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29605)
*Dehao Huang,Aoxiang Gu,Chengjie Zhang,Bolin Zou,Wenlong Dong,Zilang Cen,Yue Wang,Hong Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VLAConf提出了一种基于单类判别性置信度框架，通过冻结的VLA内部表示和轻量级置信度头实现高效、跨架构的置信度估计，在LIBERO基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型的置信度估计方法存在计算效率低（需要重复采样）和跨架构泛化性差（仅适用于离散动作空间）的问题，亟需一种高效且通用的置信度估计方案。

Method: 提出VLAConf框架：1）利用冻结的预训练VLA内部表示，通过轻量级置信度头在单次前向传播中直接估计逐步骤异常分数；2）采用步骤条件化建模，编码操作轨迹中的 rollout 阶段信息，无需穷举重采样。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上，VLAConf显著提升了置信度信号的质量，后验校准效果优于现有基线，且推理效率大幅提升；在真实机器人实验中进一步验证了有效性。

Conclusion: VLAConf通过单类判别性框架和轻量级置信度头，兼顾了计算效率与跨架构泛化性，为VLA模型在开放世界中的风险敏感决策和故障预测提供了可靠的置信度信号。

Abstract: Confidence estimation for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is essential for robots to perform manipulation tasks in the open world, providing crucial signals for risk-sensitive decision-making and failure anticipation. Existing confidence estimation methods typically rely on ensemble-based paradigms or action-token probabilities to predict the likelihood of task success. However, they still encounter challenges in computational efficiency and cross-architecture generalizability. These methods usually require repeated sampling, leading to inference inefficiency, and are restricted to VLA models with discrete action outputs, making them difficult to apply to continuous action spaces. To address this issue, we propose VLAConf, a one-class discriminative confidence framework. By leveraging frozen pretrained VLA internal representations, VLAConf directly estimates step-wise anomaly scores in a single forward pass using a lightweight confidence head, thereby eliminating the overhead of exhaustive resampling. We additionally use step-conditioned modeling to encode rollout-phase information along the manipulation trajectory. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark demonstrate that VLAConf significantly improves the quality of the confidence signal constructed for post-hoc calibration, outperforming existing baselines by a large margin in inference efficiency. The effectiveness of VLAConf is further validated in real-robot experiments. To access the source code and supplementary videos, visit https://sites.google.com/view/vlaconf.

</details>


### [531] [EXACT-MPPI: Exact Signed-Distance Navigation for Arbitrary-Footprint Robots from Point Clouds via Path Integral Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29663)
*Chen Peng,Zhikang Ge,Wenwu Lu,Haiming Gao,Stavros Vougioukas,Peng Wei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EXACT-MPPI是一个无需训练的局部导航框架，通过将精确足迹距离评估嵌入MPPI控制器，直接处理非凸复杂形状机器人的碰撞避免，在JAX上并行化实现实时控制，适用于多种运动模型平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有局部导航规划器通常将机器人复杂非凸足迹简化为凸形状或膨胀代理，并将传感器数据栅格化，导致在间隙与足迹几何尺度相近时丢失可行运动。

Method: 提出EXACT-MPPI框架：无中间地图表示，直接将点云观测与稀疏引导映射为运动指令；嵌入式精确符号距离评估器；足迹以简单多边形表示（通用凸/凹形状），支持矩形覆盖特化加速；所有操作在JAX中批量处理，利用GPU并行实现滚动时域控制。

Result: 相比学习型点对机器人距离基线，EXACT-MPPI加速了批量距离评估；在凸足迹规划器失败的场景中保留了可行运动；在密集静态和移动障碍物下保持鲁棒性；仅通过更改足迹描述和运动模型即可部署到差速、阿克曼、全向及混合模式平台。

Conclusion: 将精确足迹几何与基于采样的预测控制相结合，为不同机器人提供了一种实用、无需训练的足迹感知局部导航方法。

Abstract: Ground robots often carry payloads, implements, or other attachments that turn their effective footprint into complex, non-convex shapes. Navigating safely through clutter then requires reasoning about this true geometry, yet most local planners simplify it with convex or inflated proxies and rasterize sensor data into occupancy grids or distance fields. Both choices eliminate feasible motions when clearance is comparable to the footprint geometry. We present EXACT-MPPI, a training-free local navigation framework that maps local point-cloud observations and sparse guidance directly to motion commands, without any intermediate map representation. The framework embeds an analytic, exact signed-distance evaluator into a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller. The footprint is represented as a simple polygon for general convex or concave planar shapes, with a rectangle-cover specialization for faster evaluation of rectilinear footprints, enabling footprint-aware collision costs without convex decomposition, inflation, or learned encoders. During each MPPI rollout, observed obstacle points are transformed into the predicted body frame and evaluated against the footprint. All operations are batched in JAX, leveraging GPU parallelism for real-time receding-horizon control. Experiments show that EXACT-MPPI accelerates batched distance evaluation over a learned point-to-robot baseline, preserves feasible motion where convex-footprint planners fail, and remains robust under dense static and moving obstacles. The same framework deploys on differential-drive, Ackermann, omnidirectional, and hybrid-mode platforms by changing only the footprint description and motion model without per-platform training. Pairing exact footprint geometry with sampling-based predictive control thus offers a practical, training-free path to footprint-aware local navigation across diverse robots.

</details>


### [532] [FLIP: Real-Time and Resilient Formation Planning for Large-Scale DIstributed Swarms via Point Cloud Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29704)
*Yuan Zhou,Guangtong Xu,Zhenyu Hou,Jialiang Hou,Fei Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将大规模编队规划问题转化为时空点云配准问题，通过分布式计算最优编队位置序列并利用带离群值剔除的点云配准方法，实现了可扩展、鲁棒且高效的分布式编队轨迹规划，在120架无人机仿真中验证了优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统大规模编队规划方法要么过度简化编队表征导致性能差，要么采用完全协作关系导致计算负载过大，缺乏同时兼顾高性能与可扩展性的方案。

Method: 将最优编队位置序列（OFPS）计算转化为时空点云配准（PCR）问题；每个智能体通过分布式计算自身当前位置与其他智能体目标编队位置的匹配结果来获得OFPS；利用带离群值剔除的PCR方法进行大规模编队位置配准，防止次优轨迹和失效智能体通过协作网络传播。

Result: 通过120架无人机大规模仿真和与SOTA方法的严格对比基准测试，验证了所提方法的有效性和优越性。

Conclusion: 该方法统一实现了大规模集群的鲁棒、高效、分布式轨迹规划，兼顾了可扩展性与高性能。

Abstract: Traditional large-scale formation planning either oversimplify the formation representation which leads to poor performance, or they employ complete collaborative relationships, which results in excessive computational load. To achieve high-performance and large-scale formation planning, we transform the Optimal Formation Position Sequence \cite{c1} (OFPS) calculation problem into a spatiotemporal Point Cloud Registration (PCR) problem. Each agent derives its OFPS by distributively computing the matching result between current positions and the desired formation positions of all other agents. Then each agent optimizes the cooperative formation trajectory by using OFPS. We leverage the PCR method with outlier rejection to rapidly perform large-scale formation position registration. This prevents suboptimal trajectories and failed agents from propagating through the cooperative network and affecting more agents. Consequently, we uniformly achieve resilient, efficient, and distributed trajectory planning for large-scale swarms. The effectiveness and the superiority of the proposed method are demonstrated through large-scale simulations of 120-drone formation, and rigorous benchmarking against state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.

</details>


### [533] [PhAIL: A Real-Robot VLA Benchmark and Distributional Methodology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29710)
*Sergey Arkhangelskiy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出PhAIL物理AI排行榜，采用时间-成功累积分布函数（CDF）作为评估基础，引入人类相对吞吐量（HRT）得分和Kolmogorov-Smirnov显著性检验，在N≤30的有限样本下能分辨二值阈值指标无法区分的模型性能差异，发现最佳VLA策略比人类参考慢约7倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的真实机器人评估仍依赖于固定超时下的二值成功率，且样本量极小（N≤25），缺乏置信区间和统计比较，无法可靠区分性能接近的模型。

Method: 提出PhAIL基准，采用时间-成功累积分布函数（CDF）作为评估原语；使用人类相对吞吐量（HRT）作为无量纲标量得分，结合bootstrap置信区间；采用Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验进行显著性比较，按对象计算后宏观平均。

Result: 在四种公开VLA上，宏观平均KS检验在N≤30时解决了GR00T vs. ACT、OpenPI vs. ACT两个二值指标无法区分的比较；OpenPI vs. GR00T在预算内未能分辨。最佳VLA每操作耗时（RMST比）比人类参考慢约7倍。

Conclusion: PhAIL提出的分布式评估方法在有限样本下比传统二值成功率更敏感，能够提供置信区间和统计显著性检验，为VLA策略的可靠比较提供了新标准。

Abstract: Real-world evaluation of vision-language-action (VLA) policies still rests on binary success rate at a fixed timeout with $N \le 25$ rollouts per condition, almost always without confidence intervals or paired statistical comparison; these cohort sizes struggle to resolve close comparisons reliably. We introduce PhAIL (Physical AI Leaderboard, https://phail.ai), an open real-robot benchmark on a Franka FR3 (dataset, per-rollout artifacts, and end-to-end reference implementation) of a distributional evaluation methodology: the time-to-success cumulative distribution function (CDF) as the evaluation primitive, with two separated jobs. The first is scoring via Human-Relative Throughput (HRT), a dimensionless scalar with bootstrap confidence intervals, anchored to same-fixture human teleoperation. The second is a significance test (Kolmogorov-Smirnov, computed per-object and macro-averaged across objects). On four publicly-available VLAs, the macro-averaged KS test resolves two close comparisons (GR00T vs. ACT, OpenPI vs. ACT) at $N \le 30$ rollouts per (model, object) cell where binary-threshold metrics do not; the closest pair (OpenPI vs. GR00T) remains unresolved within our budget. The best evaluated VLA is $\sim 7\times$ slower per operation (RMST ratio) than the human reference.

</details>


### [534] [MARS Policy: Multimodality Only When It Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29766)
*Jindou Jia,Tuo An,Yuxuan Hu,Gen Li,Jingliang Li,Bohan Hou,Xiangyu Chen,Jiaqi Bai,Bofan Lyu,Jianfei Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MARS策略，通过自适应地在多模态阶段注入随机噪声、在单模态阶段使用确定性学习，在保持多模态表达能力的同时显著提升训练和推理效率，在仿真和真实任务中成功率提升16.67%，推理延迟降低83.20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式策略依赖随机噪声初始化和迭代去噪过程来实现多模态行为，导致训练复杂度高、推理效率低；但并非机器人任务的每个阶段都需要行为多样性，因此需要一种能自适应选择何时引入随机性的方法。

Method: 提出Modality-Adaptive Robot Sampling (MARS)策略，仅在真正需要多模态的阶段激活生成式噪声注入，在单模态阶段退化为高效的确定性学习，实现噪声的适时适量注入。

Result: 在8个仿真和4个真实任务中，MARS策略展现鲁棒的多模态表达能力和高效率，真实测试中成功率提升16.67%，推理延迟降低83.20%，且在近确定性任务中训练效率甚至超过确定性策略。

Conclusion: MARS策略通过自适应模态切换，弥合了生成式策略多模态能力与确定性模型高效训练推理之间的鸿沟，是一种兼顾表达效率与计算效率的机器人学习新范式。

Abstract: Imitation learning has become a cornerstone for solving complex robotic manipulation tasks. In particular, multimodality, which enables robots to capture diverse yet valid behavioral patterns, has driven the rapid emergence of generative policies as a dominant paradigm in robot learning. However, achieving such multimodality typically relies on stochastic noise initialization and iterative denoising procedures, resulting in substantial training complexity and low inference efficiency. Meanwhile, not all phases of a robotic task inherently require behavioral diversity. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Modality-Adaptive Robot Sampling (MARS) policy, which adaptively invokes tailored stochasticity only when it is truly beneficial, while reverting to an efficient deterministic learning during single-modal phases. In other words, the proper amount of noise is injected only at the proper time. By selectively activating multimodal generation, MARS policy bridges the gap between the multimodal capability of generative policies and the superior training and inference efficiency of deterministic models. Empirical studies across 8 simulated and 4 real-world tasks demonstrate that MARS exhibits robust multimodal expressivity and high efficiency, with a 16.67% success rate improvement and an 83.20% inference latency reduction in real-world tests. Counterintuitively, MARS also outpaces deterministic policies in training efficiency on near-deterministic tasks by more effectively modeling nuanced action diversity.

</details>


### [535] [Joint Angle Estimation with Customized Wristband Based on Online Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29771)
*Shuo Wang,Xiaobin Chen,Xiaoming Tao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于在线增量学习的定制腕带系统，用于估计腕关节角度。该方法采用两阶段估计：第一阶段利用IMU实时数据通过在线学习更新模型，第二阶段仅使用腕带进行角度估计。模型在数据采集期间完成训练，能适应数据漂移问题（如左右手腕差异、佩戴位置偏差、不同受试者差异），在不同场景下误差约为15度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可穿戴传感器研究大多过于简单，难以适应不同情境下的使用需求，缺乏对数据漂移（如佩戴位置偏差、不同受试者差异等）的有效应对方法。

Method: 提出两阶段估计方法：第一阶段使用定制腕带采集数据，并结合IMU作为地面真值，通过在线增量学习根据佩戴者手腕运动特征更新模型；第二阶段仅依靠腕带进行腕关节角度估计，模型在数据采集过程中即完成训练。

Result: 传感器在应变变化下表现出良好性能，在不同测试场景下腕关节轨迹估计误差约为15度。

Conclusion: 所提出的在线增量学习腕带系统能够有效适应不同测试配置下的数据漂移，包括同一受试者的左右手腕差异、同一手腕上佩戴位置偏差以及不同受试者之间的差异，具有良好的适应性和实用性。

Abstract: Intelligent wearable technology plays an increasingly important role in human-computer interaction, motion, and health monitoring. To ensure comfort and practicality of use, one common form for motion monitoring is to utilize soft wearable sensors. However, many research applications regarding wearable sensors are simplistic and difficult to adapt to different situations. This study proposes a system for estimating the angle of the wrist joint using a customized wristband based on an online incremental learning approach. It is a two-stage estimation method: the first stage updates the model based on the wearer's wrist movement characteristics using online learning, integrating real-time data from an IMU as ground truth. The second stage utilizes the updated model for estimation of wrist joint angle solely with the wristband. In other words, model training is completed during data acquisition, allowing the trained model to be used for subsequent angle estimation. This method offers advantages in adapting to data drift caused by variations in different testing configurations, such as the left and right wrists of the same subject, deviations in the wearing position on the same wrist, and even differences among various subjects. The results indicate that the sensors exhibit good performance under strain variations, and the wrist joint trajectory estimation of the proposed system has an approximate error of 15 degree in different scenarios.

</details>


### [536] [LLM-Guided Future Hypotheses for Horizon-Aware Exploration in Multi-Step Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29864)
*Mohammad Khoshnazar,Andrew Melnik,Michael Beetz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出未来经验条件化（FEC）框架，通过将闭环策略条件化于短时未来视频的潜在表征，为多步机器人操作提供结构化先验。未来视频由LLM推理器、数字孪生和视频扩散模型三级生成。实验表明，生成式未来可提升BC和BC+RL性能，且未来质量与策略表现正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步机器人操作面临场景演化的不确定性，探索和策略自适应极具挑战。现有方法缺乏对未来信息的有效利用，作者旨在验证短视域、任务一致的未来视频能否为控制和强化学习微调提供有用的结构化先验。

Method: 提出FEC接口，将闭环策略条件化于短时未来视频的潜在表征。未来视频三级生成：(1) LLM推理器基于任务本体和当前场景规划；(2) 无机器人数字孪生滚动执行目标物体运动；(3) 无掩码视频扩散模型合成与机器人一致的未来片段。主要用BC和BC+RL实例化，并与未来条件化的流式流策略（SFP）基线对比。

Result: 在RoboCasa和CALVIN上，生成式未来（GenFuture）优于无未来条件（NoFuture），真实未来（GTFuture）最佳，错误未来（WrongFuture）退化性能。BC+RL实例化总体最强。CALVIN 8任务学习曲线分析：GTFuture收敛最快，GenFuture比NoFuture更早达到更高水平，WrongFuture全程零表现。

Conclusion: 短时未来视频可作为探索和策略自适应的有效结构化先验，即使在未来预测不完美的情况下也能提升性能。FEC框架为机器人操作中利用生成式未来信息提供了可行的范式。

Abstract: Multi-step robot manipulation requires acting under uncertainty about how the scene will evolve, making exploration and policy adaptation challenging. We study whether short-horizon, task-consistent future videos can provide useful structured priors for control and reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. We formalize this idea through Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), a simple interface that conditions closed-loop policies on a latent representation of a short future video. In our simulation setup, future clips are generated in three stages, an LLM reasoner operating over a task ontology initialized from the current scene state, a robot-free digital-twin rollout of the intended object motion, and a mask-free video diffusion model that synthesizes a robot-consistent future clip without requiring segmentation at inference. We instantiate this future-conditioning interface primarily with BC and BC+RL, and compare against a future-conditioned Streaming Flow Policy (SFP) baseline on RoboCasa and CALVIN under NoFuture, GTFuture, GenFuture, and WrongFuture. Generated futures improve performance over no-future conditioning, while mismatched futures degrade it, and our BC+RL instantiation achieves the strongest overall results. An average BC+RL learning-curve analysis across 8 CALVIN tasks further shows that GTFuture improves fastest, GenFuture improves earlier and to a higher level than NoFuture, and WrongFuture remains at zero throughout training. These results suggest that short-horizon future videos can serve as useful structured priors for exploration and policy adaptation under imperfect future predictions. https://enact2026.github.io/

</details>


### [537] [Fisher-Preserving Guidance: Training-Free Manifold Constraints for Safe Diffusion Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29937)
*Hao Ren,Zetong Bi,Yiming Zeng,Le Zheng,Zhi Li,Zhaoliang Wan,Lu Qi,Hui Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Fisher Preserving Guidance with Outer Product Span Projection，一种无需训练即可在采样过程中避免Fisher漂移、优化任务目标的推理方法，适用于视觉导航中的轨迹预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在视觉导航的路径点预测中效果显著，但标准采样和测试时引导会产生不可靠或低效的轨迹，因为更新会偏离训练流形。作者希望在不额外训练的前提下，保持更新在数据流形内，同时优化任务目标。

Method: 通过低秩Jacobian分解计算Fisher保持更新，每步仅需一次反向传播；引入Truncated Fisher Denoising Sensitivity作为不确定性信号，用于鲁棒的多样本动作混合。

Result: 在Maze2D、PushT、仿真及真实机器人视觉导航任务上，相较于强扩散策略基线，均取得一致性能提升。

Conclusion: 所提方法是一种无需额外训练、计算高效的推理策略，能有效缓解扩散模型采样过程中的流形漂移问题，提升轨迹质量与任务表现。

Abstract: Diffusion models are effective for waypoint prediction in visual navigation, but standard sampling and test time guidance can produce unreliable or inefficient trajectories when updates drift off the training manifold. We propose Fisher Preserving Guidance with Outer Product Span Projection, a training-free inference method that avoids large Fisher drift associated with off-distribution actions while optimizing a task objective. Our method computes the Fisher-preserving update via a low-rank Jacobian factorization, requiring only a single backward pass per step and enabling real-time use. We further introduce Truncated Fisher Denoising Sensitivity as an uncertainty signal and use it for robust multi-sample action blending. Experiments on toy and realistic navigation benchmarks, including Maze2D with TSDF-based guidance, PushT with official Diffusion Policy weights, and visual navigation in simulation and on real robots, demonstrate consistent improvements in performance over strong diffusion-policy baselines without additional training.

</details>


### [538] [Replicable Simulation-Based Robot Validation through Provenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29973)
*Argentina Ortega,Samuel Wiest,Frederik Pasch,Nico Hochgeschwender*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文论证了数据溯源与FAIR原则对于提升机器人仿真测试可复现性的重要性，通过扩展现有测试框架集成溯源追踪与元数据采集机制，并在移动机器人导航数据集上验证了该方法，同时讨论了实施过程中遇到的障碍与建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人行为常通过仿真测试验证，但测试的可复现性严重依赖于测试配置、执行和后处理过程是否被透明地记录。当前缺乏系统性的文档化机制来追踪测试工件的关联关系。

Method: 在现有仿真测试框架基础上增加数据溯源追踪与元数据采集机制，结构化记录文件来源和关键设计决策，并将溯源和元数据嵌入测试流程中，而非事后添加。

Result: 成功扩展了一个仿真测试框架，并用该扩展方法丰富了移动机器人导航数据集，使其具备结构化溯源信息和符合FAIR原则的元数据。

Conclusion: 数据溯源与FAIR元数据必须贯穿测试全流程而非事后处理。研究还识别了词汇对齐、属性选择、领域标准采纳等关键障碍，并给出了在机器人验证工作流中实施FAIR化溯源的具体建议。

Abstract: Robot behavior is often validated through simulation-based testing, yet the replicability of such campaigns depends critically on transparent documentation of how tests are configured, executed, and post-processed. We argue that data provenance, coupled with the FAIR principles (findability, accessibility, interoperability, and reusability), addresses this gap by explicitly tracking links between artifacts and by attaching machine-readable metadata about file origins and key design decisions. Moreover, provenance and metadata cannot be treated as an afterthought confined to final datasets; they must be integrated into the testing processes that generate those datasets so that evidence can be reconstructed end-to-end. We demonstrate this by augmenting an existing simulation-based testing framework with provenance tracking and metadata collection mechanisms, and by using these extensions to enrich a mobile robot navigation dataset with structured provenance and FAIR-aligned metadata.
