Finally, we discuss obstacles encountered in this integration -- such as vocabulary alignment, attribute selection, and adoption of domain standards -- and provide actionable recommendations for implementing provenance-centric, FAIR metadata in robotics validation workflows.

</details>


### [539] [Sample-Efficient Diffusion-based Reinforcement Learning with Critic Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30056)
*Shutong Ding,Zejia Zhong,Zhongyi Wang,Ke Hu,Bikang Pan,Jingya Wang,Ye Shi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CGPO将训练-free的引导技术集成到扩散策略的去噪过程中，通过评论家网络引导动作生成走向高价值区域，有效平衡扩散策略在强化学习中的探索与利用，在MuJoCo任务和Franka机械臂抓取任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的强化学习方法存在两难困境：采样策略优化虽探索能力强但利用率低、收敛慢；梯度策略优化虽充分利用Q值梯度但易坍缩为单峰策略、多样性差。本研究旨在平衡探索与利用的权衡。

Method: 提出CGPO框架，在扩散策略的去噪过程中集成训练-free的引导技术，利用评论家网络将动作生成导向高价值区域，并将引导后的动作作为回归目标进行优化。

Result: 在5个MuJoCo locomotion任务上达到SOTA性能，并在Franka机械臂抓取任务上首次成功将扩散策略应用于真实世界强化学习。

Conclusion: CGPO通过训练-free引导技术有效平衡了探索与利用，减少了获取高质量动作的时间并提升了最终性能，是首个将扩散策略成功应用于真实世界RL的方法。

Abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have achieved great successes by leveraging the multimodality and exploration capability of diffusion policies. Among these approaches, one representative branch focuses on the sampling-based policy optimization. This design enables better exploration capability of the diffusion model, particularly at the beginning of training, but suffer from low exploitation in Q-value information, resulting in a slow policy convergence. Another branch pays attention to gradient-based policy optimization, which sufficiently exploits the gradient of the Q function yet tends to collapse into a unimodal policy with low diversity. To address this issue, we propose CGPO, \textbf{C}ritic-\textbf{G}uided diffusion \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization, which effectively balances exploration and exploitation with the training-free guidance technique integrated into the denoising process of diffusion policy. Concretely, CGPO steers action generation toward high-value regions defined by the critic network and uses the guided actions as regression objectives. In this manner, CGPO reduces the time required to obtain high-quality actions and improves final performance with better balance between the exploration-exploitation tradeoff. We validate the effectiveness of CGPO on 5 MuJoCo locomotion tasks, and CGPO achieves state-of-the-art performance compared with existing diffusion-based RL methods. Notably, CGPO is the first success to incorporate diffusion policy into real-world RL, with its superior performance on Franka robot arm grasping tasks. Our official page is released at https://dingsht.tech/cgpo-webpage.

</details>


### [540] [BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30226)
*Zhongxi Chen,Yifan Han,Yanming Shao,Huanming Liu,Congsheng Xu,Xiaoyu Chen,Yao Mu,Wenzhao Lian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BORA是一个面向真实世界灵巧操作VLA模型的离线到在线RL后训练框架，通过引入动作条件价值引导的分块残差适应机制，解决了高维灵巧探索中的时序不一致性和样本效率问题，在五个复杂任务上实现了33%的成功率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在灵巧操作中面临高维手部控制和累积执行误差的挑战，现有方法在真实世界的RL后训练中存在时序不一致、样本效率低下和硬件风险等问题。

Method: 提出BORA框架：离线阶段构建以VLM认知token和动作分块为输入的critic，提供动作条件价值引导；在线阶段冻结VLA基础模型，引入轻量级的人机回环分块残差适应机制，通过继承离线critic和干预驱动奖励来校正执行偏差。

Result: 在五个复杂真实灵巧任务上，BORA相比纯模仿学习和传统解耦RL基线，在标准设置下平均成功率达到33%的绝对提升，在新物体泛化场景下提升达43%。

Conclusion: BORA通过离线到在线的RL后训练框架有效弥合了视觉引导动作生成与物理可靠灵巧执行之间的差距，同时保持了预训练策略作为稳定先验。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding visual-language understanding into real-world robotic manipulation. However, dexterous manipulation remains challenging for VLA policies due to high-dimensional hand control and compounding execution errors, which makes real-world RL post-training essential for bridging the gap between visually grounded action generation and physically reliable dexterous execution. However, high-dimensional dexterous exploration often triggers temporal inconsistency, sample inefficiency and hardware risks in the real world. To address these challenges, we propose BORA, an offline-to-online RL post-training framework designed for real-world dexterous VLA models. In the offline phase, BORA constructs a critic that takes both the VLM's cognition tokens and action chunks as inputs. This design enables action-conditioned value guidance, allowing the critic to evaluate dexterous hand motions beyond visual context alone. During the subsequent online phase, BORA freezes the VLA base and introduces a lightweight, Human-in-the-Loop (HiL) chunk-wise residual adaptation mechanism to mitigate real-world execution errors and further correct the offline-learned intents within the actual physical environment. By inheriting the offline critic and employing intervention-driven rewards, BORA effectively corrects execution discrepancies and adapts to real-world physical variances while preserving the pretrained policy as a stable prior. Extensive evaluations across five complex real-world dexterous tasks demonstrate that BORA significantly outperforms pure imitation learning and traditional decoupled RL baselines, achieving a 33% absolute increase in average success rate under standard settings and up to a 43% improvement in unseen object generalization.

</details>


### [541] [Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30280)
*Qiuyue Wang,Mingsheng Li,Jian Guan,Jinhui Ye,Sicheng Xie,Yitao Liu,Junhao Chen,Zhixuan Liang,Jie Zhang,Xintong Hu,Xuhong Huang,Pei Lin,Junyang Lin,Dayiheng Liu,Shuai Bai,Jingren Zhou,Jiazhao Zhang,Haoqi Yuan,Gengze Zhou,Hang Yin,Ye Wang,Yiyang Huang,Zixing Lei,Wujian Peng,Delin Chen,Yingming Zheng,Jingyang Fan,Xianwei Zhuang,Xin Zhou,Haoyang Li,Anzhe Chen,Tong Zhang,Xuejing Liu,Yuchong Sun,Ruizhe Chen,Zhaohai Li,Chenxu Lü,Zhibo Yang,Tao Yu,Xionghui Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Qwen-VLA是一个统一的具身基础模型，通过DiT动作解码器和具身感知提示，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）建模扩展到连续动作生成，在操作、导航和轨迹预测任务上实现跨平台泛化，并在多个基准测试上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能研究针对操作、导航等任务使用专用模型，导致能力碎片化且难以跨任务、环境和机器人形态泛化。作者希望探索能否将异构的具身决策问题统一到一个视觉-语言-动作模型中。

Method: Qwen-VLA基于Qwen的视觉-语言建模堆栈，通过DiT（Diffusion Transformer）动作解码器将感知、理解和推理扩展到连续动作和轨迹生成。采用大规模联合预训练，涵盖机器人操作轨迹、人类第一人称演示、合成仿真数据、视觉-语言导航数据、轨迹级监督数据及辅助视觉-语言数据。引入具身感知提示（embodiment-aware prompt conditioning），通过机器人特定文本描述指定当前本体和控制约定，并将操作、导航和轨迹预测统一为动作-轨迹预测框架。

Result: Qwen-VLA-Instruct在LIBERO上达到97.9%，Simpler-WidowX 73.7%，RoboTwin-Easy/Hard 86.1%/87.2%，R2R OSR 69.0%，RxR SR 59.6%，真实ALOHA实验平均OOD成功率76.9%，DOMINO动态操作零样本成功率26.6%。

Conclusion: 实验表明Qwen-VLA在操作、导航和轨迹基准测试上实现了一致的多任务性能和跨场景布局、背景、光照、物体配置及机器人本体的分布外泛化能力。

Abstract: Embodied intelligence is often studied through specialized models for individual tasks such as manipulation or navigation, resulting in fragmented capabilities and limited generalization across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments. In this work, we study whether heterogeneous embodied decision-making problems can be unified within a single vision-language-action model. We present Qwen-VLA, a unified embodied foundation model that extends Qwen's vision-language modeling stack from perception, understanding, and reasoning to continuous action and trajectory generation through a DiT-based action decoder. Qwen-VLA is trained with a large-scale joint pretraining recipe over diverse data sources, including robotics manipulation trajectories, human egocentric demonstrations, synthetic simulation data, vision-and-language navigation data, trajectory-centric supervision, and auxiliary vision-language data. To support multiple robot platforms, we introduce embodiment-aware prompt conditioning, where robot-specific textual descriptions specify the current embodiment and control convention. We further cast manipulation, navigation, and trajectory prediction into a unified action-and-trajectory prediction framework, enabling transferable visual grounding, spatial reasoning, and continuous action generation across robot morphologies, task families, and environments. Experiments on manipulation, navigation, and trajectory-centric benchmarks show consistent multi-task performance and out-of-distribution generalization under variations in scene layout, background, lighting, object configuration, and robot embodiment. Qwen-VLA-Instruct achieves 97.9% on LIBERO, 73.7% on Simpler-WidowX, 86.1%/87.2% on RoboTwin-Easy/Hard, 69.0% OSR on R2R, 59.6% SR on RxR, 76.9% average OOD success in real-world ALOHA experiments, and 26.6% zero-shot success on DOMINO dynamic manipulation.

</details>


### [542] [Gaze2Act: Gaze-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Policies for Interactive Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30282)
*Kuangji Zuo,Gen Li,Bofan Lyu,Yanshuo Lu,Boyu Ma,Shijia Han,Xinyu Zhou,Xichen Yuan,Chuhao Zhou,Jiaqi Bai,Geng Li,Jianfei Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Gaze2Act 提出利用人类视线作为动态直观的意图信号，通过跨视角语义匹配将第一人称视线映射到机器人视角，实现粗到细的目标指定，并在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言指令在实际应用中难以精确传达人类意图，尤其是在物体区分、动作位置指定和执行过程中的动态变化方面存在局限。

Method: 通过跨视角语义匹配桥接自我-外部视角差异，将第一人称视线映射到机器人视角，生成物体掩码和视线点实现粗到细的目标指定；通过感知级提示和动作级条件调控将视线线索集成到策略中。

Result: 在7个任务类别、16个真实机器人任务上，Gaze2Act 在意图准确率和任务成功率上均达到最先进水平，在物体消歧、细粒度交互和动态意图引导方面显著优于基线。

Conclusion: 人类视线是一种自然、低负担且高表达力的模态，适用于人机协作的 VLA 控制。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown strong potential for robot learning by following language instructions. However, in practice, language alone is often insufficient to precisely convey human intent. It is difficult to describe which exact object to interact with among similar candidates, where to act on the object, or how the target may change during execution. To address this limitation, we propose Gaze2Act, a novel VLA framework that leverages human gaze as a dynamic and intuitive intent signal for complex interactive manipulation. Gaze2Act first bridges the ego-exo view gap by mapping first-person gaze into the robot's perspective through cross-view semantic matching, producing both an object mask and a gaze point for coarse-to-fine target specification. These cues are then integrated into the policy through perception-level prompting and action-level conditioning, allowing the robot to attend to relevant regions and execute precise interactions under dynamic intent. In a systematic evaluation across seven task categories and 16 real-robot tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, Gaze2Act achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intent accuracy and task success rate. It notably outperforms baselines in object disambiguation, fine-grained interaction, and dynamic intent steering. These results demonstrate that human gaze provides a natural, low-burden, and highly expressive modality for human-in-the-loop VLA control.

</details>


### [543] [A Heterogeneous Architecture for Robot RL Beyond GPU-Dominant Paradigms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30313)
*Yufei Jia,Zhanxiang Cao,Mingrui Yu,Heng Zhang,Shenyu Chen,Dixuan Jiang,Meng Li,Xiaofan Li,Yiyang Liu,Junzhe Wu,Zheng Li,XiLin Fang,Tingyu Cui,Shengcheng Fu,Haoyang Li,Anqi Wang,Zifan Wang,Dongjie Zhu,Chenyu Cao,Zhenbiao Huang,Ziang Zheng,Jie Lu,Xin Ma,Zhengyang Wei,Xiang Zhao,Tianyue Zhan,Ye He,Yuxiang Chen,Yizhou Jiang,Yue Li,Haizhou Ge,Yuhang Dong,Fan Jia,Ziheng Zhang,Meng Zhang,Xiwa Deng,Zhixing Chen,Hanyang Shao,Chenxin Dong,Yixuan Li,Yizhi Chen,Bokui Chen,Kaifeng Zhang,Hanqing Cui,Yusen Qin,Ruqi Huang,Lei Han,Tiancai Wang,Xiang Li,Yue Gao,Guyue Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出UniLab，一种异构CPU仿真/GPU学习架构，通过统一运行时分隔CPU并行仿真与GPU策略更新，在相同硬件配置下将端到端训练效率提升3-10倍，证明GPU仿真并非高效训练的必要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于仿真的机器人强化学习默认采用纯GPU仿真管线，但这一假设可能限制了系统架构选择。作者旨在重新审视"高效训练必须将物理引擎放在GPU上"的默认假设，探索CPU仿真+GPU学习的异构架构能否同样高效甚至更优。

Method: 提出UniLab系统，采用CPU批量化仿真后端（MuJoCoUni和MotrixSim）进行物理模拟，GPU负责策略网络学习；通过统一运行时管理数据搬运、缓冲和同步，解耦CPU仿真与GPU策略更新的执行流程；支持PPO、SAC、FlashSAC、TD3、APPO等多种算法，并提供跨平台执行能力（macOS、AMD ROCm、Intel XPU）。

Result: 在相同硬件配置下，UniLab相比纯GPU仿真方案将端到端训练效率提升3-10倍；降低了对NVIDIA CUDA软件栈的依赖；成功支持Apple macOS、AMD ROCm和Intel XPU等跨平台后端。

Conclusion: GPU仿真是高效训练的有效路径，但并非必要路径。UniLab拓宽了机器人强化学习训练的实际系统选择空间，为不同硬件生态下的研究工作提供了更灵活的架构选项。

Abstract: Simulation-based RL for contemporary robot control is increasingly organized around GPU-resident simulation: physics, rollout collection, and learning are placed on a single GPU-centric execution path. This paradigm has greatly improved training speed, but it has also encouraged a default assumption that efficient training requires physics to reside on the GPU. We revisit this assumption. Our view is that, in simulation-dominated robot control, the essential question is not which processor runs physics, but whether simulation throughput, policy learning, and runtime synchronization form an efficient end-to-end loop. We present UniLab, a heterogeneous CPU-simulation / GPU-learning architecture that decouples CPU-parallel simulation from GPU policy updates through a unified runtime for data movement, buffering, and synchronization. UniLab is implemented as a complete and extensible training system using MuJoCoUni and MotrixSim CPU-batched physics backends, supporting PPO, SAC, FlashSAC, TD3, and APPO. On representative simulation-based robot control tasks, UniLab improves end-to-end training efficiency by 3--10$\times$ under the same hardware configuration, while reducing dependence on the NVIDIA CUDA-based software stack and supporting cross-platform execution on the Apple macOS platform and the AMD ROCm and Intel XPU accelerator backends. These results show that GPU simulation is an effective path to efficient training, but not a necessary one, broadening the practical system choices available for robot RL training. Project page: https://github.com/unilabsim/UniLab.

</details>


### [544] [RoboWits: Unexpected Challenges for Robotic Creative Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30326)
*Chunru Lin,Hongxin Zhang,Fenghao Yu,Zhehuan Chen,Thomas L. Griffiths,Yejin Choi,David Held,Chuang Gan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboWits是一个双臂机器人基准测试，通过自动化任务生成流程创建具有难度分级的推理型任务，评估机器人在意外条件下的认知推理、创造性工具使用和鲁棒性。实验显示预训练VLA在种子任务上表现尚可，但在变异任务中表现脆弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人基准测试主要侧重技能执行，缺乏对机器人在真实环境中应对意外挑战时的认知推理、适应性及创造性问题解决能力的系统性评估。

Method: 提出基于多智能体协作框架的自动化任务生成流程，包含种子任务生成与验证、指标生成、场景生成和任务变异四个智能体；构建了30个种子任务和208个变异任务，涵盖几何、材料和装配三个推理维度并设置难度分级。

Result: 预训练VLA在单任务微调后能在种子任务上取得初步成功，但在变异任务上表现不佳，暴露了其在需要推理、策略适应和对欺骗性或受限环境鲁棒性的操作任务中的脆弱性。

Conclusion: 当前机器人策略在推理型操作任务中存在显著性能差距，尤其是对任务变异和意外条件的鲁棒性严重不足，亟需提升认知推理能力。

Abstract: The ability to reason, adapt, and creatively solve problems under unexpected challenges is essential for robots operating in real-world environments. However, current robotic benchmarks primarily emphasize skill-level execution and provide limited insight into such cognitive reasoning capabilities. We introduce RoboWits, a bi-manual robotic benchmark designed to systematically evaluate cognitive reasoning, creative tool use, and robustness to unexpected conditions. To enable scalable construction of high-quality reasoning-centric unexpected scenarios, we propose an automated task generation pipeline formulated as a multi-agent cooperative framework, comprising agents for seed task generation and verification, metric generation, scene generation, and task mutation. Using the pipeline, we curated 30 diverse seed tasks and 208 tasks with mutations and graded difficulty across geometry, material, and assembly-based reasoning. We benchmark popular robot policies, pre-trained VLAs, and oracle-state planners. Our results reveal a significant performance gap: while pre-trained VLAs exhibit preliminary success on seed tasks after single-task fine-tuning, they struggle to perform on mutated tasks, implying their brittleness in manipulation tasks requiring reasoning, strategy adaptation, and robustness to deceptive or constrained environments. Project page is available at https://umass-embodied-agi.github.io/RoboWits.

</details>


### [545] [DynaFLIP: Rethinking Robotics Perception via Tri-Modal-Dynamics Guided Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30350)
*Jusuk Lee,Seungjae Lee,Jonghun Shin,Hoseong Jung,Sungha Kim,Daesol Cho,H. Jin Kim,Jia-Bin Huang,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DynaFLIP提出一种动力学感知的多模态预训练框架，通过构建图像-语言-3D流三元组并最小化共享超球面空间中的单纯形体积，将运动理解融入视觉编码器预训练，显著提升机器人操作中下游策略的泛化能力，在分布外场景下性能提升达22.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人学习流水线中，视觉编码器通常基于静态识别或视觉-语言对齐进行预训练，导致运动理解完全依赖下游策略学习，未能充分利用预训练阶段捕捉动作相关的动态场景信息。

Method: 构建图像-语言-3D流三元组作为训练监督信号，在共享超球面空间中最小化三个模态的单纯形体积以增强对齐；同时结合余弦正则化器和对比学习目标，避免几何歧义和平凡坍塌。

Result: DynaFLIP在多种仿真和真实场景中，作为可复用的视觉骨干网络，在不同下游策略（包括VLA）上均一致优于基线方法，在分布外场景下性能提升高达22.5%。

Conclusion: 视觉表征不仅应编码场景中存在什么，还应编码世界在动作作用下如何变化，这种动力学感知的表征能有效提升机器人操作的泛化性能。

Abstract: Robot manipulation critically depends on perception that preserves the action-relevant aspects of a scene. Yet most robot learning pipelines are built upon visual encoders pre-trained for static recognition or vision-language alignment, leaving motion understanding to downstream policies. We introduce DynaFLIP, a dynamics-aware multimodal pre-training framework that pushes motion understanding upstream into perception. We construct image-language-3D flow triplets from heterogeneous human and robot videos, and use these triplets as training-time supervision to shape an image-only encoder. Our key idea is to encourage the three modalities to span a small simplex volume in the shared hyperspherical space -- a smaller simplex volume indicating stronger alignment. To avoid the geometric ambiguity and trivial collapse of naive volume minimization, we combine simplex-volume minimization with a cosine regularizer and a contrastive objective. Our analyses show that DynaFLIP focuses on control-relevant regions critical for manipulation. The resulting dynamics-aware representations serve as reusable visual backbones and consistently outperform baselines across diverse downstream policies, including VLAs. We validate this across diverse simulation and real-world setups, with gains reaching +22.5% under out-of-distribution scenarios. Our results suggest that robot generalization improves when visual representations are trained to encode not just what is present, but how the world changes under action.

</details>


### [546] [Learning A Simulation-based Visual Policy for Real-world Peg In Unseen Holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.04297)
*Liang Xie,Hongxiang Yu,Kechun Xu,Tong Yang,Minhang Wang,Haojian Lu,Rong Xiong,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于学习的视觉插拔方法，通过解耦感知和策略模块，实现在仿真中训练多种形状，并零样本或少样本迁移到真实世界中任意未见形状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉插拔方法对特定形状依赖性强，泛化到未见形状需要大量真实数据或重新训练，sim-to-real迁移成本高。

Method: 框架由分割网络(SN)、虚拟传感器网络(VSN)和控制器网络(CN)组成。VSN从分割图像中测量未见形状的位姿，CN基于形状无关的位姿测量实现通用插拔。迁移时仅需微调SN，且通过一分钟人工教学自动收集和标注数据。

Result: 在电动车辆充电系统中，仅需数百个自动标注样本完成SN迁移，实现了2-3秒内10/10的成功率。

Conclusion: 通过解耦感知与策略的泛化，以极小的sim-to-real代价实现了对任意未见形状的视觉插拔，验证了方法的有效性和实用性。

Abstract: This paper proposes a learning-based visual peg-in-hole that enables training with several shapes in simulation, and adapting to arbitrary unseen shapes in real world with minimal sim-to-real cost. The core idea is to decouple the generalization of the sensory-motor policy to the design of a fast-adaptable perception module and a simulated generic policy module. The framework consists of a segmentation network (SN), a virtual sensor network (VSN), and a controller network (CN). Concretely, the VSN is trained to measure the pose of the unseen shape from a segmented image. After that, given the shape-agnostic pose measurement, the CN is trained to achieve generic peg-in-hole. Finally, when applying to real unseen holes, we only have to fine-tune the SN required by the simulated VSN+CN. To further minimize the transfer cost, we propose to automatically collect and annotate the data for the SN after one-minute human teaching. Simulated and real-world results are presented under the configurations of eye-to/in-hand. An electric vehicle charging system with the proposed policy inside achieves a 10/10 success rate in 2-3s, using only hundreds of auto-labeled samples for the SN transfer.

</details>


### [547] [Phantom: Training Robots Without Robots Using Only Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00779)
*Marion Lepert,Jiaying Fang,Jeannette Bohg*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种可扩展框架，直接从人类视频演示中训练机器人操作策略，无需任何机器人数据，通过手部姿态估计和视觉域编辑将人类演示转化为机器人兼容的观察-动作对，在多种任务上实现高达92%的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前通用机器人训练严重依赖遥操作演示，难以规模化扩展，需要探索直接从人类视频学习的方法以降低数据收集成本。

Method: 利用手部姿态估计提取人类演示中的动作信息，通过视觉数据编辑（去除人类手臂、叠加渲染机器人模型）对齐视觉域，将人类视频转化为机器人兼容的观察-动作对，实现零样本部署。

Result: 在可变形物体操作、多物体清扫、插入等多种任务上达到最高92%的成功率，且能泛化到新环境并支持闭环执行。

Conclusion: 证明了仅使用人类视频即可训练有效的机器人操作策略，为可扩展的机器人学习开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Training general-purpose robots requires learning from large and diverse data sources. Current approaches rely heavily on teleoperated demonstrations which are difficult to scale. We present a scalable framework for training manipulation policies directly from human video demonstrations, requiring no robot data. Our method converts human demonstrations into robot-compatible observation-action pairs using hand pose estimation and visual data editing. We inpaint the human arm and overlay a rendered robot to align the visual domains. This enables zero-shot deployment on real hardware without any fine-tuning. We demonstrate strong success rates-up to 92%-on a range of tasks including deformable object manipulation, multi-object sweeping, and insertion. Our approach generalizes to novel environments and supports closed-loop execution. By demonstrating that effective policies can be trained using only human videos, our method broadens the path to scalable robot learning.

</details>


### [548] [Practical Insights on Grasp Strategies for Mobile Manipulation in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.12512)
*Isabella Huang,Richard Cheng,Sangwoon Kim,Dan Kruse,Carolyn Chen,Lukas Kaul,JC Hancock,Shanmuga Harikumar,Mark Tjersland,James Borders,Dan Helmick*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了SHOPPER机器人平台，在真实杂货店环境中开发并测试通用抓取策略，通过数百次抓取实验分析主要失败模式，为机器人抓取领域提供实践见解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前移动操作机器人在非结构化环境中的可靠抓取能力仍存在显著不足，阻碍了其广泛的实际部署。

Method: 开发了SHOPPER移动操作机器人平台，在真实杂货店（物品、货架、布局多样性极高）中设计和部署通用抓取策略，并进行数百次实地抓取实验和失败模式分析。

Result: 识别了数百次不同抓取尝试中的关键失败模式，提供了详细的实地测试分析结果。

Conclusion: 通过分析真实世界部署中的失败模式，为机器人社区指出了抓取领域亟待解决的开放性问题，提供了有价值的实践指导。

Abstract: Mobile manipulation robots are continuously advancing, with their grasping capabilities rapidly progressing. However, there are still significant gaps preventing state-of-the-art mobile manipulators from widespread real-world deployments, including their ability to reliably grasp items in unstructured environments. To help bridge this gap, we developed SHOPPER, a mobile manipulation robot platform designed to push the boundaries of reliable and generalizable grasp strategies. We develop these grasp strategies and deploy them in a real-world grocery store -- an exceptionally challenging setting chosen for its vast diversity of manipulable items, fixtures, and layouts. In this work, we present our detailed approach to designing general grasp strategies towards picking any item in a real grocery store. Additionally, we provide an in-depth analysis of our latest real-world field test, discussing key findings related to fundamental failure modes over hundreds of distinct pick attempts. Through our detailed analysis, we aim to offer valuable practical insights and identify key grasping challenges, which can guide the robotics community towards pressing open problems in the field.

</details>


### [549] [Follow Everything: A Leader-Following and Obstacle Avoidance Framework with Goal-Aware Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19399)
*Qianyi Zhang,Shijian Ma,Boyi Liu,Jianhao Jiao,Dimitrios Kanoulas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一框架，通过分割模型替代传统检测模型实现任意形态领导者跟随，并利用距离帧缓冲器增强识别鲁棒性；同时设计目标感知自适应机制和基于图的规划器，在领导者离开视野时仍能保持高效、避障的跟随。四足机器人实验证明该方法在跟随成功率、视觉丢失时长、碰撞率和距离控制上均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有领导者跟随方法难以泛化到任意形态的领导目标，且当领导者暂时离开机器人视野时往往失效，缺乏一个统一、鲁棒的解决方案。

Method: 1）用分割模型替代检测模型，使领导者可以是任意物体；2）引入距离帧缓冲器，存储多距离下的领导者嵌入以增强识别鲁棒性；3）设计目标感知自适应机制，根据领导者的可见性和运动状态调控机器人规划状态；4）采用基于图的规划器为每种状态生成候选轨迹，实现高效跟随与避障。

Result: 在室内外环境中使用四足机器人跟随多种领导者（人、地面机器人、无人机、四足机器人、停止标识），在跟随成功率、视觉丢失时长、碰撞率和领导者-跟随者距离等指标上均取得竞争力提升。

Conclusion: 所提统一框架有效解决了领导者形态泛化与视野丢失两大挑战，为机器人灵活、鲁棒的领导者跟随任务提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Robust and flexible leader-following is a critical capability for robots to integrate into human society. While existing methods struggle to generalize to leaders of arbitrary form and often fail when the leader temporarily leaves the robot's field of view, this work introduces a unified framework addressing both challenges. First, traditional detection models are replaced with a segmentation model, allowing the leader to be anything. To enhance recognition robustness, a distance frame buffer is implemented that stores leader embeddings at multiple distances, accounting for the unique characteristics of leader-following tasks. Second, a goal-aware adaptation mechanism is designed to govern robot planning states based on the leader's visibility and motion, complemented by a graph-based planner that generates candidate trajectories for each state, ensuring efficient following with obstacle avoidance. Simulations and real-world experiments with a legged robot follower and various leaders (human, ground robot, UAV, legged robot, stop sign) in both indoor and outdoor environments show competitive improvements in follow success rate, reduced visual loss duration, lower collision rate, and decreased leader-follower distance.

</details>


### [550] [Simulation-based planning of Motion Sequences for Automated Procedure Optimization in Multi-Robot Assembly Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.23270)
*Loris Schneider,Marc Ungen,Elias Huber,Jan-Felix Klein*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于仿真的方法，用于生成可重构多机器人装配单元中优化、协调的无碰撞运动序列，通过将装配步骤分解为核心操作与遍历操作，并采用基于分解的运动规划策略，在调度优化中整合可行遍历操作，最终生成了优于分散式运动规划基线的多机器人装配方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可重构多机器人单元能够应对波动的装配需求，但其配置的重复规划带来了新挑战，特别是需要生成优化的、协调的多机器人运动序列以最小化装配时长。

Method: 将装配步骤分解为任务相关的核心操作（受约束且预定）和连接遍历操作（具有优化潜力）；将核心操作调度建模为优化问题，采用采样启发式、树搜索和无梯度优化等多种求解技术；提出基于分解的运动规划策略，识别调度中可独立求解的特定区域，并采用修改后的集中式路径规划算法。

Result: 所提方法生成了高效且无碰撞的多机器人装配流程，在仿真实验中优于依赖分散式、机器人独立运动规划的基线方法。

Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了可重构多机器人装配单元中的运动序列优化问题，通过分解策略实现了优于分散式规划的性能。

Abstract: Reconfigurable multi-robot cells offer a promising approach to meet fluctuating assembly demands. However, the recurrent planning of their configurations introduces new challenges, particularly in generating optimized, coordinated multi-robot motion sequences that minimize the assembly duration. This work presents a simulation-based method for generating such optimized sequences. The approach separates assembly steps into task-related core operations and connecting traverse operations. While core operations are constrained and predetermined, traverse operations offer substantial optimization potential. Scheduling the core operations is formulated as an optimization problem, requiring feasible traverse operations to be integrated using a decomposition-based motion planning strategy. Several solution techniques are explored, including a sampling heuristic, tree-based search and gradient-free optimization. For motion planning, a decomposition method is proposed that identifies specific areas in the schedule, which can be solved independently with modified centralized path planning algorithms. The proposed method generates efficient and collision-free multi-robot assembly procedures that outperform a baseline relying on decentralized, robot-individual motion planning. Its effectiveness is demonstrated through simulation experiments.

</details>


### [551] [TRUST-Planner: Topology-guided Robust Trajectory Planner for AAVs with Uncertain Obstacle Spatial-temporal Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.14610)
*Junzhi Li,Teng Long,Jingliang Sun,Jianxin Zhong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TRUST-Planner 提出了一种拓扑引导的分层规划框架，通过前端动态增强可见概率路线图（DEV-PRM）和后端无终端最小控制多项式（UTF-MINCO）结合动态距离场（DDF），实现了复杂动态环境中自主空中飞行器的高鲁棒时空避障，仿真成功率96%且计算达毫秒级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自主空中飞行器运动规划框架在复杂动态环境中面临局部极小值和死锁问题，导致碰撞风险增加，亟需更鲁棒的规划方法。

Method: 提出TRUST-Planner：前端采用动态增强可见概率路线图（DEV-PRM）快速探索拓扑路径提供全局引导；后端使用无终端最小控制多项式（UTF-MINCO）和动态距离场（DDF）实现高效预测性避障与并行计算；并引入增量多分支轨迹管理框架支持时空拓扑决策，利用历史信息减少重规划时间。

Result: 仿真实验中TRUST-Planner在复杂环境下达到96%的成功率，计算效率达毫秒级；真实实验验证了方法的可行性与实用性。

Conclusion: TRUST-Planner通过拓扑引导与分层规划有效解决了局部极小值和死锁问题，显著提升了复杂动态环境中的避障鲁棒性和实时性。

Abstract: Despite extensive developments in motion planning of autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs), existing frameworks faces the challenges of local minima and deadlock in complex dynamic environments, leading to increased collision risks. To address these challenges, we present TRUST-Planner, a topology-guided hierarchical planning framework for robust spatial-temporal obstacle avoidance. In the frontend, a dynamic enhanced visible probabilistic roadmap (DEV-PRM) is proposed to rapidly explore topological paths for global guidance. The backend utilizes a uniform terminal-free minimum control polynomial (UTF-MINCO) and dynamic distance field (DDF) to enable efficient predictive obstacle avoidance and fast parallel computation. Furthermore, an incremental multi-branch trajectory management framework is introduced to enable spatio-temporal topological decision-making, while efficiently leveraging historical information to reduce replanning time. Simulation results show that TRUST-Planner outperforms baseline competitors, achieving a 96\% success rate and millisecond-level computation efficiency in tested complex environments. Real-world experiments further validate the feasibility and practicality of the proposed method.

</details>


### [552] [Contrastive Representation Regularization for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01711)
*Taeyoung Kim,Jimin Lee,Myungkyu Koo,Dongyoung Kim,Kyungmin Lee,Changyeon Kim,Younggyo Seo,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出机器人状态感知对比损失（RS-CL），通过将VLM表示与机器人本体感觉状态对齐，弥补VLA模型中视觉-语言表示与机器人信号之间的鸿沟，显著提升了RoboCasa-Kitchen基准和真实机器人操作任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型虽然利用预训练VLM的丰富表示，但其表示对机器人信号（如控制动作和本体感觉信息）缺乏敏感性，导致表示不够优化。

Method: 提出RS-CL损失函数，利用机器人本体感觉状态之间的相对距离作为软监督信号，将VLM表示与机器人状态进行对齐，作为原始动作预测目标的补充正则化项，轻量级且兼容标准VLA训练流程。

Result: 在RoboCasa-Kitchen基准上达到69.7%的当前最优性能；在真实机器人操作任务上将成功率从45.0%提升至58.3%。

Conclusion: RS-CL作为一种简单有效的表示正则化方法，能够显著提升VLA模型在机器人操作任务中的性能，且计算开销小、易于集成到现有训练流程中。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robot manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, their representations arguably remain suboptimal, lacking sensitivity to robotic signals such as control actions and proprioceptive information. To address the issue, we introduce Robot State-aware Contrastive Loss (RS-CL), a simple and effective representation regularization for VLA models, designed to bridge the gap between VLM representations and robotic signals. In particular, RS-CL aligns the representations more closely with the robot's proprioceptive states by using relative distances between the states as soft supervision. Complementing the original action prediction objective, RS-CL enhances control-relevant representation learning, while being lightweight and fully compatible with standard VLA training pipelines. Our empirical results demonstrate that RS-CL substantially improves the performance of state-of-the-art VLA models; it pushes the prior art to 69.7% achieving the state-of-the-art performance on the RoboCasa-Kitchen benchmark, and boosts success rates from 45.0% to 58.3% on challenging real-robot manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [553] [ScheduleStream: Temporal Planning with Samplers for GPU-Accelerated Multi-Arm Task and Motion Planning & Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.04758)
*Caelan Garrett,Fabio Ramos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ScheduleStream，首个支持采样操作的一般性规划与调度框架，通过混合持续动作和GPU加速采样，将任务与运动规划(TAMP)扩展为并行调度方案，在双臂机器人任务中验证了其高效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂和人形机器人因多臂并行操作能力而具有吸引力，但控制多臂面临混合离散-连续动作空间的计算挑战。现有TAMP算法虽能高效规划混合空间，但生成的方案通常每次仅移动单臂，无法实现并行调度，限制了任务效率。

Method: 提出ScheduleStream框架，核心创新包括：(1) 混合持续动作（Hybrid Durative Actions）建模时间动力学，动作可异步启动且持续时间是参数的函数；(2) 领域无关的通用求解算法；(3) 将框架应用于任务与运动规划及调度（TAMPAS），在采样器中引入GPU加速以提升规划效率。

Result: 在仿真环境中与多种消融基线对比，ScheduleStream算法产生更高效的解决方案。并在多个真实世界双臂机器人任务上成功部署验证。

Conclusion: ScheduleStream作为首个通用规划与调度框架，有效弥合了TAMP与并行调度之间的鸿沟，为双臂/人形机器人的高效协作操作提供了可行的技术路径。

Abstract: Bimanual and humanoid robots are appealing because of their human-like ability to leverage multiple arms to efficiently complete tasks. However, controlling multiple arms at once is computationally challenging due to the growth in the hybrid discrete-continuous action space. Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) algorithms can efficiently plan in hybrid spaces but generally produce plans, where only one arm is moving at a time, rather than schedules that allow for parallel arm motion. In order to extend TAMP to produce schedules, we present ScheduleStream, the first general-purpose framework for planning & scheduling with sampling operations. ScheduleStream models temporal dynamics using hybrid durative actions, which can be started asynchronously and persist for a duration that's a function of their parameters. We propose domain-independent algorithms that solve ScheduleStream problems without any application-specific mechanisms. We apply ScheduleStream to Task and Motion Planning & Scheduling (TAMPAS), where we use GPU acceleration within samplers to expedite planning. We compare ScheduleStream algorithms to several ablations in simulation and find that they produce more efficient solutions. We demonstrate ScheduleStream on several real-world bimanual robot tasks at https://schedulestream.github.io.

</details>


### [554] [SM2ITH: Safe Mobile Manipulation with Interactive Human Prediction via Task-Hierarchical Bilevel Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.17798)
*Francesco D'Orazio,Sepehr Samavi,Xintong Du,Siqi Zhou,Giuseppe Oriolo,Angela P. Schoellig*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SM$^2$ITH框架，将层次化任务模型预测控制与交互式人体运动预测相结合，通过双层优化实现移动机械臂在动态人类环境中的安全多任务执行，在两个机器人平台上的实验验证了其优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于优化的层次化任务MPC方法主要应用于静态或结构化场景，缺乏对人类反应行为的预测能力，难以扩展到动态人类中心环境。

Method: 提出SM$^2$ITH框架，通过双层优化将层次化任务MPC（HTMPC）与交互式人体运动预测统一建模，联合考虑机器人与人类动力学。

Result: 在Stretch 3和Ridgeback-UR10两个移动机械臂平台上，通过递送任务、顺序抓取放置任务和对抗性人类行为三类实验验证，交互式预测方法在安全和效率上优于加权目标或开环人体模型基线。

Conclusion: 交互式人体运动预测能够实现安全高效的机器人-人类协调，为移动机械臂在动态人类环境中的应用提供了有效框架。

Abstract: Mobile manipulators are designed to perform complex sequences of navigation and manipulation tasks in human-centered environments. While recent optimization-based methods such as Hierarchical Task Model Predictive Control (HTMPC) enable efficient multitask execution with strict task priorities, they have so far been applied mainly to static or structured scenarios. Extending these approaches to dynamic human-centered environments requires predictive models that capture how humans react to the actions of the robot. This work introduces Safe Mobile Manipulation with Interactive Human Prediction via Task-Hierarchical Bilevel Model Predictive Control (SM$^2$ITH), a unified framework that combines HTMPC with interactive human motion prediction through bilevel optimization that jointly accounts for robot and human dynamics. The framework is validated on two different mobile manipulators, the Stretch 3 and the Ridgeback-UR10, across three experimental settings: (i) delivery tasks with different navigation and manipulation priorities, (ii) sequential pick-and-place tasks with different human motion prediction models, and (iii) interactions involving adversarial human behavior. Our results highlight how interactive prediction enables safe and efficient coordination, outperforming baselines that rely on weighted objectives or open-loop human models.

</details>


### [555] [A Review of Learning-Based Motion Planning: Toward a Data-Driven Optimal Control Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.11944)
*Jia Hu,Yang Chang,Haoran Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次系统综述了数据驱动最优控制（DDOC）范式在自动驾驶运动规划中的应用，该范式融合了最优控制的理论保证与机器学习（包括模仿学习、强化学习和生成式AI）的自适应能力。论文提出了DDOC运动规划的实施路线图（包含定制化、动力学自适应和自调优三个维度），并指出了四个未来研究方向以弥合现实鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于规则的规划方法可验证且可解释，但复杂场景泛化能力差；而基于学习的方法（IL、RL、生成式AI）适应性强，但存在不透明性和安全风险。现有综述多孤立分析AI方法，忽视了将其与严格控制框架融合的潜力，因此需要系统性综述数据驱动最优控制范式。

Method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，聚焦DDOC范式，从定制化、动力学自适应和自调优三个关键维度构建实施路线图，并识别未来研究方向。

Result: 提出了首个DDOC运动规划路线图，将实施结构化组织为三个维度，并指出了四个弥合现实鸿沟的未来研究方向。

Conclusion: DDOC范式有望加速向可信赖且类人的自动驾驶过渡，通过融合最优控制的理论严谨性与机器学习的自适应能力来弥补现有方法的不足。

Abstract: Motion planning for autonomous driving (AD) faces a critical trade-off. While traditional rule-based pipelines offer verifiable safety and interpretability, they often fail to generalize in complex scenarios. Conversely, emerging learning-based methods-including imitation learning (IL), reinforcement learning (RL), and generative AI-offer greater adaptability but are often constrained by opacity and safety risks. Existing surveys typically analyze these AI methods in isolation, overlooking the potential of integrating them with rigorous control frameworks. To bridge this gap, this paper presents the first systematic review of the Data-Driven Optimal Control (DDOC) paradigm, explicitly examining how it synergizes the theoretical guarantees of optimal control with the adaptive capabilities of modern machine learning. Building on this framework, we propose the first roadmap for DDOC-based motion planning, structuring its implementation into three critical dimensions: customization, dynamics adaptation, and self-tuning. Finally, to close the remaining reality gap, we identify four future research directions, thereby accelerating the transition to trustworthy and human-like autonomous driving.

</details>


### [556] [TACO: Temporal Consensus Optimization for Continual Neural Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04516)
*Xunlan Zhou,Hongrui Zhao,Negar Mehr*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TACO提出了一种无需重放历史数据的连续神经映射框架，通过时序共识优化，利用历史模型快照作为时序邻居来约束当前地图更新，在动态场景中平衡记忆效率与适应性，性能优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经隐式映射方法依赖重放历史观测来保持一致性，且假设场景静态，无法在严格内存和计算约束下适应动态环境中的持续学习需求。

Method: 将映射问题重新表述为时序共识优化问题，将过去的模型快照视为时序邻居，通过加权共识约束当前地图更新：可靠的过去几何约束优化，不可靠或过时的区域允许根据新观测进行修正，无需存储或重放历史数据。

Result: 在仿真和真实实验中，TACO能够稳健地适应场景变化，并在持续学习基线中一致取得更优性能。

Conclusion: TACO为动态机器人环境中的连续神经映射提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案，在记忆效率和适应性之间实现了良好平衡。

Abstract: Neural implicit mapping has emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic navigation and scene understanding. However, real-world robotic deployment requires continual adaptation to changing environments under strict memory and computation constraints, which existing mapping systems fail to support. Most prior methods rely on replaying historical observations to preserve consistency and assume static scenes. As a result, they cannot adapt to continual learning in dynamic robotic settings. To address these challenges, we propose TACO (TemporAl Consensus Optimization), a replay-free framework for continual neural mapping. We reformulate mapping as a temporal consensus optimization problem, where we treat past model snapshots as temporal neighbors. Intuitively, our approach resembles a model consulting its own past knowledge. We update the current map by enforcing weighted consensus with historical representations. Our method allows reliable past geometry to constrain optimization while permitting unreliable or outdated regions to be revised in response to new observations. TACO achieves a balance between memory efficiency and adaptability without storing or replaying previous data. Through extensive simulated and real-world experiments, we show that TACO robustly adapts to scene changes, and consistently outperforms other continual learning baselines. Code is available at https://iconlab.negarmehr.com/TACO

</details>


### [557] [Force Sensing for Wearable Human-Robot Interfaces via Fluidic Innervation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13436)
*Noah Rubin,Ava Schraeder,Hrishikesh Sahu,Thomas C. Bulea,Lillian Chin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种流体神经支配（fluidic innervation）传感方法，通过3D打印硅胶垫内嵌气道测量人机交互力，该方法具有高线性度（R²=0.998），并在等长膝关节力矩测试、动态二头肌弯举及下肢外骨骼深蹲实验中验证了其有效性，为可穿戴机器人实时传感提供了可定制的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机界面的力学表征对理解用户行为和优化可穿戴机器人性能至关重要，但传统传感器存在制造复杂性和非线性响应问题，亟需一种易于定制且信噪比高的传感方案。

Method: 采用3D打印制造内含空气通道的硅胶垫，施加外力时气道压缩导致气压变化，通过商用压力传感器测量；在台架测试、等长膝关节力矩测试、动态与阶梯式等长二头肌弯举以及下肢外骨骼深蹲等多种场景下验证性能。

Result: 台架测试中压力与施加力呈高度线性相关（R²=0.998）；临床测力计中与等长膝关节力矩呈强线性关系；在非约束动态运动中保持良好性能；集成至外骨骼后，垫压力能够一致追踪深蹲相位和整体任务动力学。

Conclusion: 流体神经支配是一种易于定制、高信噪比、高时间分辨率的传感模态，可用于捕获人机交互信息；长期有望为可穿戴机器人提供实时传感输入以优化控制和评估用户功能。

Abstract: Mechanically characterizing the human-machine interface is essential to understanding user behavior and optimizing wearable robot performance. This interface has been challenging to sensorize due to manufacturing complexity and non-linear sensor responses. Here, we measure human limb-device interaction via fluidic innervation, creating a 3D-printed silicone pad with embedded air channels to measure forces. As forces are applied to the pad, the air channels compress, resulting in a pressure change measurable by off-the-shelf pressure transducers. We demonstrate in benchtop testing that pad pressure is highly linearly related to applied force ($R^2 = 0.998$) and confirmed strong linear relationships to isometric knee torque in a clinical dynamometer with strategic pad placement. We built on these idealized settings to test pad performance in more unconstrained settings, including during cyclic dynamic and stepwise isometric bicep curls. Finally, we integrated the sensor into a lower-extremity robotic exoskeleton and recorded pad pressure during repeated squats with the device unpowered. Pad pressure tracked squat phase and overall task dynamics consistently. Collectively, our preliminary results suggest fluidic innervation is a readily customizable sensing modality with high signal-to-noise ratio and temporal resolution for capturing human-machine interaction. In the long-term, this modality may provide an alternative real-time sensing input to control / optimize wearable robotic systems and to capture user function during device use.

</details>


### [558] [Multifingered force-aware control for humanoid robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08142)
*Pasquale Marra,Gabriele M. Caddeo,Ugo Pattacini,Lorenzo Natale*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种力感知控制与力分配框架，利用触觉传感器估计力，通过模型控制方案最小化压力中心与指尖接触多边形质心之间的距离，在平衡任务中达到82.7%的成功率，多物体场景下达到80%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决多指手机器人平台中，面对质量分布变化或不稳定接触时，如何通过力感知控制维持稳定接触的问题。

Method: 1) 使用Xela磁传感器采集触觉信号与真实力测量数据，训练力估计器；2) 设计基于模型的控制器，同时调整躯干、手臂、手腕和手指的运动，重新分配力；3) 通过最小化压力中心(CoP)与指尖接触多边形质心之间的距离来实现稳定控制。

Result: 在五种物体的平衡任务中成功率为82.7%，多物体场景下准确率为80%。

Conclusion: 该方法依赖估计力而非原始触觉信号，因此可迁移至任何具备力估计能力的传感器，具有良好的泛化性和实用性。

Abstract: In this paper, we address force-aware control and force distribution in robotic platforms with multi-fingered hands. Given a target goal and force estimates from tactile sensors, we design a controller that adapts the motion of the torso, arm, wrist, and fingers, redistributing forces to maintain stable contact with objects of varying mass distribution or unstable contacts. To estimate forces, we collect a dataset of tactile signals and ground-truth force measurements using five Xela magnetic sensors interacting with indenters, and train force estimators. We then introduce a model-based control scheme that minimizes the distance between the Center of Pressure (CoP) and the centroid of the fingertips contact polygon. Since our method relies on estimated forces rather than raw tactile signals, it has the potential to be applied to any sensor capable of force estimation. We validate our framework on a balancing task with five objects, achieving a $82.7\%$ success rate, and further evaluate it in multi-object scenarios, achieving $80\%$ accuracy. Code and data can be found here https://github.com/hsp-iit/multifingered-force-aware-control.

</details>


### [559] [When Should a Robot Think? Resource-Aware Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Embodied Robotic Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16673)
*Jun Liu,Pu Zhao,Zhenglun Kong,Xuan Shen,Peiyan Dong,Fan Yang,Lin Cui,Hao Tang,Geng Yuan,Wei Niu,Wenbin Zhang,Xue Lin,Gaowen Liu,Yanzhi Wang,Dong Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RARRL框架，通过强化学习学习高层编排策略，让具身智能体根据当前观测、执行历史和剩余资源自适应决定是否调用推理、调用何种推理角色以及分配多少计算预算，从而在保持高任务成功率的同时降低执行延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型驱动的具身机器人系统在推理时引入大量计算延迟和资源开销，过度推理会延迟行动，而推理不足则导致决策错误和任务失败。现有方法缺乏对"何时该推理、何时该行动"这一基本问题的有效解答。

Method: 提出RARRL（Resource-Aware Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning）层次化框架。不同于学习底层控制策略，RARRL学习一个高层编排策略，在智能体的决策层运行，自适应决定是否调用推理、选择推理角色以及基于当前观测、执行历史和剩余资源分配计算预算。

Result: 在ALFRED基准测试上进行的实验表明，与固定或启发式推理策略相比，RARRL在提升任务成功率的同时降低了执行延迟并增强了鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 自适应推理控制对于构建可靠且高效的具身机器人智能体至关重要，RARRL为资源感知的具身智能体编排提供了一种有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Embodied robotic systems increasingly rely on large language model (LLM)-based agents to support high-level reasoning, planning, and decision-making during interactions with the environment. However, invoking LLM reasoning introduces substantial computational latency and resource overhead, which can interrupt action execution and reduce system reliability. Excessive reasoning may delay actions, while insufficient reasoning often leads to incorrect decisions and task failures. This raises a fundamental question for embodied agents: when should the agent reason, and when should it act? In this work, we propose RARRL (Resource-Aware Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning), a hierarchical framework for resource-aware orchestration of embodied agents. Rather than learning low-level control policies, RARRL learns a high-level orchestration policy that operates at the agent's decision-making layer. This policy enables the agent to adaptively determine whether to invoke reasoning, which reasoning role to employ, and how much computational budget to allocate based on current observations, execution history, and remaining resources. Extensive experiments, including evaluations with empirical latency profiles derived from the ALFRED benchmark, show that RARRL consistently improves task success rates while reducing execution latency and enhancing robustness compared with fixed or heuristic reasoning strategies. These results demonstrate that adaptive reasoning control is essential for building reliable and efficient embodied robotic agents.

</details>


### [560] [Environment-Adaptive Solid-State LiDAR-Inertial Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15864)
*Zhi Zhang,Chalermchon Satirapod,Bingtao Ma,Changjun Gu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种环境自适应的固态激光雷达-惯性SLAM方法，通过引入局部法向量约束和退化感知的地图更新策略，在极端和感知退化环境下实现了更高的定位精度和鲁棒性，平均RMSE降低12.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在极端环境中，固态LiDAR-inertial SLAM由于严重的几何退化（geometric degeneracy）和不可靠观测，导致优化病态和地图不一致，现有方法难以实现精确建图。

Method: 提出环境自适应固态LiDAR-惯性里程计，创新点包括：(1) 引入局部法向量约束（local normal-vector constraints）提升退化场景下状态估计的稳定性，抑制定位漂移；(2) 设计退化引导的地图更新策略（degeneration-guided map update strategy），提升地图精度，并通过优化后的地图表示进一步增强后续估计的定位精度。

Result: 在极端和感知退化环境下，所提方法在制图精度和鲁棒性上优于基线方法，平均RMSE降低最高达12.8%。

Conclusion: 局部法向量约束与退化感知地图维护相结合，能够有效应对几何退化问题，显著提升固态LiDAR-inertial SLAM在恶劣环境下的定位与建图性能。

Abstract: Solid-state LiDAR-inertial SLAM has attracted significant attention due to its advantages in speed and robustness. However, achieving accurate mapping in extreme environments remains challenging due to severe geometric degeneracy and unreliable observations, which often lead to ill-conditioned optimization and map inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we propose an environment-adaptive solid-state LiDAR-inertial odometry that integrates local normal-vector constraints with degeneracy-aware map maintenance to enhance localization accuracy. Specifically, we introduce local normal-vector constraints to improve the stability of state estimation, effectively suppressing localization drift in degenerate scenarios. Furthermore, we design a degeneration-guided map update strategy to improve map precision. Benefiting from the refined map representation, localization accuracy is further enhanced in subsequent estimation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior mapping accuracy and robustness in extreme and perceptually degraded environments, with an average RMSE reduction of up to 12.8% compared to the baseline method.

</details>


### [561] [Sentinel-VLA: A Metacognitive VLA Model with Active Status Monitoring for Dynamic Reasoning and Error Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01191)
*Wenhao Li,Xiu Su,Dan Niu,Yichao Cao,Hongyan Xu,Zhe Qu,Lei Fan,Shan You,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Sentinel-VLA，一种具有主动监控模块的元认知VLA模型，通过按需推理和自进化持续学习算法，在真实世界实验中任务成功率比当前最优模型PI0提升超过30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型面临推理能力有限、缺乏状态监控和难以自我纠错三大关键挑战。

Method: 提出Sentinel-VLA，包含：(1) 主动"哨兵"模块实时监控执行状态，仅在必要时触发动态推理或纠错；(2) 全自动数据生成与标注流程（44个任务，260万+转换）；(3) 自进化持续学习（SECL）算法识别能力边界并自动扩展数据；(4) 正交持续适配器（OC-Adapter）约束参数更新到正交空间，防止灾难性遗忘。

Result: 真实世界实验中，Sentinel-VLA的任务成功率比当前最优模型PI0提升超过30%。

Conclusion: 按需推理机制在保证鲁棒决策的同时最小化计算开销，持续学习策略有效扩展模型能力边界，代码、权重和数据生成流程将开源。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced the field of embodied manipulation by harnessing broad world knowledge and strong generalization. However, current VLA models still face several key challenges, including limited reasoning capability, lack of status monitoring, and difficulty in self-correction. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Sentinel-VLA}, a metacognitive VLA model equipped with an active ``sentinel'' module to monitor real-time execution status. Only when necessary, such as during initial planning or upon detecting an error, the model triggers a dynamic reasoning or formulate error recovery solutions. This on-demand reasoning mechanism ensures robust decision-making while minimizing computational overhead. Notably, all training data (spanning 44 tasks and over 2.6 million transitions) is automatically generated and annotated through our designed pipeline. We also propose the Self-Evolving Continual Learning (SECL) algorithm, which allows Sentinel-VLA to identify its capability boundaries and automatically collect data for expansion, paired with Orthogonal Continual Adapter (OC-Adapter) to constrain parameter updates to an orthogonal space, thereby preventing catastrophic forgetting. Real-world experiments demonstrate that Sentinel-VLA boosts the task success rate by over 30\% compared to the SOTA model, PI0. We will open-source all the code, weights, and data generation pipeline.

</details>


### [562] [VLA-ATTC: Adaptive Test-Time Compute for VLA Models with Relative Action Critic Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01194)
*Wenhao Li,Xiu Su,Yichao Cao,Hongyan Xu,Xiaobo Xia,Shan You,Yi Chen,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VLA-ATTC通过不确定性驱动的“认知离合器”使VLA模型具备自适应测试时计算能力，利用相对动作评论家模型进行成对比较选择最优动作，在LIBERO-LONG基准上将SOTA模型PI0.5的失败率降低超过50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖快速的直觉决策过程，缺乏深思熟虑，在复杂或模糊场景下容易产生次优甚至灾难性动作。

Method: 提出VLA-ATTC框架：(1) 基于不确定性的“认知离合器”动态切换反射执行与TTC深思阶段；(2) 相对动作评论家(RAC)模型通过成对比较从候选动作中识别最优动作，替代不稳定的绝对值估计；(3) 高效采样策略分摊计算成本；(4) 自动化数据流水线无需人工标注即可构建偏好对。

Result: 在LIBERO-LONG基准上，VLA-ATTC将SOTA模型PI0.5的失败率降低超过50%。

Conclusion: 自适应测试时计算能显著提升VLA模型在复杂场景下的决策质量，相对评价机制比绝对价值估计更稳定有效。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities and generalization in embodied manipulation. However, their decision-making relies on a fast, instinctive process that lacks deliberation. This strategy often leads to suboptimal or catastrophic actions when facing complex or ambiguous scenarios that require greater consideration. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{VLA-ATTC}, a framework that endows VLA models with adaptive test-time compute (TTC). VLA-ATTC employs an uncertainty-based ``cognitive clutch'' to dynamically transition from reflexive execution to a TTC deliberation phase when necessary. During TTC phase, a novel \textbf{Relative Action Critic} (RAC) model identifies the optimal action from generated candidates via pairwise comparisons. This relative mechanism replaces unstable absolute value estimation, significantly simplifying the learning objective. Furthermore, we introduce an efficient sampling strategy to amortize computational costs and an automated data pipeline that curates preference pairs without manual annotation. On the LIBERO-LONG benchmark, VLA-ATTC reduces the failure rate of the SOTA model PI0.5 by over 50\%. We will open-source all the code and weights.

</details>


### [563] [AttenA+: Rectifying Action Inequality in Robotic Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13548)
*Daojie Peng,Fulong Ma,Jiahang Cao,Qiang Zhang,Xupeng Xie,Jian Guo,Ping Luo,Andrew F. Luo,Boyu Zhou,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AttenA+框架，通过速度驱动的动作注意力机制重新加权训练目标，使视觉-语言-动作模型的学习重点与操作任务的物理关键性对齐，在多个基准测试和真实机器人上显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人基础模型沿用语言模型的"平坦"训练范式，对所有动作赋予相同的优化权重，忽视了机器人轨迹中低速度段（高精度需求）与高速度段（容错过渡）之间的物理层次异质性，导致模型在复杂长时域任务中性能受限。

Method: 提出AttenA+框架，这是一个与架构无关的即插即用增强方法。通过逆速度场重新加权训练目标，优先关注运动学关键段（低速度段），使模型的学习能力与操作任务的物理需求自然对齐，无需修改现有主干网络结构或增加额外参数。

Result: 在Libero基准上，将OpenVLA-OFT提升至98.6%（+1.5%）；在RoboTwin 2.0上，将FastWAM提升至92.4%（+0.6%）；在Franka机械臂的真实世界实验中验证了鲁棒性和跨任务泛化能力。

Conclusion: 挖掘动作序列的内在结构先验提供了一种高效、物理感知的范式，可作为标准缩放定律的补充，为通用机器人控制开辟新路径。

Abstract: Existing robotic foundation models, while powerful, are predicated on an implicit assumption of temporal homogeneity: treating all actions as equally informative during optimization. This "flat" training paradigm, inherited from language modeling, remains indifferent to the underlying physical hierarchy of manipulation. In reality, robot trajectories are fundamentally heterogeneous, where low-velocity segments often dictate task success through precision-demanding interactions, while high-velocity motions serve as error-tolerant transitions. Such a misalignment between uniform loss weighting and physical criticality fundamentally limits the performance of current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World-Action Models (WAM) in complex, long-horizon tasks. To rectify this, we introduce AttenA+, an architecture-agnostic framework that prioritizes kinematically critical segments via velocity-driven action attention. By reweighting the training objective based on the inverse velocity field, AttenA+ naturally aligns the model's learning capacity with the physical demands of manipulation. As a plug-and-play enhancement, AttenA+ can be integrated into existing backbones without structural modifications or additional parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AttenA+ significantly elevates the ceilings of current state-of-the-art models. Specifically, it improves OpenVLA-OFT to 98.6% (+1.5%) on the Libero benchmark and pushes FastWAM to 92.4% (+0.6%) on RoboTwin 2.0. Real-world validation on a Franka manipulator further showcases its robustness and cross-task generalization. Our work suggests that mining the intrinsic structural priors of action sequences offers a highly efficient, physics-aware complement to standard scaling laws, paving a new path for general-purpose robotic control.

</details>


### [564] [GaussianDream: A Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian World Model for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20752)
*Zijian Zhang,Yuqing Jiang,Qian Cheng,Xiaofan Li,Si Liu,Ding Zhao,Ping Luo,Weitao Zhou,Haibao Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GaussianDream，一种前馈式3D高斯世界模型插件，用于增强VLA策略的3D空间建模和未来预测能力，在多个机器人操作基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准动作模仿学习缺乏对显式3D空间信息、密集几何监督和未来环境演变的充分建模，而这些对于精确的机器人交互至关重要。

Method: 在编码器中引入可学习的GaussianDream Queries；训练时使用静态重建头和未来预测头分别生成当前3D高斯场景状态和未来高斯演化状态；当前分支用RGB渲染和深度监督，未来分支用未来RGB、深度和伪3D场景流信号监督；推理时丢弃辅助头，仅保留学到的前缀来条件化动作生成。

Result: LIBERO上98.4%，RoboCasa Human-50上54.8%，真实机器人任务上50.0%，均达到SOTA。相比现有3D增强VLA方法精度更高，且推理效率优于基于视频的世界模型方法。

Conclusion: GaussianDream通过3D高斯世界模型插件有效提升了VLA策略的空间感知能力和未来预测能力，在不增加测试时计算负担的前提下实现了高性能机器人操作。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have advanced language-conditioned robotic manipulation by transferring semantic priors from pretrained vision-language models to action generation. However, standard action-imitation learning often lacks sufficient modeling of explicit 3D spatial information, dense geometric supervision, and future environment evolution, all critical for precise robotic interaction. To address this, we propose \textbf{GaussianDream}, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian world-model plug-in. Specifically, we introduce learnable GaussianDream Queries in the encoder, enabling the model to capture current-frame 3D spatial structure and short-horizon future evolution. During training, the latent GaussianDream prefix is processed by a static reconstruction head and a future prediction head to produce current 3D Gaussian scene states and future Gaussian evolution states. The current branch is supervised by RGB rendering and depth, while the future branch uses future RGB, depth, and pseudo 3D scene-flow signals. During inference, GaussianDream discards all auxiliary heads and retains only the learned prefix to condition action generation, without test-time Gaussian reconstruction or future prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that GaussianDream achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple robotic manipulation benchmarks, reaching \textbf{98.4\%} on LIBERO, \textbf{54.8\%} on RoboCasa Human-50, and \textbf{50.0\%} on real-robot tasks. Compared with existing 3D-enhanced VLA methods, GaussianDream achieves strong accuracy while providing higher inference efficiency than video-based world-model approaches.

</details>


### [565] [CoRMA: Contrastive RMA for Contact-Rich Meta-Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22082)
*Wentian Wang,Chutong Wen,Hongxu Ma,Wuhao Wang,Zhexiong Xue,Abdul Haseeb Nizamani,Dandi Zhou,Xinhai Sun,Jianqiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CoRMA是一种基于对比学习的机器人运动自适应框架，通过6D语义接触上下文替换传统仿真参数自适应，结合因果Transformer在线推理接触状态，在装配任务中实现了无需示教、特权信息或梯度更新的 episode 内自适应，在仿真和真实机器人上均优于FORGE基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RMA在力主导的装配任务中依赖原始仿真参数适配，缺乏对接触状态语义层面的理解，且FORGE等基线在仿真中表现好但迁移到真实硬件后性能大幅下降，亟需一种更鲁棒、可泛化的接触感知自适应方法。

Method: 提出CoRMA框架：(1) 将原始仿真参数适配替换为紧凑的6D语义接触上下文（接触开始、侧向啮合、导引过渡、接触方向、卡滞）；(2) 使用可部署的因果Transformer适配器，基于力、本体感知和动作历史，通过语义回归和力状态对比学习目标在线推断该上下文；(3) 部署时移除oracle上下文，替换为推断出的语义接触上下文，实现无示教、无特权输入、无梯度更新的episode内自适应。

Result: 在PegInsert、GearMesh、NutThread三个装配任务的仿真（Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim 5.0）和真实Marvin机械臂上评估。与FORGE基线相比，FORGE在仿真中成功率高但真实硬件上大幅下降，CoRMA在受控目标位姿噪声下保持了更高的真实验证成功率。

Conclusion: 语义接触推断可作为相关装配任务族内可复用的自适应接口；更广泛的未见任务泛化和Real2Sim校准留作未来工作。

Abstract: We present CoRMA(Contrastive Robotic Motor Adaptation), a context-based meta-adaptation framework that modifies RMA for force-dominant assembly. CoRMA replaces raw simulator-parameter adaptation with a compact 6D simulator-only semantic contact context describing contact onset, lateral engagement, guided transition, contact direction, and jamming. A deployable causal Transformer adapter infers this context online from force, proprioceptive, and action histories using semantic regression and a force-regime contrastive objective. At deployment, oracle context is removed and replaced by the inferred context, enabling within-episode adaptation without demonstrations, privileged inputs, or gradient updates. We evaluate CoRMA on PegInsert, GearMesh, and NutThread in Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim 5.0 and on a real Marvin arm. Compared with FORGE baselines that achieve high simulation success but degrade substantially on hardware, CoRMA retains higher verified real success under controlled target-pose noise. These results support semantic contact inference as a reusable adaptation interface within a related assembly task family, while broader unseen-task generalization and Real2Sim calibration remain future work.

</details>


### [566] [HumanEgo: Zero-Shot Robot Learning from Minutes of Human Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24934)
*Zhi Wang,Botao He,Kelin Yu,Seungjae Lee,Ruohan Gao,Furong Huang,Yiannis Aloimonos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HumanEgo是一个无需机器人数据、硬件无关的框架，通过将人类第一人称视频中的操作演示提升到实体级别的双手交互表示，并利用密集辅助目标训练流匹配策略，实现零样本从人类到机器人的技能迁移。仅需30分钟人类视频即可达到92.5%平均成功率，远超同等时间的遥操作基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类第一人称视频中包含了丰富的操作演示，但人类与机器人在外观和运动学上的具身差异（embodiment gap）导致直接从人类数据迁移技能到机器人非常困难。现有方法通常依赖机器人数据或遥操作，成本高、泛化性差。

Method: 1) 提出实体级手-物交互表示（entity-level representation），将人类演示中的手和物体解耦为独立实体，桥接视觉外观差异；2) 采用流匹配策略（flow matching policy）进行动作生成；3) 引入密集辅助目标（dense auxiliary objectives），从轨迹的每个时间步提供监督信号，提升数据效率。

Result: 1) 每任务仅需30分钟人类视频即达92.5%平均成功率（15分钟达75%）；2) 相比同等时间的机器人遥操作数据，性能提升41%；3) 零样本迁移到新型机器人、相机和环境，表现鲁棒。

Conclusion: HumanEgo证明了仅利用少量人类第一人称视频即可高效、鲁棒地学习机器人操作策略，无需任何机器人数据或遥操作，为从人类演示到机器人技能迁移提供了实用且开源的解决方案。

Abstract: Human egocentric video captures rich manipulation demonstrations without any robot hardware, yet transferring these skills to robots remains challenging due to the embodiment gap between human and robot in both visual appearance and kinematics. We present HumanEgo, a framework that bridges the embodiment gap by lifting each human demonstration to an entity-level representation of hand-object interaction, and training a flow matching policy with dense auxiliary objectives that amplify supervision from every trajectory. HumanEgo is robot-data-free, hardware-agnostic, data-efficient, and zero-shot human-to-robot transferable. With only 30 minutes of human videos per task, HumanEgo achieves 92.5% average success across four real-world tasks (75% with just 15 minutes), outperforms matched-time robot teleoperation by 41%, and robustly transfers zero-shot across novel robots, cameras, and environments. We release HumanEgo as an easy-to-use, open-source framework for learning robot policies directly from human data: https://github.com/TX-Leo/HumanEgo

</details>


### [567] [Trust, Geometry, and Rules: A Credibility-Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework for Safe USV Navigation under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26974)
*Yuhang Zhang,Shuqi Chai,Yukang Zhang,Liusha Yang,Mingchuan Zhang,Wei Wang,Qingjiang Shi,Quanbo Ge*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对USV自主导航中感知不确定性导致RL方法失效的问题，提出融合可信度加权值学习、协方差膨胀速度障碍几何盾和风险感知COLREGs责任嵌入的框架，在动态海事环境中提升了训练鲁棒性、避碰能力和规则合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL方法在USV自主导航中因状态估计误差导致不可靠的信念状态误导值函数，同时离散交通规则导致学习目标不连续，难以实现安全且合规的自主导航。

Method: 1) 可信度加权值学习(CW-VL)：利用滤波估计协方差与经验误差统计之间的差异推导动态信任因子，调节评论家的异方差损失，防止策略过拟合噪声样本；2) 协方差膨胀速度障碍(CI-VO)：将位置估计不确定性映射为集合角度裕度，形成保守几何盾覆盖危险探索动作；3) 风险感知COLREGs责任嵌入：将二元会遇责任松弛为连续规则感知信号，提供平滑扇区转换信息，抑制稀疏规则奖励导致的振荡。

Result: 模拟会遇实验表明，该方法在感知不一致条件下具有更好的训练鲁棒性，并在避碰性能和COLREGs合规性上优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 所提框架通过显式建模感知不确定性并设计连续规则嵌入，有效解决了RL在USV自主导航中对状态估计误差敏感和离散规则导致学习不连续的关键问题。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation of Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) that is safe and compliant with the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs) remains a formidable challenge in dynamic maritime environments, particularly when perception systems exhibit miscalibrated uncertainty. Existing Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based methods often falter because state-estimation errors induce unreliable belief states that mislead the value function, while discrete traffic rules introduce discontinuity in the learning objective. To address these challenges, we propose a framework integrating credibility-aware learning, geometric safety shielding, and continuous rule-aware embedding. First, Credibility-Weighted Value Learning (CW-VL) introduces a dynamic trust factor derived from the discrepancy between filter-estimated covariance and empirical error statistics to modulate the critic's heteroscedastic loss, preventing policy overfitting to noisy samples. Second, the Covariance-Inflated Velocity Obstacle (CI-VO) maps position-estimation uncertainty into set-wise angular margins, forming a conservative geometric shield that overrides hazardous exploratory actions. Third, Risk-Aware COLREGs Duty Embedding relaxes binary encounter duties into continuous rule-aware signals, providing smooth sector-transition information and suppressing oscillation from sparse rule rewards. Simulated encounter studies demonstrate improved training robustness against perceptual inconsistency and superior collision avoidance and COLREGs compliance over baselines.

</details>


### [568] [Safety-Critical Adaptive Impedance Control via Nonsmooth Control Barrier Functions under State and Input Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28367)
*Faisal Lawan,Xiaoran Han,Joaquin Carrasco,Barry Lennox,Xiaoxiao Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种在线自适应阻抗控制框架，结合基于二次规划的安全滤波器与新型组合位置-速度非光滑控制屏障函数（NCBF），在不确定动力学环境下实现机械臂关节状态安全与柔顺交互。采用区间二型模糊逻辑系统补偿未知动力学，通过软约束与精确罚函数恢复处理执行器力矩限幅，并利用扰动观测器增强鲁棒性。复合李雅普诺夫分析证明了安全集前向不变性与阻抗跟踪误差一致最终有界性。7自由度机械臂仿真验证了安全约束满足与鲁棒阻抗跟踪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人与机器人交互及接触密集型任务中，不确定性、外力及执行器限制会同时损害机械臂操作的安全性与性能，现有方法难以统一处理关节位置/速度约束、未知动力学补偿与执行器饱和等问题。

Method: 1. 基于二次规划的安全滤波器结合组合位置-速度非光滑控制屏障函数（NCBF），将关节位置和速度约束统一为相对度为一的屏障函数；2. 区间二型模糊逻辑系统在线补偿未知动力学；3. 通过软约束与精确罚函数恢复机制处理执行器力矩限幅；4. 扰动观测器增强安全机制以抑制建模误差与外部交互力干扰。

Result: 在7自由度机械臂上，面对严重参数不确定性与外部交互力/力矩的仿真中，所提方法成功满足了关节位置与速度安全约束，并实现了鲁棒的阻抗跟踪性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的自适应阻抗控制框架通过NCBF与模糊学习、扰动观测器的协同设计，在理论上保证了安全性（安全集前向不变性）与稳定性（阻抗跟踪误差一致最终有界），为接触密集场景下的机器人安全交互提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Safe physical interaction is critical for deploying robotic manipulators in human-robot interaction and contact-rich tasks, where uncertainty, external forces, and actuator limitations can compromise both performance and safety. We propose an online adaptive impedance control framework that enforces joint-state safety while achieving compliant interaction under uncertain dynamics. The approach combines a quadratic-program-based safety filter with a novel composed position-velocity non-smooth control barrier function (NCBF), enabling joint position and velocity constraints to be enforced through a unified relative-degree-one barrier. Unknown dynamics are compensated online using an interval type-2 fuzzy logic system, while actuator torque limits are handled through soft constraints with exact penalty recovery of feasible solutions. A disturbance-observer-enhanced safety mechanism improves robustness against modelling errors and external interaction forces. Using composite Lyapunov analysis, we prove forward invariance of the safe set and the uniform ultimately boundedness of the impedance-tracking error. Simulations on a 7-DOF manipulator with severe parametric uncertainty and external interaction wrenches demonstrate safe constraint satisfaction and robust impedance tracking.

</details>


### [569] [Multi-Resolution End-to-End Deep Neural Network for Optimizing Latency-Accuracy Tradeoff in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29138)
*Qitao Weng,Heechul Yun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多分辨率端到端CNN，通过运行时选择输入分辨率和分辨率重定向技术，在延迟预算下优化自动驾驶安全指标，相比固定分辨率基线在车道侵入、闯红灯和碰撞等安全指标上取得一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在自动驾驶等实时系统中，DNN的延迟-精度权衡至关重要。现有单固定分辨率模型在场景上下文和计算资源变化时变得次优，需要一种能动态调整输入分辨率以适应变化条件的方案。

Method: 提出多分辨率端到端CNN架构，支持：(1) 通过逐分辨率批归一化实现运行时输入分辨率选择；(2) 分辨率重定向技术，可在不访问原始训练数据集的情况下进行多分辨率训练。在CARLA城市驾驶挑战中使用单目摄像头输入。

Result: 在CARLA仿真中评估，相比固定分辨率基线，该方法在每路线安全指标（车道侵入、闯红灯、碰撞）上取得一致改进。

Conclusion: 考虑延迟时，最优网络配置随场景上下文和计算资源动态变化；多分辨率方法能有效探索延迟-安全前沿面，提升自动驾驶系统的整体安全性。

Abstract: Latency-accuracy tradeoffs are fundamental in real-time applications of deep neural networks (DNNs) for cyber-physical systems. In autonomous driving, in particular, safety depends on both prediction quality and the end-to-end delay from sensing to actuation. We observe that (1) when latency is accounted for, the latency-optimal network configuration varies with scene context and compute availability; and (2) a single fixed-resolution model becomes suboptimal as conditions change.
  We present a multi-resolution, end-to-end deep neural network for the CARLA urban driving challenge using monocular camera input. Our approach employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) that supports multiple input resolutions through per-resolution batch normalization, enabling runtime selection of an ideal input scale under a latency budget, as well as resolution retargeting, which allows multi-resolution training without access to the original training dataset.
  We implement and evaluate our multi-resolution end-to-end CNN in CARLA to explore the latency-safety frontier. Results show consistent improvements in per-route safety metrics - lane invasions, red-light infractions, and collisions - relative to fixed-resolution baselines.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [570] [Generalizing a Highly Configurable Analytics Pipeline to Replicate and Support Educational Research Across Multiple Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30303)
*Yallen Bai,Ploy Thajchayapong,Ashok Goel*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了A4L（AI增强学习架构）数据分析管道，这是一种模块化数据基础设施，用于收集、整合和分析来自教育AI助手的异构学习交互数据。通过三个不同领域案例的评估，证明该管道能够跨领域复用统计分析能力，并支持分析功能的可扩展迁移，为未来教育AI系统的数据分析和教学设计提供可重用基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线学习环境中部署的AI助手产生了海量异构学习交互数据，但缺乏统一的数据架构来有效收集、整合和分析这些数据，以生成可改善学生学习成果的教学洞察。现有方法难以在不同领域和系统间复用分析能力，需要一种可扩展的基础设施来支持个性化学习和教与学的双向反馈闭环。

Method: 采用模块化数据架构设计，构建A4L数据分析管道，支持异构数据集的摄取、处理和分析。通过三个来自佐治亚理工学院在线学习环境的教育AI助手的案例研究，评估管道在跨领域复用统计分析方法和分析功能可扩展性方面的表现。

Result: 一组通用的统计分析方法能够在不同结构和教学背景的数据集上一致应用，成功复现跨领域的关键分析发现。最初为一个领域开发的分析能力可以扩展到支持其他领域的更丰富分析，证明了管道的可扩展性。

Conclusion: A4L分析管道可作为未来教育AI助手产生数据进行分析的可复用基础设施，通过系统化扩展到新领域，为教育AI系统的设计和评估提供洞察基础。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence assistants deployed in online learning environments create new opportunities to collect large volumes of learner interaction data and generate insights to improve student outcomes. Architecture for AI-Augmented Learning (A4L) is a modular data architecture that enables the collection, integration, and analysis of learner interaction data from educational AI systems, supporting the generation of instructional insights that facilitate personalized learning and reinforce the bidirectional feedback loop between instructors and learners. This study examines the modular design of the A4L Data Analytics Pipeline, an extensible data infrastructure that enables the ingestion, processing, and analysis of heterogeneous datasets generated by educational AI assistants. We describe the design principles and development process used to extend the pipeline's analytical capabilities while preserving flexibility across domains. We evaluate the pipeline through case studies spanning three research domains corresponding to three educational AI assistants deployed in online learning environments at Georgia Tech. Results show that a common set of statistical analysis methods can be consistently applied across datasets with differing structures and instructional contexts, enabling the pipeline to reproduce key analytical findings across domains. We demonstrate how analytical capabilities initially developed for one domain can be extended to support richer analyses in another, illustrating the pipeline's extensibility. These findings suggest that the A4L Analytics Pipeline can serve as reusable infrastructure for analyzing data generated by future educational AI assistants. By enabling analytics that can be systematically extended to new domains, the pipeline provides a foundation for deriving insights that inform the design and evaluation of educational AI systems.

</details>


### [571] [Agent4Edu: Generating Learner Response Data by Generative Agents for Intelligent Education Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.10332)
*Weibo Gao,Qi Liu,Linan Yue,Fangzhou Yao,Rui Lv,Zheng Zhang,Hao Wang,Zhenya Huang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: Agent4Edu是一个利用大语言模型驱动的个性化学习模拟器，通过构建具有学习者档案、记忆和动作模块的生成式智能体，来弥合个性化学习系统中离线指标与在线性能之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化学习系统中离线指标与在线性能之间存在显著差距，严重阻碍了智能教育系统的进展。

Method: 提出Agent4Edu框架，利用大语言模型构建生成式智能体，包含学习者档案模块（基于真实响应数据初始化）、记忆模块（记录练习事实与高级摘要，融合反思机制）和动作模块（支持习题理解、分析与响应生成），智能体可与计算机化自适应测试等个性化学习算法交互。

Result: 通过全面评估，探索了Agent4Edu的优势与不足，重点分析了智能体与人类学习者在响应上的一致性与差异。

Conclusion: Agent4Edu为个性化学习算法的多方位评估与优化提供了一种有效模拟平台，有助于缩小离线与在线性能之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Personalized learning represents a promising educational strategy within intelligent educational systems, aiming to enhance learners' practice efficiency. However, the discrepancy between offline metrics and online performance significantly impedes their progress. To address this challenge, we introduce Agent4Edu, a novel personalized learning simulator leveraging recent advancements in human intelligence through large language models (LLMs). Agent4Edu features LLM-powered generative agents equipped with learner profile, memory, and action modules tailored to personalized learning algorithms. The learner profiles are initialized using real-world response data, capturing practice styles and cognitive factors. Inspired by human psychology theory, the memory module records practice facts and high-level summaries, integrating reflection mechanisms. The action module supports various behaviors, including exercise understanding, analysis, and response generation. Each agent can interact with personalized learning algorithms, such as computerized adaptive testing, enabling a multifaceted evaluation and enhancement of customized services. Through a comprehensive assessment, we explore the strengths and weaknesses of Agent4Edu, emphasizing the consistency and discrepancies in responses between agents and human learners. The code, data, and appendix are publicly available at https://github.com/bigdata-ustc/Agent4Edu.

</details>


### [572] [Multi-Level Barriers to Generative AI Adoption Across Disciplines and Professional Roles in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27052)
*Jianhua Yang,Kerem Öge,Adrian von Mühlenen,Abdullah Bilal Akbulut,Tanya Suzanne Carey,Chidi Okorro*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过对英国罗素集团大学272名学术和专业人员调查，运用多项逻辑回归、结构方程模型和语义聚类分析，发现非STEM学科人员主要面临伦理文化障碍（学术诚信），而STEM学科和专业人员则更多遭遇制度、治理和基础设施约束，表明GenAI采纳障碍是结构性产生的，而非仅由个体因素决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献多将GenAI采纳障碍归因于个体层面因素（如感知有用性和易用性），但不同学科和机构角色之间的结构性和系统性障碍尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 对272名学术和专业人员（来自罗素集团大学）进行多方法调查分析，综合运用多项逻辑回归（MLR）、结构方程模型（SEM）和开放式回答的语义聚类分析，从多层面解释GenAI采纳障碍。

Result: 非STEM学科人员主要报告与学术诚信相关的伦理和文化障碍；STEM学科和专业服务人员则更多地强调制度、治理和基础设施方面的约束。障碍类型呈现系统性、结构性差异。

Conclusion: GenAI采纳障碍深嵌于组织生态系统和学科认识论规范中，大学应超越通用型培训，开发针对具体角色和学科的治理与支持框架。

Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly reshaping higher education, yet barriers to its adoption across different disciplines and institutional roles remain underexplored. Existing literature frequently attributes adoption barriers to individual-level factors such as perceived usefulness and ease of use. This study instead investigates whether such barriers are structurally produced. Drawing on a multi-method survey analysis of 272 academic and professional services (PSs) staff at a Russell Group university, we examine how disciplinary contexts and institutional roles shape perceived barriers. By integrating multinomial logistic regression (MLR), structural equation modelling (SEM), and semantic clustering of open-ended responses, we move beyond descriptive accounts to provide a multi-level explanation of GenAI adoption. Our findings reveal clear, systematic differences: non-STEM academics primarily report ethical and cultural barriers related to academic integrity, whereas STEM and PSs staff disproportionately emphasize institutional, governance, and infrastructure constraints. We conclude that GenAI adoption barriers are deeply embedded in organizational ecosystems and epistemic norms, suggesting that universities must move beyond generalized training to develop role-specific governance and support frameworks.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [573] [Subcortical Shape Variations and Their Associations with Cognition Across the 8th Decade of Life. A Study in the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29703)
*Maria del C. Valdes-Hernandez,Wonjung Park,Joanna Moodie,Susana Muñoz Maniega,Janie Corley,Fraser N. Sneden,Mark E. Bastin,Joanna M. Wardlaw,Simon R. Cox,Jinah Park*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究利用Lothian出生队列1936年的纵向数据，探索了社区老年人在80多岁期间皮层下脑结构的形态变化及其与认知老化的关联。研究发现皮层下结构形态变化具有异质性，海马和腹侧间脑存在左右不对称的形态变形，而丘脑和苍白球则呈现更均匀的体积收缩。一般认知能力的变化主要与不同时间点之间的顶点向内和向外位移相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正常个体的脑形态变化可能捕捉到全脑体积测量无法完全揭示的、与功能相关的大脑老化特征。尽管皮层下脑结构在认知中起重要作用，但其形态变化轨迹与认知老化的关联尚未被充分记录。

Method: 使用来自Lothian出生队列1936年的大样本纵向研究数据（包括神经影像、人口统计学和认知数据），采用ANCOVA和混合线性模型分析，探索社区老年人80多岁期间皮层下脑结构的形状变化及其与认知老化的关联。

Result: 皮层下结构形态变化具有异质性，不同结构呈现不同的萎缩模式。海马和腹侧间脑从基线点开始经历左右不对称的形态变形，而丘脑和苍白球则呈现更均匀、近乎对称的体积收缩。一般认知能力的变化主要与不同时间点之间的顶点向内和向外位移相关。

Conclusion: 皮层下脑结构的形态变化模式多样，且其形态变化与认知老化存在显著关联，表明对皮层下结构进行形态学分析可提供比单纯体积测量更丰富的脑老化信息。

Abstract: The study of brain morphology changes in normal individuals may capture aspects of functionally-relevant brain aging not fully indicated by gross volumetry. Despite the important role of subcortical brain structures in cognition, the associations between their morphological trajectories and cognitive changes in aging have not been documented. We use neuroimaging, demographic, and cognitive data from a large longitudinal study of cognitive aging, the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936, to explore shape changes in subcortical brain structures of community-dwelling individuals across their 8th decade of life. We investigate the association of these changes with cognitive aging using ANCOVA and mixed linear model analyses. Subcortical shape changes were heterogeneous, with varied atrophy patterns across whole period. The hippocampus and the ventral DC experienced varied morphological deformations (from its baseline point) different in left and right hemispheres, while the thalami and globus pallidi shapes, for example, experienced a more uniform volume contraction, nearly symmetrical throughout different timelines. Changes in general cognition were mainly associated with inwards and outwards vertex displacements between the time-points.

</details>


### [574] [A Deep Learning Model of Mental Rotation Informed by Interactive VR Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13517)
*Raymond Khazoum,Daniela Fernandes,Aleksandr Krylov,Qin Li,Stephane Deny*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个结合深度等变学习和神经符号计算的机械模型，通过三个组件（等变神经编码器、神经符号对象编码器和神经决策智能体）模拟人类心理旋转能力，在VR实验和已有文献数据中准确复现了人类的行为表现、反应时间和策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理旋转是人类空间推理和心智模拟的核心能力，现有深度神经网络模型尚缺乏能够完整解释人类心理旋转行为机制的机械模型，作者希望构建一个在认知上可解释的计算模型来模拟这一过程。

Method: 模型由三个堆叠组件构成：(1)等变神经编码器，从图像中生成物体的3D空间表征；(2)神经符号对象编码器，从空间表征中提取符号化的对象描述；(3)神经决策智能体，通过循环路径在3D潜空间中进行旋转模拟，比较符号描述并输出决策。模型设计基于已有心理旋转实验文献，并通过VR实验补充数据。

Result: 模型在人类参与者的实验数据（包括作者自己进行的VR实验和已有文献数据）中准确捕捉了行为表现、反应时间和策略；消融实验验证了每个组件的必要性。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了深度等变学习与符号化表征相结合在建模人类心理旋转中的有效性，为深度神经网络模型在人类空间推理领域的应用提供了新的范例，进一步证明整合深度、等变和符号表征对于建模人类心智的潜力。

Abstract: Mental rotation -- the ability to compare objects seen from different viewpoints -- is a fundamental example of mental simulation and spatial world modeling in humans. Here we propose a mechanistic model of human mental rotation, leveraging recent advances in deep, equivariant, and neuro-symbolic learning.
